Regulates body size and organ size by altering cell number and cell size in a cell-autonomous manner. Involved in the development of the embryonic nervous system, and is necessary for axon guidance and targeting in the visual system. Also plays a role in life-span determination. (UniProtKB:P09208)

Name: Brr2 U5 snRNP complex subunit
Description: Catalyzes the ATP-dependent unwinding of U4/U6 RNA duplices, an essential step in the assembly of a catalytically active spliceosome (By similarity). Plays a role in pre-mRNA splicing (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VUV9)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal dorsal trunk; gut section; and labral segment. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including bone disease (multiple); brain edema; eye disease (multiple); leukostasis; and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. Orthologous to human SERPINF1 (serpin family F member 1).

Name: drop out
Description: drop out (dop) encodes a microtubule-associated Ser/Thr (MAST) protein kinase. Among its potential substrates is the microtubule motor Dynein. The product of dop is required for membrane growth and polarity during cell formation in the early cleavage stage embryo.

Name: X11Lbeta
Description: Involved in protein localization to membrane. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm; dendritic spine; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in embryonic/larval brain; embryonic/larval central nervous system; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to several human genes including APBA1 (amyloid beta precursor protein binding family A member 1) and APBA2 (amyloid beta precursor protein binding family A member 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transcription corepressor activity. Involved in wing disc dorsal/ventral pattern formation. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Shukla-Vernon syndrome; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); and syndromic microphthalmia (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including BCORL1 (BCL6 corepressor like 1).

Name: paralytic
Description: paralytic (para) is an essential gene required for locomotor activity. It encodes an alpha-subunit of voltage-gated sodium channels. It is required for generation of sodium-dependent action potentials.

Name: DNA polymerase zeta subunit 1
Description: DNA polymerase zeta subunit 1 (PolZ1) encodes a DNA polymerase zeta catalytic subunit. It acts as a translesion polymerase during the bypass of DNA damage and has roles in DNA double-strand break and interstrand crosslink repair.

Name: TBP-associated factor 1
Description: TBP-associated factor 1 (Taf1) encodes a component of the evolutionarily conserved general transcription factor TFIID. It regulates transcription by binding the initiator element at transcription start sites and binding acetylated histones via its bromodomains.

Name: Myosin 28B1
Description: Myosin 28B1 (Myo28B1) encodes a high duty ratio motor protein belonging to the MyTH4-FERM subgroup of actin-based molecular motors.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human ANKRD50 (ankyrin repeat domain containing 50).

Name: female sterile (1) Nasrat
Description: female sterile (1) Nasrat (fs(1)N) encodes encodes a protein that is required, along with the products of fs(1)M3 and clos, for their accumulation at the vitelline membrane and function in vitelline membrane integrity and Torso receptor activation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable glutamate synthase (NADH) activity. Predicted to be involved in ammonia assimilation cycle and glutamate biosynthetic process. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region.

Name: N/A
Description: Component of the nuclear pore complex (PubMed:28366641, PubMed:29773558). Binds to transcriptionally active chromatin including regulatory regions (PubMed:28366641, PubMed:31784359). (UniProtKB:Q9VWE6)

Name: Helicase with zinc finger
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in RNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing. Predicted to be active in P granule and cytosol. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human HELZ (helicase with zinc finger).

Name: Dorado
Description: Substrate recognition component of a SCF-like E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex that promotes target-directed microRNA degradation (TDMD), a process that mediates degradation of microRNAs (miRNAs) (PubMed:33184237). The SCF-like E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex acts by catalyzing ubiquitination and subsequent degradation of AGO1, thereby exposing miRNAs for degradation (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VWN9)

Name: Enhancer of Polycomb
Description: Enhancer of Polycomb (E(Pc)) encodes a chromatin protein that functions as a suppressor of position-effect variegation. An unusual member of the Polycomb group; it does not exhibit homeotic transformations on its own, but rather enhances mutations in other Polycomb group genes. It forms part of the TIP60 histone acetyltransferase complex, which has been involved in many processes, including both transcriptional activation and repression.

Name: lethal (2) k09022
Description: Involved in nucleolar processing of pre-18S ribosomal RNA. Involved in ribosome biosynthesis (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VM75)

Name: Nucleoporin 205kD
Description: Plays a role in the nuclear pore complex (NPC) assembly and maintenance, but with limited role in NPC permeability. Required for specific nuclear import pathways such as Mad import. (UniProtKB:Q8IQV9)

Name: rough deal
Description: rough deal (rod) encodes the major subunit of the Rod-Zw10-Zwilch (RZZ) complex. RZZ is an essential component of the outer kinetochore during mitosis. RZZ helps monitor and correct kinetochore-microtubule attachments during prometaphase, and consequently it regulates mitotic progression.

Name: Down syndrome cell adhesion molecule 3
Description: Down syndrome cell adhesion molecule 3 (Dscam3) encodes a large transmembrane protein that functions in homophilic cell adhesion. It may also function as an axon guidance receptor.

Name: Rab3 GDP-GTP exchange factor
Description: Rab3 GDP-GTP exchange factor (Rab3-GEF) encodes a guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF) for the small GTPase encoded by Rab3. They control synaptic development and function, including the regulation of active zone protein composition at the neuromuscular junction.

Name: Myosin 81F
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity. Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Predicted to be part of myosin complex.

Name: xmas
Description: xmas (xmas) encodes encodes a hydrophilic protein that is involved in spermatogenesis, oogenesis and embryogenesis.

Name: Nipped-B
Description: Nipped-B (Nipped-B) encodes a protein that interacts with the product of Mau2 to form the kollerin complex, which topologically loads the cohesin ring complex onto chromosomes. The product of Nipped-B and cohesin participate in transcriptional regulation and DNA repair.

Name: Down syndrome cell adhesion molecule 2
Description: Down syndrome cell adhesion molecule 2 (Dscam2) encodes a transmembrane protein. Its alternative splicing produces two biochemically distinct homophilic binding proteins expressed in different cells. It can mediate both repulsion and adhesion between neurons and contributes to boundary formation, neurite targeting and synapse formation in the brain.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4G2
Description: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4G2 (eIF4G2) encodes an eIF4G homolog involved in regulation of translation initiation within male germ cells.  It is required for spermatogenesis.

Name: still life
Description: still life (sif) encodes a guanine nucleotide exchange factor for Rho family GTPases. It is specifically localized to presynaptic terminals in both the central nervous system and neuromuscular junctions (NMJs), and regulates synaptic growth at NMJs.

Name: Sin3A
Description: Sin3A (Sin3A) encodes a chromatin regulator with roles during muscle development, cell migration and Wnt signalling regulation.

Name: Zizimin-related
Description: Zizimin-related (Zir) encodes a Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor involved in the cellular immune response.

Name: miles to go
Description: Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult brain; adult head; adult mushroom body; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to several human genes including FNDC3B (fibronectin type III domain containing 3B).

Name: DNA polymerase theta
Description: DNA polymerase theta (PolQ) encodes DNA polymerase theta, a dual-domain protein with helicase-like and translesion polymerase domains. It contributes to repair/tolerance of DNA interstrand crosslinks and alternative-end joining repair of DNA double-strand breaks.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in maturation of 5.8S rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Orthologous to human URB1 (URB1 ribosome biogenesis homolog).

Name: zipper
Description: zipper (zip) encodes a microtubule-binding protein involved in cytoskeleton-dependent intracellular transport. Its knockout or knockdown does not affect overall oocyte growth during mid-oogenesis, but the oocyte marker orb appears to be less evenly localized in zip loss-of-function mutant egg chambers.

Name: Integrator 1
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). Involved in the 3'-end processing of the U7 snRNA, and also the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424, PubMed:23288851). Required for the normal expression of the Integrator complex component IntS12 (PubMed:23288851). May mediate recruitment of cytoplasmic dynein to the nuclear envelope, probably as component of the INT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9W1C5)

Name: Plexin B
Description: Plexin B (PlexB) encodes a transmembrane receptor for ligands including semaphorins, which signals via RhoGTPases. It can signal both attractive and repulsive axon guidance.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of ARF protein signal transduction. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human ARFGEF3 (ARFGEF family member 3).

Name: canoe
Description: canoe (cno) encodes a scaffold protein in adherens junctions that is involved in morphogenesis in a variety of tissues.

Name: Rootletin
Description: Rootletin (Root) encodes the major structural component of the ciliary rootlet. It is expressed in sensory neurons and is required for ciliary-transmitted sensory functions including hearing, touch and taste.

Name: taiman
Description: taiman (tai) encodes an ecdysone receptor co-activator related to mammalian steroid receptor coactivator (SRC) proteins. It contributes to border cell migration.

Name: Calmodulin-binding transcription activator
Description: Calmodulin-binding transcription activator (Camta) encodes a Ca[2+]-responsive transcription factor that either binds directly to DNA sequences containing a CGCG core motif or functions as a coactivator of NKX2 transcription factors. It mediates various physiological functions, including the regulation of visual signal transduction, memory formation and cell survival.

Name: mini spindles
Description: Binds to the plus end of microtubules and regulates microtubule dynamics and microtubule organization. Promotes cytoplasmic microtubule nucleation and elongation. May act as a microtubule antipause factor that rapidly catalyzes the transition from pause to either growth or shrinkage. Involved in mitotic spindle elongation. Involved in the establishment of cell polarity and mitotic spindle orientation in neuroblasts. Required for maintaining the bipolarity of acentrosomal meiotic spindles; the function is dependent on tacc and involves ncd. Involved in oocyte microtubule cytoskeleton organization and bicoid mRNA localization. Seems to be involved in elongation of kinetochore-derived microtubule fibers. (UniProtKB:Q9VEZ3)

Name: female sterile (1) homeotic
Description: female sterile (1) homeotic (fs(1)h) encodes a Bromodomain and Extra-Terminal domain (BET) family of protein, characterized by the presence of two tandem bromodomains and an extra-terminal (ET) domain. BET proteins can bind acetylated lysine residues in histones and regulate transcription. The proteins encoded by fs(1)h and human BRD2 possess protein kinase activity.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG14200 (FBgn0031023). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:19495505..19518402. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of low expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-18 hour embryonic stages, during early pupal stages, in stages of adults of both sexes.

Name: Down syndrome cell adhesion molecule 1
Description: N/A

Name: Transmembrane channel-like
Description: Transmembrane channel-like (Tmc) encodes a protein involved in proprioception and locomotory behavior in larvae.

Name: shattered
Description: shattered (shtd) encodes the largest subunit that forms the scaffold of the Anaphase Promoting Complex/Cyclosome (APC/C) E3 ubiquitin ligase. APC/C is active during mitosis and G1 phases of the cell cycle to mediates the degradation of cyclins and other key cell cycle regulators, which triggers the metaphase to anaphase transition and the exit from mitosis.

Name: Leukocyte-antigen-related-like
Description: Leukocyte-antigen-related-like (Lar) encodes a transmembrane receptor tyrosine phosphatase with a extracellular domain that binds to the product of Sdc. It regulates signaling through the product of Abl. While the product of Lar has many functions, it is best known for its roles in embryonic motor axon guidance and in target recognition by axons of R7 photoreceptors.

Name: Ephexin
Description: Ephexin (Exn) encodes a Eph-specific RhoGEF involved olfactory map formation.

Name: missing-in-metastasis
Description: missing-in-metastasis (mim) encodes a protein involved in guided cell migration via endocytosis inhibition of the product encoded by Cortactin.

Name: Transient receptor potential cation channel, subfamily M
Description: Calcium channel mediating constitutive calcium ion entry. (UniProtKB:A8DYE2)

Name: N/A
Description: Located in Z disc. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: stardust
Description: stardust (sdt) encodes membrane-associated guanylate kinase (MAGUK) protein involved in the maintenance of apico-basal cell polarity and the organization of zonula adherens.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and testis. Orthologous to human BTBD8 (BTB domain containing 8).

Name: protein partner of snf
Description: protein partner of snf (pps) encodes a protein that is part of the machinery required for sex-specific splicing of the Sxl and tra pre-mRNAs.

Name: Phosphatidic Acid Phospholipase A1
Description: Phosphatidic Acid Phospholipase A1 (PAPLA1) encodes a protein required for the endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi trafficking of a family of G-protein coupled receptors.

Name: LDL receptor related protein 4
Description: LDL receptor related protein 4 (Lrp4) encodes a type I transmembrane protein that is enriched in presynaptic terminals and regulates synaptic organization in the olfactory circuit.

Name: myoblast city
Description: myoblast city (mbc) encodes an unconventional bipartite GEF that, in combination with the product of Ced-12, activates the monomeric GTPase encoded by Rac1. It contributes to myoblast fusion, border cell migration and dorsal closure.

Name: Grunge
Description: Grunge (Gug) encodes a nuclear repressor protein that likely responds to Egfr signaling to control cell behavior for normal developmental patterning.

Name: enhancer of yellow 3
Description: enhancer of yellow 3 (e(y)3) encodes a nuclear protein required for embryogenesis and oogenesis. It participates in gene activation in euchromatin as a component of both the SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex and the TFIID transcription coactivator. It also contributes to gene silencing in pericentric heterochromatin and is also a coactivator in the JAK/STAT pathway.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transcription corepressor activity. Predicted to be involved in histone deacetylation; negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be part of histone deacetylase complex and transcription regulator complex. Orthologous to human MIDEAS (mitotic deacetylase associated SANT domain protein); TRERF1 (transcriptional regulating factor 1); and ZNF541 (zinc finger protein 541).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in sperm axoneme assembly. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 20. Orthologous to human CFAP44 (cilia and flagella associated protein 44).

Name: lipid droplet defective
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity and lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 1; autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 4A; and autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 4B. Orthologous to human ABCA12 (ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 12).

Name: Chitin deacetylase-like 5
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity and hydrolase activity, acting on carbon-nitrogen (but not peptide) bonds. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in larval foregut atrium; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and spermatozoon.

Name: plexus
Description: plexus (px) encodes a ubiquitously expressed nuclear matrix protein required to restrict excess wing vein development by repressing transcription of the pro-vein gene rho.

Name: SET domain binding factor
Description: Enables several functions, including chromatin binding activity; enzyme binding activity; and guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in several processes, including histone modification; positive regulation of autophagosome maturation; and regulation of Rab protein signal transduction. Located in several cellular components, including cell cortex; polytene chromosome; and recycling endosome. Part of histone acetyltransferase complex; histone methyltransferase complex; and transcription elongation factor complex. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4B2 and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4B3. Orthologous to human SBF1 (SET binding factor 1) and SBF2 (SET binding factor 2).

Name: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 10D
Description: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 10D (Ptp10D) encodes a transmembrane receptor tyrosine phosphatase closely related to the product of Ptp4E. Ptp4E-Ptp10D double mutants have lethal respiratory defects. Ptp10D-Ptp69D double mutants have a strong phenotype in which embryonic CNS axons abnormally cross the ventral midline. The product of Ptp10D regulates signaling through the receptor tyrosine kinases encoded by Egfr, btl and Pvr. It also binds to the product of sas to regulate its signaling in glia.

Name: yolkless
Description: Involved in uptake of vitellogenin by endocytosis. (UniProtKB:P98163)

Name: Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor at 64C
Description: Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor at 64C (RhoGEF64C) encodes a guanine nucleotide exchange factor with apical protein localization. In some ectodermal cells localization is controlled at the level of RNA.

Name: gartenzwerg
Description: gartenzwerg (garz) encodes a guanine nucleotide exchange factor localized to the cis-Golgi apparatus. The roles of the product of garz include membrane and protein trafficking between the Golgi apparatus and the endoplasmic reticulum. It is required for epithelial morphogenesis in the embryo.

Name: Mi-2
Description: Mi-2 (Mi-2) encodes a nuclear ATP-dependent nucleosome remodeler of the CHD family. It associates with active chromatin and utilizes the energy of ATP hydrolysis to move nucleosomes along DNA. It is required for repression of cell type-specific genes, full activation of heat shock genes and regulates higher order chromatin structure of polytene chromosomes.

Name: Cadherin 88C
Description: Cadherin 88C (Cad88C) encodes a member of the cadherin superfamily of transmembrane proteins, which mediate cell-cell adhesion and/or cell-cell communication.

Name: Centrosomal protein 290kDa
Description: Centrosomal protein 290kDa (Cep290) encodes a cytoplasmic protein located in the cilium transition zone, which assists in the compartmentalization of the cilium in sensory cilia, and the ciliary tip in sperm flagella. Its roles include coordinated movement behavior and sperm motility.

Name: anastral spindle 3
Description: anastral spindle 3 (ana3) encodes a centriole and basal body localized protein that is required for the proper function of these organelles.

Name: Cadherin 87A
Description: Cadherins are calcium-dependent cell adhesion proteins. They preferentially interact with themselves in a homophilic manner in connecting cells (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VGG5)

Name: Stac-like
Description: Involved in several processes, including calcium ion transmembrane transport; positive regulation of cell size; and positive regulation of voltage-gated calcium channel activity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Native American myopathy. Orthologous to human STAC (SH3 and cysteine rich domain); STAC2 (SH3 and cysteine rich domain 2); and STAC3 (SH3 and cysteine rich domain 3).

Name: Cyclic nucleotide-gated ion channel-like
Description: Predicted to enable intracellular cyclic nucleotide activated cation channel activity. Predicted to be involved in cation transport and cyclic-nucleotide-mediated signaling. Predicted to be part of intracellular cyclic nucleotide activated cation channel complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior-posterior subdivision of organism.

Name: molting defective
Description: molting defective (mld) encodes a nuclear zinc finger protein required for ecdysone biosynthesis.

Name: Myosin heavy chain
Description: Myosin heavy chain (Mhc) encodes the motor protein that provides the force for muscle contraction through its ATP-dependent interaction with actin filaments. It functions with essential and regulatory light chains.

Name: claret
Description: claret (ca) encodes a protein that is required for wild-type eye color. ca mutant flies show a wine-red eye color.

Name: Spc105-related
Description: Spc105-related (Spc105R) encodes an essential component of the kinetochore, to which it is recruited by binding to the Mis12 kinetochore complex. The products of Spc105R and Mis12 recruit the Ndc80 complex, which provides the major microtubule binding activity of the kinetochore.

Name: Nucleoporin 98-96kD
Description: Nucleoporin 98-96kD (Nup98-96) encodes a precursor protein that is cleaved into Nup98 and Nup96 proteins, two integral parts of the nuclear pore. In the male gonad, loss of Nup98-96 function results in premature differentiation of germ line cells at the expense of proliferation.

Name: hangover
Description: hangover (hang) encodes a nuclear zinc finger protein that is expressed in adult fly brain neurons. Lack of hang produces a reduction of Fas2 expression. Its roles include life span, bouton growth at the neuromuscular junction and regulation of cellular stress in response to ethanol, heat and paraquat.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of GTPase activity and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including RALGAPA2 (Ral GTPase activating protein catalytic subunit alpha 2).

Name: Kinesin heavy chain 73
Description: Kinesin heavy chain 73 (Khc-73) encodes a member of the Kinesin-3 family of microtubule-based transport motors. It facilitates endosomal transport during interphase and modulates cortical polarity during asymmetric neuroblast cell division.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in axonemal central apparatus assembly and cilium movement. Predicted to be active in axoneme.

Name: abnormal spindle
Description: Required to maintain the structure of the centrosomal microtubule organizing center (MTOC) during mitosis. May have a preferential role in regulating neurogenesis. Required for germ cell mitosis and oocyte differentiation. (UniProtKB:Q9VC45)

Name: Pcf11 cleavage and polyadenylation factor subunit
Description: Protein 1 of cleavage and polyadenylation factor 1 (Pcf11) encodes an RNA binding protein involved in RNA splicing regulation.

Name: WD repeat domain 81
Description: Used to study microcephaly. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cerebellar ataxia, mental retardation and dysequlibrium syndrome and hydrocephalus. Orthologous to human WDR81 (WD repeat domain 81).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable cell-cell adhesion mediator activity. Predicted to be involved in axon guidance; dendrite self-avoidance; and homophilic cell adhesion via plasma membrane adhesion molecules. Predicted to be active in axon and plasma membrane.

Name: Plexin A
Description: Plexin A (PlexA) encodes a transmembrane receptor for Semaphorin ligands encoded by Sema1a and Sema1b. The intracellular region of this receptor has GTPase activating protein (GAP) activity on Ras/Rap small GTPases. The signaling by the product of PlexA  alters actin, microtubules and cell adhesion in developmental processes such as axon guidance.

Name: Cadherin 86C
Description: Cadherin 86C (Cad86C) encodes a member of the cadherin superfamily of transmembrane proteins, which mediate cell-cell adhesion and/or cell-cell communication.

Name: viking
Description: viking (vkg) encodes a subunit of Collagen IV and a major component of basement membranes. It is secreted by haemocytes and fat body cells and is required for the normal morphogenesis of many tissues. It also contributes to TGF-beta signalling in the early embryo and the developing Malpighian tubules.

Name: rapamycin-insensitive companion of Tor
Description: rapamycin-insensitive companion of Tor (rictor) encodes an essential component of TOR complex 2 where it controls phosphorylation of protein kinases, such as those encoded by Akt and trc. The product of rictor contributes to the regulation of tissue growth, dendritic tiling, long term memory, tolerance to heat stress, and mitochondrial quality control.

Name: Down syndrome cell adhesion molecule 4
Description: Down syndrome cell adhesion molecule 4 (Dscam4) one of four Dscam paralogs in the D. melanogaster genome. It encodes a homophilic cell adhesion molecule that regulates interactions between dendrites and axons in the visual system.

Name: testis-specific gamma-tubulin ring protein 91
Description: Enables gamma-tubulin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in meiotic cell cycle; microtubule cytoskeleton organization; and mitotic cell cycle. Located in centriole and mitochondrial outer membrane.

Name: CENP-ana
Description: CENP-ana (cana) encodes a kinetochore kinesin that contributes to metaphase chromosome alignment.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in wing disc.

Name: lethal (3) persistent salivary gland 2
Description: Involved in ecdysone-mediated induction of salivary gland cell autophagic cell death and imaginal disc-derived leg morphogenesis. Is expressed in embryonic/larval salivary gland.

Name: Helicase 89B
Description: Helicase 89B (Hel89B) encodes a protein that belongs to the SNF2 family of chromatin regulators. Hel89B product binds to large number of sites on polytene chromosomes and positively regulates the expression of antimicrobial peptide genes.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval nervous system; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4G1
Description: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4G1 (eIF4G1) encodes a protein that contributes to translation and spermatogenesis.

Name: forked
Description: forked (f) encodes a protein involved in assembly of actin filament bundles.

Name: Discs large 5
Description: N/A

Name: javelin
Description: javelin (jv) encodes an actin associated protein with roles in actin organization during bristle growth.

Name: twenty-four
Description: twenty-four (tyf) encodes a protein that forms a complex together with the products of Atx2 and Lsm12. This complex binds per mRNA and activates its translation to sustain circadian rhythms. The tyf product is also involved in immune defense against Listeria monocytogenes infection.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in 5S class rRNA transcription by RNA polymerase III and transcription initiation at RNA polymerase III promoter. Predicted to be part of transcription factor TFIIIC complex. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human GTF3C1 (general transcription factor IIIC subunit 1).

Name: Autophagy-related 2
Description: Autophagy-related 2 (Atg2) encodes a protein known to be required for autophagy.

Name: Puratrophin-1-like
Description: Puratrophin-1-like (Pura) encodes a RhoGEF involved in leg morphogenesis, neuron morphogenesis, and locomotor rhythm regulation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of autophagy. Predicted to be located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human SOGA3 (SOGA family member 3); MTCL1 (microtubule crosslinking factor 1); and SOGA1 (suppressor of glucose, autophagy associated 1).

Name: rolling pebbles
Description: rolling pebbles (rols) encodes a protein required for myoblast fusion in founder cells. it interacts with the membrane spanning Immunoglobulin superfamily protein encoded by kirre and with the product of Mhcl.

Name: N/A
Description: Phosphorylates diacylglycerol (DAG) to generate phosphatidic acid (PA). (UniProtKB:A8JQ65)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG15040 (FBgn0030940). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:18606610..18617589. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Name: pebbled
Description: pebbled (peb) encodes a protein that acts as a tissue-specific transcriptional attenuator. It contributes to embryonic morphogenesis and development of ovary, retina and respiratory system.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG2861 (FBgn0029728). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. It has 9 annotated transcripts and 9 polypeptides (6 unique). Gene sequence location is X:4797231..4804862. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . 56 alleles are reported. The phenotypes of these alleles manifest in: synapse; neuron projection; flight muscle cell; egg; chaeta. The phenotypic classes of alleles include: increased size; abnormal locomotor behavior; abnormal stress response; phenotype. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable molecular adaptor activity. Predicted to be involved in ubiquitin-dependent ERAD pathway. Predicted to be part of proteasome complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human ECPAS (Ecm29 proteasome adaptor and scaffold).

Name: RNA polymerase II subunit A
Description: DNA-dependent RNA polymerase catalyzes the transcription of DNA into RNA using the four ribonucleoside triphosphates as substrates. Largest and catalytic component of RNA polymerase II which synthesizes mRNA precursors and many functional non-coding RNAs. Forms the polymerase active center together with the second largest subunit. Pol II is the central component of the basal RNA polymerase II transcription machinery. It is composed of mobile elements that move relative to each other. RPB1 is part of the core element with the central large cleft, the clamp element that moves to open and close the cleft and the jaws that are thought to grab the incoming DNA template. At the start of transcription, a single-stranded DNA template strand of the promoter is positioned within the central active site cleft of Pol II. A bridging helix emanates from RPB1 and crosses the cleft near the catalytic site and is thought to promote translocation of Pol II by acting as a ratchet that moves the RNA-DNA hybrid through the active site by switching from straight to bent conformations at each step of nucleotide addition. During transcription elongation, Pol II moves on the template as the transcript elongates. Elongation is influenced by the phosphorylation status of the C-terminal domain (CTD) of Pol II largest subunit (RPB1), which serves as a platform for assembly of factors that regulate transcription initiation, elongation, termination and mRNA processing (By similarity). (UniProtKB:P04052)

Name: ZAP3
Description: Enables protein phosphatase 1 binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of telomere maintenance. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; gonad; and nervous system. Orthologous to human YLPM1 (YLP motif containing 1).

Name: Nucleoporin 153kD
Description: Component of the nuclear pore complex (NPC), a complex required for the trafficking across the nuclear envelope (PubMed:17682050). Functions as a scaffolding element in the nuclear phase of the NPC (PubMed:17682050). Essential for the nuclear import of nuclear localization signal (NLS)-containing proteins in a Importin alpha/Importin beta receptor-dependent manner (PubMed:17682050). Required for nuclear import of Mad (PubMed:20547758). Plays a role in chromosomal organization and gene expression regulation; stimulates transcription by promoting the formation of an open chromatin environment (PubMed:20174442). Binds chromatin to nucleoporin-associated regions (NARs) that define transcriptionally active regions of the genome (PubMed:20174442). Associates with extended chromosomal regions that alternate between domains of high density binding with those of low occupancy (PubMed:20174442). Preferentially binds to NARs of the male X chromosome (PubMed:20174442). In males, together with Mtor, required for the localization of the male-specific lethal (MSL) histone acetyltransferase complex to the X chromosome and therefore for the transcription of dosage compensation genes (PubMed:16543150). May play a role in double strand break DNA repair (PubMed:26502056). (UniProtKB:Q9VXE6)

Name: Chromodomain-helicase-DNA-binding protein 1
Description: Chromodomain-helicase-DNA-binding protein 1 (Chd1) encodes an ATPase involved in the remodeling and assembly of chromatin. Its biological functions include regulation of gene transcription, incorporation of the histone variant H3.3 into paternal chromatin at fertilization and regulation of intestinal immunity and microbiota.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG2750 (FBgn0030376). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:12107200..12113357. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Name: slowpoke 2
Description: slowpoke 2 (SLO2) encodes a channel involved in potassium ion transmembrane transport.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable cell adhesion molecule binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell-cell adhesion. Predicted to be active in cell-cell junction and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal ectoderm; extended germ band embryo; gastrula embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and sensory nervous system primordium.

Name: telomere ends associated
Description: Protects telomeres from fusion. Likely to function as a component of the MTV complex along with moi and ver. The complex binds single-stranded DNA in a sequence-independent manner and can protect it from DNA degradation. (UniProtKB:E1JH25)

Name: Phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase 68D
Description: Phosphotidylinositol 3 kinase 68D (Pi3K68D) encodes a phosphatidylinositol kinase involved in the organization of the cortical actin cytoskeleton and the regulation of the Egfr signaling pathway.

Name: Glycoprotein 210 kDa
Description: Glycoprotein 210 kDa (Gp210) encodes a glycoprotein of the nuclear pore complex.

Name: Spt20
Description: Predicted to enable transcription coregulator activity. Predicted to be involved in histone acetylation and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of SAGA complex. Is expressed in chordotonal neurons. Orthologous to several human genes including SUPT20H (SPT20 homolog, SAGA complex component).

Name: Prosap
Description: Prosap (Prosap) encodes a member of SH3 and multiple ankyrin repeat domain (SHANK) family of genes that encode synaptic scaffolding proteins. It regulates synaptic growth and development, including the structure of the neuromuscular junction and synapses of the calyx, and olfactory acuity.

Name: stumble
Description: Required for locomotion and mechanical sensing in proprioceptive neurons by transducing dendrite stretching into cellular responses. Required for transduction of mechanical stimuli in a specific subpopulation of proprioceptive neurons that sense joint angles. Probably does not constitute the mechanically activated channel and may rather serve as an accessory module required for the proper localization or function of the transduction channels. (UniProtKB:Q9W2E1)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: Nucleoporin 188kDa
Description: Component of the nuclear pore complex (NPC), a complex required for the trafficking across the nuclear envelope. Required for proper protein transport into the nucleus. (UniProtKB:A0A0B4K859)

Name: Rho GTPase activating protein at 100F
Description: GTPase activator for the Rho-type GTPases by converting them to an inactive GDP-bound state. (UniProtKB:Q9V9S7)

Name: sticky
Description: sticky (sti) encodes a member of the AGC family of kinases that functions to regulate both actin-myosin-mediated cytokinesis and epigenetic gene silencing.

Name: qin
Description: qin (qin) is a piRNA pathway gene that encodes a protein involved in posttranscriptional gene silencing.

Name: virilizer
Description: Associated component of the WMM complex, a complex that mediates N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methylation of mRNAs, a modification that plays a role in the efficiency of mRNA splicing and is required for sex determination (PubMed:27919077). Required for sex determination and dosage compensation via Sxl alternative splicing: m6A methylation acts as a key regulator of Sxl pre-mRNA and promotes female-specific alternative splicing of Sxl, which determines female physiognomy (PubMed:11156988, PubMed:27919077). M6A methylation is also required for neuronal functions (PubMed:27919077). Required for proper inclusion of regulated exons in Ubx transcripts, leading to isoforms Ia/b and IIa/b (PubMed:10101174). (UniProtKB:Q9W1R5)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; adenylate cyclase-inhibiting G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; and cAMP biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lethal congenital contracture syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ADCY5 (adenylate cyclase 5).

Name: scribble
Description: scribble (scrib) encodes a scaffolding protein that is part of the conserved machinery regulating apicobasal polarity. It acts with the products of dlg1 and l(2)gl to distinguish the basolateral domain of epithelial cells and neuroblasts, via reciprocally antagonistic interactions with the aPKC/par-6 complex that impacts vesicle trafficking. The product of scrib also organizes synaptic architecture and is implicated in learning and memory.

Name: cacophony
Description: cacophony (cac) encodes the primary structural subunit of a voltage-gated calcium channel, which is located at presynaptic active zones. It functions in evoked neurotransmitter release at neuromuscular synapses. It contributes to male courtship behavior and a wide range of neurophysiological processes.

Name: grappa
Description: Histone methyltransferase. Methylates 'Lys-79' of histone H3. Required for Polycomb Group (PcG) and trithorax Group (trxG) maintenance of expression. Also involved in telomeric silencing but do not in centric heterochromatin. Probably participates in pairing sensitivity. (UniProtKB:Q8INR6)

Name: gigas
Description: gigas (gig) encodes a tumour suppressor protein that, together with with the product of Tsc1, controls cellular growth via antagonizing insulin and TOR signalling pathways.

Name: Neurexin 1
Description: Neurexin 1 (Nrx-1) encodes a transmembrane synaptic adhesive molecule that regulates the synaptic architecture and function in the brain and neuromuscular junction. It contributes to synaptic growth, transmission, synaptic formation and also regulation of learning and memory, locomotion and visual function.

Name: RIM-binding protein
Description: RIM-binding protein (Rbp) encodes an active zone protein involved in neuromuscular synaptic transmission and presynaptic active zone organization.

Name: Cd GTPase activating protein-related
Description: Cd GTPase activating protein-related (CdGAPr) encodes a protein that acts in concert with the product of Fak in the formation of the optic stalk, a tubular structure composed of glial cells.

Name: Lysine demethylase 5
Description: Lysine demethylase 5 (Kdm5) encodes a trimethyl H3K4 histone demethylase that regulates transcription through both demethylase-dependent and demethylase-independent mechanisms. It has roles in regulating cell growth, circadian rhythm, stress resistance, hematopoiesis and fertility.

Name: multi sex combs
Description: multi sex combs (mxc) encodes a Cylin E/Cdk2 substrate and molecular scaffold that is necessary for assembly of the histone locus body, which is a nuclear body associated with replication dependent histone gene clusters that contains factors necessary for the transcription and processing of histone mRNA.

Name: female sterile (1) M3
Description: female sterile (1) M3 (fs(1)M3) encodes a protein that is required, along with the products of fs(1)N and clos, for their accumulation at the vitelline membrane and function in vitelline membrane integrity and Torso receptor activation.

Name: closca
Description: closca (clos) encodes a protein that is required, together with the products of fs(1)N and fs(1)M3, for their accumulation at the vitelline membrane and function in vitelline membrane integrity and Torso receptor activation.

Name: myopic
Description: myopic (mop) encodes an endocytic protein that is required for normal Egfr signaling and for the progression of the product of Egfr through the endocytic pathway. It also controls the endosomal localization and signaling activity of the product of yki.

Name: veloren
Description: veloren (velo) encodes a SUMO protease that is required for dendrite and axon targeting of olfactory projection neurons.

Name: capicua
Description: capicua (cic) encodes an HMG-box family transcriptional repressor that serves as a general sensor of RTK signaling. cic-dependent gene silencing is alleviated by phosphorylation mediated by the product of rl, which causes the translocation of the product of cic from the nucleus to the cytoplasm. It governs gene expression in diverse processes including cell proliferation and specification.

Name: Spt6
Description: Transcription elongation factor which binds histone H3 and enhances transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II (RNAPII). Required for the transcriptional induction of heat shock response genes and for maximal recruitment of two other elongation factors, Spt5 and Paf1, to the induced Hsp70. Plays a critical role in normal fly development throughout the lifecycle. (UniProtKB:Q9W420)

Name: Ubr1 ubiquitin ligase
Description: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase which is a component of the N-end rule pathway. Recognizes and binds to proteins bearing specific N-terminal residues that are destabilizing according to the N-end rule, leading to their ubiquitination and subsequent degradation. (UniProtKB:Q9VX91)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in cytoskeleton. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human PLEKHH1 (pleckstrin homology, MyTH4 and FERM domain containing H1) and PLEKHH2 (pleckstrin homology, MyTH4 and FERM domain containing H2).

Name: Cadherin 74A
Description: Cadherin 74A (Cad74A) encodes a non-classical cadherin involved in cell-cell adhesion.

Name: encore
Description: encore (enc) encodes a protein involved in the regulation of germline mitoses. It promotes the upregulation of grk mRNA translation in the dorsal anterior corner of the oocyte, allowing normal dorso-ventral pattern formation.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including COVID-19; hepatitis B; hepatitis C; human immunodeficiency virus infectious disease; and primary immunodeficiency disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including IGFALS (insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit); NRROS (negative regulator of reactive oxygen species); and TLR3 (toll like receptor 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in several processes, including axo-dendritic transport; axon extension; and synaptic vesicle transport. Predicted to be active in several cellular components, including axon; dendrite; and synapse. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease axonal type 2X; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 5; and hereditary spastic paraplegia 11. Orthologous to human SPG11 (SPG11 vesicle trafficking associated, spatacsin).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity and lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gastric adenocarcinoma. Orthologous to human ABCA13 (ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 13).

Name: fab1 kinase
Description: fab1 kinase (fab1) encodes a phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate 5-kinase. It phosphorylates phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate lipid head groups on the cytosolic leaflet of endosomal compartments. The product of fab1 functions in late endosome-to lysosome trafficking, retrograde trafficking, and autophagy.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human PPP1R37 (protein phosphatase 1 regulatory subunit 37).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chromatin DNA binding activity and histone binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including SBNO1 (strawberry notch homolog 1).

Name: dilute class unconventional myosin
Description: dilute class unconventional myosin (didum) encodes a class V unconventional myosin that binds actin and hydrolyzes ATP. It functions in mRNA localization in the oocyte, spermatid individualization during spermatogenesis, transport of pigment granules in photoreceptors and mitochondrial transport in neuronal cells.

Name: Cadherin-N2
Description: Cadherins are calcium-dependent cell adhesion proteins. They preferentially interact with themselves in a homophilic manner in connecting cells (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VJB6)

Name: Mucin 68E
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be located in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in embryonic/larval proventriculus and organism.

Name: radish
Description: radish (rad) encodes a protein involved in anesthesia-resistant memory and heart contraction regulation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in cell surface receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including ADGRA2 (adhesion G protein-coupled receptor A2).

Name: Mucin related 2B
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Located in egg chorion. Is expressed in embryonic/larval gut; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and organism.

Name: sprint
Description: Potential Ras effector protein. May function as a guanine nucleotide exchange (GEF), by exchanging bound GDP for free GTP (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q8MQW8)

Name: GUK-holder
Description: GUK-holder (gukh) encodes a protein that regulates spindle orientation in neuroblasts via direct interaction with microtubules and the tumor suppressors encoded by dlg1 and scrib. It also plays a role in polarizing fate determinants, such as the product of mira.

Name: LanB1
Description: LanB1 (LanB1) encodes a subunit of laminin, a heterotrimeric protein found in the extracellular matrix (ECM) and a major component of the basal lamina. Laminins interact with a variety of cell surface molecules such as integrin receptors and other secreted ECM components. It contributes to ECM organization, tissue adhesion, cell motility and developmental patterning.

Name: Myocardin-related transcription factor
Description: Myocardin-related transcription factor (Mrtf) encodes a protein that binds to the product of bs, and likely other transcription factors, to enhance downstream gene activation. The activity of the product of Mrtf is regulated by free actin levels. It contributes to tracheal branching, border cell migration, and other cell stretching and invasive migration processes during development.

Name: hulk
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including adult fat body; adult heart; embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell; integumentary system; and spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic/larval dorsal vessel; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human FIZ1 (FLT3 interacting zinc finger 1); ZBTB44 (zinc finger and BTB domain containing 44); and ZNF618 (zinc finger protein 618).

Name: Neuralized E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 4
Description: Located in centrosome. Orthologous to human NEURL4 (neuralized E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 4).

Name: Collagen type IV alpha 1
Description: Collagen type IV alpha 1 (Col4a1) encodes a subunit of Collagen IV and a major component of basement membranes. It is required for muscle and epithelium integrity.

Name: DISCO Interacting Protein 2
Description: DISCO Interacting Protein 2 (DIP2) encodes a member of DIP2 family. It interacts physically with the product of disco in vitro and participates in axonal bifurcation and guidance downstream of the JNK pathway.

Name: heavyweight
Description: Predicted to enable phosphotyrosine residue binding activity. Orthologous to several human genes including SHB (SH2 domain containing adaptor protein B); SHE (Src homology 2 domain containing E); and SHF (Src homology 2 domain containing F).

Name: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 4E
Description: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 4E (Ptp4E) encodes a transmembrane receptor tyrosine phosphatase closely related to the product of Ptp10D. Ptp4E single mutants have no known phenotypes. However, Ptp4E-Ptp10D double mutants have lethal respiratory defects. The product of Ptp4E regulates signaling through the receptor tyrosine kinases encoded by Egfr, btl and Pvr.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: echinus
Description: echinus (ec) encodes a protein phosphatase 1 (PP1) binding protein involved in interommatidial cell sorting and cell death.

Name: no mechanoreceptor potential C
Description: no mechanoreceptor potential C (nompC) encodes a pore-forming subunit for a mechanosensitive non-selective cation channel. It belongs to the TRP channel family and is expressed in peripheral sensory neurons. It senses gentle touch and regulates locomotion in larval body wall neurons. In the adult, the product of nompC is involved in hearing transduction in the Johnston's organ.

Name: Macroglobulin complement-related
Description: Macroglobulin complement-related (Mcr) encodes a transmembrane protein of the conserved thioester-containing protein (TEP) superfamily including macroglobulins and complement proteins. It is a core component of septate junctions, which provide an essential paracellular barrier to epithelia.

Name: Outer segment 2
Description: Required for the maintenance and formation of cilia. (UniProtKB:Q9W040)

Name: Listerin E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1
Description: Listerin E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1 (Ltn1) encodes an enzyme involved in ribosome quality control for co-translational degradation of the 'nonstop' proteins. It associates with the 60S ribosome subunit and ubiquitylates the peptidyl-tRNA so the nascent peptide can be degraded by the proteasome.

Name: THADA
Description: THADA (THADA) encodes a metabolic regulator that controls the balance between fat storage and heat production. It physically interacts with the ER calcium pump encoded by SERCA and regulates its activity to control metabolism.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables protein phosphatase 1 binding activity.

Name: c11.1
Description: Located in Golgi apparatus and late endosome. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to several human genes including MROH1 (maestro heat like repeat family member 1).

Name: wings apart-like
Description: wings apart-like (wapl) encodes a protein that interacts with the product of pds5 to form the releasin complex that enables sister chromatid separation at mitosis by removing the cohesin ring complex from chromosomes. It also influences gene activation and silencing through interactions with cohesin.

Name: muscle wasted
Description: muscle wasted (mute) encodes a component of the histone locus body involved in muscle homeostasis.

Name: Thymine DNA glycosylase
Description: Enables G/U mismatch-specific uracil-DNA glycosylase activity and double-stranded DNA binding activity. Involved in mismatch repair. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell; embryonic/larval muscle system; and organism. Orthologous to human TDG (thymine DNA glycosylase).

Name: N/A
Description: CG32436 encodes a protein which contains five copies of a VTD-type deubiquitinase domain. It is most likely inactive, since crucial active site residues are missing.

Name: Zinc finger CCHC-type containing 7
Description: Predicted to enable nucleic acid binding activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to contribute to polynucleotide adenylyltransferase activity. Involved in defense response to virus. Predicted to be part of TRAMP complex. Orthologous to human ZCCHC7 (zinc finger CCHC-type containing 7).

Name: short spindle 3
Description: Located in spindle. Is expressed in adult head. Used to study Bardet-Biedl syndrome and azoospermia. Orthologous to human SCAPER (S-phase cyclin A associated protein in the ER).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in DNA-templated DNA replication and rRNA processing. Predicted to be part of Rix1 complex and nuclear pre-replicative complex. Orthologous to human NWD2 (NACHT and WD repeat domain containing 2).

Name: anastral spindle 1
Description: anastral spindle 1 (ana1) encodes a cytoplasmic protein located in the centrioles, including the sperm giant centriole and proximal centriole-like structure, which assists in centrioles formation. Its roles include coordinated movement behavior, sperm motility, and fertility.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in activation of GTPase activity. Orthologous to human RALGAPB (Ral GTPase activating protein non-catalytic subunit beta).

Name: ATPase 8B
Description: ATPase 8B (ATP8B) encodes a phospholipid flippase involved in olfaction.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity and lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pulmonary alveolar proteinosis. Orthologous to human ABCA3 (ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 3).

Name: Dicer-2
Description: Dicer-2 (Dcr-2) encodes a member of the RNase III family of double-stranded RNA-specific endonucleases. It acts in the RNAi pathway by cutting long dsRNA into siRNAs. It helps defend flies against viral infection, particularly RNA viruses. It also processes long, partially double-stranded endogenous transcripts (hairpin RNAs) into endo-siRNAs.

Name: Adenylyl cyclase 78C
Description: Adenylyl cyclase 78C (Ac78C) encodes a member of the adenyly cyclase family of proteins. It converts adenosine triphosphate (ATP) to 3',5'-cyclic AMP (cAMP) and pyrophosphate. In taste receptor neurons, Ac78C product is involved in the sugar taste transduction pathway.

Name: Alhambra
Description: Alhambra (Alh) encodes a zinc finger/leucine zipper nuclear protein. It is required in the nervous system for maintaining eve expression and normal growth. It is also involved in muscle development and male courtship behavior.

Name: formin 3
Description: formin 3 (form3) encodes a protein that belongs to the formin family, which functions in various actin-based processes. It is involved in tracheal fusion.

Name: TATA box binding protein-related factor 2
Description: TATA box binding protein-related factor 2 (Trf2) encodes a core promoter recognition factor that mediates gene transcription. It contributes to spiracle morphogenesis, pupal development and salivary gland cell death.

Name: Ubiquitin specific protease 32
Description: Deubiquitinating enzyme that acts as an inhibitor of mitophagy probably by counteracting the action of park. Possibly functions by hydrolyzing ubiquitin attached by park on target proteins, thereby reducing park's ability to drive mitophagy. (UniProtKB:M9PD06)

Name: Glutamyl-prolyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Catalyzes the attachment of the cognate amino acid to the corresponding tRNA in a two-step reaction: the amino acid is first activated by ATP to form a covalent intermediate with AMP and is then transferred to the acceptor end of the cognate tRNA. (UniProtKB:P28668)

Name: ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 3
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity and lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Used to study autism spectrum disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pulmonary alveolar proteinosis. Orthologous to human ABCA3 (ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 3).

Name: pericardin
Description: pericardin (prc) encodes a type IV collagen-like extracellular matrix protein involved in heart development.

Name: GTPase activating protein and VPS9 domains 1
Description: Acts both as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP) and a guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF), and participates in endocytosis. (UniProtKB:Q9VZ08)

Name: chiffon
Description: chiffon (chif) encodes a protein associated with the origin recognition complex that binds to chromosomal origins of replication and is required for the initiation of cellular DNA replication. It is involved in DNA replication, chorion production, muscle homeostasis, and axon guidance.

Name: Nucleoporin 214kD
Description: Part of the nuclear pore complex (PubMed:14638854). Serves as a docking site in the receptor-mediated import of substrates across the nuclear pore complex including emb, RanGAP and phosphorylated Mad (PubMed:17682050, PubMed:20547758, PubMed:17032737). Protects mbo/Nup88 from proteasomal degradation at the nuclear pore (PubMed:17032737). Together with mbo/Nup88, sequesters emb in the cytoplasm and thereby attenuates nuclear export signal (NES)-mediated nuclear export (PubMed:17032737). Together with mbo/Nup88, required for the nuclear import of the Rel family transcription factors dorsal (dl) and Dorsal-related immunity factor (Dif) and the activation of an immune response (PubMed:17032737). (UniProtKB:Q9W1X4)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 39. Orthologous to human ST18 (ST18 C2H2C-type zinc finger transcription factor); MYT1 (myelin transcription factor 1); and MYT1L (myelin transcription factor 1 like).

Name: Cadherin 99C
Description: Cadherin 99C (Cad99C) encodes a member of the cadherin superfamily of transmembrane proteins, which mediate cell-cell adhesion and/or cell-cell communication. Its roles include microvillus morphogenesis, tube elongation, endosome formation and immunity.

Name: Adenylyl cyclase 13E
Description: Enables adenylate cyclase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human ADCY9 (adenylate cyclase 9).

Name: prospero
Description: prospero (pros) encodes a protein that promotes the expression of neural differentiation genes and represses neuroblast stem cell identity genes and cell cycle proliferation genes; it is also important for astrocyte development. The product of pros is asymmetrically localized to the basal cortex during neuroblast asymmetric cell division, resulting in its partioning into GMC daughter cells, where it translocates into the nucleus.

Name: without children
Description: without children (woc) encodes a chromatin-binding factor related to the mammalian MYM-type family of transcription factors. It is involved in telomere capping, regulation of transcription, ecdysone biosynthesis and germline stem cell differentiation.

Name: Sterile20-like kinase
Description: Sterile20-like kinase (Slik) encodes a member of the Sterile-20 kinase family. It acts via Raf to promote cell proliferation in imaginal disc epithelia. Independently, Slik acts via the product of Moe to support epithelial integrity.

Name: Mucin 30E
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be located in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in amnioserosa; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and organism.

Name: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase
Description: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (Alk) encodes a protein that employs Ras/ERK and PI3K signalling pathways to function in multiple contexts including embryonic visceral muscle development, growth and organ size regulation, retinal axon targeting, modulation of neuromuscular transmission as well as sleep regulation and olfactory learning. Its ligand is the secreted protein encoded by jeb.

Name: coracle
Description: An integral component of the septate junction. May play a role in cell-cell interactions that are necessary for proper development. Vital for embryonic development. (UniProtKB:Q9V8R9)

Name: Calcium-independent receptor for alpha-latrotoxin
Description: G-protein coupled receptor - involved in the perception of tactile, proprioceptive, and auditory stimuli through chordotonal neurons of the PNS - sensitizes these neurons for the detection of mechanical stimulation by amplifying their input-output function

Name: lethal (1) G0196
Description: Bifunctional inositol kinase that acts in concert with the IP6K kinases to synthesize the diphosphate group-containing inositol pyrophosphates diphosphoinositol pentakisphosphate, PP-InsP5, and bis-diphosphoinositol tetrakisphosphate, (PP)2-InsP4. PP-InsP5 and (PP)2-InsP4, also respectively called InsP7 and InsP8, may regulate a variety of cellular processes, including apoptosis, vesicle trafficking, cytoskeletal dynamics, and exocytosis. Phosphorylates inositol hexakisphosphate (InsP6) at position 1 to produce PP-InsP5 which is in turn phosphorylated by IP6Ks to produce (PP)2-InsP4. Alternatively, phosphorylates PP-InsP5 at position 1, produced by IP6Ks from InsP6, to produce (PP)2-InsP4. (UniProtKB:Q9VR59)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity and lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gastric adenocarcinoma. Orthologous to human ABCA13 (ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 13).

Name: filzig
Description: Probable endopeptidase. In tracheal terminal cells, acts downstream of ich to regulate seamless tube growth and/or maintenance probably by processing lumenal matrix proteins. (UniProtKB:B7YZU2)

Name: stranded at second
Description: stranded at second (sas) encodes a single-pass transmembrane protein that localizes to the apical cell surface in polarized epithelia, such as the embryonic/larval salivary gland (SG). Overexpression of sas in the developing SG leads to all membrane domains taking on apical membrane character, with the exception of the region where septate junctions form.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity and lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gastric adenocarcinoma. Orthologous to human ABCA13 (ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 13).

Name: Cytoplasmic linker protein 190
Description: Together CLIP-190 and jar may coordinate the interaction between the actin and microtubule cytoskeleton. May link endocytic vesicles to microtubules. May play a role in formation of furrows during cellularization. (UniProtKB:Q9VJE5)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanylate cyclase activity and peptide receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in cGMP biosynthetic process; cGMP-mediated signaling; and receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling pathway. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leber congenital amaurosis 1; choroidal sclerosis; cone-rod dystrophy 6; congenital stationary night blindness; and retinitis pigmentosa. Orthologous to several human genes including GUCY2F (guanylate cyclase 2F, retinal).

Name: sidestep III
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval tracheal section; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval central nervous system; spermatozoon; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: ADAM metallopeptidase with thrombospondin type 1 motif A
Description: ADAM metallopeptidase with thrombospondin type 1 motif A (AdamTS-A) encodes a secreted matrix metalloprotease involved in  cell migration. Loss of AdamTS-A in the salivary glands results in apical surface irregularities and cell elongation defects.

Name: Brahma associated protein 170kD
Description: Brahma associated protein 170kD (Bap170) encodes a multidomain protein that forms a trimeric complex together with the products of e(y)3 and polybromo, characterizing the Brahma chromatin remodeling complex PBAP.

Name: monensin sensitivity 2
Description: May be required for traffic between late Golgi and early endosomes. (UniProtKB:Q9VLT1)

Name: four wheel drive
Description: four wheel drive (fwd) encodes a Golgi-localized lipid kinase that synthesizes phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate from phosphatidylinositol. It is involved in  spermatocyte cytokinesis and male fertility.

Name: Furin 2
Description: Furin is likely to represent the ubiquitous endoprotease activity within constitutive secretory pathways and capable of cleavage at the RX(K/R)R consensus motif. (UniProtKB:P30432)

Name: Clathrin heavy chain
Description: Clathrin heavy chain (Chc) encodes a protein that forms part of the clathrin complex, which is the major component of coated vesicles.

Name: arrow
Description: arrow (arr) encodes a type I trans-membrane protein and functions as an obligate co-receptor with the product of fz for the ligand encoded by wg in the canonical Wnt signaling pathway. The product of arr is involved in developmental patterning, cell survival and growth regulation.

Name: Hig-anchoring scaffold protein
Description: component of synaptic cleft of brain cholinergic synapses, regulates levels of Discs large and nAChR subunits at postsynaptic terminals, required for trapping Hikaru genki at the synapse

Name: Senataxin
Description: Predicted to enable 5'-3' RNA helicase activity; RNA binding activity; and transcription termination site sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in termination of RNA polymerase II transcription. Predicted to be active in nuclear body. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 4 and ataxia with oculomotor apraxia type 2. Orthologous to human SETX (senataxin).

Name: La related protein
Description: La related protein (larp) encodes a protein that associates and interacts with poly(A)-binding protein. It is required for multiple processes in male meiosis and syncytial embryo development.

Name: lilliputian
Description: Has a role in transcriptional regulation. Acts in parallel with the Ras/MAPK and the PI3K/PKB pathways in the control of cell identity and cellular growth. Essential for regulation of the cytoskeleton and cell growth but not for cell proliferation or growth rate. Required specifically for the microtubule-based basal transport of lipid droplets. Plays a partially redundant function downstream of Raf in cell fate specification in the developing eye. Pair-rule protein that regulates embryonic cellularization, gastrulation and segmentation. (UniProtKB:Q9VQI9)

Name: Calmodulin-binding protein related to a Rab3 GDP/GTP exchange protein
Description: Calmodulin-binding protein related to a Rab3 GDP/GTP exchange protein (Crag) encodes a guanine exchange factor for the products of Rab10 and Rab11. It is involved in the exclusive secretion of basement membrane proteins on the basal side of cells.

Name: uncoordinated-104
Description: Required for presynaptic maturation, has a role in axonal transport of dense-core vesicles carrying synaptic vesicle precursors, components required for the morphological transformation of axonal growth cones to mature boutons. (UniProtKB:A1ZAJ2)

Name: Additional sex combs
Description: Additional sex combs (Asx) encodes a chromatin binding protein with deubiquitination activity of the product of His2A. It genetically interacts with Pc and sxc and represses homeotic genes transcription. It contributes to antennal development and embryonic cell cycle.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity; ATP hydrolysis activity; and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to human RAD54L2 (RAD54 like 2).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG9626 (FBgn0037565). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3R:8293843..8300978. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed within 06-24 hour embryonic stages, at stages throughout the larval period, at stages throughout the pupal period, in stages of adults of both sexes.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Involved in gravitaxis. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Zinc finger MYND-type containing 8
Description: Chromatin reader that recognizes specific histone signatures to regulate transcription (By similarity). Plays a role in neuronal development (PubMed:35916866). (UniProtKB:Q7KRS9)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in imaginal disc-derived leg morphogenesis. Predicted to be active in axon; endocytic vesicle; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in leg and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease recessive intermediate C and distal spinal muscular atrophy type 4. Orthologous to several human genes including PLEKHG5 (pleckstrin homology and RhoGEF domain containing G5).

Name: Daxx-like protein
Description: Transcription regulator (PubMed:23593018, PubMed:17933869). Acts as a histone chaperone that facilitates deposition of histone H3.3 (PubMed:28320872). Has a role in chromatin remodeling together with asf1 and XNP (PubMed:28320872). Has role in the transcriptional apoptotic response to oxidative and UV stress (PubMed:17933869, PubMed:23593018). (UniProtKB:Q9VMD0)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protease binding activity. Predicted to be part of Ino80 complex. Orthologous to human NFRKB (nuclear factor related to kappaB binding protein).

Name: winged eye
Description: winged eye (wge) encodes a protein that localizes to the histone locus body and regulates histone expression to ensure genomic stability. wge overexpression produces eye to wing transformation.

Name: G9a
Description: G9a (G9a) encodes a histone-lysine methyltransferase involved in epigenetic regulation. It contributes to multiple processes including gene expression, dendrite morphogenesis, larval locomotory behavior as well as short and long-term memory.

Name: combover
Description: combover (cmb) encodes an in vitro substrate of the product of Rok, that physically interacts with the planar cell polarity (PCP) effector encoded by mwh, contributing to PCP during wing hair formation. Independent of PCP, cmb is required for spermiogenesis, during which it interacts with Rsph3.

Name: N/A
Description: Located in nucleus. Is expressed in adult brain cell body rind; adult head; and spermatozoon.

Name: Serine-arginine repetitive matrix 2/3/4
Description: Involved in alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in central brain primordium; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Orthologous to human SRRM2 (serine/arginine repetitive matrix 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity and lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gastric adenocarcinoma. Orthologous to human ABCA13 (ATP binding cassette subfamily A member 13).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitotic spindle assembly. Predicted to be active in cilium and microtubule cytoskeleton. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon.

Name: polybromo
Description: polybromo (polybromo) encodes a subunit of Polybromo-associated Brahma complex (PBAP). Its main biological role is involved in chromatin remodeling together with Brahma complex. It can also regulate gene transcription through DNA binding, which is dependent or independent ofthe PBAP complex.

Name: Secretory 71
Description: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and small GTPase binding activity. Involved in Golgi to plasma membrane protein transport; positive regulation of endocytosis; and positive regulation of neuron remodeling. Located in trans-Golgi network. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in periventricular nodular heterotopia. Orthologous to several human genes including ARFGEF2 (ADP ribosylation factor guanine nucleotide exchange factor 2).

Name: strawberry notch
Description: strawberry notch (sno) encodes a nuclear protein that functions in Notch signaling pathway during imaginal disc development. In the developing eye imaginal disc, the product of sno functions downstream of RTK signaling to regulate the expression of the products of N and Delta in the specification of cone and pigment cells.

Name: wide awake
