Description: Salt-inducible kinase 2 (Sik2) encodes a serine/threonine kinase that is activated by the product of Lkb1. It regulates lipid storage and energy homeostasis by controlling the activity of cAMP-response element-binding protein (CREB)-regulated transcription coactivator (CRTC).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin conjugating enzyme activity. Predicted to be involved in postreplication repair; protein K63-linked ubiquitination; and protein monoubiquitination. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human UBE2O (ubiquitin conjugating enzyme E2 O).

Name: cubitus interruptus
Description: cubitus interruptus (ci) encodes a Zn-finger family of transcription factor. It contributes to Hedgehog (Hh) signaling pathway that is involved in pattern formation and growth control. The product of ci undergoes limited proteolysis to be converted into a truncated form that function as a transcription repressor in the absence of the ligand encoded by hh but is converted into a full-length transcription activator in the presence of the product of hh.

Name: Corin
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypertension and pre-eclampsia. Orthologous to human CORIN (corin, serine peptidase).

Name: inflated
Description: inflated (if) encodes one of five fly integrin alpha subunits, and when in a heterodimer with an integrin beta subunit makes a receptor for extracellular matrix proteins containing an RGD motif, such as those encoded by Tig, wb laminin and Tsp. It is required in numerous tissues for cell migration and adhesion between cell layers.

Name: Interacts with the C terminus of ELL 1
Description: Component of the little elongation complex (LEC), a complex required to regulate small nuclear RNA (snRNA) gene transcription by RNA polymerase II and III (PubMed:22195968, PubMed:23932780). Specifically acts as a scaffold protein that promotes the LEC complex formation and recruitment and RNA polymerase II occupancy at snRNA genes in subnuclear bodies (PubMed:23932780). (UniProtKB:Q9W1R4)

Name: roundabout 1
Description: roundabout 1 (robo1) encodes a member of the Robo receptor family that uses the secreted glycoprotein encoded by sli as ligand and the products of Sdc and Dscam1 as co-receptors. It contributes to axon guidance and dendrite morphogenesis as well as regulating trachea and heart tube development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable peroxidase activity. Predicted to be involved in response to oxidative stress. Is expressed in adult head; labral segment; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: no long nerve cord
Description: no long nerve cord (nolo) encodes a protein involved in ventral cord development.

Name: Chitin synthase 2
Description: Predicted to enable chitin synthase activity. Predicted to be involved in cell wall chitin biosynthetic process and cuticle chitin biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in cell periphery and cell septum.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG31551 (FBgn0051551). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3R:5627852..5632033. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very low expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed within 00-06 hour embryonic stages, during late larval stages, at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: fire dancer
Description: fire dancer (fid) encodes a protein involved in heat resistance.

Name: Rho kinase
Description: Rho kinase (Rok) encodes a kinase that, when activated by the GTP form of the product of  Rho1, phosphorylates and modulates cytoskeletal proteins, particularly myosin II. Dynamic regulation of this kinase in subcellular locales influences cell polarization, movement, and shape during interphase and mitosis.

Name: Contactin
Description: Contactin (Cont) encodes a GPI-anchored cell adhesion molecule. It interacts with the product of Nrx-IV in cis to organize septate junctions in epithelial cells and also between ensheathing glial cells and neurons.

Name: uncoordinated
Description: uncoordinated (unc) encodes a basal body-associated protein that is required for normal ciliogenesis. unc depletion results in spermatids with defective flagella and truncated cilia in mechanosensory and chemosensory neurons. Its name arises from the severe uncoordination phenotype due to a lack of proprioceptive sensory feedback.

Name: 18 wheeler
Description: 18 wheeler (18w) encodes a member of the Toll-like receptor family. It contributes to multiple processes including ovarian follicle cell migration, antibacterial humoral response and ventral cord development. A role in convergent extension during early embryogenesis is suggested by the genetic interaction of 18w with Toll-6 and Tollo.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable actin binding activity and muscle alpha-actinin binding activity. Involved in mesoderm development. Predicted to be part of filamentous actin. Predicted to be active in Z disc; adherens junction; and stress fiber. Is expressed in adult heart.

Name: timeout
Description: timeout (timeout) encodes a role in the maintenance of chromosome integrity and in the light synchronization of the adult circadian clock

Name: gawky
Description: Required for gene silencing mediated by micro-RNAs (miRNAs). Silences both polyadenylated and deadenylated mRNAs. Required for miRNA-mediated translational repression and mRNA decay. Not required for miRNA target recognition. Necessary to initiate but not to maintain silencing. Promotes mRNA deadenylation through the recruitment of the CCR4-NOT and PAN complexes and promotes decapping by the DCP1-DCP2 complex. Dissociates from silenced mRNAs after deadenylation. Required for completion of nuclear divisions during early embryonic development. (UniProtKB:Q8SY33)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human RRP12 (ribosomal RNA processing 12 homolog).

Name: cap-n-collar
Description: cap-n-collar (cnc) encodes cap-n-collar (cnc) encodes a transcription factor that interacts with the product of Keap1 to regulate the activation of genes by oxidative stress. The cnc-encoded product also contributes to mRNA localization mediated by microtubules, dendrite morphogenesis and intestinal stem cell homeostasis.

Name: RNA polymerase III subunit A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity. Predicted to contribute to RNA polymerase III activity. Involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase III and positive regulation of translation. Predicted to be part of RNA polymerase III complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 7 with or without oligodontia and-or hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and progeria. Orthologous to human POLR3A (RNA polymerase III subunit A).

Name: Girdin
Description: Predicted to enable dynein light intermediate chain binding activity and microtubule binding activity. Involved in several processes, including dendrite morphogenesis; epithelial cell-cell adhesion; and positive regulation of cell size. Located in adherens junction; cytoplasm; and sensory dendrite. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; epithelial cell; germline cell; mechanosensory system; and ventral midline of embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hydrocephalus and spinocerebellar ataxia type 40. Orthologous to several human genes including CCDC88A (coiled-coil domain containing 88A) and CCDC88C (coiled-coil domain containing 88C).

Name: CAP-D2 condensin subunit
Description: CAP-D2 condensin subunit (Cap-D2) encodes a component of the conserved condensin I complex, together with the products of Cap-G, barr, SMC2 and glu. Condensin I associates with mitotic chromatin and plays a crucial role in shaping mitotic chromosomes and in their faithful segregation during anaphase.

Name: Rad, Gem/Kir family member 1
Description: Rad, Gem/Kir family member 1 (Rgk1) encodes a small GTPase involved in anesthesia-resistant and medium-term memory.

Name: three rows
Description: three rows (thr) encodes a protein that, together with the product of Sse, forms the endoprotease separase complex, which cleaves a subunit of the cohesin complex, thereby allowing separation of the sister chromatids.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; and gut section.

Name: Protein tyrosine phosphatase-ERK/Enhancer of Ras1
Description: Protein tyrosine phosphatase-ERK/Enhancer of Ras1 (PTP-ER) encodes a phosphatase required for mitosis. It is involved in RAS/MAPK signaling regulation and eye development.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Predicted to be located in extracellular space.

Name: lingerer
Description: lingerer (lig) encodes a putative RNA binding protein that forms a complex with the products of orb and orb2. Loss of lig results in defects in copulation and short-term memory.

Name: lethal (2) 03659
Description: Vital for development. (UniProtKB:P91660)

Name: red dog mine
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval circulatory system; embryonic/larval digestive system; embryonic/larval nervous system; endocrine system component; and imaginal disc. Orthologous to human ABCC4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 4).

Name: wispy
Description: wispy (wisp) encodes a conserved cytoplasmic poly-A polymerase of the GLD2 family that is expressed in the female germline and, at low levels, in the nervous system. Its maternal germline expression is essential for completion of normal meiosis by oocytes at egg activation. The product of wisp elongates the poly-A tails of many mRNAs during egg activation. This activity is essential for the translation of maternal mRNAs.

Name: smallish
Description: Involved in morphogenesis of embryonic epithelium and protein localization to cell-cell junction. Located in zonula adherens. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval digestive system; epithelium; muscle system; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable endoribonuclease activity and single-stranded DNA endodeoxyribonuclease activity. Predicted to be involved in apoptotic DNA fragmentation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane and nucleus. Orthologous to human EXOG (exo/endonuclease G).

Name: unc-13-4A
Description: Predicted to be active in secretory vesicle. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis 3. Orthologous to several human genes including BAIAP3 (BAI1 associated protein 3).

Name: RNA polymerase mitochondrial
Description: Enables 3'-5'-exoribonuclease activity and DNA primase activity. Involved in DNA replication, synthesis of RNA primer and DNA synthesis involved in mitochondrial DNA replication. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial DNA-directed RNA polymerase complex. Orthologous to human POLRMT (RNA polymerase mitochondrial).

Name: Suppressor of zeste 2
Description: Suppressor of zeste 2 (Su(z)2) encodes a protein that regulates gene expression by modifying epigenetic marks.  The gene is related to Psc and was orginally identified due to its ability to suppress transvection at z.

Name: bicoid-interacting protein 3
Description: bicoid-interacting protein 3 (bin3) encodes an RNA methyltransferase that adds a 5'-methyl cap to the product of snRNA:7SKa preventing its degradation. It contributes to inhibition of cad mRNA translation in the anterior of the embryo.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG43736 (FBgn0263993). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:6863888..6881580. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported.

Name: Outer segment 6
Description: Involved in cilium assembly. Located in non-motile cilium. Is expressed in antenno-maxillary complex; chordotonal neurons; and eo neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Caroli disease; Senior-Loken syndrome; asphyxiating thoracic dystrophy 5; cranioectodermal dysplasia 4; and nephronophthisis 13. Orthologous to human WDR19 (WD repeat domain 19).

Name: spalt major
Description: spalt major (salm) encodes a zinc finger transcriptional repressor. It mediates most dpp functions during development of the central part of the wing through regulation of the products of kni and ara. The product of salm is required for cell specification during the development of the nervous system, muscle, eye or trachea.

Name: Nucleoporin 154kD
Description: Component of the nuclear pore complex (PubMed:17410542). Has a role in the organization of the inner nuclear membrane proteins at the nuclear envelope (PubMed:22718353). In germ cells, plays a role in the nuclear localization of components of the dpp signaling pathways, such as Medea and phosphorylated Mad (PubMed:21696798). Binds to chromatin, and together with Nup62 and Nup93-1, contributes to karyosome morphology and chromatin organization including attachment to the nuclear envelope in oocytes and nurse cells (PubMed:22718353, PubMed:26341556). Has a role in female fertility including egg chamber development; in nurse cells, has a role in the organization of F-actin in subcortical and cytoplasmic actin filaments important for the transfer of cytoplasm from nurse cells to the growing oocytes (PubMed:9732281, PubMed:10511559, PubMed:17410542, PubMed:17277377). Has a role in male spermatogenesis and fertility (PubMed:9732281, PubMed:10511559). Has a role in germ line cell proliferation (PubMed:21696798). (UniProtKB:Q9V463)

Name: Phospholipase D
Description: Enables phospholipase D activity. Involved in several processes, including gastrulation involving germ band extension; phototransduction; and positive regulation of Golgi vesicle fusion to target membrane. Located in cytoplasmic vesicle. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head and gut section. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental cardiac valvular defect. Orthologous to human PLD1 (phospholipase D1) and PLD2 (phospholipase D2).

Name: GLD2 poly(A) polymerase
Description: GLD2 poly(A) polymerase (Gld2) encodes a conserved poly-A polymerase in the GLD2 family. It is a paralog of the wisp gene. Gld2 is expressed strongly in the testis and at low levels in other tissues including the nervous system. In the male germ line, the product of Gld2 is essential for postmeiotic development of sperm; its depletion causes arrest of spermatogenesis prior to individualization, with abnormal nuclear condensation phenotypes. In the brain it is required for long-term memory.

Name: Apoptotic signal-regulating kinase 1
Description: Apoptotic signal-regulating kinase 1 (Ask1) encodes a serine/threonine kinase that belongs to the MAPK kinase kinase family. In response to various stresses, it phosphorylates MAPK kinases in JNK and p38 MAPK pathways, inducing cellular stress responses including cell death and immune responses.

Name: pawn
Description: pawn (pwn) encodes a protein involved in chaeta morphogenesis.

Name: SP2353
Description: SP2353 (SP2353) encodes a EGF-like- and LamininG-domain-containing protein. It interacts genetically with Dg, which encodes a extracellular matrix receptor. It regulates muscle homeostasis, rhabdomere differentiation and innate immune response.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval muscle system; embryonic/larval nervous system; sensory nervous system primordium; and ventral sensory complex primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable lysozyme activity. Predicted to be involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium. Predicted to be located in extracellular space. Used to study viral infectious disease.

Name: Sterile alpha and Armadillo motif
Description: Sterile alpha and Armadillo motif (Sarm) encodes an intracellular signaling molecule that is required for execution of a pro-degenerative pathway after axotomy.

Name: rickets
Description: rickets (rk) encodes a G-protein coupled receptor that signals intracellularly using the second messenger cAMP. It binds the heterodimeric hormone bursicon and is developmentally important for molting-related behaviors. It is also required after adult emergence for cuticle hardening and melanization.

Name: Autophagy-related 17
Description: Autophagy-related 17 (Atg17) encodes a subunit of the evolutionarily conserved Atg1 kinase complex, which controls the initiation of autophagosome formation. The product of Atg17 also has a role in maintaining neuromuscular function and normal lifespan.

Name: N/A
Description: Located in egg chorion.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables ABC-type heme transporter activity. Involved in heme export. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ABCC4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 4).

Name: pruning defect 1
Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including Golgi organization; lysosome localization; and positive regulation of membrane tubulation. Located in Golgi apparatus. Orthologous to human PLEKHM2 (pleckstrin homology and RUN domain containing M2).

Name: Neuroligin 1
Description: Neuroligin 1 (Nlg1) encodes a transsynaptic adhesion protein of the neuroligin family that is expressed in muscles and accumulates at the postsynaptic side of neuromuscular junctions. Lack of Nlg1 causes smaller and underdeveloped neuromuscular junctions due to insufficient postsynaptic maturation and differentiation of synaptic boutons.

Name: Thioester-containing protein 1
Description: Predicted to enable endopeptidase inhibitor activity. Involved in innate immune response. Predicted to be located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult proventriculus; embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval lymph gland; embryonic/larval plasmatocyte; and embryonic/larval proventriculus. Orthologous to human CD109 (CD109 molecule).

Name: Ge-1
Description: In the process of mRNA degradation, seems to play a role in mRNA decapping. Required for silencing a subset of endogenous miRNA targets. (UniProtKB:Q9VKK1)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable BMP binding activity; BMP receptor binding activity; and integrin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in epithelial tube morphogenesis and positive regulation of BMP signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in extracellular matrix. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase
Description: Phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase (Pfas) encodes a phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase, which is an essential enzyme in the pathway for de novo synthesis of the purine nucleotide inosine monophosphate (IMP). IMP is the precursor for purine nucleotides required for nucleic acids, energy transfer, cell signaling, and coenzymes.

Name: GART trifunctional enzyme
Description: GART trifunctional enzyme (Gart) encodes a multifunctional enzyme that exhibits phosphoribosylamine-glycine ligase, phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine cyclo-ligase and phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase activities.

Name: Grip163
Description: Grip163 (Grip163) encodes a gamma-tubulin binding protein involved in the mitotic cell cycle.

Name: ovo
Description: ovo (ovo) encodes a Zn finger transcription factor, with several isoforms acting as repressor or activator. It is involved in epidermis differentiation, under the control of Wnt and EGFR signaling pathways and Hox factors, as well as female germline differentiation and sex determination.

Name: Chromosome associated protein G
Description: Chromosome associated protein G (Cap-G) encodes a component of the condensin I complex, necessary for accurate mitotic and meiotic chromosome segregation.

Name: Nidogen
Description: Cell adhesion glycoprotein which is widely distributed in basement membranes (PubMed:30260959, PubMed:30567930). Involved in cell-extracellular matrix (ECM) interactions probably by connecting the laminin and collagen IV networks (PubMed:30260959, PubMed:30567930). Required for permeability and mechanical stability of basement membranes, and ECM dependent neural plasticity (PubMed:30567930). Not involved in assembly of the embryonic basement membrane (PubMed:30567930). (UniProtKB:A1Z877)

Name: ATPase 8A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled intramembrane lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in phospholipid translocation. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane and trans-Golgi network. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic hindgut; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cerebellar ataxia, mental retardation and dysequlibrium syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP8A2 (ATPase phospholipid transporting 8A2).

Name: Peroxin 23
Description: Involved in peroxisome biogenesis. (UniProtKB:Q9VWB0)

Name: Nitric oxide synthase
Description: Catalyzes the conversion of L-arginine to L-citrulline producing nitric oxide (NO) which is a messenger molecule with diverse functions throughout the body (PubMed:7568075, PubMed:12804606). Truncated isoforms (isoform 3-isoform 6) are able to form intracellular complexes with the full-length protein and serve as dominant negative inhibitors of the enzyme activity. (UniProtKB:Q27571)

Name: hattifattener
Description: hattifattener (haf) encodes a large transmembrane leucine-rich repeat (LRR) protein whose mutants have variable motor axon defects in which ISNb motor axons fail to make the correct decisions at choice points.

Name: Tollo
Description: Tollo (Tollo) encodes a member of the Toll-like receptor family. It contributes to the innate immune response, regulation of glucose metabolism and protein glycosylation, as well as peripheral nervous system development. Genetic interaction with 18w and Toll-6 suggests a Tollo role in convergent extension during early embryogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables enzyme binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of apoptotic process and ubiquitin-dependent ERAD pathway. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of BAT3 complex. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lung non-small cell carcinoma and osteoarthritis. Orthologous to human BAG6 (BAG cochaperone 6).

Name: Lysine demethylase 2
Description: Histone demethylase that specifically demethylates 'Lys-36' of histone H3, thereby playing a central role in histone code. (UniProtKB:Q9VHH9)

Name: mustard
Description: mustard (mtd) encodes an ecdysone-regulated late puff protein. A isoform including only the C-terminal with a TLDc domain enters the nucleus. This isoform increases intestinal stem cell division and suppresses expression of the antimicrobial peptide encoded by DptA at the transcriptional level, independent of IMD pathway signaling.

Name: Smad anchor for receptor activation
Description: Smad anchor for receptor activation (Sara) encodes an endosomal protein involved in asymmetric stem cell division, intestinal stem cell homeostasis and stem cell fate determination.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 15
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 15 (Vps15) encodes a serine/threonine protein kinase that is a core component of the Vps34/class III PI3-Kinase complex. It is required for the production of PI3P and influences multiple vesicle trafficking pathways, including autophagy and endocytosis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled intramembrane lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in phospholipid translocation. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum; plasma membrane; and trans-Golgi network. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in X-linked congenital hemolytic anemia and autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness. Orthologous to human ATP11A (ATPase phospholipid transporting 11A); ATP11B (ATPase phospholipid transporting 11B (putative)); and ATP11C (ATPase phospholipid transporting 11C).

Name: roundabout 3
Description: roundabout 3 (robo3) encodes a member of the Robo receptor family that uses the secreted glycoprotein encoded by sli as ligand. It is involved in the development of the nervous system and gonad.

Name: Rab3 GTPase activating protein
Description: Regulatory subunit of the Rab3 GTPase-activating (Rab3GAP) complex composed of Rab3-GAP and Rab3GAP1, which has both GTPase-activating protein (GAP) activity towards Rab3, and guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF) activity towards Rab18 (PubMed:21338884, PubMed:32248620). As part of the Rab3GAP complex, required for the rapid induction and sustained expression of synaptic homeostasis at the neuromuscular junction (NMJ) (PubMed:21338884). Also participates in the regulation of autophagy in tissues such as larval fat cells and adult muscles (PubMed:32248620). The Rab3GAP complex, acts as a GAP for Rab3 by converting active Rab3-GTP to the inactive form Rab3-GDP (PubMed:21338884). At the neuromuscular junction (NMJ), forms a presynaptic signaling mechanism with Rab3 that regulates progression of synaptic homeostasis at a late stage of vesicle release (PubMed:21338884). Within this mechanism Rab3-GTP acts, directly or indirectly, to inhibit the progression of synaptic homeostasis, and Rab3-GAP functions to inactivate this action of Rab3-GTP (PubMed:21338884). The Rab3GAP complex, acts as a GEF for Rab18 by promoting the conversion of inactive Rab18-GDP to the active form Rab18-GTP (By similarity). Regulates autophagy as part of a Rab3GAP-Rab18 module (PubMed:32248620). Once Rab18 is activated by the GEF Rab3GAP complex, the Rab3GAP-Rab18 module localizes to autophagosomes, and regulates autolysosome formation and maturation together with the Rab18 interacting effector, the PI3K/Vps34 Complex I (PubMed:32248620). (UniProtKB:Q9VKB9)

Name: Splicing factor 3b subunit 1
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in spliceosomal complex assembly. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in adult heart. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hepatocellular carcinoma and myelodysplastic syndrome. Orthologous to human SF3B1 (splicing factor 3b subunit 1).

Name: NADPH oxidase
Description: NADPH oxidase (Nox) encodes a protein involved in calcium flux and smooth muscle contraction during ovulation.

Name: Kank
Description: Kank (Kank) encodes a microtubule plus-end binding protein.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule plus-end binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic microtubule organization; establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; and nuclear migration. Predicted to be part of microtubule associated complex. Predicted to be active in several cellular components, including axon; kinetochore; and microtubule cytoskeleton. Is expressed in extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; and proventriculus primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Perry syndrome; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 1; and distal hereditary motor neuronopathy type 7B. Orthologous to human DCTN1 (dynactin subunit 1).

Name: atossa
Description: Transcription regulator that syncronizes transcriptional and translational programs to promote macrophage invasion of tissues. Required in macrophages for their early invasion into the extended germband. Induces transcriptional expression of metabolic enzymes as well as of the translational regulator pths/DDX47. With pths/DDX47, adjusts transcription and translation of a subset of OXPHOS genes to increase mitochondrial bioenergetics and allow macrophage tissue invasion. (UniProtKB:Q7JXG9)

Name: white walker
Description: Predicted to enable calcium activated cation channel activity and intracellular calcium activated chloride channel activity. Predicted to be involved in cation transport; chloride transport; and transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to human ANO8 (anoctamin 8).

Name: Activated Cdc42 kinase-like
Description: Activated Cdc42 kinase-like (Ack-like) encodes a non-receptor tyrosine kinase that participates in signaling by the small GTPase encoded by Cdc42. It is involved in embryonic dorsal closure, an epithelial morphogenetic event.

Name: Coiled-coil and C2 domain containing 2A
Description: Probable component of the tectonic-like complex (also named MKS complex), a complex localized at the transition zone of primary cilia (Probable). Required for ciliary structure and function (By similarity). (UniProtKB:A1ZAV1)

Name: nahoda
Description: Is expressed in adult head; dorsal epidermis primordium; gonad; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: rosy
Description: Key enzyme in purine degradation. Catalyzes the oxidation of hypoxanthine to xanthine. Catalyzes the oxidation of xanthine to uric acid (By similarity). (UniProtKB:P10351)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Coiled-Coils Y
Description: The gene Coiled-Coils Y is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CCY (CG45930, FBgn0267592). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is Y:3649996..3666928. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism; pole plasm; posterior endoderm; and primordial germ cell.

Name: grainy head
Description: grainy head (grh) encodes the founding member of a highly conserved family of transcription factors essential for embryonic development. It is both a transcriptional activator and repressor, responsible for the proper expression of many genes primarily involved in epithelial cell fate, barrier formation, wound healing, tube morphogenesis and proliferation of larval neuroblasts.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable 5'-3' RNA helicase activity and RNA binding activity. Involved in dendrite morphogenesis. Predicted to be active in P granule and cytosol. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Kip1 ubiquitination-promoting complex subunit 1
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process. Located in sperm flagellum. Part of ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral midline of embryo. Orthologous to human RNF123 (ring finger protein 123).

Name: echinoid
Description: echinoid (ed) encodes a cell adhesion molecule of adherens junctions that mediate cell adhesion/recognition. It participates in multiple signaling pathways including Egfr, Notch and Hippo during organogenesis. It is also required in multiple steps of dorsal closure during embryogenesis.

Name: rha
Description: rha (rha) encodes a protein that is postmeiotically present in spermatid nuclei and might be involved in the chromatin substitution process removing histones from the chromatin during sperm development.

Name: bunched
Description: Probable transcription factor required for peripheral nervous system morphogenesis, eye development and oogenesis. May be required for the transmission of the dpp signal and for a morphogenetic movement of the medulla in the brain that reorients the second optic lobe relative to the first. Plays a role in determining proper dorsal cell fates leading to the formation of the dorsal appendages. (UniProtKB:Q24523)

Name: bedraggled
Description: bedraggled (bdg) encodes a putative transporter involved in the fate commitment of the R3/R4 pair of photoreceptor cells.

Name: Nostrin
Description: Nostrin (Nost) encodes a lipid binding protein involved in epithelial cell differentiation, plasma membrane tubulation and adherens junction organization.

Name: nucampholin
Description: nucampholin (ncm) encodes a protein that is predicted to be an essential component of the spliceosome, implicated in regulation of pre-mRNA splicing and assembly of the exon junction complex.

Name: Rho GTPase activating protein at 93B
Description: Enables GTPase activator activity. Involved in axon midline choice point recognition and positive regulation of GTPase activity. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult fat body; adult head; and leg. Orthologous to human ARHGAP39 (Rho GTPase activating protein 39).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in COVID-19; X-Linked immunodeficiency 74; and primary immunodeficiency disease. Orthologous to several human genes including NRROS (negative regulator of reactive oxygen species); TLR7 (toll like receptor 7); and TLR8 (toll like receptor 8).

Name: arc
Description: arc (a) encodes a protein involved in eye development.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in MHC class II deficiency and severe combined immunodeficiency. Orthologous to human RFX5 (regulatory factor X5) and RFX7 (regulatory factor X7).

Name: I[[h]] channel
Description: I[[h]] channel (Ih) encodes a low-threshold, voltage-gated ion channel. It may influence excitatory postsynaptic potential kinetics and integration.

Name: drosha
Description: drosha (drosha) encodes a protein that contributes to miRNA processing. It is involved in salivary gland histolysis and oocyte development.

Name: archipelago
Description: archipelago (ago) encodes a protein that is the founding member of the Ago/Fbxw7 family of tumor suppressor genes and the substrate adaptor component of the SCF-Ago ubiquitin ligase. The product of ago has various substrates including the bHLH transcription factors encoded by Myc, trh, and sima, and the G1 cell cycle kinase component encoded by CycE. The product of ago presents tissue specific roles in cell proliferation, survival, and hypoxia-induced gene expression.

Name: FER tyrosine kinase
Description: Tyrosine-protein kinase which is required during embryogenesis for formation of the actin cable in leading edge cells of the dorsal epidermis and for the timely progression of dorsal closure. May play a role in regulation of adherens junctions and cell adhesion through phosphorylation of the beta-catenin arm. (UniProtKB:P18106)

Name: schizo
Description: schizo (siz) encodes an Arf1 guanine nucleotide exchange factor involved in commissural axon guidance and myoblast fusion.

Name: suppressor of sable
Description: RNA-binding protein that suppresses transcription of some RNAs (PubMed:1703632, PubMed:9121479, PubMed:11027289, PubMed:15082769, PubMed:19687295, PubMed:26577379). Together with Wdr82, part of a transcription termination checkpoint that promotes transcription termination of RNAs and their subsequent degradation by the nuclear exosome (PubMed:26577379). Promotes transcription termination of aberrant RNAs, transcripts from genes containing a transposon inserted at their very 5' end or RNAs from heat-shock-inducible repetitive element (PubMed:1703632, PubMed:19687295, PubMed:26577379). Binds RNA preferentially at a sequence that resembles a cryptic 5'-splice site (PubMed:9121479). (UniProtKB:P22293)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to several human genes including ANKS1A (ankyrin repeat and sterile alpha motif domain containing 1A).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG7692 (FBgn0036714). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:17351822..17358056. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of low expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-06 hour embryonic stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Orthologous to human ABCC4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 4).

Name: distracted
Description: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in synaptic target recognition. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ATRN (attractin) and ATRNL1 (attractin like 1).

Name: Na[+]/H[+] hydrogen exchanger 2
Description: Na[+]/H[+] hydrogen exchanger 2 (Nhe2) encodes a Na-H exchanger of the SLC family 9A that increases intracellular pH. The product of Nhe2 activity promotes proliferation, morphogenesis and planar cell polarity, and contributes to oncogene-induced metastatic cell behaviors.

Name: transforming acidic coiled-coil protein
Description: transforming acidic coiled-coil protein (tacc) encodes a centrosomal protein that helps to stabilize microtubules. It seems to influence microtubules indirectly, primarily through its interaction with the product of msps. It is also phosphorylated by the product of aurA, and this activates its ability to stabilize microtubules.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG18265 (FBgn0036725). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:17439401..17457461. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 06-24 hour embryonic stages, during early larval stages.

Name: Alstrom syndrome 1a
Description: In asymmetrically dividing germline stem cells (GSCs), plays a critical role in ensuring centrosome duplication, which is essential for the production of centrosomes and centrioles in all downstream germ cells (PubMed:32965218). Might recruit SAK for daughter centriole duplication (PubMed:32965218). (UniProtKB:Q5BI31)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ABC-type xenobiotic transporter activity and efflux transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in renal tubular secretion and response to toxic substance. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be part of ATP-binding activity cassette (ABC) transporter complex. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autoimmune disease (multiple); carcinoma (multiple); cholestasis (multiple); human immunodeficiency virus infectious disease (multiple); and leukemia (multiple). Orthologous to human ABCB1 (ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 1); ABCB4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 4); and ABCB5 (ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 5).

Name: brunelleschi
Description: Cooperates with Rab11 and fwd/PI4K to mediate the flow of membrane through the Golgi, which is required to support cleavage furrow ingression, therefore promoting cytokinesis in male meiotic cells. (UniProtKB:Q9VIL0)

Name: centrosomin
Description: centrosomin (cnn) encodes an essential mitotic centrosome component. During early embryogenesis it is required to organize the mitotic spindle, the actin cytoskeleton and centriole replication. It is also required for mitotic and meiotic divisions during spermatogenesis, as well as organization of the sperm axoneme. The product of cnn can interact with microtubules, actin and the kinase encoded by polo.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Orthologous to human ABCC4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 4).

Name: gryzun
Description: gryzun (gry) encodes a protein required for secretion that localizes to the early Golgi apparatus. It has been implicated in memory formation.

Name: lethal (3) 76BDm
Description: Predicted to be involved in endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport and protein localization to phagophore assembly site. Located in Golgi apparatus. Part of TRAPPIII protein complex. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human TRAPPC8 (trafficking protein particle complex subunit 8).

Name: IA-2 protein tyrosine phosphatase
Description: IA-2 protein tyrosine phosphatase (IA-2) encodes a protein involved in gut development and insulin-like peptide secretion.

Name: cysts
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction. Is expressed in adult head; leg; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodevelopmental disorder with midbrain and hindbrain malformations and retinitis pigmentosa. Orthologous to several human genes including ARHGEF18 (Rho/Rac guanine nucleotide exchange factor 18) and ARHGEF2 (Rho/Rac guanine nucleotide exchange factor 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein kinase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein localization. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human STK11IP (serine/threonine kinase 11 interacting protein).

Name: Phospholipase C at 21C
Description: Phospholipase C at 21C (Plc21C) encodes a phospholipase C beta involved in olfaction and flight. It functions downstream of G-protein-coupled receptors coupled to Gq.

Name: inactivation no afterpotential E
Description: inactivation no afterpotential E (inaE) encodes a diacylglycerol lipase involved in phototransduction and response to oxidative stress.

Name: rad50
Description: rad50 (rad50) encodes a protein belonging to the SMC family and RAD50 subfamily that is involved in DNA repair. It is required for double-strand break repair and telomere maintenance.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Rho GTPase activating protein at 18B
Description: Rho GTPase activating protein at 18B (RhoGAP18B) encodes a protein that can act as a GTPase activating protein for several Rho GTPase and is involved in the regulation of actin dynamics.

Name: Multidrug resistance protein 4
Description: Multidrug resistance protein 4 (Mrp4) encodes a member of the MRP/ABCC subfamily of ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters. It is involved in the response to oxidative stress and hypoxia.

Name: chaoptin
Description: Required for photoreceptor cell morphogenesis. Mediates homophilic cellular adhesion. (UniProtKB:P12024)

Name: javelin-like
Description: javelin-like (jvl) encodes a microtubule associated protein whose roles include actin and microtubule organization during oocyte development and bristle growth.

Name: Fife
Description: Fife (Fife) encodes a synaptic scaffolding protein that promotes neurotransmitter release and normal motor behavior.

Name: Multi drug resistance 50
Description: Predicted to enable ABC-type xenobiotic transporter activity and efflux transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in renal tubular secretion and response to insecticide. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be part of ATP-binding activity cassette (ABC) transporter complex. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autoimmune disease (multiple); carcinoma (multiple); cholestasis (multiple); human immunodeficiency virus infectious disease (multiple); and leukemia (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ABCB1 (ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 1); ABCB4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 4); and ABCB5 (ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 5).

Name: N/A
Description: CG10505 encodes an ABC transporter whose expression is induced by excess copper, zinc, and cadmium. It is a target of the metal-responsive transcription factor encoded by MTF-1.

Name: disco-related
Description: disco-related (disco-r) encodes a C2H2 zinc-finger transcription factor. It has known roles in larval and adult appendage development, where it appears to control proximal-distal fate in ventral appendages including adult legs, antenna, and larval and adult mouthparts.

Name: pebble
Description: pebble (pbl) encodes a Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor that contributes to multiple processes involving actin cytoskeleton reorganization, including cytokinesis, axogenesis and wound healing as well as cell shape regulation and cell migration during gastrulation.

Name: XNP
Description: XNP (XNP) encodes two protein isoforms that participate in the maintenance of heterochromatin and chromosomal stability. They interact with heterochromatin proteins such as those encoded by Su(var)205 and ADD1.

Name: Rho-type guanine nucleotide exchange factor
Description: Rho-type guanine nucleotide exchange factor (RtGEF) encodes a putative Rho-type guanine nucleotide exchange factor for the GTPases encoded by Rac1 and Cdc42. It signals through the sterile-20 kinases encoded by Pak and hpo. The product of RtGEF contributes to regulation of postsynaptic structure, post synaptic muscle development, protein localization and the growth of epithelial tissue.

Name: meiotic P26
Description: meiotic P26 (mei-P26) encodes a protein involved in meiosis, germline differentiation and spermatogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Adenylyl cyclase 76E
Description: Catalyzes the formation of the signaling molecule cAMP in response to G-protein signaling. (UniProtKB:Q9VW60)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and embryonic central brain.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human ABCC4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 4).

Name: Insulator su(Hw) mRNA adaptor
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA cleavage; mRNA polyadenylation; and termination of RNA polymerase II transcription. Is expressed in larval ventral nerve cord and organism. Orthologous to human SCAF4 (SR-related CTD associated factor 4) and SCAF8 (SR-related CTD associated factor 8).

Name: metabotropic GABA-B receptor subtype 3
Description: metabotropic GABA-B receptor subtype 3 (GABA-B-R3) encodes a G-protein coupled receptor for the GABA neurotransmitter that is coupled to the Go G protein and activation of phospholipase C. Activation of the product of GABA-B-R3 can inhibit neuronal activity. It functions in the olfactory system and in the regulation of sleep and circadian rhythms.

Name: bifocal
Description: bifocal (bif) encodes an actin and microtubule binding protein involved in axon guidance and regulation of axon extension.

Name: Meiosis regulator and mRNA stability factor 1
Description: Enables CCR4-NOT complex binding activity and protein-RNA adaptor activity. Involved in 3'-UTR-mediated mRNA destabilization and positive regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human MARF1 (meiosis regulator and mRNA stability factor 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase 3
Description: Predicted to enable glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity. Predicted to be involved in NADH oxidation and glycerol-3-phosphate metabolic process. Predicted to be part of glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Brugada syndrome 2. Orthologous to human GPD1 (glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase 1) and GPD1L (glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase 1 like).

Name: Neuroglian
Description: Neuroglian (Nrg) encodes an immunoglobulin domain-containing cell adhesion molecule that mediates cell-cell adhesion by forming homo- or heterophilic interactions. The long isoform of the product of Nrg is neuron specific and plays roles in neurite outgrowth, axon guidance and synapse formation. The short isoform of the product of Nrg contributes to the formation of septate junctions in epithelial cells.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: Multi drug resistance 49
Description: Multi drug resistance 49 (Mdr49) encodes drug transmembrane transporter that belongs to the ABCB transporter subfamily and contributes to insecticide resistance.

Name: gprs
Description: Is expressed in embryonic/larval central nervous system and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: Multi drug resistance 65
Description: Multi drug resistance 65 (Mdr65) encodes a member of the MRP/ABCC subfamily of ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters. It is involved in humoral/CNS barrier drug exclusion and response to insecticide.

Name: Dodeca-satellite-binding protein 1
Description: Dodeca-satellite-binding protein 1 (Dp1) encodes a single-stranded nucleic acid binding protein that belongs to the vigilin protein family. It binds to target mRNAs and enhances their translation.

Name: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 99A
Description: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 99A (Ptp99A) encodes a transmembrane receptor tyrosine phosphatase. Its single mutants have no known phenotypes, but Ptp99A synergizes with Ptp69D to increase the penetrance of the Ptp69D motor axon defects. Ptp99A mutations also suppress the 'bypass' motor axon phenotype produced by Lar mutations.

Name: relative of woc
Description: relative of woc (row) encodes a zinc-finger protein involved in transcription regulation that is required for the factor encoded by HP1c to bind chromatin.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine phosphatase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of protein dephosphorylation. Predicted to be part of protein phosphatase type 1 complex. Orthologous to human LRRC49 (leucine rich repeat containing 49).

Name: Histone methyltransferase 4-20
Description: Histone methyltransferase 4-20 (Hmt4-20) encodes a di- and trimethyltransferase, acting on the lysine 20 residue of monomethylated Histone H4.

Name: prickle
Description: prickle (pk) encodes a core component of the Frizzled-dependent planar polarity complex, which localises to cell junctions in developing epithelia, most likely via direct protein-protein interactions with the transmembrane proteins encoded by Vang and stan. pk product contributes to planar polarity defects in epithelia, as well as nervous system development.

Name: plum
Description: plum (plum) encodes an Ig-superfamily transmembrane protein. It is required for developmental pruning of both mushroom body neurons and motor neurons via TGF-beta signaling. plum genetically interacts with myo and babo.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity. Is expressed in spermatogonium. Orthologous to human CFAP61 (cilia and flagella associated protein 61).

Name: Sin3A-associated protein 130
Description: Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleoplasm. Part of Sin3-type complex. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain cell body rind; embryonic/larval brain; embryonic/larval salivary gland; epithelial tube; and ring gland. Orthologous to human SAP130 (Sin3A associated protein 130).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable 5-oxoprolinase (ATP-hydrolyzing) activity. Predicted to be involved in glutathione metabolic process. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval circulatory system; epithelium; and gut section. Orthologous to human OPLAH (5-oxoprolinase, ATP-hydrolysing).

Name: Xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group C
Description: Xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group C (Xpc) encodes a protein involved in recognition of DNA damage and recruitment of nucleotide excision repair proteins.

Name: maleless
Description: maleless (mle) encodes a helicase and a member of the Male-Specific-Lethal dosage compensation complex, which increases male X chromosome transcription approximately two-fold. mle homozygous mutant males die as larvae, while females are viable.

Name: pou domain motif 3
Description: pou domain motif 3 (pdm3) encodes a POU domain transcription factor that acts in odor receptor gene expression and axon targeting of olfactory neurons.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ABCC4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 4).

Name: TBC1 domain family member 8/9
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in activation of GTPase activity. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Used to study nephrotic syndrome type 20. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nephrotic syndrome type 20. Orthologous to several human genes including TBC1D8 (TBC1 domain family member 8); TBC1D8B (TBC1 domain family member 8B); and TBC1D9 (TBC1 domain family member 9).

Name: Cytoplasmic FMR1 interacting protein
Description: Cytoplasmic FMR1 interacting protein (Cyfip) encodes an essential protein that is a component of the WAVE actin nucleator complex. It controls actin cytoskeleton remodeling and interacts with the products of Fmr1 and Rac1. It controls morphogenesis and synapse organization.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and helicase activity. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to human DHX57 (DExH-box helicase 57).

Name: Myosin 95E
Description: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity and microfilament motor activity. Predicted to be involved in actin filament organization and vesicle transport along actin filament. Predicted to be part of myosin complex. Predicted to be active in several cellular components, including actin cytoskeleton; microvillus; and vesicle. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 48 and sensorineural hearing loss. Orthologous to human MYO1A (myosin IA) and MYO1B (myosin IB).

Name: kibra
Description: Regulator of the Hippo/SWH (Sav/Wts/Hpo) signaling pathway, a signaling pathway that plays a pivotal role in organ size control and tumor suppression by restricting proliferation and promoting apoptosis. The core of this pathway is composed of a kinase cascade wherein Hippo (Hpo), in complex with its regulatory protein Salvador (Sav), phosphorylates and activates Warts (Wts) in complex with its regulatory protein Mats, which in turn phosphorylates and inactivates the Yorkie (Yki) oncoprotein. Kibra acts synergistically along with Ex and Mer to regulate the Hippo signaling pathway. (UniProtKB:Q9VFG8)

Name: Niemann-Pick type C-1a
Description: Niemann-Pick type C-1a (Npc1a) encodes a cholesterol trafficking protein that contributes to sterol and ecdysone metabolism. It is involved in sperm individualization.

Name: patched
Description: patched (ptc) is a segment polarity gene that encodes a 12-pass transmembrane protein involved in Hh signalling regulation. ptc product contributes to the binding, internalization and degradation of the ligand encoded by hh, limiting its activity spatial range. ptc product also represses the constitutive signaling activity of the transmembrane protein encoded by smo.

Name: Salivary gland secretion 1
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Involved in puparial adhesion. Located in adhesive extracellular matrix. Is expressed in embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and organism.

Name: Integrator 6
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). Involved in the 3'-end processing of the U7 snRNA, and also the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). May mediate recruitment of cytoplasmic dynein to the nuclear envelope, probably as component of the INT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9W485)

Name: Eag-like K[+] channel
Description: Predicted to enable voltage-gated potassium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in potassium ion transmembrane transport and regulation of membrane potential. Predicted to be part of voltage-gated potassium channel complex. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to human KCNH3 (potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 3); KCNH4 (potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 4); and KCNH8 (potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 8).

Name: Neurexin IV
Description: Neurexin IV (Nrx-IV) encodes a transmembrane protein that is critical for septate junction formation in epithelia and between ensheathing glial cells and neurons.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; germ layer; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (succinyl-transferring) activity. Predicted to be involved in tricarboxylic acid cycle. Predicted to be part of oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human OGDH (oxoglutarate dehydrogenase).

Name: domeless
Description: Domeless (dome) encodes the transmembrane receptor for signalling ligands (encoded by upd1, upd2 and upd3) in the cytokine family, which utilises the intracellular JAK/STAT pathway. The product of dome is involved in growth, stem cells, immune responses and development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleolus. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism; wing hinge primordium; and wing pouch. Orthologous to several human genes including ZNF136 (zinc finger protein 136); ZNF333 (zinc finger protein 333); and ZNF34 (zinc finger protein 34).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of GTPase activity and regulation of G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm; neuron projection; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in bradyopsia. Orthologous to several human genes including RGS9 (regulator of G protein signaling 9).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-3,4-bisphosphate 4-phosphatase activity. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human INPP4A (inositol polyphosphate-4-phosphatase type I A) and INPP4B (inositol polyphosphate-4-phosphatase type II B).

Name: mutator 2
Description: mutator 2 (mu2) encodes an androgen receptor co-activator involved in double-strand break repair and regulation of chromatin organization.

Name: Glial cell line-derived neurotrophic family receptor-like
Description: a GPI-anchored membrane protein with four GDNF family receptor-like domains - regulates oogenesis and male fertility - expressed in the central and peripheral nervous systems

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult fat body; embryonic maxillary sensory complex; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; extended germ band embryo; and germ layer.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: SREBP cleavage activating protein
Description: Predicted to enable sterol binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of cholesterol biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in Golgi membrane. Predicted to be part of SREBP-SCAP complex. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human SCAP (SREBF chaperone).

Name: transient receptor potential
Description: transient receptor potential (trp) encodes a non-selective plasma membrane cation channel with high Ca[2+] permeability. It is highly eye-enriched and contributes to the electrical response to light in photoreceptors.

Name: Aldehyde oxidase 1
Description: Aldehyde oxidase 1 (AOX1) encodes a pyridoxal oxidase involved in pyridoxal metabolism.

Name: Myosin binding subunit
Description: Myosin binding subunit (Mbs) encodes a regulatory subunit of myosin phosphatase. It interacts with the catalytic subunit of the myosin phosphatase encoded by flw. It is involved in cell movement in various biological processes and in the arrest of constriction of contractile rings and ring canals during oogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in several structures, including adult heart; embryonic brain; extended germ band embryo; larval ventral nerve cord; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 54. Orthologous to several human genes including HNRNPU (heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein U) and HNRNPUL2 (heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein U like 2).

Name: golden goal
Description: golden goal (gogo) encodes a transmembrane protein involved in axonal pathfinding, especially in axon-axon and axon-target interactions.

Name: Ubiquitin specific protease 15/31
Description: Ubiquitin specific protease 15/31 (Usp15-31) encodes a ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase that is involved in the positive regulation of the apoptosome components encoded by Dark and Dronc.

Name: stripe
Description: stripe (sr) encodes a transcription factor that induces the fate of tendon cells in the embryo as well as in the adult fly. It works upstream of tendon specific genes including Tsp, slow and Lrt.

Name: straightjacket
Description: straightjacket (stj) encodes a voltage-gated calcium channel subunit involved in neuromuscular junction development and autophagosome maturation.

Name: stolid
Description: Predicted to enable voltage-gated calcium channel activity. Involved in positive regulation of voltage-gated calcium channel activity. Predicted to be part of voltage-gated calcium channel complex. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human CACNA2D3 (calcium voltage-gated channel auxiliary subunit alpha2delta 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to DNA damage stimulus and protein polyubiquitination. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human SHPRH (SNF2 histone linker PHD RING helicase).

Name: Furin 1
Description: Furin is likely to represent the ubiquitous endoprotease activity within constitutive secretory pathways and capable of cleavage at the RX(K/R)R consensus motif. (UniProtKB:P26016)

Name: N/A
Description: CG42260 encodes a protein predicted to form the beta subunit of a cyclic nucleotide-gated ion channel. It could form a functional channel as a heterodimer with either the products of CngA or Cngl.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic epidermis; gut section; and spermatozoon.

Name: Histone deacetylase 4
Description: Histone deacetylase 4 (HDAC4) encodes a Class IIa histone deacetylase that modulates gene expression by associating with transcriptional factors. It is regulated by nucleocytoplasmic shuttling and contributes to embryogenesis, muscle development, circadian function, energy balance and memory.

Name: Checkpoint suppressor 1-like
Description: Checkpoint suppressor 1-like (CHES-1-like) encodes a transcription factor that regulates the division of cardiac progenitor cells and dpp transcription in testis.

Name: Anion exchanger 2
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in intracellular pH reduction. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; central nervous system; embryonic/larval midgut; eye disc; and photoreceptor neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hemolytic anemia; hereditary spherocytosis; hereditary spherocytosis type 4; malaria; and renal tubular acidosis. Orthologous to human SLC4A1 (solute carrier family 4 member 1 (Diego blood group)); SLC4A2 (solute carrier family 4 member 2); and SLC4A3 (solute carrier family 4 member 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol phosphate binding activity and phosphatidylinositol-3,4-bisphosphate binding activity. Orthologous to human SESTD1 (SEC14 and spectrin domain containing 1).

Name: spalt-related
Description: spalt-related (salr) encodes a zinc finger transcriptional repressor that, together with the product of salm, mediates most dpp functions during development of the central part of the wing. It is repressed by the product of Ubx during haltere development.

Name: Chromosome associated protein D3
Description: N/A

Name: pod1 coronin
Description: pod1 (pod1) encodes a microtubule and actin filament binding protein involved in actin cytoskeleton reorganization and axon guidance.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable nuclear localization sequence binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of nuclear pore. Predicted to be involved in RNA export from nucleus and protein import into nucleus. Predicted to be part of nuclear pore. Is expressed in several structures, including adult fat body; embryonic brain; extended germ band embryo; gonad; and gut section.

Name: Dynactin 1, p150 subunit
Description: Dynactin 1, p150 subunit (DCTN1-p150) encodes the p150 subunit of the dynactin complex. Dynactin is thought to act as a dynein receptor that modulates binding of dynein to cellular cargoes and enhances the processivity of dynein movement. The roles of the product of DCTN1-p150 include oocyte polarity, mitotic cell division, embryonic development, neuronal transport and neurogenesis.

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 98A
Description: Plus end-directed motor protein involved in asymmetric cell division of sensory organ precursor (SOP) cells by playing a role in the asymmetric localization of Sara-expressing endosomes to the pIIa daughter cell but not to the pIIb cell. Targets Sara-expressing endosomes to the central spindle which is symmetrically arranged in early cell division. During late cytokinesis, central spindle asymmetry is generated by enrichment of Patronin on the pIIb side which protects microtubules from depolymerization by Klp10A while unprotected microtubules on the pIIa side are disassembled by Klp10A, leading to the asymmetric delivery of Sara-expressing endosomes to the pIIa daughter cell (PubMed:26659188). Also plays a role in regulation of autophagosome formation, fusion and positioning and is required for normal localization of Rab14 (PubMed:26763909). (UniProtKB:Q9VB25)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Is expressed in wing hinge primordium and wing pouch. Orthologous to human RNF111 (ring finger protein 111).

Name: serpent
Description: serpent (srp) encodes an important transcription factor for the proper development of mesodermal derivatives such as fat body, hemocytes and limph gland. It contributes to endoderm development, hemopoiesis and glucose metabolism.

Name: PFTAIRE-interacting factor 1A
Description: Involved in sperm individualization. Located in investment cone and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; extended germ band embryo; foregut; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and spermatozoon.

Name: Aldehyde oxidase 2
Description: Aldehyde oxidase 2 (AOX2) encodes a pyridoxal oxidase involved in pyridoxal metabolism.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG30089 (FBgn0050089). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:15727381..15762044. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-06 and 12-24 hour embryonic stages, at stages throughout the pupal period.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG33125 (FBgn0053125). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:2648360..2652414. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carnitine O-acetyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in carnitine metabolic process, CoA-linked. Predicted to be active in peroxisome. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation. Orthologous to human CRAT (carnitine O-acetyltransferase).

Name: Asator
Description: Asator (Asator) encodes a tau-tubulin kinase homolog that is localized to the cytoplasm at interphase. It directly interacts with the spindle matrix protein encoded by Mgtor and localizes to the spindle region during mitosis.

Name: stoned B
Description: Adapter protein involved in endocytic recycling of synaptic vesicles membranes. May act by mediating the retrieval of synaptotagmin protein Syt from the plasma membrane, thereby facilitating the internalization of multiple synaptic vesicles from the plasma membrane. (UniProtKB:Q24212)

Name: Dystroglycan
Description: Dystroglycan (Dg) encodes a major non-integrin extracellular matrix (ECM) receptor that connects the ECM to the actin cytoskeleton. It regulates animal survival and temperature preference, muscle integrity, myotendinous and neuromuscular junction formation and function, nervous system development, axon pathfinding, rhabdomere differentiation, neuronal stem cell division and epithelial polarity.

Name: eggless
Description: eggless (egg) encodes a histone methyltransferase involved in epigenetic regulation of gene expression. It contributes to stem cell asymmetric division, oogenesis and wing disc development.

Name: Secretory 31
Description: Secretory 31 (Sec31) encodes a protein involved in the innate immune response.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleoplasm. Orthologous to human ZNF318 (zinc finger protein 318).

Name: retinal degeneration B
Description: retinal degeneration B (rdgB) encodes a member of the Class IIA Phosphatidylinositol transfer protein (PITP) family. It supports multiple biochemical functions involving lipid transfer during G-protein coupled phospholipase C activation.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head; embryonic myoblast; and organism.

Name: LIM domain kinase 1
Description: LIM domain kinase 1 (LIMK1) encodes a protein that belongs to a phylogenetically conserved family of serine/threonine kinases. It is a potent stabilizer of the actin cytoskeleton by inactivating the product of tsr. It stabilizes the synapse structure at the neuromuscular junction and promotes synaptic remodeling and glomerular development in the developing antennal lobe.

Name: flightless I
Description: May play a key role in embryonic cellularization by interacting with both the cytoskeleton and other cellular components. Alternatively, it may play a structural role in indirect flight muscle. Vital for embryonic development. (UniProtKB:Q24020)

Name: Octopamine beta3 receptor
Description: Autoreceptor for octopamine, which is a neurotransmitter, neurohormone, and neuromodulator in invertebrates (By similarity). Probably also acts as a receptor for tyramine during ecdysone biosynthesis (PubMed:25605909). Required for the biosynthesis of the steroid hormone ecdysone which is necessary for metamorphosis (PubMed:25605909). Involved in activation of prothoracicotropic hormone and insulin-like peptide signaling which is required for the expression of ecdysone biosynthetic genes (PubMed:25605909). (UniProtKB:Q4LBB6)

Name: Aldehyde oxidase 4
Description: Aldehyde oxidase 4 (AOX4) encodes an oxidoreductase that catalyzes the oxidation of pyridoxal to pyridoxate with the release of hydrogen peroxide.

Name: Rho GTPase activating protein at 102A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of GTPase activity. Orthologous to human ARHGAP36 (Rho GTPase activating protein 36) and ARHGAP6 (Rho GTPase activating protein 6).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled intramembrane lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in endocytosis; phospholipid translocation; and retrograde vesicle-mediated transport, Golgi to endoplasmic reticulum. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endosome; plasma membrane; and trans-Golgi network. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP9B (ATPase phospholipid transporting 9B (putative)).

Name: plasma membrane calcium ATPase
Description: plasma membrane calcium ATPase (PMCA) encodes a P-type ion pump found in the plasma membrane. It functions as a low-capacity, high-affinity Ca[2+]-extrusion mechanism, which is required for maintaining resting Ca[2+] levels in all cells. In the larval neuromuscular junction it plays an important role in restoring resting Ca[2+] levels after pre- or post-synaptic Ca[2+] influx.

Name: Niemann-Pick type C-1b
Description: Important for cholesterol absorption at the midgut epithelium. Acts only in the early steps of sterol absorption, prior to Npc1a-dependent intracellular sterol trafficking. (UniProtKB:Q9VRC9)

Name: ATP7
Description: ATP7 (ATP7) encodes a copper transmembrane transporter involved in cuticle pigmentation, copper homeostasis and larval development.

Name: dyschronic
Description: dyschronic (dysc) encodes a protein that regulates the localization of the calcium-activated potassium channel encoded by slo. The product of dysc impacts circadian locomotor patterns, synaptic morphology, active zone structure, and both spontaneous and evoked neurotransmitter release.

Name: Chronophage
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of peptide hormone secretion. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and visceral muscle primordium. Used to study neurodegenerative disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autism spectrum disorder; beta thalassemia; immunodeficiency 49; schizophrenia; and sickle cell anemia. Orthologous to human BCL11A (BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit BCL11A) and BCL11B (BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit BCL11B).

Name: Aldehyde oxidase 3
Description: Aldehyde oxidase 3 (AOX3) encodes a pyridoxal oxidase involved in pyridoxal metabolism.

Name: Epidermal growth factor receptor pathway substrate clone 15
Description: Epidermal growth factor receptor pathway substrate clone 15 (Eps-15) encodes a multi-domain adaptor protein involved in endocytosis. It interacts with several other endocytic factors such as those encoded by shi, stnB, Dap160 and AP-2alpha. It is enriched at sites of endocytosis and is required for normal synaptic bouton development and vesicle endocytosis during high frequency stimulation.

Name: jaguar
Description: Myosin is a protein that binds to actin and has ATPase activity that is activated by actin. Together CLIP-190 and jar may coordinate the interaction between the actin and microtubule cytoskeleton. May link endocytic vesicles to microtubules and may be involved in transport in the early embryo and in the dynamic process of dorsal closure. It is believed that its function changes during the life cycle. (UniProtKB:Q01989)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic brain; embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: Pez
Description: Pez (Pez) encodes an adaptor protein that is degraded via the product of Su(dx). It contributes to stem cell proliferation by regulating Hippo signalling. It interacts with the product of kibra and restricts the product of yki activity.

Name: Elongator complex protein 1
Description: Component of the elongator complex which is required for multiple tRNA modifications, including mcm5U (5-methoxycarbonylmethyl uridine), mcm5s2U (5-methoxycarbonylmethyl-2-thiouridine), and ncm5U (5-carbamoylmethyl uridine) (By similarity).
