The elongator complex catalyzes formation of carboxymethyluridine in the wobble base at position 34 in tRNAs (By similarity). ELP1 binds to tRNA, mediating interaction of the elongator complex with tRNA (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VGK7)

Name: lambik
Description: Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix and extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval peripheral nervous system; wing hinge primordium; and wing pouch. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in urofacial syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including LRIG1 (leucine rich repeats and immunoglobulin like domains 1).

Name: Negative elongation factor A
Description: Essential component of the NELF complex, a complex that negatively regulates the elongation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Has an essential role in postembryonic development. (UniProtKB:Q86NP2)

Name: Suppressor of variegation 3-7
Description: Suppressor of variegation 3-7 (Su(var)3-7) encodes a protein associated with heterochromatin. Increasing the amount of the product of Su(var)3-7 triggers heterochromatin expansion and epigenetic gene silencing.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatase activity and protein phosphatase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-tyrosine dephosphorylation; phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation; and regulation of autophagy. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and membrane. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to several human genes including MTMR4 (myotubularin related protein 4).

Name: Topoisomerase 3alpha
Description: Topoisomerase 3alpha (Top3alpha) encodes a type IA topoisomerase that works with the helicase encoded by Blm to perform double Holliday junction dissolution during homologous recombination. It is also involved in DNA disentangling during chromosome segregation and mitochondrial DNA replication.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanylate cyclase activity and peptide receptor activity. Involved in several processes, including Golgi organization; negative regulation of cell size; and positive regulation of mitotic cell cycle. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: GRAM domain containing 1B
Description: Predicted to enable sterol binding activity and sterol transfer activity. Predicted to be involved in intracellular sterol transport. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane; endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane contact site; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval brain; and embryonic/larval gut. Orthologous to several human genes including GRAMD1C (GRAM domain containing 1C).

Name: alpha-Mannosidase class II b
Description: alpha-Mannosidase class II b (alpha-Man-IIb) encodes a mannosidase involved in cellular encapsulation response and glycoprotein metabolism.

Name: Neuroligin 2
Description: Neuroligin 2 (Nlg2) encodes a transmembrane protein that interacts with the product of Nrx-1, and recruits scaffolding proteins for organization of postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors. The product of Nlg2 functions in synaptic growth and regulation, and is involved in the modulation of social and courtship behavior.

Name: Cullin-associated and neddylation-dissociated 1
Description: Key assembly factor of SCF (SKP1-CUL1-F-box protein) E3 ubiquitin ligase complexes that promotes the exchange of the substrate-recognition F-box subunit in SCF complexes, thereby playing a key role in the cellular repertoire of SCF complexes. Acts as a F-box protein exchange factor. Probably plays a similar role in other cullin-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complexes (Probable). (UniProtKB:Q9VKY2)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable lipid binding activity. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human TEX2 (testis expressed 2).

Name: polycystine-related-Y
Description: The gene polycystine-related-Y is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\PRY (CG45787, FBgn0267489). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is Y:146092..192020. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported.

Name: N/A
Description: Phosphorylase b kinase catalyzes the phosphorylation of serine in certain substrates, including troponin I. The alpha chain may bind calmodulin (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9W391)

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to several human genes including PHLDB1 (pleckstrin homology like domain family B member 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hepatocellular carcinoma and nephronophthisis 15. Orthologous to human CEP164 (centrosomal protein 164).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable intracellular calcium activated chloride channel activity. Predicted to be involved in chloride transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Scott syndrome; bone disease (multiple); dystonia 24; isolated elevated serum creatine phosphokinase levels; and muscular dystrophy (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ANO4 (anoctamin 4).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; procephalic neuroblast; and ventral ectoderm.

Name: peanuts
Description: Involved in pre-mRNA splicing as component of the spliceosome (PubMed:18981222, PubMed:24244416). Facilitates nuclear export of spliced mRNA by releasing the RNA from the spliceosome (By similarity). Before and after egg-chamber formation, required for nurse-cell chromatin dispersal (NCCD) probably by playing a role in spliceosome localization to chromatin/interchromatin spaces (PubMed:24244416). (UniProtKB:A1Z9L3)

Name: Poly(A)-binding protein-dependent poly(A) ribonuclease 2
Description: Catalytic subunit of the poly(A)-nuclease (PAN) deadenylation complex, one of two cytoplasmic mRNA deadenylases involved in general and miRNA-mediated mRNA turnover. PAN specifically shortens poly(A) tails of RNA and the activity is stimulated by poly(A)-binding protein (PABP). PAN deadenylation is followed by rapid degradation of the shortened mRNA tails by the CCR4-NOT complex. Deadenylated mRNAs are then degraded by two alternative mechanisms, namely exosome-mediated 3'-5' exonucleolytic degradation, or deadenlyation-dependent mRNA decaping and subsequent 5'-3' exonucleolytic degradation by XRN1. (UniProtKB:A1Z7K9)

Name: Ranbp21
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and nuclear export signal receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in RNA export from nucleus. Predicted to be part of RNA nuclear export complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung carcinoma (multiple); multiple myeloma; and primary ovarian insufficiency. Orthologous to human XPO5 (exportin 5).

Name: Mid1
Description: Predicted to contribute to stretch-activated, cation-selective, calcium channel activity. Involved in locomotor rhythm and social behavior. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in embryonic brain; larval head segment; larval ventral nerve cord; trunk ectoderm; and ventral nerve cord primordium. Orthologous to human NALF1 (NALCN channel auxiliary factor 1) and NALF2 (NALCN channel auxiliary factor 2).

Name: ensconsin
Description: ensconsin (ens) encodes a microtubule associated protein required for multiple kinesin-1 functions. It contributes to microtubule motor activity, centrosome separation, nuclear positioning and skeletal muscle development.

Name: Upf2
Description: Upf2 (Upf2) encodes a protein required for nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD). It interacts directly with the product of Upf1 to identify and degrade NMD-substrate mRNAs, including mRNAs containing premature termination codons and a number of normal endogenous mRNAs.

Name: discs lost
Description: discs lost (dlt) encodes a protein required for cell survival and cell cycle progression in imaginal discs.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatogonium. Orthologous to human CFAP61 (cilia and flagella associated protein 61).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; and endoderm.

Name: scraps
Description: scraps (scra) encodes a homolog of anilin, a conserved pleckstrin homology domain (PLEKH) containing protein that binds actin, nonmuscle myosin II and microtubules. It stabilizes the contractile ring and is required for completion of cytokinesis.

Name: kuzbanian
Description: kuzbanian (kuz) encodes an ADAM metalloendopeptidase that regulates activation of the receptors encoded by N and robo1 by cleavage.

Name: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 1
Description: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 1 (SMC1) encodes an ATPase that heterodimerizes with the product of SMC3 to interact with the products of vtd and SA1 to form the cohesin ring complex. Cohesin encircles sister chromatids after DNA replication and has multiple roles in the regulation of gene expression and DNA repair.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic brain and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Smith-Magenis syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including TCF20 (transcription factor 20).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Orthologous to several human genes including NOL4 (nucleolar protein 4).

Name: small wing
Description: small wing (sl) encodes a phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholiase type C that is required as a general modulator for growth downstream of the insulin pathway, and interacts with the Ras-MAPK pathway.

Name: mutagen-sensitive 201
Description: mutagen-sensitive 201 (mus201) encodes a protein involved in UV-damage excision repair.

Name: Ret oncogene
Description: Ret oncogene (Ret) encodes a cell surface receptor mediating dendrite development of class IV dendritic arborization sensory neurons. It interacts with integrins and mediates rac1 signaling to promote dendrite adhesion to the extracellular matrix.

Name: rigor mortis
Description: rigor mortis (rig) encodes a component of the cytoplasmic U snRNP body and a member of the SMN-Gemins complex. It is required in the motor system for viability and motor behaviour. It also works as a nuclear receptor interacting protein required for ecdysone signalling during larval development.

Name: prominin
Description: prominin (prom) encodes an evolutionary conserved five transmembrane protein required for the correct positioning and formation of photoreceptor rhabdomeres.

Name: hibris
Description: hibris (hbs) encodes a Ig repeat transmembrane protein with a fibronectin type III domain. It functions as a receptor involved in muscle cell fusion.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic central brain neurons; and embryonic/larval nervous system. Orthologous to human KIAA1217 (KIAA1217) and SRCIN1 (SRC kinase signaling inhibitor 1).

Name: Coat Protein (coatomer) alpha
Description: Predicted to enable structural molecule activity. Involved in several processes, including male meiosis cytokinesis; protein localization to cleavage furrow; and regulation of lipid storage. Located in endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi intermediate compartment. Part of COPI vesicle coat. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; male germline cyst; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to human COPA (COPI coat complex subunit alpha).

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process. Predicted to be part of Ski complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in trichohepatoenteric syndrome 1. Orthologous to human SKIC3 (SKI3 subunit of superkiller complex).

Name: Tie-like receptor tyrosine kinase
Description: Tie-like receptor tyrosine kinase (Tie) encodes a predicted transmembrane tyrosine kinase receptor. Its potential ligands for include Pvf protein family members. It may be involved in cell survival and cell migration.

Name: Cuticular protein 76Bd
Description: Cuticular protein 76Bd (Cpr76Bd) encodes a cuticle component involved in adult fly melanization.

Name: something that sticks like glue
Description: something that sticks like glue (snama) encodes a protein required for cell proliferation and survival in the developing eye. It is involved in apoptosis.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in central brain primordium; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium.

Name: Secretory 24CD
Description: Secretory 24CD (Sec24CD) encodes a subunit of the coat protein complex of COPII vesicles, which transport cargo from the endoplasmic reticulum to the Golgi apparatus. It is essential for export of membrane and secreted proteins from the endoplasmic reticulum. It is involved in epithelial morphogenesis and differentiation.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 8
Description: Plays a role in vesicle-mediated protein trafficking to lysosomal compartments and in membrane docking/fusion reactions of late endosomes/lysosomes probably as part of the class C core vacuole/endosome tethering (CORVET) complex. Specifically required for endocytic trafficking in a subset of cells, such as hemocytes and nephrocytes, which are highly active in endocytosis. (UniProtKB:Q9VRX2)

Name: Isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Predicted to enable isoleucine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in isoleucyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Part of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase multienzyme complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; gut section; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human IARS1 (isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase 1).

Name: Lobe
Description: Probable transcription factor that can both act as an activator or a repressor depending on the context (By similarity). Involved in posterior spiracle development. Acts downstream of ems and cut in posterior spiracle development. (UniProtKB:A1Z9R4)

Name: Splicing factor 3b subunit 3
Description: Involved in pre-mRNA splicing as a component of the splicing factor SF3B complex, a constituent of the spliceosome (PubMed:18981222). SF3B complex is required for 'A' complex assembly formed by the stable binding of U2 snRNP to the branchpoint sequence (BPS) in pre-mRNA (PubMed:18981222). Sequence independent binding of SF3A/SF3B complex upstream of the branch site is essential, it may anchor U2 snRNP to the pre-mRNA (By similarity). May also be involved in the assembly of the 'E' complex (By similarity). Belongs also to the minor U12-dependent spliceosome, which is involved in the splicing of rare class of nuclear pre-mRNA intron (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9W0M7)

Name: sunday driver
Description: sunday driver (syd) encodes a member of a family of scaffolding proteins that bind to JNK and facilitate its activation. syd is an organ size regulator that functions in Hippo signaling and is essential for Diap1 protein stability and function.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG9068 (FBgn0034106). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:16283435..16287450. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very low expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed within 00-18 hour embryonic stages, during late pupal stages, in adult male stages.

Name: mind bomb 1
Description: mind bomb 1 (mib1) encodes an E3 ubiquitin ligase that regulates Notch signaling by influencing the endocytosis of the products of Delta and Ser.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable P-type ion transporter activity and transmembrane protein dislocase activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular calcium ion homeostasis; extraction of mislocalized protein from ER membrane; and transmembrane transport. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human ATP13A1 (ATPase 13A1).

Name: metabotropic GABA-B receptor subtype 2
Description: Enables G protein-coupled GABA receptor activity and protein heterodimerization activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to mechanical stimulus; negative regulation of secretion by cell; and olfactory behavior. Located in plasma membrane. Part of G protein-coupled receptor heterodimeric complex. Is expressed in adult head; adult insulin secreting cell of pars intercerebralis; and central nervous system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 59 and nicotine dependence. Orthologous to human GABBR2 (gamma-aminobutyric acid type B receptor subunit 2).

Name: pre-mRNA processing factor 5
Description: Predicted to enable RNA helicase activity. Involved in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Predicted to be part of spliceosomal complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human DDX46 (DEAD-box helicase 46).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region.

Name: period
Description: Essential for biological clock functions. Determines the period length of circadian and ultradian rhythms; an increase in PER dosage leads to shortened circadian rhythms and a decrease leads to lengthened circadian rhythms. Essential for the circadian rhythmicity of locomotor activity, eclosion behavior, and for the rhythmic component of the male courtship song that originates in the thoracic nervous system. The biological cycle depends on the rhythmic formation and nuclear localization of the TIM-PER complex. Light induces the degradation of TIM, which promotes elimination of PER. Nuclear activity of the heterodimer coordinatively regulates PER and TIM transcription through a negative feedback loop. Behaves as a negative element in circadian transcriptional loop. Does not appear to bind DNA, suggesting indirect transcriptional inhibition. Required for binding of cwo to the E box regions in the promoters of target genes of the transcriptional activator Clock, probably by binding to Clock-cycle heterodimers, reducing their affinity for E box binding and allowing cwo to bind instead (PubMed:27814361). (UniProtKB:P07663)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-iditol 2-dehydrogenase activity. Predicted to be involved in sorbitol catabolic process. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: Sno oncogene
Description: Sno oncogene (Snoo) encodes a protein that belongs to the highly conserved Sno/Ski family of Smad binding proteins. It specifically binds the product of Med and switches its affinity from the products of Mad to Smox, resulting in antagonism of the product of dpp and facilitation of Activin signaling. Snoo overexpression antagonizes both pathways.

Name: tapas
Description: Involved in negative regulation of transposition and piRNA processing. Located in P granule and perinuclear region of cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; female-specific anatomical entity; and gut section. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cataract 36. Orthologous to human TDRD7 (tudor domain containing 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chromatin insulator sequence binding activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be active in chromosome. Is expressed in dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; and organism.

Name: pre-mRNA processing factor 16
Description: pre-mRNA processing factor 16 (Prp16) encodes a protein involved in alternative mRNA splicing regulation.

Name: TBP-associated factor 2
Description: TBP-associated factor 2 (Taf2) encodes a protein that forms part of the multisubunit basal transcription factor TFIID. Together with the product of Taf1, it binds the Initiator and/or the DPE core promoter elements.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable AP-2 adaptor complex binding activity and phospholipid binding activity. Predicted to be involved in clathrin coat assembly and clathrin-dependent endocytosis. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary immunodeficiency disease. Orthologous to several human genes including FCHO2 (FCH and mu domain containing endocytic adaptor 2).

Name: Scm-related gene containing four mbt domains
Description: Scm-related gene containing four mbt domains (Sfmbt) encodes a subunit of the Polycomb Group protein complex Pho repressive complex (PhoRC). This chromatin binding protein recognizes with high selectivity mono- and dimethylated lysine residues in various histone peptides.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in embryonic dorsal epidermis; embryonic head epidermis; and embryonic ventral epidermis.

Name: stumps
Description: stumps (stumps) encodes a fibroblast growth factor (FGF) scaffolding protein. Upon FGF receptor activation, it mediates the recruitment of the phosphatase encoded by csw, which is essential for the activation of the MAPK pathway.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity; chromatin binding activity; and histone binding activity. Predicted to be involved in chromatin remodeling. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm; nucleolus; and nucleoplasm.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG32719 (FBgn0052719). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:7508651..7547992. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: precocious dissociation of sisters 5
Description: precocious dissociation of sisters 5 (pds5) encodes a protein that interacts with the product of wapl to form the releasin complex, which enables sister chromatid separation at mitosis by removing the cohesin ring complex from chromosomes. The product of pds5 influences gene activation and silencing through interactions with cohesin. It is also required to initiate and/or maintain sister chromatid cohesion.

Name: dispatched
Description: dispatched (disp) encodes a multipass transmembrane protein and a member of the RND transporter family. It is required for the release and long-range activity of the lipid-modified product of hh from producing cells. The products of hh and disp control cell growth, survival, fate, and patterning.

Name: Synaptojanin
Description: Synaptojanin (Synj) encodes a synaptic Phosphoinositide phosphate (PtdInsP) phosphatase that catalyzes the hydrolysis of phosphate groups from phosphorylated inositols. It is recruited or stabilized by the product of EndoA to endocytic membranes, and it catalyzes dephosphorylation reactions implicated in the uncoating of nascent endocytic vesicles. When the product of Synj dephosphorylates phosphoinositides on nascent vesicles, endocytic adaptors with affinity for these lipids will leave the membrane to uncoat the vesicle.

Name: happyhour
Description: happyhour (hppy) encodes the Drosophila orthologue of MAP4K3, a Ser/Thr Kinase belonging to the Germinal Center Kinase I family of Ste20-related kinases. The function of hppy has being linked to the Egfr, Hippo and Tor signalling pathways.

Name: Ubiquitination factor E4B
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein polyubiquitination and ubiquitin-dependent ERAD pathway. Predicted to be part of ubiquitin ligase complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head; organism; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human UBE4B (ubiquitination factor E4B).

Name: Blimp-1
Description: Blimp-1 (Blimp-1) encodes a zinc finger transcription repressor that is induced by 20-hydroxylecdysone and plays important roles for metamorphosis. It also contributes to embryonic trachea formation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human RPAP1 (RNA polymerase II associated protein 1).

Name: Ca[2+] channel Muscle-specific alpha2/delta subunit
Description: Predicted to enable voltage-gated calcium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in calcium ion transmembrane transport. Located in T-tubule and sarcoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; embryonic/larval muscle system; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinal cone dystrophy 4. Orthologous to human CACNA2D4 (calcium voltage-gated channel auxiliary subunit alpha2delta 4).

Name: benign gonial cell neoplasm
Description: benign gonial cell neoplasm (bgcn) encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in germline stem cell lineage differentiation. It forms a translational repressor complex with the product of bam in ovaries and with the products of bam and tut in testis.

Name: Liprin-alpha
Description: Liprin-alpha (Liprin-alpha) encodes a scaffolding protein that interacts with the receptor phosphatase Lar. It is involved in synapse morphogenesis and axon guidance.

Name: Argonaute 2
Description: Argonaute 2 (AGO2) encodes an Argonaute/Piwi family protein, which interacts with small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) to form RNA-induced silencing complexes (RISCs). RISCs are guided to target and cleave transcripts (mostly from transposons and viruses).

Name: charlatan
Description: charlatan (chn) encodes a C2H2 zinc-finger transcriptional factor that regulates multiple genes, including emc, hry, ac and Delta. It functions in sensory neurons, photoreceptors, blood cells, muscle precursors and intestinal precursors.

Name: center divider
Description: center divider (cdi) encodes a serine/threonine kinase that stimulates the formation of actin fibers and focal adhesions through phosphorylation of the F-actin depolimerization factor tsr.

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 3A
Description: Kinesin-like protein at 3A (Klp3A) encodes a microtubule motor protein involved in chromosome segregation and mitotic spindle morphogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human EDRF1 (erythroid differentiation regulatory factor 1).

Name: Diacyl glycerol kinase
Description: Upon cell stimulation converts the second messenger diacylglycerol into phosphatidate, initiating the resynthesis of phosphatidylinositols and attenuating protein kinase C activity (By similarity). May have a role in the development of the embryonic nervous system and the function of the adult nervous system and muscle; regulating signal transduction in neurons. (UniProtKB:Q01583)

Name: dunce
Description: dunce (dnc) encodes a cAMP-specific phosphodiesterase, responsible for cAMP degradation. dnc product plays a pivotal role in neurological and behavioral plasticity including synaptic development and function, learning and courtship. The product of dnc is also known to affect regulation of several developmental processes such as oogenesis.

Name: moira
Description: moira (mor) encodes a member of the trithorax group of homeotic gene regulators. The product of mor is a chromatin remodeling protein and functions as the Swi3 component of the Brahma complex.

Name: JIL-1 kinase
Description: JIL-1 kinase (JIL-1) encodes a Serine/Threonine tandem kinase that phosphorylates the Serine 10 residue of the product of His3. A key function of the product of JIL-1 is to antagonize heterochromatization and to regulate levels of gene expression by controlling the distribution of the Lysine 9 dimethylation mark of the epigenetic histone encoded by His3.

Name: sodium chloride cotransporter 69
Description: sodium chloride cotransporter 69 (Ncc69) encodes a member of the SLC12 family of Na[+]/K[+]/2Cl[-] cotransporters (NKCC).

Name: bonus
Description: bonus (bon) encodes a nuclear receptor cofactor involved in axon guidance and chromatin organization.

Name: Outer segment 4
Description: Involved in cilium assembly and positive regulation of canonical Wnt signaling pathway. Located in non-motile cilium. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal epidermis primordium; ectodermal derivative; embryonic epidermis; gut section; and sensory neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Ellis-Van Creveld syndrome; cranioectodermal dysplasia 2; and short-rib thoracic dysplasia 7 with or without polydactyly. Orthologous to human WDR35 (WD repeat domain 35).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of post-transcriptional gene silencing. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human FOCAD (focadhesin).

Name: Magi
Description: Magi (Magi) encodes a molecular scaffolding protein that is involved in adherens junction (AJ) organization. Magi is ubiquitously expressed and its product localizes at AJ with the Par polarity complex.

Name: sidestep VIII
Description: Is expressed in 3-1M; adult head; and pCC neuron.

Name: Nna1 carboxypeptidase
Description: Nna1 carboxypeptidase (Nna1) encodes a highly conserved cytoplasmic carboxypeptidase. Nna1 loss leads to neurodegeneration by causing mitochondrial dysfunction. It has been proposed to function as protein-deglutamylases, possibly interacting with and modifying tubulin.

Name: costa
Description: costa (cos) encodes a kinesin-like protein and a key component in the Hedgehog (Hh) pathway that is involved in pattern formation and growth control. It forms a complex with the product of fu to restrict the activity of the Hh pathway transcription factor encoded by ci.

Name: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 3
Description: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 3 (SMC3) encodes a subunit of the cohesin complex. It is involved in planar cell polarity by regulating the membrane enrichment of the transmembrane cadherin encoded by stan.

Name: lethal (3) L1231
Description: Involved in gravitaxis. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism; wing hinge primordium; and wing pouch. Orthologous to human INO80D (INO80 complex subunit D).

Name: slowpoke
Description: slowpoke (slo) encodes the structural alpha subunit of a BK ('maxi K') calcium-activated potassium channel. It regulates neurotransmitter release at the synapse and maintain electrical excitability in neurons and muscle cells.

Name: Nucleoporin 133kD
Description: Probable component of the nuclear pore complex (NPC) (Probable). Plays a role in NPC assembly and/or maintenance (PubMed:20547758). (UniProtKB:Q9VCW3)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carbohydrate binding activity. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle system; foregut primordium; gastrula embryo; hindgut proper primordium; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system. Orthologous to human NOMO1 (NODAL modulator 1); NOMO2 (NODAL modulator 2); and NOMO3 (NODAL modulator 3).

Name: ADD domain-containing protein 1
Description: ADD domain-containing protein 1 (ADD1) encodes a strong Heterochromatin Protein 1 interactor that interacts with methylated H3K9 silencing marks in heterochromatin.

Name: Organic anion transporting polypeptide 30B
Description: Organic anion transporting polypeptide 30B (Oatp30B) encodes a transmembrane transporter involved in the transport of the cardiac glycoside ouabain.

Name: Pyruvate carboxylase
Description: Pyruvate carboxylase (PCB) encodes an enzyme that regulates D-serine levels.

Name: twister
Description: twister (tst) encodes a protein that regulates mRNA alternative splicing

Name: Transient receptor potential cation channel A1
Description: Transient receptor potential cation channel A1 (TrpA1) encodes a cation channel activated by warming and by reactive chemicals. Its roles include the control of thermotaxis at innocuous temperatures, as well as thermal and chemical nociception in response to noxious heat and chemical exposure.

Name: PIP82
Description: Required for the morphological differentiation and maintenance of the rhabdomeric photoreceptor apical domain (PubMed:32579558). Acts as a downstream component of the gl and Pph13 transcriptional pathway which is required for photoreceptor cell development (PubMed:32579558). Likely to function by regulating the trafficking or retention of rhabdomeric proteins including the phototransduction proteins ninaE and didum (PubMed:32579558). (UniProtKB:Q9W3E2)

Name: N/A
Description: Enables aminopeptidase activity. Involved in several processes, including cell dedifferentiation; germ-line stem-cell niche homeostasis; and male germ-line stem cell population maintenance. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: GTPase activating protein and centrosome-associated
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in activation of GTPase activity. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Orthologous to several human genes including RABGAP1 (RAB GTPase activating protein 1).

Name: Chloride channel-a
Description: Chloride channel-a (ClC-a) encodes a plasma membrane chloride channel expressed in the stellate cells of Malpighian tubules. It is involved in transepithelial transport of ions and water.

Name: Maternal transcript 89Ba
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in rRNA processing and tRNA export from nucleus. Predicted to be located in condensed nuclear chromosome and nucleolus. Predicted to be part of CURI complex; UTP-C complex; and small-subunit processome. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; gut section; and ovary. Orthologous to human NOL6 (nucleolar protein 6).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism; wing hinge primordium; and wing pouch. Orthologous to human RBM33 (RNA binding motif protein 33).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in activation of GTPase activity. Orthologous to human SGSM1 (small G protein signaling modulator 1) and SGSM2 (small G protein signaling modulator 2).

Name: kurz
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and RNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in ovary. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in 46,XY sex reversal. Orthologous to human DHX37 (DEAH-box helicase 37).

Name: pangolin
Description: pangolin (pan) encodes an HMG-domain transcription factor that is a key component of the canonical Wingless signaling pathway. It toggles between acting as a transcriptional repressor (when bound to the product of gro) and activator (when bound to the product of arm) to promote cell fate specification.

Name: Strumpellin
Description: Acts at least in part as component of the WASH complex which may regulate wash nucleation-promoting factor (NPF) activity and is required for its membrane targeting during endosomal sorting (By similarity). During embryogenesis, not involved in the wash-dependent developmental migration of hemocytes anteriorly from the tail (PubMed:25739458). (UniProtKB:Q9VUY8)

Name: u-shaped
Description: u-shaped (ush) encodes a member of the Friend of GATA (FOG) multi-type zinc finger protein family, which bind GATA factors (like those encoded by srp or pnr). These complexes can interface with major signal transduction pathways such as TGFbeta, Hedgehog, JAK/STAT and Insulin/PI3K to regulate diverse biological processes such as embryonic development, heart, blood and neural development and body size.

Name: Ubiquitin activating enzyme 1
Description: Ubiquitin activating enzyme 1 (Uba1) encodes an E1 enzyme involved in protein ubiquitylation. It contributes to multiple processes including regulation of Ras-ERK signaling, autophagy, apoptosis and tissue growth.

Name: Na[+]-driven anion exchanger 1
Description: Na[+]-driven anion exchanger 1 (Ndae1) encodes an intrinsic membrane protein that reversibly mediates the exchange of 1 Na[+] and 2 HCO[[3]][-] for 1 Cl[-] at basolateral membranes of gut and renal epithelia as well as CNS neurons. In the CNS, the product of Ndae1 can lower resting intracellular Cl[-] controlling GABA(A) Cl-channel activity.

Name: Dynamin associated protein 160
Description: Dynamin associated protein 160 (Dap160) encodes an adaptor protein that contributes to endocytosis. It regulates the Notch pathway and mediates the asymmetric accumulation of a number or proteins, including the product of aPKC during neuroblast division.

Name: Protein kinase N
Description: Protein kinase N (Pkn) encodes a serine/threonine protein kinase activated by Rho family GTPases, especially those encoded by Rho1 and Rac1. When activated, the product of Pkn regulates the actin cytoskeleton during oogenesis, wound repair, and in morphogenetic events including dorsal closure and wing development.

Name: Msh6
Description: Msh6 (Msh6) encodes a heterodimer with the product of spel1 to detect base-base mismatches and small insertion/deletion loops. It then recruits the rest of the mismatch repair machinery.

Name: Tubulin-binding cofactor D
Description: Tubulin-binding cofactor D (Tbcd) encodes one of the tubulin folding cofactors, which assist in the formation of tubulin heterodimers. It cooperates with the product of Dscam1 to regulate microtubule organization during neural development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of protein tyrosine kinase activity. Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Orthologous to human IBTK (inhibitor of Bruton tyrosine kinase).

Name: Glycine transporter
Description: Enables glycine:sodium symporter activity and neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity. Involved in glycine import across plasma membrane; neurotransmitter transport; and regulation of circadian rhythm. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; and adult thorax. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hyperekplexia 3 and obesity. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC6A5 (solute carrier family 6 member 5).

Name: Ecdysone-induced protein 93F
Description: Ecdysone-induced protein 93F (Eip93F) encodes a DNA binding protein that plays an important role as an adult determinant during fly metamorphosis.

Name: armitage
Description: armitage (armi) encodes a highly conserved cytosolic 5'-3' RNA helicase that is involved in biogenesis of PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs), which suppress transposable elements in the fly germline.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chromatin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in histone H4-K16 acetylation. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in chromatin. Is expressed in organism.

Name: tonalli
Description: tonalli (tna) is an essential gene that encodes several isoforms, including Tna-A, which physically associates with subunits of the Brahma chromatin remodeling complex and is involved in transcriptional activation.

Name: meiotic 218
Description: meiotic 218 (mei-218) is encoded on the same mRNA as the product of mei-217. The products of mei-217 and mei-218 interact physically and are involved in meiotic recombination.

Name: Microtubule-associated protein 205
Description: Microtubule-associated protein 205 (Map205) encodes a protein that binds and stabilizes microtubules. It also binds, inhibits and stabilizes the product of polo on microtubules during interphase.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in proteolysis.

Name: Secretory 24AB
Description: Predicted to enable SNARE binding activity; signal sequence binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in COPII-coated vesicle cargo loading. Predicted to be part of COPII vesicle coat. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum exit site. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including SEC24A (SEC24 homolog A, COPII coat complex component).

Name: Chromatin assembly factor 1, p180 subunit
Description: Chromatin assembly factor 1, p180 subunit (Caf1-180) encodes a component of the chromatin assembly factor-1, which couples DNA replication to histone deposition. The product of Caf1-180 is involved in nucleosome organization, DNA endoduplication and double-strand DNA break repair.

Name: Formin-like
Description: Together with Cdc42, involved in establishment of planar cell polarity in the developing compound eye by contributing to ommatidial rotation. Together with DAAM and Cdc42, has a role in neuronal development of mushroom bodies. (UniProtKB:Q9VUC6)

Name: Leucyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Predicted to enable leucine-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in wound healing. Part of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase multienzyme complex. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in infantile liver failure syndrome 1. Orthologous to human LARS1 (leucyl-tRNA synthetase 1).

Name: F-box protein 11
Description: F-box protein 11 (FBXO11) encodes a subunit of a SCF-like E3 ubiquitin ligase involved in gene silencing mediated by both siRNAs and miRNAs.s

Name: Glutamate receptor IB
Description: Predicted to enable extracellular ligand-gated ion channel activity and signaling receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in cation transport. Predicted to be part of ionotropic glutamate receptor complex. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult brain; adult head; and embryonic/larval central nervous system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder; autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 76; schizophrenia; and syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 94. Orthologous to several human genes including GRIA2 (glutamate ionotropic receptor AMPA type subunit 2) and GRIA3 (glutamate ionotropic receptor AMPA type subunit 3).

Name: tankyrase
Description: tankyrase (Tnks) encodes an ADP-ribose polymerase that regulates Wnt signalling by contributing to the degradation of Axn.

Name: farmer
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of chitin-based larval cuticle. Predicted to be active in chitin-based extracellular matrix. Is expressed in embryonic dorsal epidermis; embryonic head epidermis; and embryonic ventral epidermis.

Name: Upf1 RNA helicase
Description: RNA-dependent helicase and ATPase required for nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) of mRNAs containing premature stop codons. Is recruited to mRNAs upon translation termination and undergoes a cycle of phosphorylation and dephosphorylation; its phosphorylation appears to be a key step in NMD. The formation of an Upf1-Upf2-Upf3 surveillance complex is believed to activate NMD (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VYS3)

Name: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 2
Description: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 2 (SMC2) encodes a condensin subunit involved in chromosome condensation and cell division. It contributes to neurogenesis and stem cell differentiation.

Name: Histone deacetylase 6
Description: Histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6) encodes a cytosolic deacetylase that functions as a key modulator of proteostasis by mediating ubiquitin-proteasomal and lysosomal degradation of native and/or misfolded proteins.

Name: hemipterous
Description: hemipterous (hep) encodes a serine/threonine protein kinase involved in the Jun-N-terminal kinase pathway by phosphorylating the product of bsk.

Name: hopscotch
Description: hopscotch (hop) encodes a non-receptor tyrosine kinase for interleukin-like ligands (encoded by upd1, upd2, and upd3) and functions in the JAK-STAT signaling pathway. It is involved in embryonic segmentation, cell proliferation, and cell migration.

Name: Smg5 nonsense mediated mRNA decay factor
Description: Smg5 (Smg5) encodes a protein involved in mRNA catabolism.

Name: RNA polymerase II subunit B
Description: RNA polymerase II subunit B (Polr2B) encodes a protein thought to be present in all RNA pol II complexes.

Name: Krueppel target at 95D
Description: Predicted to be involved in protein localization to plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic head; extended germ band embryo; gut section; and muscle cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Schuurs-Hoeijmakers Syndrome and developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 66. Orthologous to several human genes including PACS2 (phosphofurin acidic cluster sorting protein 2).

Name: Nucleolar complex protein 1
Description: Nucleolar complex protein 1 (Noc1) encodes a protein expressed in the nucleolus, and whose reduction affects rRNA maturation and protein synthesis, inducing apoptosis.

Name: ether a go-go
Description: Structural component of a potassium channel. Mediates the potassium permeability of membranes; potassium current is regulated by CaMKII and CASK. Has a role in growth of the perineurial glial layer of the larval peripheral nerve. (UniProtKB:Q02280)

Name: Ankle2
Description: Ankle2 (Ankle2) encodes an important protein for proper development of the third instar larval CNS. Ankle2 loss causes a small brain phenotype, defects in proliferation and excessive apoptosis.

Name: sidestep V
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: furrowed
Description: furrowed (fw) encodes a selectin that mediates the interaction of planar cell polarity proteins by stabilizing the product of fz.

Name: male sterile (3) 76Cc
Description: male sterile (3) 76Cc (ms(3)76Cc) encodes a protein which contains multiple copies of a VTD-type deubiquitinase domain. It is most likely inactive, since crucial active site residues are missing.

Name: slow as molasses
Description: slow as molasses (slam) encodes a protein involved in cortical polarization and furrow invagination during cellularization, as well in germ cell migration during later embryogenesis. slam RNA co-localizes and forms a complex with its encoded protein, which is needed for full expression and subcellular localization.

Name: murashka
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Involved in behavioral response to ethanol and long-term memory. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in anterior midgut primordium; embryonic/larval midgut; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and posterior midgut primordium. Orthologous to human RNF38 (ring finger protein 38) and RNF44 (ring finger protein 44).

Name: testes of unusual size
Description: testes of unusual size (tous) encodes a protein involved in ciliogenesis, and is required for proper cytokinesis during male meiosis. When mutated, it results in male sterility with decreased fitness, immotile flagella, irregular testis morphology, and disrupted localization of subcellular structures during spermatogenesis.

Name: X11L
Description: X11L (X11L) encodes a scaffolding protein that is important for eye development. It interacts with the products of rst and Appl and is required for targeting several proteins to cell membranes.

Name: par-1
Description: par-1 (par-1) encodes a protein kinase involved in multiple processes, including microtubule cytoskeleton organization, axis specification and cell polarity. It regulates hippo signaling and osk mRNA localization.

Name: pipsqueak
Description: pipsqueak (psq) encodes a transcription factor that regulates chromatin silencing. It mediates the interaction of Polycomb group (Pc-G) members with Pc-G response elements.

Name: Outer segment 1
Description: Outer segment 1 (Oseg1) encodes a protein required for ciliogenesis.

Name: Patched-related
Description: Predicted to be involved in cognition. Located in cytoplasmic vesicle membrane and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; ectoderm; ectoderm anlage; epithelium; and extended germ band embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autistic disorder. Orthologous to several human genes including PTCHD1 (patched domain containing 1) and PTCHD4 (patched domain containing 4).

Name: MBD-R2
Description: MBD-R2 (MBD-R2) encodes a Zinc finger C2H2 transcription factor. It is a component of nonspecific lethal (NSL) complex involved in transcriptional activation.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including blastoderm embryo; embryonic/larval digestive system; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and trunk ectoderm.

Name: Adenylate cyclase 3
Description: Adenylate cyclase 3 (Ac3) encodes an adenylate cyclase that is coupled to the receptor encoded by Pdfr via Gs signaling in the Morning circadian pacemakers.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable cell adhesion molecule binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell adhesion and extracellular matrix organization. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix and extracellular space. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: auxilin
Description: auxilin (aux) encodes a co-factor for the ATPase Hsc70 that regulates Clathrin dynamics. It regulates Notch signaling, eye morphogenesis, sperm individualization and neuron death.

Name: Symplekin
Description: Symplekin (Sym) encodes a large protein that contains many protein interaction sites, and acts as a scaffold for protein complexes in the nucleus. It functions in RNA 3' end formation for both polyadenyated mRNAs and non-polyadenylated histone mRNAs. In some cells it also localizes to the cell cortex, especially the tricellular junctions of some epithelia.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; adenylate cyclase-inhibiting G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; and cAMP biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human ADCY2 (adenylate cyclase 2) and ADCY7 (adenylate cyclase 7).

Name: Ras GTPase activating protein 1
Description: Inhibitory regulator of the Ras-cyclic AMP pathway. May function as a negative regulator of Ras85D/Ras1 in the sev signaling pathway. Acts cell autonomously in cone cell precursors as a negative regulator of R7 photoreceptor cell determination. (UniProtKB:P48423)

Name: Guanylyl cyclase at 32E
Description: Predicted to enable guanylate cyclase activity and peptide receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in cGMP biosynthetic process; cGMP-mediated signaling; and receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling pathway. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; egg chamber; germarium; nurse cell; and organism.

Name: pancreatic eIF-2alpha kinase
Description: pancreatic eIF-2alpha kinase (PEK) encodes an endoplasmic reticulum (ER) transmembrane kinase and a component of the integrated stress response. During ER stress the product of PEK phosphorylates the translation initiation factor encoded by eIF2alpha resulting in the inhibition of most cap-dependent translation. This is especially important during the development of secretory tissues and the response to cellular stress.

Name: enhanced level of genomic instability 1
Description: Has an important role in DNA replication and in maintaining genome integrity during replication stress (By similarity). Promotes PCNA deubiquitination (By similarity). As component of the Elg1 RFC-like complex, regulates the functions of the DNA polymerase processivity factor PCNA by unloading it from DNA after replication during the S phase of the cell cycle (PubMed:27198229). The PCNA-unloading might be regulated via interaction with the Enok acetyltransferase complex (PubMed:27198229). Might have a role in restarting of stalled/regressed replication forks during replication stress (By similarity). In the ovaries, has a role in nurse cell endoreplication (PubMed:27198229). (UniProtKB:Q86BP6)

Name: pico
Description: pico (pico) encodes an intracellular adapter protein belonging to the MRL family of proteins, which transduce signals from growth factor receptors to changes in the actin cytoskeleton. Its roles include the regulation of growth and cell migration.

Name: Adenylyl cyclase X D
Description: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; adenylate cyclase-inhibiting G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; and cAMP biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval midgut; germline cell; and gonad. Orthologous to human ADCY2 (adenylate cyclase 2) and ADCY7 (adenylate cyclase 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable beta-tubulin binding activity and microtubule binding activity. Is expressed in spermatogonium. Orthologous to human DNAI7 (dynein axonemal intermediate chain 7).

Name: slipper
Description: Activates the JUN N-terminal pathway during dorsal closure. (UniProtKB:Q95UN8)

Name: lethal (2) giant larvae
Description: lethal (2) giant larvae (l(2)gl) encodes a tumor suppressor protein that regulates cell polarity and asymmetric cell division. It acts on the basolateral side of epithelial cells, antagonizing the activity of apical complex proteins encoded by baz, par-6 and aPKC.

Name: Aftiphilin
Description: Aftiphilin (Afti) encodes an AP-1 adaptor complex binding protein involved in eye photoreceptor development and intracellular transport.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanylate cyclase activity and peptide receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in cGMP biosynthetic process; cGMP-mediated signaling; and receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling pathway. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: ruby
Description: ruby (rb) encodes  the beta3-adaptin subunit of the Adaptor protein-3 (AP-3) complex involved in biogenesis of lysosome-related organelles. It is required for regulation of lipid storage, eye pigment biogenesis and the processing of the receptor encoded by N.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in monocarboxylic acid transport. Predicted to be active in membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTP binding activity; GTPase activity; and U3 snoRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in endonucleolytic cleavage of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of 90S preribosome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nonsyndromic aplasia cutis congenita. Orthologous to human BMS1 (BMS1 ribosome biogenesis factor).

Name: Neuroligin 3
Description: Neuroligin 3 (Nlg3) encodes a synaptic adhesion molecule involved in synapse formation and synaptic transmission.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic proventriculus and head mesoderm.

Name: weary
Description: weary (wry) encodes a ligand for the receptor encoded by N. It is involved in the Notch signaling pathway and normal heart function.

Name: Cyclin-dependent kinase 12
Description: Cyclin-dependent kinase which displays CTD kinase activity: hyperphosphorylates the C-terminal heptapeptide repeat domain (CTD) of the largest RNA polymerase II subunit, thereby acting as a key regulator of transcription elongation. (UniProtKB:Q9VP22)

Name: hu li tai shao
Description: hu li tai shao (hts) encodes an adducin homolog that is associated with the plasma membrane cytoskeleton, fusome and oocyte ring canals. It has essential functions in muscle, nerve and other tissues, and is required for fertility in males and females.

Name: 2mit
Description: 2mit (2mit) encodes a putative leucine-rich repeat transmembrane protein that is mainly expressed in the developing central nervous system. In the adult, it has a role in short-term memory.

Name: ArfGAP with SH3 domain, ankyrin repeat and PH domain
Description: ArfGAP with SH3 domain, ankyrin repeat and PH domain (Asap) encodes a GTPase activating proteins for Arf family GTPases. Arf proteins regulate actin dynamics, cell shape, and cell positioning within epithelia such as the eye.

Name: trabuco
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Involved in protein secretion. Located in endoplasmic reticulum exit site. Orthologous to human SGSM1 (small G protein signaling modulator 1) and SGSM2 (small G protein signaling modulator 2).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG18368 (FBgn0033864). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:13667736..13671594. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages, in adult male stages.

Name: Related to Sod
Description: Predicted to enable metal ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in superoxide metabolic process. Is expressed in early extended germ band embryo; foregut; foregut primordium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: staccato
Description: Essential for tracheal development in embryos. Functions with the GTPase Rab39 and downstream of dnd, to regulate lumen fusion between previously separate tracheal branches (anastomosis). Essential component of secretory lysosome-related organelles (SLs) that are present in the tracheal fusion tip cells (FCs). Mediates intracellular fusion of the extending tracheal stalk cell lumen in the FCs by recruiting the SNARE complex component Syx1A to the SLs, this may then enable the SLs to interact with complementary SNAREs (such as Syb) present in the apical membrane of the FC-FC interface and the membranes of the separate tracheal stalk cells. May also function in the maturation and exocytosis of the SLs. (UniProtKB:Q9VBY8)

Name: MEP-1
Description: MEP-1 (MEP-1) encodes a zinc finger protein that associates with the ATP-dependent nucleosome remodeler encoded by Mi-2. It cooperates with the product of Mi-2 in the repression of cell type-specific genes.

Name: Liprin-gamma
Description: Liprin-gamma (Liprin-gamma) encodes an adaptor protein that counteracts the functions of the product of Liprin-alpha in photoreceptor axon targeting and the product of Liprin-beta in neuromuscular junction development, potentially through competition for binding partners.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatogonium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 51. Orthologous to human CFAP91 (cilia and flagella associated protein 91).

Name: Biorientation Defective 1
Description: Involved in nonassociative learning and synaptic assembly at neuromuscular junction. Is expressed in embryonic/larval salivary gland and organism. Used to study intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including BOD1 (biorientation of chromosomes in cell division 1) and BOD1L2 (biorientation of chromosomes in cell division 1 like 2).

Name: Ctr9
Description: Ctr9 (Ctr9) encodes a highly conserved member of the polymerase-associated factor 1 complex, which controls a number of transcriptional and epigenetic processes. It is involved in the proliferation and terminal differentiation of the central nervous system.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Fl(2)d-associated complex component
Description: Associated component of the WMM complex, a complex that mediates N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methylation of mRNAs, a modification that plays a role in the efficiency of mRNA splicing and is required for sex determination (PubMed:29535189, PubMed:29555755). In the WMM complex, acts as a key regulator of m6A methylation by bridging fl(2)d to the RNA-binding component nito (PubMed:29535189). Required for sex determination and dosage compensation via Sxl alternative splicing: m6A methylation acts as a key regulator of Sxl pre-mRNA and promotes female-specific alternative splicing of Sxl, which determines female physiognomy (PubMed:29535189, PubMed:29555755). (UniProtKB:Q9VWN4)

Name: datilografo
Description: datilografo (dati) encodes a conserved zinc finger transcription factor required for the differentiation of neurons in the ventral nerve cord and the brain. In adult brains, the product of dati is required in cholinergic neurons to generate the decisions of accepting or rejecting male courtship.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable histone binding activity and transcription corepressor activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription; nucleosome assembly; and regulation of apoptotic process. Predicted to be active in PML body. Is expressed in spermatozoon; wing hinge primordium; and wing pouch.

Name: Nardilysin
Description: Nardilysin (Nrd1) encodes a protein involved in chaperone-mediated protein folding.

Name: spindle defective 2
Description: spindle defective 2 (spd-2) encodes a centriole and centrosome protein that is primarily involved in centrosome assembly. Together with the product of cnn, it helps to assemble a "scaffold" around the mother centriole that can recruit other centrosomal proteins to the centrosome during mitosis.

Name: multiple edematous wings
Description: multiple edematous wings (mew) encodes one of 5 fly integrin alpha subunits, and when in a heterodimer with an integrin beta subunit makes a receptor for the extracellular matrix protein laminin. It is required in numerous tissues for cell migration, adhesion between cell layers, and cell differentiation.

Name: mutagen-sensitive 312
Description: mutagen-sensitive 312 (mus312) is a scaffolding protein that interacts with at least three structure-selective endonucleases (encoded by mei-9-Ercc1, mus81-mms4, and slx1). It is involved in DNA repair and meiotic recombination pathways.

Name: Shal Interactor of Di-Leucine Motif
Description: May play a role in vesicular transport from endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi (By similarity). Has a role in one of the several mechanisms underlying dendritic localization of Shal channels. (UniProtKB:Q9VFB7)

Name: DNA polymerase gamma subunit 1
Description: DNA polymerase gamma subunit 1 (PolG1) encodes the catalytic subunit of mitocondrial DNA polymerase gamma, which is responsible for the replication and repair of the mitochondrial genome.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG15599 (FBgn0030667). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:15684947..15688857. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-06 hour embryonic stages, in adult female stages.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5B
Description: Predicted to enable translation initiation factor activity. Predicted to be involved in translational initiation. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in adult brain cell body rind and adult head. Orthologous to human EIF5B (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5B).

Name: spermathreecae
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation and regulation of endocytic recycling. Predicted to be active in clathrin-coated endocytic vesicle and early endosome. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human INPP5F (inositol polyphosphate-5-phosphatase F).

Name: Lk6 kinase
Description: Lk6 kinase (Lk6) encodes the single ortholog of MAPK signal integrating kinases, which are phosphorylated and activated by ERK. Lk6 product phosphorylates the protein encoded by eIF4E1 to influence translation initiation via formation of the eIF4F complex.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carbohydrate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in calcium-dependent cell-cell adhesion via plasma membrane cell adhesion molecules. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including IgA glomerulonephritis; artery disease (multiple); atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome; autoimmune disease (multiple); and hemolytic-uremic syndrome. Orthologous to human CD46 (CD46 molecule); APOH (apolipoprotein H); and SELL (selectin L).

Name: Eps15 homology domain containing protein-binding protein 1
Description: Eps15 homology domain containing protein-binding protein 1 (Ehbp1) encodes a protein that mediates asymmetric protein secretion. It regulates the trafficking and secretion of distinct Notch signaling components and extracellular membrane proteins.

Name: piccolo
Description: piccolo (pic) encodes the Ddb1 protein, which functions to recruit substrate receptors to Cul4-based E3 ubiquitin ligase complexes, which catalyze the ubiquitylation and subsequent destruction of proteins that function in cell growth and proliferation as well as transcription, replication and repair of the genome.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit a
Description: RNA-binding component of the eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 (eIF-3) complex, which is involved in protein synthesis of a specialized repertoire of mRNAs and, together with other initiation factors, stimulates binding of mRNA and methionyl-tRNAi to the 40S ribosome. The eIF-3 complex specifically targets and initiates translation of a subset of mRNAs involved in cell proliferation. (UniProtKB:Q9VN25)

Name: Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial (AspRS-m) encodes a protein predicted to function within mitochondria to catalyze the ligation of aspartate to its cognate tRNA to form aspartyl-tRNA.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, nonsense-mediated decay. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human DHX34 (DExH-box helicase 34).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in several processes, including microtubule organizing center organization; neuron migration; and tube formation. Predicted to be active in centriole and centrosome. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic head sensory system; extended germ band embryo; and sensory nervous system primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Bardet-Biedl syndrome 16 and Senior-Loken syndrome. Orthologous to human SDCCAG8 (SHH signaling and ciliogenesis regulator SDCCAG8).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG9902 (FBgn0030757). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:16542124..16547520. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed during early pupal stages.

Name: RNA polymerase III subunit B
Description: RNA polymerase III subunit B (Polr3B) encodes one of the subunits that forms the multi-protein RNA Polymerase III holoenzyme. RNA Polymerase III transcribes several types of small non-coding RNAs in the nuclear genome including tRNAs and 5SrRNA.

Name: thawb
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable tRNA (guanine) methyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in tRNA methylation. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human TARBP1 (TAR (HIV-1) RNA binding protein 1).

Name: Utx histone demethylase
Description: Utx histone demethylase (Utx) encodes a Jumonji C containing protein that catalyzes the removal of methyl groups from Histone H3 lysine 27. Together with the products of trr and Lpt, it is thought to regulate chromatin structure at transcriptional enhancers.

Name: stall
Description: stall (stl) encodes a protein involved in neuron migration inhibition and ovarian follicle development.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region.

Name: Phosphatase 1 nuclear targeting subunit
Description: Phosphatase 1 nuclear targeting subunit (PNUTS) encodes a protein phosphatase 1 binding protein involved in developmental growth and gene expression.

Name: GRIP and coiled-coil domain containing 185 kDa
Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein localization to Golgi apparatus and retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi. Located in Golgi trans cisterna. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human GCC2 (GRIP and coiled-coil domain containing 2).

Name: dilatory
Description: Cilium-specific protein with a role in cilium/flagellum formation (PubMed:21750193, PubMed:27646273). May be involved in transport of components into the growing cilium (PubMed:21750193). In germ cells and sensory neurons, plays a role with Cby in the building of the transition zone necessary for the formation of the ciliary cap and for the correct elongation of the axoneme (PubMed:27646273). (UniProtKB:A1Z7Z9)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in embryonic/larval central nervous system; eye disc; larval caeca region; photoreceptor neurons; and ring gland.

Name: MYB binding protein 1a
Description: Has a role in rRNA biogenesis, cell proliferation and tissue growth by contributing to the localization of nclb to the nucleolus. (UniProtKB:Q9W5E4)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metallocarboxypeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in embryonic dorsal epidermis; embryonic head epidermis; and embryonic ventral epidermis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial febrile seizures 11 and familial temporal lobe epilepsy 5. Orthologous to human CPA6 (carboxypeptidase A6).

Name: missing minor mitochondria
Description: missing minor mitochondria (mmm) encodes a component of the flagellar axoneme that is also involved in the formation or maintenance of the minor mitochondrial derivative during spermatogenesis. It is required for completion of ciliogenesis and results in male sterility with immotile flagella when mutated.

Name: Reduction in Cnn dots 1
Description: Reduction in Cnn dots 1 (Rcd1) encodes a protein involved in centriole replication and transcription regulation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Predicted to be part of kinesin complex. Predicted to be active in microtubule. Orthologous to human KIF26A (kinesin family member 26A) and KIF26B (kinesin family member 26B).

Name: Adenylyl cyclase X C
Description: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity. Involved in spermatogenesis. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in organism; spermatid; and spermatocyte. Orthologous to human ADCY7 (adenylate cyclase 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval midgut; extended germ band embryo; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human ZNF316 (zinc finger protein 316) and ZNF787 (zinc finger protein 787).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable actin binding activity and phospholipid binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell projection assembly and membrane organization. Predicted to be active in actin cytoskeleton and cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane. Is expressed in wing hinge primordium and wing pouch.

Name: Ubiquitin-specific protease 7
Description: Hydrolase that deubiquitinates target proteins. (UniProtKB:Q9VYQ8)

Name: RNA polymerase I subunit B
Description: DNA-dependent RNA polymerase catalyzes the transcription of DNA into RNA using the four ribonucleoside triphosphates as substrates. Second largest core component of RNA polymerase I which synthesizes ribosomal RNA precursors. Proposed to contribute to the polymerase catalytic activity and forms the polymerase active center together with the largest subunit. Pol I is composed of mobile elements and RPA2 is part of the core element with the central large cleft and probably a clamp element that moves to open and close the cleft (By similarity). (UniProtKB:P20028)

Name: Transient receptor potential cation channel gamma
Description: A light-sensitive calcium channel that is required for inositide-mediated Ca(2+) entry in the retina during phospholipase C (PLC)-mediated phototransduction (By similarity). Forms a regulated cation channel when heteromultimerized with trpl. (UniProtKB:Q9VJJ7)

Name: Stromalin 1
Description: Stromalin 1 (SA1) encodes a subunit of the cohesin ring complex, which encircles sister chromatids after DNA replication and has multiple roles in the regulation of gene expression and DNA repair.

Name: HEM-protein
Description: HEM-protein (Hem) encodes a component of the WAVE Regulatory Complex. Hem product regulates processes such as neuronal migration and asymmetric division of neural precursors by inhibiting the product of SCAR degradation. In the asymmetric process, the Hem-pathway indirectly maintains proper localization of proteins such as those encoded by insc and numb.

Name: Ubiquitin specific protease 16/45
Description: Predicted to enable cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity and cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein deubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leber congenital amaurosis 19. Orthologous to several human genes including USP45 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 45).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to contribute to cation channel activity. Predicted to be involved in calcium ion transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloaminopeptidase activity; peptide binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in peptide catabolic process and proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cervix carcinoma and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human ERAP1 (endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 1); ERAP2 (endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 2); and LNPEP (leucyl and cystinyl aminopeptidase).

Name: Toll-4
Description: Toll-4 (Toll-4) encodes a putative transmembrane protein related to Toll by virtue of containing intracellular TIR domain and extracellular Leucine-rich repeats. It is expressed in the apical part of the embryonic lymph gland precursors.

Name: Huntingtin interacting protein 1
Description: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity; anion binding activity; and clathrin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in actin filament organization; clathrin coat assembly; and endocytosis. Predicted to be active in clathrin-coated vesicle. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human HIP1 (huntingtin interacting protein 1) and HIP1R (huntingtin interacting protein 1 related).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metal ion binding activity. Involved in embryonic morphogenesis; endocytosis; and epithelial cell morphogenesis. Located in vacuole. Is expressed in adult head; head mesoderm; organism; trunk mesoderm; and ventral ectoderm. Orthologous to human ANKFY1 (ankyrin repeat and FYVE domain containing 1).

Name: transient receptor potential-like
Description: transient receptor potential-like (trpl) encodes a non-selective plasma membrane cation channel with modest Ca[2+] permeability. It is highly eye-enriched and contributes to the electrical response to light in photoreceptors.

Name: inactive
Description: inactive (iav) encodes a protein involved in the response to different stimuli such as startle, heat or sound.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in several structures, including endoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; nervous system; and sensory nervous system primordium. Orthologous to several human genes including TCERG1 (transcription elongation regulator 1).

Name: Adenylyl cyclase X E
Description: Catalyzes the formation of the signaling molecule cAMP in response to G-protein signaling. (UniProtKB:Q9VK50)

Name: stuxnet
Description: stuxnet (stx) encodes a protein that controls the homeostasis of the product of Pc via proteasomal degradation through an ubiquitin-independent pathway.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables ubiquitin conjugating enzyme binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein polyubiquitination and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process.
