Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human UBE3C (ubiquitin protein ligase E3C).

Name: milton
Description: Required for kinesin-mediated axonal transport of mitochondria to nerve terminals (PubMed:12495622, PubMed:16887820, PubMed:16717129). The oocyte acquires the majority of its mitochondria by competitive bidirectional transport along microtubules mediated by the Milton adapter. Mitochondria enter the young oocyte en mass from interconnected germ cells to generate the large aggregate known as the Balbiani body (PubMed:16887820). Milt and Miro form an essential protein complex that links Khc to mitochondria for light chain-independent, anterograde transport of mitochondria (PubMed:16717129). (UniProtKB:Q960V3)

Name: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 6
Description: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 6 (SMC6) encodes a subunit of the SMC5/6 protein complex. It is involved genotoxic stress and response to caffeine.

Name: rudhira
Description: rudhira (rudhira) is expressed in nephrocytes and encodes a protein that regulates macromolecular uptake and clearance by nephrocytes to maintain tissue homeostasis.

Name: nebbish
Description: nebbish (neb) encodes a microtubule motor protein that interacts with PP1 phosphatases and is involved in chromosome segregation.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in tRNA methylation.

Name: Mondo
Description: Mondo (Mondo) encodes a basic helix-loop-helix-leucine zipper transcription factor involved in lipid and carbohydrate metabolism. Together with its binding partner encoded by bigmax, it controls sugar-dependent gene expression, including activation of genes involved in lipogenesis. Mondo mutants are intolerant to dietary sugars and have impaired muscle function.

Name: Phosphodiesterase 6
Description: Hydrolyzes the second messenger cGMP, which is a key regulator of many important physiological processes (PubMed:15673286). Has cAMP phosphodiesterase activity in vitro but not in vivo (PubMed:15673286). Has a role regulating cGMP transport in Malpighian tubule principal cells (PubMed:16232123). (UniProtKB:Q9VFI9)

Name: snazarus
Description: snazarus (snz) encodes a sorting nexin protein involved in lifespan.

Name: cup
Description: Adapter protein that plays a central role in localization of transcripts in the oocyte and in young embryos (PubMed:9118812). Maintains RNA targets in a repressed state by promoting their deadenylation and protects deadenylated mRNAs from further degradation (PubMed:21937713). Binds to and recruits eIF-4E to the 3'-UTR of some mRNA targets which prevents interaction between eIF4E1 and eIF4G (PubMed:14685270, PubMed:15465908, PubMed:21081899). This may contribute to translational repression but does not appear to be necessary for it to occur (PubMed:21081899). Can promote translational repression independently of deadenylation and eIF4E1 binding (PubMed:21937713). Required for correct localization of eIF4E1 in the developing oocyte (PubMed:15465908). Required for translational repression of oskar (osk) mRNA (PubMed:14691132, PubMed:14723848). Also required for the translational repression of nanos (nos) mRNA (PubMed:21081899). Promotes the accumulation of the germ plasm components osk, vas and stau at the posterior pole of the oocyte and is required for germ cell development (PubMed:22454519, PubMed:17277377). Represses orb positive autoregulatory activity which prevents premature activation of orb and ensures its accumulation specifically in the developing oocyte (PubMed:22164257). In 0-1 hour embryos, forms a complex with me31B, cup, tral and pAbp which binds to various mRNAs including maternal mRNAs, and down-regulates their expression during the maternal-to-zygotic transition (PubMed:28875934). (UniProtKB:Q9VMA3)

Name: RING-associated factor 2
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Part of PcG protein complex. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: scab
Description: scab (scb) encodes the alpha-PS3 Integrin, believed to dimerise with mys and possibly Itgbn. It regulates adhesion, signalling, polarity and cell migration. Genetic interaction with Laminin genes implicates them as extracellular matrix ligands.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm.

Name: Sulfated
Description: Sulfated (Sulf1) encodes a heparan sulfate modifying enzyme, which extracellularly removes specific 6-O-sulfate groups from heparan sulfate in a post-synthetic manner. It regulates Wg signaling by reducing extracellular wg protein levels. It also regulates Hh signaling by acting as a positive regulator in cells producing the product of hh and a negative regulator in cells receiving the product of hh.

Name: Adenylyl cyclase X B
Description: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity. Involved in spermatogenesis. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; organism; pre-elongation spermatid; and spermatocyte. Orthologous to human ADCY2 (adenylate cyclase 2) and ADCY7 (adenylate cyclase 7).

Name: Sterol regulatory element binding protein
Description: Sterol regulatory element binding protein (SREBP) encodes a membrane protein that functions as a master-regulator of lipogenesis. It activates transcription of lipogenic genes upon reduction of lipid or cholesterol levels.

Name: ATP citrate lyase
Description: ATP citrate lyase (ATPCL) encodes a protein involved in glucose homeostasis.

Name: Adenylyl cyclase X A
Description: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity. Involved in spermatogenesis. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; organism; pre-elongation spermatid; and spermatocyte. Orthologous to human ADCY2 (adenylate cyclase 2) and ADCY7 (adenylate cyclase 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity. Involved in chaeta development and notum development. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and larval ventral nerve cord.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human WDR44 (WD repeat domain 44).

Name: argus
Description: argus (aus) encodes a protein required for one or more steps of mature autophagosome degradation. Loss of its autophagy function results in sleep loss.

Name: alpha-Mannosidase class II a
Description: Catalyzes the first committed step in the biosynthesis of complex N-glycans. It controls conversion of high mannose to complex N-glycans; the final hydrolytic step in the N-glycan maturation pathway (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q24451)

Name: cornetto
Description: cornetto (corn) encodes a microtubule binding protein involved in exocytosis regulation.

Name: Golgi complex-localized glycoprotein 1
Description: Predicted to enable fibroblast growth factor binding activity. Located in Golgi apparatus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; endoderm; and wing disc. Orthologous to human GLG1 (golgi glycoprotein 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA adenylyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA stabilization. Located in cytosol and nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval garland cell; embryonic/larval salivary gland; extended germ band embryo; and ventral ectoderm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lung non-small cell carcinoma; osteoarthritis; and osteogenesis imperfecta type 18. Orthologous to several human genes including TENT5A (terminal nucleotidyltransferase 5A); TENT5B (terminal nucleotidyltransferase 5B); and TENT5C (terminal nucleotidyltransferase 5C).

Name: B4
Description: B4 (B4) encodes a protein involved in imaginal disc development.

Name: shuttle craft
Description: shuttle craft (stc) encodes a zinc finger transcription factor of the NFX1 family. Maternally contributed protein is essential for segmentation. During the late stages of embryonic neurogenesis, zygotically expressed stc product is involved in axon guidance, which is vital for proper muscle innervation. stc expression in the embryo is important for the adult life span and aging.

Name: warts
Description: warts (wts) encodes a tumor suppressor kinase in the Hippo pathway involved in the control of tissue growth. It also plays a post-mitotic role in R8 photoreceptor cells where it antagonizes the product of melt to control the bistable choice of Rhodospin expression.

Name: Karyopherin beta 3
Description: Predicted to enable nuclear import signal receptor activity and nuclear localization sequence binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into nucleus. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to human RANBP6 (RAN binding protein 6) and IPO5 (importin 5).

Name: brother of ihog
Description: brother of ihog (boi) encodes a transmembrane protein that binds to the product of hh. The products of boi and ihog promote Hh signaling in receiving cells by acting as a co-receptor for the effector protein encoded by ptc. The product of boi also can suppress Hh signaling through a sequestration and release mechanism in cells producing the product of hh. It regulates many hh-dependent processes including proliferation, cell fate specification, and patterning.

Name: Integrator 2
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). Involved in the 3'-end processing of the U7 snRNA, and also the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). May mediate recruitment of cytoplasmic dynein to the nuclear envelope, probably as component of the INT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VX31)

Name: Oxoglutarate dehydrogenase
Description: Predicted to enable oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (succinyl-transferring) activity. Predicted to be involved in 2-oxoglutarate metabolic process and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Predicted to be part of oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; foregut primordium; germ layer; and spermatozoon. Used to study neurodegenerative disease. Orthologous to several human genes including OGDH (oxoglutarate dehydrogenase).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable beta-tubulin binding activity and microtubule binding activity. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable dipeptidyl-peptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Orthologous to human DPP8 (dipeptidyl peptidase 8) and DPP9 (dipeptidyl peptidase 9).

Name: sol narae
Description: sol narae (sona) encodes a member of the ADAMTS family of proteases secreted to the extracellular matrix. It is involved in Wg signaling by promoting the secretion of the product of wg, and is essential for development and growth.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in recombination-dependent repair of stalled or collapsed replication forks. (UniProtKB:O46089)

Name: Strumpellin and WASH-interacting protein
Description: Strumpellin and WASH-interacting protein (SWIP) encodes a protein that is part of the multi-subunit WASH regulatory complex (SHRC) to activate Arp2/3-mediated actin nucleation in a context-dependent manner. The product of SWIP, along with the SHRC, has been found to play a role in actin architecture and ooplasmic streaming during oogenesis, in endosome recycling, and in integrin-mediated cell spreading of hemocytes.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin conjugating enzyme binding activity; ubiquitin protein ligase activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process; protein polyubiquitination; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be part of ubiquitin ligase complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic proventriculus; embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human RNF144A (ring finger protein 144A) and RNF144B (ring finger protein 144B).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable beta-tubulin binding activity and microtubule binding activity. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: DNA replication helicase/nuclease 2
Description: Predicted to enable 5'-3' DNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA replication, Okazaki fragment processing. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon.

Name: Tsc1
Description: Tsc1 (Tsc1) encodes a tumour suppressor protein that forms a complex with the product of gig. They control cellular growth via antagonizing insulin and TOR signalling pathways.

Name: subdued
Description: subdued (subdued) encodes a chloride ion channel activated by calcium and heat belonging to the TMEM16 family. Its roles include host defense against ingested pathogenic bacteria and modulation of sensory neuronal signaling.

Name: Bub1 kinase
Description: Bub1 kinase (Bub1) encodes a spindle checkpoint protein regulating chromosome congression. It also contributes to clathrin-dependent endocytosis of pathogens.

Name: N/A
Description: CG8155 encodes a Rab GTPase activator of the Rab signaling pathway. It's involved in border follicle cell migration, regulation of GTPase activity, intracellular trafficking of vesicles and determination of lifespan.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable dipeptidyl-peptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 33; and spinal muscular atrophy. Orthologous to human DPP6 (dipeptidyl peptidase like 6).

Name: Ranbp16
Description: May function as a nuclear transport receptor. (UniProtKB:Q9GQN0)

Name: Cyclin T
Description: Regulatory subunit of the cyclin-dependent kinase pair (CDK9/cyclin T) complex, also called positive transcription elongation factor B (P-TEFb), which is proposed to facilitate the transition from abortive to production elongation by phosphorylating the CTD (carboxy-terminal domain) of the large subunit of RNA polymerase II (RNAP II). (UniProtKB:O96433)

Name: Toll
Description: Toll (Tl) encodes a transmembrane receptor that activates the Tl intracellular signaling pathway upon binding the ligand encoded by spz. It is involved in dorso-ventral embryonic patterning and immunity.

Name: Guanylyl cyclase at 88E
Description: Guanylyl cyclase at 88E (Gyc88E) encodes an atypical soluble guanylyl cyclase. It forms heterodimers with the products of Gyc89Da or Gyc89Db to form an oxygen-sensitive soluble guanylyl cyclase, which likely functions as a neuronal oxygen detector, activated at reduced oxygen levels.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG43691 (FBgn0263774). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:13389495..13393361. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported.

Name: Centrosomal protein 190kD
Description: Centrosomal protein 190kD (Cp190) encodes a C2H2 zinc finger transcription factor which binds to most boundaries of contact domains, defined by enhanced internal contact frequencies. Cp190 is required to form most contact domain boundaries that are distal to a transcribed promoter, is essential for early development, and prevents regulatory cross-talk between specific gene loci that pattern the embryo.

Name: Eph receptor tyrosine kinase
Description: Eph receptor tyrosine kinase (Eph) encodes an axon guidance molecule involved in the development of the nervous system. It also contributes to shaping the antero-posterior compartment boundary of the wing disc.

Name: no receptor potential A
Description: The production of the second messenger molecules diacylglycerol (DAG) and inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate (IP3) is mediated by activated phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase C enzymes (By similarity). Essential component of the phototransduction pathway (PubMed:2457447). Essential downstream component of a hh-signaling pathway which regulates the Duox-dependent gut immune response to bacterial uracil; required for the activation of Cad99C and consequently Cad99C-dependent endosome formation, which is essential for the Duox-dependent production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in response to intestinal bacterial infection (PubMed:25639794). (UniProtKB:P13217)

Name: PIH1 domain containing 1
Description: Is expressed in adult head; organism; and spermatozoon.

Name: split discs
Description: Involved in adult somatic muscle development; imaginal disc development; and sarcomere organization. Predicted to be part of filamentous actin. Predicted to be active in microtubule organizing center. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Teebi hypertelorism syndrome 1 and oblique facial clefting 1. Orthologous to several human genes including SPECC1L (sperm antigen with calponin homology and coiled-coil domains 1 like).

Name: N/A
Description: Phosphorylase b kinase catalyzes the phosphorylation of serine in certain substrates, including troponin I. The beta chain acts as a regulatory unit and modulates the activity of the holoenzyme in response to phosphorylation (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VLS1)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG6280 (FBgn0033866). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:13753964..13758971. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages.

Name: Semaphorin 5c
Description: Semaphorin 5c (Sema5c) encodes a member of the Semaphorins family, which are membrane and secreted short-range signaling proteins. The product of Sema5c is involved in olfactory behavior.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital stationary night blindness 1E. Orthologous to human GPR158 (G protein-coupled receptor 158) and GPR179 (G protein-coupled receptor 179).

Name: Grip128
Description: Grip128 (Grip128) encodes a component of the Gamma-tubulin ring complex, which is a potent microtubule nucleator in eukaryotic cells essential for successful chromosome segregation and cell division.

Name: DNA polymerase delta subunit 1
Description: As the catalytic component of the DNA polymerase delta complex, plays a crucial role in high fidelity genome replication, including lagging strand synthesis, DNA recombination and repair (By similarity). Exhibits both DNA polymerase and 3'- to 5'-exonuclease activities (PubMed:7907087, PubMed:8415662, PubMed:1360647). Required at the nucleus of rapidly dividing embryonic cells to activate genome replication during the earliest cell cycles (PubMed:31100062). Likely to require the presence of accessory proteins PolD2 and PolD3 for full activity (PubMed:31100062). (UniProtKB:P54358)

Name: convoluted
Description: convoluted (conv) encodes a leucine-rich repeat protein involved in axon guidance and the development of the tracheal system.

Name: diaphanous
Description: diaphanous (dia) encodes the sole Dia-class formin in Drosophila. It nucleates actin filaments de novo and acts as a processive actin polymerase, stimulating actin addition at the barbed end. It plays an essential role in cytokinesis and also regulates cell shape change and protrusion.

Name: Lipin
Description: Lipin (Lpin) encodes a protein that plays a central role in fat body function and energy metabolism. It works as a phosphatidate phosphatase required for normal insulin pathway signaling.

Name: Phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase 92E
Description: Pi3K92E (Pi3K92E) encodes the catalytic subunit of a class I phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase that functions downstream of the product of InR and other receptors during several processes, including cell and tissue growth.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly. Predicted to be located in centrosome. Predicted to be active in cilium and microtubule. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human CCDC66 (coiled-coil domain containing 66).

Name: foraging
Description: foraging (for) encodes a serine/threonine kinase and a member of the protein kinase G family. For roles include feeding, locomotion, metabolism, development, olfactory habituation, learning and memory, stress, social behavior, as well as Malpighian tubule, heart, muscle and synaptic function.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables serine hydrolase activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 8. Orthologous to human LIPK (lipase family member K); LIPM (lipase family member M); and LIPN (lipase family member N).

Name: sidestep VI
Description: Is expressed in A1-7 ventral longitudinal muscle cell; adult head; and embryonic/larval nervous system.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and adult heart.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG15865 (FBgn0015336). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:16660898..16664455. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period.

Name: Ataxin-2
Description: Ataxin-2 (Atx2) encodes the ortholog of human gene ATXN2, which is implicated in spinocerebellar ataxia 2. It contributes to eye development, circadian behaviour, and microRNA function.

Name: NMDA receptor 2
Description: voltage/Mg-dependent Ca channels activated by glutamate - required for olfactory learning

Name: dre4
Description: dre4 (dre4) encodes a chromatin regulator that, along with the product of Ssrp, forms the facilitates chromatin transcription (FACT) protein complex. FACT facilitates GAGA factor-directed chromatin remodeling.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in wing hinge primordium and wing pouch.

Name: onecut
Description: onecut (onecut) encodes a transcription factor that binds two different DNA motifs (Cut and Hox). It is mainly expressed in mature neurons and maintains neuronal identity.

Name: dachshund
Description: dachshund (dac) encodes a transcriptional cofactor that physically interacts with several other retinal determination proteins, including those encoded by eya and so, and regulates eye, leg, gonad, and brain development.

Name: Lysosomal alpha-mannosidase II
Description: Lysosomal alpha-mannosidase II (LManII) encodes a mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,2-alpha-mannosidase involved in the degradation of asparagine-linked carbohydrates of glycoproteins.

Name: headcase
Description: headcase (heca) encodes two proteins by translational readthrough of a single mRNA. It is an esg target in the trachea and presumably also in imaginal tissues. The readthrough product is necessary for heca function in the trachea.

Name: Artemis
Description: Predicted to enable nuclear import signal receptor activity and nuclear localization sequence binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into nucleus. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head; organism; ovary; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human IPO4 (importin 4).

Name: Telo2 interacting protein 1
Description: Predicted to be involved in chromatin remodeling. Predicted to be part of ASTRA complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human TTI1 (TELO2 interacting protein 1).

Name: Apollo
Description: Predicted to enable nuclear import signal receptor activity and nuclear localization sequence binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into nucleus. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in organism and testis. Orthologous to human IPO4 (importin 4).

Name: Shal K[+] channel interacting protein
Description: Involved in sensory perception of smell. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; inclusive hindgut primordium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria. Orthologous to human SASH1 (SAM and SH3 domain containing 1) and SAMD5 (sterile alpha motif domain containing 5).

Name: sterile affecting ciliogenesis
Description: sterile affecting ciliogenesis (sac) encodes a component of the flagellar axoneme that is required for ciliogenesis and cytokinesis during spermatogenesis. When mutated, it results in male sterility with immotile flagella and disrupted localization of subcellular structures.

Name: Spt5
Description: Component of the DRB sensitivity-inducing factor complex (DSIF complex), which regulates transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. DSIF enhances transcriptional pausing at sites proximal to the promoter, which may facilitate the assembly of an elongation competent RNA polymerase II complex. DSIF may also promote transcriptional elongation within coding regions. DSIF is required for the transcriptional induction of heat shock response genes and regulation of genes which control anterior-posterior patterning during embryonic development. (UniProtKB:Q9V460)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein polyubiquitination and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic anal pad; embryonic hindgut; embryonic large intestine; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Kaufman oculocerebrofacial syndrome. Orthologous to human UBE3B (ubiquitin protein ligase E3B).

Name: Ubiquitin specific protease 1
Description: Predicted to enable cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity and cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein deubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human USP1 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 1).

Name: Hairless
Description: Hairless (H) encodes the major antagonist of Notch signaling activity during imaginal development. It silences target genes of the product of N by assembling a transcriptional repressor complex, which includes the transcription factor encoded by Su(H) and general co-repressors like those encoded by gro and CtBP.

Name: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class O
Description: Predicted to enable mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in GPI anchor biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human PIGO (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class O).

Name: kazachoc
Description: kazachoc (kcc) encodes a potassium:chloride symporter that contributes to seizure susceptibility.

Name: Gp150
Description: Gp150 (Gp150) encodes a transmembrane glycoprotein that regulates Notch signaling and is involved in eye development.

Name: Insulin receptor substrate 53 kDa
Description: Insulin receptor substrate 53 kDa (IRSp53) encodes a protein required for filopodia formation during the adhesion and fusion of myoblasts.

Name: Lipophorin receptor 1
Description: Lipophorin receptor 1 (LpR1) encodes a transmembrane receptor that regulates immune response by mediating clearance of the protein encoded by nec from the hemolymph. Some of the LpR1-encoded isoforms are also involved in the cellular uptake of neutral lipids from the circulating protein encoded by apolpp.

Name: Doublecortin-domain-containing echinoderm-microtubule-associated protein
Description: May modify the assembly dynamics of microtubules, such that microtubules are slightly longer, but more dynamic. (UniProtKB:Q9VUI3)

Name: Importin beta11
Description: Predicted to enable small GTPase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into nucleus. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nuclear envelope. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval hypodermal muscle cell; embryonic/larval neuromuscular junction; and organism. Orthologous to human IPO11 (importin 11).

Name: nervous wreck
Description: nervous wreck (nwk) encodes a membrane- and actin cytoskeleton-remodeling protein that localizes to presynaptic periactive zones. It regulates the traffic of synaptic vesicles and synaptic growth-regulating endosomal cargoes such as BMP receptors.

Name: Puromycin sensitive aminopeptidase
Description: Predicted to enable metalloaminopeptidase activity; peptide binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in peptide catabolic process and proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval digestive system; embryonic/larval tracheal system; extended germ band embryo; gonad; and imaginal disc. Orthologous to several human genes including NPEPPS (aminopeptidase puromycin sensitive).

Name: eater
Description: eater (eater) encodes a transmembrane receptor of the Nimrod family specifically expressed in hemocytes and required for the phagocytosis of Gram positive bacteria and the attachment of hemocytes to sessile niches.

Name: Inositol-requiring enzyme-1
Description: Inositol-requiring enzyme-1 (Ire1) encodes a transmembrane protein that mediates the unfolded protein response. Misfolded peptides in the endoplasmic reticulum activate the RNase activity of the product of Ire1, thereby promoting the cleavage of its downstream substrates, such as Xbp1 mRNA. The product of Ire1 is also required for photoreceptor differentiation.

Name: Hormone receptor-like in 38
Description: Hormone receptor-like in 38 (Hr38) encodes a protein that can heterodimerize with the U adult cuticle and for the proper uptake and storage of glycogen in larvae.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic dorsal epidermis and embryonic ventral epidermis.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables serine hydrolase activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic head sensory system; sensory nervous system primordium; spermatozoon; and ventral sensory complex primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Wolman disease; autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 8; cholesterol ester storage disease; and lysosomal and lipase deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including LIPA (lipase A, lysosomal acid type); LIPF (lipase F, gastric type); and LIPJ (lipase family member J).

Name: Activated Cdc42 kinase
Description: Non-receptor tyrosine-protein and serine/threonine-protein kinase that is implicated in diverse biological functions such as cell survival, cell differentiation, cell growth and proliferation (PubMed:11997505, PubMed:18816840, PubMed:22615583, PubMed:23562806, PubMed:25223282, PubMed:27462444). Phosphorylates SH3PX1 and ex (PubMed:22615583, PubMed:11773052, PubMed:27462444). Phosphorylates SH3PX1 predominantly on 'Tyr-56', which likely promotes the recruitment of SH3PX1 to an axonal guidance receptor complex that includes dock and Dscam; because phosphorylation of SH3PX1 increases its interaction with the complex member dock while decreasing its interaction with the actin cytoskeleton modulator WASp (PubMed:11773052). In the wing and eye, promotes tissue growth, and during embryogenesis coordinates cell shape changes required for correct dorsal closure (PubMed:22615583, PubMed:27462444, PubMed:18816840). Functions in the negative regulation of the Hippo/SWH (Sav/Wts/Hpo) signaling pathway by enhancing yki activity thereby promoting cell proliferation and inhibiting apoptosis (PubMed:22615583, PubMed:27462444). This is accomplished, at least in part, by phosphorylating ex thereby reducing its ability to efficiently activate the Hippo signaling cascade (PubMed:27462444). In the eye disk, wing disk and possibly spermatids, inhibits programmed cell death induced by hid and rpr through a mechanism that is independent of the MAP kinase signal transduction pathway (PubMed:22615583). Essential for male and female fertility (PubMed:22615583, PubMed:23562806). During oogenesis required for the correct temporal assembly, and consequently the catalytic activity of long CTPsyn filaments (cytoophidium) in the germline nurse cells, likely by phosphorylating an unidentified substrate that is essential for linking individual CTPsyn filaments into large, catalytically active assemblies (PubMed:25223282). (UniProtKB:Q9VZI2)

Name: unc-5
Description: unc-5 (unc-5) encodes a netrin receptor involved in motor axon guidance and glial migration as well as netrin-mediated repulsion during salivary gland migration.

Name: Leucine-rich pentatricopeptide repeat containing 2
Description: Leucine-rich pentatricopeptide repeat containing 2 (Lrpprc2) encodes an RNA-binding protein that forms a complex with the product of SLIRP2. It localizes to the mitochondrial matrix where it functions to coordinate mitochondrial translation.

Name: Reversion-inducing-cysteine-rich protein with kazal motifs
Description: Predicted to enable endopeptidase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in extracellular matrix organization and negative regulation of metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human RECK (reversion inducing cysteine rich protein with kazal motifs).

Name: lethal (2) 05287
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of rRNA processing and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase I. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle cell; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human WDR75 (WD repeat domain 75).

Name: Tubulin tyrosine ligase-like 4A
Description: Predicted to enable protein-glycine ligase activity; tubulin binding activity; and tubulin-glutamic acid ligase activity. Involved in wound healing. Predicted to be active in cilium. Orthologous to human TTLL4 (tubulin tyrosine ligase like 4).

Name: Ankyrin-repeat, SH3-domain, and Proline-rich-region containing Protein
Description: Ankyrin-repeat, SH3-domain, and Proline-rich-region containing Protein (ASPP) encodes a scaffold protein localised at the adherens junctions (AJ) of epithelial cells. It promotes AJ stability by repressing Src activity via the kinase encoded by Csk.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in neuron migration. Predicted to be active in cytoplasmic vesicle and membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; larval ventral nerve cord; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dyslexia. Orthologous to human KIAA0319 (KIAA0319) and KIAA0319L (KIAA0319 like).

Name: Integrin alphaPS4 subunit
Description: Possible role in cell adhesion. Minor involvement in the establishment of the oocyte anterior-posterior length. (UniProtKB:Q9V7A4)

Name: WD40 Y
Description: Is expressed in testis. Orthologous to human WDR49 (WD repeat domain 49).

Name: multiple wing hairs
Description: multiple wing hairs (mwh) encodes the most downstream member of the fz/stan planar cell polarity pathway. It binds to the sides of F-actin polymers, inhibits actin polymerization and bundles F-actin. It accumulates on the proximal side of wing cells prior to hair initiation and then in the growing hair.

Name: sodium potassium chloride cotransporter
Description: Predicted to enable amino acid transmembrane transporter activity and sodium:potassium:chloride symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cell volume homeostasis; inorganic ion homeostasis; and inorganic ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anal pad primordium; anterior-posterior subdivision of organism; gut section; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Gitelman syndrome and essential hypertension. Orthologous to human SLC12A3 (solute carrier family 12 member 3).

Name: Integrator 3
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). However this subunit is not essential for the 3'-end processing of the snRNA U7 and the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). Mediates recruitment of cytoplasmic dynein to the nuclear envelope, probably as component of the INT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q7PLS8)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metallodipeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including DPEP2 (dipeptidase 2).

Name: spargel
Description: transcriptional coactivator - required for the expression of multiple genes encoding mitochondrial proteins - mediates mitochondrial activity, cell growth and transcription of target genes in response to insulin signalling

Name: tolloid
Description: tolloid (tld) encodes a member of the asticin metalloprotease family. Its primary function is to cleave the product of sog, which facilitates the diffusion of the ligand encoded by dpp to the dorsal-most cells in the early blastoderm embryo, helping to specify formation of the amnioserosa.

Name: Adenomatous polyposis coli 2
Description: Adenomatous polyposis coli 2 (Apc2) encodes one of two Drosophila APC family proteins. It is a key negative regulator of Wingless signaling, as a critical component of the destruction complex that phosphorylates beta-catenin and thus targets it for ubiquitination and proteasomal destruction. It is the primary APC family member during embryonic development, and functions redundantly with the product of Apc in adult development.

Name: bric a brac 2
Description: bric a brac 2 (bab2) encodes a transcriptional regulator that functions partially redundantly with the product of bab1. It is part of the conserved proximal-distal gene regulatory network module. It contributes to pattern formation, ovary morphogenesis, abdominal pigmentation and olfactory receptor neuron fate diversity.

Name: endosomal maturation defective
Description: endosomal maturation defective (ema) encodes a protein involved in membrane trafficking that is required for endosomal maturation and autophagy.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Is expressed in embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell; and longitudinal visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to several human genes including LONRF1 (LON peptidase N-terminal domain and ring finger 1).

Name: pre-mRNA processing factor 39
Description: Involved in pre-mRNA splicing. (UniProtKB:Q7KRW8)

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 61F
Description: Kinesin-like protein at 61F (Klp61F) encodes a member of the kinesin-5 family of cytoskeletal motor proteins. It allows the crosslinking and sliding apart of adjacent microtubules. This 'sliding filament mechanism' is critical for many aspect of mitosis and chromosome segregation.

Name: Centrosomal protein 135kDa
Description: Centrosomal protein 135kDa (Cep135) encodes a microtubule binding protein important for centriole elongation and stability. It promotes centrosome asymmetry and spindle orientation in neuroblasts and it is required for male fertility.

Name: Lipophorin receptor 2
Description: Lipophorin receptor 2 (LpR2) encodes a transmembrane receptor. A subset of LpR2-encoded isoforms are involved in the cellular uptake of neutral lipids from the circulating protein encoded by apolpp.

Name: sidestep II
Description: Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval central nervous system; and embryonic/larval muscle system.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-lysine transmembrane transporter activity and L-ornithine transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in L-arginine import across plasma membrane and L-ornithine transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; and adult thorax. Orthologous to human SLC7A1 (solute carrier family 7 member 1); SLC7A2 (solute carrier family 7 member 2); and SLC7A3 (solute carrier family 7 member 3).

Name: embargoed
Description: embargoed (emb) encodes an exportin involved in protein export from the nucleus. It regulates the response to hypoxia and is involved in centriole replication.

Name: Secretory Pathway Calcium atpase
Description: Secretory Pathway Calcium atpase (SPoCk) encodes a transporting ATPase with roles in the maintenance of cellular Ca2+ homeostasis.

Name: HECT and RLD domain containing E3 ubiquitin ligase 4
Description: HECT and RLD domain containing E3 ubiquitin ligase 4 (Herc4) encodes a HECT-type E3 ubiquity ligase that is involved in the host defense against Gram-positive bacteria mediated by Toll pathway.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable beta-tubulin binding activity and microtubule binding activity.

Name: CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 4
Description: CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 4 (Cnot4) encodes a positive regulator of the Jak/Stat pathway which acts by stabilizing the DNA binding of the product of Stat92E.

Name: second mitotic wave missing
Description: Negatively regulates Hedgehog (hh) protein signal in wing development (PubMed:18245841). Regulates neural-specific glycosylation by binding to FucTA mRNA and facilitating its nuclear export in neural cells (PubMed:21203496). (UniProtKB:Q9VIV2)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process and regulation of proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in embryonic brain and larval ventral nerve cord.

Name: SMAD specific E3 ubiquitin protein ligase
Description: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase which accepts ubiquitin from an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme in the form of a thioester and then directly transfers the ubiquitin to targeted substrates. Down-regulates Dpp signaling after gastrulation by promoting MAD ubiquitination and subsequent degradation. (UniProtKB:Q9V853)

Name: lodestar
Description: lodestar (lds) encodes a protein that belongs to the helicase-related family and is part of the spindle assembly checkpoint engaged in the maintenance of chromosome/genome stability. It is required to load cohesin complexes onto the chromosomes during the embryonic cleavage mitoses. Absence of lds leads to frequent chromosome loss and death of cells and embryos.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled intramembrane lipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in phospholipid translocation. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum; plasma membrane; and trans-Golgi network. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in X-linked congenital hemolytic anemia and autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness. Orthologous to human ATP11A (ATPase phospholipid transporting 11A); ATP11B (ATPase phospholipid transporting 11B (putative)); and ATP11C (ATPase phospholipid transporting 11C).

Name: Thrombospondin
Description: Thrombospondin (Tsp) is expressed in embryonic tendons and is regulated by sr. The product of Tsp serves as a ligand for the integrin subunit encoded by if and is required for muscle adhesion to tendons.

Name: super sex combs
Description: super sex combs (sxc) is a polycomb group gene that encodes a O-GlcNAc transferase involved in epigenetic gene silencing.

Name: Brother of Yb
Description: Brother of Yb (BoYb) encodes a putative RNA helicase in the TDRD12 family and is predicted to have a role in piRNA biogenesis, specifically in ovarian germline cells.

Name: cappuccino
Description: cappuccino (capu) encodes a formin family protein that nucleates actin filaments and accelerates their elongation. It works with the product of spir to build an actin mesh that fills the oocyte during mid-oogenesis. capu is necessary for polarity establishment and female fertility.

Name: Suppressor of Triplolethal
Description: Su(Tpl) (Su(Tpl)) encodes a transcription elongation factor that enhances the catalytic rate of RNA Polymerase II by suppressing its transient pausing. It interacts with the product of lilli in the super elongation complex and the product of Ice1 in the little elongation complex. It regulates Notch and Ras signaling pathways.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly and cilium movement. Predicted to be active in motile cilium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 41. Orthologous to human CFAP70 (cilia and flagella associated protein 70).

Name: Glutamate receptor interacting protein
Description: Glutamate receptor binding protein (Grip) encodes a protein involved in muscle attachment and synapse organization.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metal ion binding activity and metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human NRDC (nardilysin convertase).

Name: RecQ5 helicase
Description: RecQ5 helicase (RecQ5) encodes a DNA helicase that maintains genome stability via participation in many nuclear DNA metabolic processes including DNA repair, DNA resolution, and RNA transcription.

Name: Upstream of N-ras
Description: Upstream of N-ras (Unr) encodes an RNA binding protein that functions as an RNA chaperone and translation regulator. It performs opposing, sex-specific, roles in X-chromosome dosage compensation by regulating lncRNA:roX2 RNA conformation in males and msl-2 mRNA translation in females.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic optic lobe primordium; germline cell; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to several human genes including MCF2L (MCF.2 cell line derived transforming sequence like).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: flapper
Description: The gene flapper is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\flap (CG11073, FBgn0034693). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:22091489..22099534. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 12-18 embryonic stages.

Name: Mtr4 helicase
Description: Mtr4 helicase (Mtr4) encodes an RNA helicase involved in the viral defense response.

Name: Valyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Predicted to enable valine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in valyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and organism. Orthologous to human VARS1 (valyl-tRNA synthetase 1).

Name: ellipsoid body open
Description: ellipsoid body open (ebo) encodes a protein that complexes with actin, the product of chic, and Ran-GTPase to mediate actin nuclear export. Loss of ebo during development results in defects in the ellipsoid body of the central complex. In the adult brain, accumulation of nuclear actin results in the inhibition of the product of bs and subsequent loss of visual orientation memory.

Name: Zn finger homeodomain 1
Description: Involved in the development of the embryonic central nervous system, embryonic mesoderm and adult musculature. (UniProtKB:P28166)

Name: junctophilin
Description: junctophilin (jp) belongs to a gene family encoding proteins anchored to the endoplasmic reticulum through a transmembrane region. The product of jp contributes to the formation and maintenance of junctional membrane complexes. It serves as a physical bridge between the plasma membrane and the endoplasmic reticulum in excitable cells, allowing the functional crosstalk between ion channels. It is necessary for calcium signalling in muscle contraction and neuronal communication.

Name: Discoidin domain receptor
Description: Predicted to enable collagen binding activity and protein tyrosine kinase collagen receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase signaling pathway. Predicted to be part of receptor complex. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcoholic liver cirrhosis; bone disease (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung disease (multiple); and skin melanoma. Orthologous to several human genes including DDR1 (discoidin domain receptor tyrosine kinase 1).

Name: Cell division cycle 14
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity and protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cilium assembly; peptidyl-tyrosine dephosphorylation; and regulation of cell cycle process. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm; microtubule cytoskeleton; and nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior midgut primordium; embryonic/larval midgut; endoderm; and larval ventral nerve cord. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 32. Orthologous to several human genes including CDC14A (cell division cycle 14A).

Name: C-terminal Src kinase
Description: C-terminal Src kinase (Csk) encodes a cytoplasmic tyrosine kinase that acts as a tumor suppressor through Src pathway inibition as well as a mediator of the  activity of the product of Egfr.

Name: Establishment of cohesion
Description: Acetyltransferase required for the establishment of sister chromatid cohesion and couple the processes of cohesion and DNA replication to ensure that only sister chromatids become paired together. In contrast to the structural cohesins, the deposition and establishment factors are required only during S phase. (UniProtKB:Q9VS50)

Name: breathless
Description: breathless (btl) encodes a Fibroblast Growth Factor (FGF) receptor for secreted FGF ligands that utilizes the intracellular Ras-MAP kinase pathway. It contributes to embryonic tracheal migration.

Name: mutagen-sensitive 301
Description: mutagen-sensitive 301 (mus301) encodes a member of the Mus308 subfamily of ATP-dependent helicases. It is involved in the repair of double-strand DNA breaks during recombination and in somatic cells, and in chromosome segregation. It contributes to dorsal-ventral patterning during oogenesis and posterior oocyte positioning.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable dynein heavy chain binding activity and dynein light chain binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cilium movement and outer dynein arm assembly. Predicted to be part of outer dynein arm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in short-rib thoracic dysplasia 8 with or without polydactyly. Orthologous to human DYNC2I1 (dynein 2 intermediate chain 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic dorsal epidermis; embryonic head epidermis; and embryonic ventral epidermis.

Name: moleskin
Description: moleskin (msk) encodes an importin that contributes to protein import into the nucleus. It is involved in eye development, muscle attachment and wing cell fate specification.

Name: mind bomb 2
Description: mind bomb 2 (mib2) encodes a protein required for regulating synaptic plasticity and memory formation and maintaining muscle integrity.

Name: knockout
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in motor neuron axon guidance. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell; epithelium; extended germ band embryo; foregut; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pre-eclampsia. Orthologous to human STOX1 (storkhead box 1) and STOX2 (storkhead box 2).

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 31E
Description: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity; microtubule binding activity; and microtubule motor activity. Predicted to be involved in microtubule-based movement. Predicted to be part of kinesin complex. Predicted to be active in microtubule. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles 1. Orthologous to human KIF21A (kinesin family member 21A) and KIF21B (kinesin family member 21B).

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in defense response to bacterium. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: sulfateless
Description: Essential bifunctional enzyme that catalyzes both the N-deacetylation and the N-sulfation of glucosamine (GlcNAc) of the glycosaminoglycan in heparan sulfate. Modifies the GlcNAc-GlcA disaccharide repeating sugar backbone to make N-sulfated heparosan, a prerequisite substrate for later modifications in heparin biosynthesis. Plays a role in diffusion of morphogen wingless (wg) via its role in heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs) biosynthesis, HSPGs being required for movement of wg morphogens. Required for wg signaling during both embryonic and imaginal disk development. Also required for FGF receptor signaling. (UniProtKB:Q9V3L1)

Name: Holocarboxylase synthetase
Description: Holocarboxylase synthetase (Hcs) encodes a biotin protein ligase that contributes to gluconeogenesis, fatty acid synthesis and amino acid catabolism.

Name: Hira
Description: Hira (Hira) encodes a histone H3-H4 chaperone that specifically assembles nucleosomes containing the histone H3.3 variant. It is involved in various replication-independent nucleosome assembly processes and is critically required for de novo chromatin assembly in the male pronucleus.

Name: masquerade
Description: In embryogenesis, has a role in somatic muscle attachment and in the development of axonal pathways probably by stabilizing cell-matrix adhesion and/or by acting as a competitive antagonist of serine proteases. (UniProtKB:Q9VZH2)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: jim lovell
Description: Has a regulatory role during midline cell development. (UniProtKB:P14083)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human HEATR6 (HEAT repeat containing 6).

Name: GST-containing FLYWCH zinc-finger protein
Description: GST-containing FLYWCH zinc-finger protein (gfzf) encodes encodes a glutathione binding protein that is predicted by phylogeny to have glutathione transferase activity.

Name: slingshot
Description: slingshot (ssh) encodes a protein that plays a pivotal role in actin dynamics by reactivating/dephosphorylating the product of tsr in vivo.

Name: Dis3 like 3'-5' exoribonuclease 2
Description: Dis3 like 3'-5' exoribonuclease 2 (Dis3l2) encodes a 3'-5'-exoribonuclease involved in catabolism of miRNA and tRNA.

Name: Bre1
Description: Bre1 (Bre1) encodes an E3 ubiquitin ligase that interacts with the E2 ubiquitin ligase encoded by Ubc6 to direct ubiquitination of histone H2B on lysine 120 at most RNA Polymerase II transcribed  genes. It regulates Notch signaling.

Name: Polycomblike
Description: Polycomblike (Pcl) encodes a protein required for taste response to sugar. It regulates the expression of Ptx1, cad, nub, scro and GATAe in response to diet. The distribution of Pcl bound to chromatin in the sweet taste cells is nutrient dependent.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in morphogenesis of a branching epithelium. Is expressed in central brain primordium; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium. Orthologous to human BTBD7 (BTB domain containing 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable alpha,alpha-trehalase activity. Predicted to be involved in trehalose catabolic process. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human TREH (trehalase).

Name: female sterile (1) Yb
Description: female sterile (1) Yb (fs(1)Yb) encodes a protein involved in maintenance of the germ-line stem cell population during oogenesis.

Name: Na pump alpha subunit
Description: Na pump alpha subunit (Atpalpha) encodes an integral membrane cation antiporter protein that utilizes ATP to shuttle Na[+] and K[+] across the plasma membrane to maintain ion homeostasis.

Name: Notopleural
Description: Enables serine-type peptidase activity. Involved in liquid clearance, open tracheal system. Located in apical plasma membrane and extracellular space. Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal system; epidermis; gut section; spermatozoon; and tracheal primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 11. Orthologous to human ST14 (ST14 transmembrane serine protease matriptase).

Name: PFTAIRE-interacting factor 1B
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including amnioserosa; dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; spermatozoon; ventral midline of embryo; and yolk nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to several human genes including FHIP1B (FHF complex subunit HOOK interacting protein 1B).

Name: Cyclic nucleotide-gated ion channel subunit B
Description: Contributes to intracellular cyclic nucleotide activated cation channel activity. Involved in cation transmembrane transport. Part of intracellular cyclic nucleotide activated cation channel complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in achromatopsia 3; color blindness; retinitis pigmentosa; and retinitis pigmentosa 45. Orthologous to human CNGB1 (cyclic nucleotide gated channel subunit beta 1) and CNGB3 (cyclic nucleotide gated channel subunit beta 3).

Name: Neprilysin 4
Description: Neprilysin 4 (Nep4) encodes a metallopeptidase considered to cleave and thus inactivate signaling peptides in the extracellular space. It contributes to muscle integrity and male fertility.

Name: omega
Description: omega (ome) encodes a dipeptidyl-peptidase.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG44666 (FBgn0265877). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:20779992..20783216. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in dsRNA transport. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human FAM102A (family with sequence similarity 102 member A) and FAM102B (family with sequence similarity 102 member B).

Name: Multiplexin
Description: Multiplexin (Mp) encodes a Collagen XV/XVIII type protein that functions in motor axon pathfinding. It is required for normal calcium channel abundance, presynaptic calcium influx, and neurotransmitter release.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable outward rectifier potassium channel activity and potassium ion leak channel activity. Predicted to be involved in potassium ion transmembrane transport and stabilization of membrane potential. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: Tao
Description: Tao (Tao) encodes a Ser/Thr kinase belonging to the Mst/Ste20 family. It is implicated in the Hippo and PAR-1 pathways. It contributes to restriction of tissue growth during development, regulation of microtubule dynamics, neuronal polarity, neural development, ethanol-stimulated behavioral response, and apoptosis.

Name: male-specific lethal 1
Description: male-specific lethal 1 (msl-1) encodes a protein that is thought to form a scaffold to organize the full male-specific-lethal dosage compensation complex, which increases male X chromosome transcription approximately two-fold. msl-1 homozygous mutant males die as larvae, while females are viable.

Name: scrawny
Description: Hydrolase that deubiquitinates polyubiquitinated target proteins including imd (PubMed:19837371, PubMed:19039105). Required for preventing the constitutive activation of the imd/NF-kappa-B (Imd) signaling cascade under unchalleneged conditions (PubMed:19837371, PubMed:25027767). Deubiquitinates imd linked 'Lys-63' chains which leads its proteasomal degradation and consequently down-regulation of the Imd signaling cascade (PubMed:19837371). Removal of the activating 'Lys-63'-linked chains is likely to enable their replacement with 'Lys-48'-linked chains which act as 'tags' the for proteosomal degradation of imd (PubMed:19837371). Required for maintaining multiple types of adult stem cells, including male and female germline, epithelial follicle cell and intestinal stem cells (PubMed:19039105). May function as a transcriptional repressor by continually deubiquiting histone H2B at the promoters of genes critical for cellular differentiation, thereby preventing histone H3 'Lys-4' trimethylation (H3K4me3) (PubMed:19039105). Controls selective autophagy activation by ubiquitinated proteins (PubMed:22622177). (UniProtKB:Q9VRP5)

Name: Kinesin associated protein 3
Description: Kinesin associated protein 3 (Kap3) encodes the non-motor accessory subunit of the heterotrimeric kinesin-2. It associates to the coiled-coil stalk domain of the products of Klp68D andKlp64D. It plays an essential role in sensory cilia assembly and axonal transport.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatogonium and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 51. Orthologous to human CFAP91 (cilia and flagella associated protein 91).

Name: Topoisomerase I-interacting protein
Description: Topoisomerase I-interacting protein (Topors) encodes a RING-finger containing putative dual Ubiquitin/SUMO ligase. It is required in the male germ line for maintenance of nuclear shape and meiosis I chromosome segregation. It also targets sumoylation of the developmental transcription factor encoded by hry.

Name: short gastrulation
Description: short gastrulation (sog) encodes a secreted BMP antagonist that is expressed in the embryonic ventral neuroectoderm. sog product promotes neural development by preventing dorsally produced dpp from diffusing into the neuroectoderm and suppressing expression of neural genes. sog protein also diffuses dorsally where it helps establish a BMP activity gradient essential for partitioning that domain into cells giving rise to the dorsal epidermis versus amnioserosa.

Name: PDZ domain containing 8
Description: Predicted to enable lipid binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial calcium ion homeostasis and mitochondrion-endoplasmic reticulum membrane tethering. Predicted to be active in mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human PDZD8 (PDZ domain containing 8).

Name: brain tumor
Description: brain tumor (brat) encodes a tumor suppressor that regulates proliferation in the brain. During neural stem cell division, it segregates into one daughter cell where it inhibits protein translation, preventing self-renewal and inducing differentiation. It also acts during oogenesis where it interacts with the products of nanos and pum to suppress hb translation.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human MACO1 (macoilin 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human BEGAIN (brain enriched guanylate kinase associated) and TJAP1 (tight junction associated protein 1).

Name: stonewall
Description: stonewall (stwl) encodes a protein that is associated with heterochromatin and modifies levels of trimethylated H3K27 and H3K9. stwl product is required for maintenance of female germline stem cells and for survival of genotoxic stress induced by DNA replication inhibition.

Name: smoothened
Description: smoothened (smo) encodes a critical component of the Hedgehog signaling pathway. It is regulated by phosphorylation, dimerization, and cell-surface accumulation upon Hedgehog stimulation. The product of smo is also regulated by ubiquitin and other small molecules such as phospholipids.

Name: Myosin 61F
Description: Unconventional myosin that functions as actin-based motor protein with ATPase activity (PubMed:30467170). Binds to membranes enriched in phosphatidylinositol 4-5-bisphosphate, and can glide along actin filaments when anchored to a lipid bilayer (PubMed:30467170). Functions as antagonist for Myo31DF, an unconventional myosin with an essential role in the establishment of body left-right asymmetry (PubMed:16598258, PubMed:18521948, PubMed:22491943, PubMed:25659376, PubMed:30467170). (UniProtKB:Q23979)

Name: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 5
Description: Structural maintenance of chromosomes 5 (SMC5) encodes a component of the SMC5/6 protein complex that is critical to genome stability and required for homologous DNA recombination-based processes.

Name: garnet
Description: garnet (g) encodes a protein that forms the Adaptor protein 3 (AP-3) complex together with the other subunits encoded by or, rb and cm. These complexes select cargo for inclusion into vesicles for transport within the cell. AP-3 delivers protein cargo to a number of specialized organelles including pigment granules, late endosomes, lysosomes and synaptic vesicles. AP-3 genes were first found through defects in pigment granules that alter eye color.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG14442 (FBgn0029893). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:6689296..6695007. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of moderate expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-06 hour embryonic stages.

Name: N/A
Description: ATP-independent protease that degrades mitochondrial transit peptides after their cleavage. Also degrades other unstructured peptides (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9V9E3)

Name: off-track
Description: off-track (otk) encodes a protein that associates with the product of PlexA to receive a repulsive signal from the product of Sema1a contributing to axon guidance in the central nervous system and motor neurons. The product of otk is also associated with non-canonical Wnt signaling, opposing canonical Wnt signaling activation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activity and ribosome binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cytosolic ribosome assembly. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval lymph gland; extended germ band embryo; and pole plasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Shwachman-Diamond syndrome. Orthologous to human EFL1 (elongation factor like GTPase 1).

Name: draper
Description: draper (drpr) encodes a single-pass transmembrane receptor that is involved in phagocytosis by glia, macrophages, and epithelia. It signals downstream through the proteins encoded by Src42A and Shark to promote Rac1 function and transcriptional changes through the products of Jra and Stat92E. It is also required for activation of autophagy in salivary glands.

Name: sisters on the loose
Description: sisters on the loose (solo) encodes a chromosome protein involved in the meiotic sister chromatid cohesion pathway. It is required for sister centromere cohesion in both male and female meiosis and for maintenance of synaptonemal complexes and normal levels of homolog crossing-over in female meiosis.

Name: suppressor of rudimentary
Description: suppressor of rudimentary (su(r)) encodes a dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase, the first step of pyrimidine catabolism. su(r) depletion does not produce visible phenotypes, but synergistic effects are exhibited by combining mutants with genes affecting pyrimidine biosynthesis and beta-alanine metabolism.

Name: Germ cell nuclear acidic peptidase
Description: May play a role in DNA-protein cross-links (DPCs) clearance, ensuring the genomic stability by protecting germ cells and early embryos from various sources of damage (PubMed:31839537). Limits replication stress and DNA double-strand breaks (PubMed:31839537). (UniProtKB:Q7KW09)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human FAM234B (family with sequence similarity 234 member B).

Name: Fat body protein 1
Description: Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; and embryonic/larval hemolymph.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable intracellular calcium activated chloride channel activity. Predicted to be involved in chloride transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in extracellular exosome. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ANO1 (anoctamin 1).

Name: Gemin 3
Description: Gemin 3 (Gem3) encodes an RNA helicase and a member of the SMN-Gemins complex. It is a component of the cytoplasmic U snRNP body and nuclear gems. It is required in the motor system for viability, neuromuscular junction development and motor behaviour.

Name: Microcephalin
Description: Microcephalin (MCPH1) encodes a BRCT domain-containing protein that acts in genome stability and cell cycle regulation. It is required to co-ordinate centrosome and nuclear division during rapid syncitial embryonic cell divisions.

Name: ftz transcription factor 1
Description: Acts as a cofactor to fushi tarazu (ftz). Facilitates the binding of ftz to DNA. Binds the sequence element 5'-YCYYGGYCR-3' in the zebra element of ftz. Probably also functions as a receptor for a yet unknown ligand. (UniProtKB:P33244)

Name: Clock
Description: Circadian regulator that acts as a transcription factor and generates a rhythmic output with a period of about 24 hours. Oscillates in antiphase to the cycling observed for period (PER) and timeless (TIM). According to PubMed:9742131, reaches peak abundance within several hours of the dark-light transition at ZT0 (zeitgeber 0), whereas PubMed:9616122 describes bimodal oscillating expression with maximum at ZT5 and ZT23. Clock-cycle heterodimers activate cycling transcription of PER and TIM by binding to the E-box (5'-CACGTG-3') present in their promoters. Once induced, Period and Timeless block Clock's ability to transactivate their promoters. (UniProtKB:O61735)

Name: Imitation SWI
Description: Energy-transducing component of the chromatin-remodeling complexes NURF (nucleosome-remodeling factor), ACF (ATP-utilizing chromatin assembly and remodeling factor), and CHRAC (chromatin accessibility complex) (PubMed:10856248, PubMed:11447119). NURF catalyzes ATP-dependent nucleosome sliding and facilitates transcription of chromatin. It is required for homeotic gene expression, proper larval blood cell development, normal male X chromosome morphology, ecdysteroid signaling and metamorphosis (PubMed:12502740, PubMed:16264191, PubMed:8521501, PubMed:8521502). (UniProtKB:Q24368)

Name: staufen
Description: staufen (stau) encodes a double-stranded RNA binding protein involved in mRNA localization. It contributes to anterior and posterior patterning, nervous system development and long term memory.

Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG15431 (FBgn0031602). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:4403992..4441282. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 12-24 hour embryonic stages, during early larval stages, during late pupal stages, in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG43968 (FBgn0264699). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:23784231..23787405. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported.

Name: Glutactin
Description: Glutactin (Glt) encodes a secreted protein that belongs to the family of cholinesterase/carboxylesterase-like proteins but lacks the catalytically active residues. It forms part of the basement membrane and regulates axonal outgrowth.

Name: GTPase regulator associated with FAK
Description: GTPase-activating protein for Rho family proteins (PubMed:33835025). Essential component of the CLIC (clathrin-independent carrier)/GEEC (GPI-anchored protein-enriched early endocytic compartment) endocytic pathway (PubMed:28993397). During hematopoiesis, inhibits Egfr-ras-MAPK signaling by promoting Spi-induced Egfr internalization through CLIC/GEEC endocytosis, thereby preventing plasmatocyte overproliferation (PubMed:28993397). Essential for normal mushroom body (MB) development and consequently the formation of olfactory long-term memories (PubMed:33892766). During MD development, required to stop the MB beta-lobe from crossing the brain midline, possibly acting via its role in the CLIC/GEEC endocytic pathway to down-regulate the Egfr-ras-MAPK signaling at the tip of the beta-lobes (PubMed:33892766). Required during embryo cellularization for maintaining and regulating the rate of actomyosin ring constriction (PubMed:33835025). During cellularization, inhibits Rho-GTP levels at the furrow canal tip in a spatiotemporal manner, thus delaying the onset of actomyosin contraction and ensuring appropriate closure of the cells at the base of nuclei after membrane extension (PubMed:33835025). (UniProtKB:X2JDY8)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloaminopeptidase activity; peptide binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in peptide catabolic process and proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; epithelial tube; germline cell; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to human ENPEP (glutamyl aminopeptidase).

Name: expansion
Description: expansion (exp) encodes an atypical Smad-like protein which regulates tube size in the trachea through receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) pathways, as well as apical secretion pathways.

Name: Synapsin
Description: Synapsin (Syn) encodes a phosphoprotein associated with synaptic vesicles. It interacts with the endocytic scaffolding protein encoded by Dap160. Phosphorylation of synapsin at serine 6 is required for associative short-term learning/memory and short-term olfactory habituation. It is important for outgrowth of synaptic boutons at the larval neuromuscular junction.

Name: tiptop
Description: tiptop (tio) encodes a DNA binding protein involved in the formation of embryonic thoracic segments, Malpighian tubules, and eye development.

Name: Lon protease
Description: Lon protease (Lon) encodes a conserved ATP-stimulated serine protease. It is encoded in the nucleus and targeted to the mitochondrial matrix, where it contributes to mitochondrial protein turnover.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon.

Name: defective proventriculus
Description: defective proventriculus (dve) encodes a transcriptional repressor that binds to the K50 site. It is involved in developmental patterning, cell-type specification, and functional differentiation.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG13457 (FBgn0036482). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:15127940..15131378. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Located in nucleus. Part of Sin3-type complex. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human EMSY (EMSY transcriptional repressor, BRCA2 interacting).

Name: ADAM metallopeptidase with thrombospondin type 1 motif B
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Involved in negative regulation of epidermal growth factor receptor signaling pathway and negative regulation of imaginal disc-derived wing vein specification. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in dorsal imaginal tissue; early extended germ band embryo; foregut; and presumptive wing vein. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Weill-Marchesani syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ADAMTS12 (ADAM metallopeptidase with thrombospondin type 1 motif 12) and ADAMTS7 (ADAM metallopeptidase with thrombospondin type 1 motif 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and adult heart.

Name: Integrator 4
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). Involved in the 3'-end processing of the U7 snRNA, and also the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). Essential for development (PubMed:21078872). May mediate recruitment of cytoplasmic dynein to the nuclear envelope, probably as component of the INT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9W3E1)

Name: Methionyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Methionyl-tRNA synthetase (MetRS) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the covalent attachment of methionine to methionyl-tRNA, an essential first step of protein translation.

Name: trachealess
