Description: fritz (frtz) encodes a cytoplasmic protein that functions as a planar polarity effector as a downstream member of the fz-stan planar cell polarity pathway that controls hair and bristle polarity. frtz protein directly binds to the product of in and accumulates on the proximal side of wing cells.

Name: Lysosomal alpha-mannosidase I
Description: Lysosomal alpha-mannosidase I (LManI) encodes an enzyme that is involved in mannose metabolism using p-nitrophenyl-alpha-mannoside as a substrate.

Name: Mucin 91C
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be located in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval tracheal section; and organism.

Name: Myb-interacting protein 120
Description: Myb-interacting protein 120 (mip120) encodes the sequence-specific DNA-binding protein of the MuvB core complex. The MuvB core binds to the oncoprotein encoded by Myb and the Rbf-E2f2-Dp tumor suppressor complex, thereby controlling the expression of many genes, including critical regulators of the cell cycle.

Name: Glucose transporter 4 enhancer factor
Description: Glucose transporter 4 enhancer factor (Glut4EF) encodes a transcription factor important for developmental patterning and morphogenesis events.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: Phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase 59F
Description: Phosphotidylinositol 3 kinase 59F (Pi3K59F) encodes a lipid kinase that is required for formation of Phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate. It functions in a core protein complex that includes the products of Atg6 and Vps15. It is involved in the control of vesicle trafficking, including autophagy, endocytosis and phagocytosis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and ribosomal small subunit assembly. Predicted to be part of Pwp2p-containing subcomplex of 90S preribosome and small-subunit processome. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human PWP2 (PWP2 small subunit processome component).

Name: Suppressor of deltex
Description: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase which accepts ubiquitin from an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme in the form of a thioester and then directly transfers the ubiquitin to targeted substrates. Down-regulates Notch/N signaling pathway, probably by promoting Notch ubiquitination, endocytosis and degradation. Involved in wing growth and leg joint formation. (UniProtKB:Q9Y0H4)

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in motor neuron axon guidance and synaptic target inhibition. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in muscle cell of A1-7 ventral longitudinal muscle 2 and muscle cell of ventral longitudinal muscle 1. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lethal congenital contracture syndrome; ocular hypertension; and open-angle glaucoma (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including GLDN (gliomedin).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in TARP syndrome; colorectal cancer; lung adenocarcinoma; and lung cancer. Orthologous to human RBM10 (RNA binding motif protein 10) and RBM5 (RNA binding motif protein 5).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anlage in statu nascendi; embryonic head sensory system; germ layer; gut section; and stage 5 embryo.

Name: phagocyte signaling impaired
Description: Non-catalytic subunit of the NatB complex which catalyzes acetylation of the N-terminal methionine residues of proteins beginning with Met-Asp or Met-Glu (By similarity). Has 2 roles in the larval immune response: required both for the phagocytic degradation of internalized bacteria and for the induction of Defensin in the fat body. Within the phagocytic blood cells, has a role in detection of infection and activation of the humoral immune response. (UniProtKB:Q9VDQ7)

Name: N/A
Description: Non-lysosomal glucosylceramidase that catalyzes the conversion of glucosylceramide to free glucose and ceramide. (UniProtKB:Q7KT91)

Name: Smg6
Description: Smg6 (Smg6) encodes an RNA endonuclease that is required for nonsense mediated mRNA decay (NMD). Upon recognition of an NMD-targeted transcript, it cleaves the mRNA in the vicinity of the termination codon, exposing free 5' and 3' ends leading to the complete exonucleolytic degradation of the target.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human SRBD1 (S1 RNA binding domain 1).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 25a
Description: Ionotropic receptor 25a (Ir25a) encodes a member of the Ionotropic Receptor (IR) family of variant ionotropic glutamate receptors. It functions as co-receptor subunit in chemosensation and thermosensation.

Name: 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) receptor 2B
Description: 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) receptor 2B (5-HT2B) encodes a 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) GPCR that belongs to the Class A GPCR family. They bind and transmit the signal from the neurotransmitter 5-HT (serotonin). The family can be subdivided into several subclasses based on pharmacology, signal transduction and structure. There are 5 genes encoding serotonin receptors in the Drosophila melanogaster genome: 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT7.

Name: uncoordinated 45
Description: uncoordinated 45 (unc-45) encodes a protein that binds the product of Hsp83 and myosin, and may may serve as a scaffold for their interaction. It is required for normal myosin accumulation and appears to play a role in myosin folding and/or protection from stress.

Name: Activin-beta
Description: Activin-beta (Actbeta) encodes a ligand of the TGF beta superfamily. It signals through the type I receptor encoded by babo and the Smad family member encoded by Smox. Actbeta is expressed primarily in the central and peripheral nervous systems and its product regulates aspects of metabolism, insulin signaling, hemocyte development and body size.

Name: rotund
Description: rotund (rn) encodes a member of the Kruppel zinc-finger transcription factor family. It functions as an olfactory neuron specification factor required for diversification of multiple developmental lineages. rn mutants are defective for multiple distal structures in the adult, including smaller legs, wings and eyes.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including CNS glial cell; early extended germ band embryo; embryonic head sensory system; embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: maheshvara
Description: maheshvara (mahe) encodes an RNA helicase.

Name: ENL/AF9-related
Description: ENL/AF9-related (ear) encodes a transcription factor that is a component of the super elongation complex (SEC), which regulates transcription by RNA Polymerase II. It also interacts with the histone methyltransferase encoded by gpp in the Dot1 complex (DotCom), which modifies chromatin structure by methylating histone H3 on lysine 79.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP-dependent activity, acting on DNA. Involved in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in pole plasm and primordial germ cell. Orthologous to human TTF2 (transcription termination factor 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) of mRNAs containing premature stop codons. Probable component of kinase complex containing nonC and recruited to stalled ribosomes (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VKQ6)

Name: smallminded
Description: AAA-protein family - ATPase - Mutants are defective in larval mitoses - expression of Smallminded in cells that undergo late embryonic or larval mitosis suggests a general role in promoting mitosis

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction and positive regulation of peptidyl-serine phosphorylation. Is expressed in embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to several human genes including BCAR3 (BCAR3 adaptor protein, NSP family member) and SH2D3C (SH2 domain containing 3C).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: black match
Description: black match (bma) encodes a protein involved in heat sensitivity.

Name: Arsenic resistance protein 2
Description: Arsenic resistance protein 2 (Ars2) encodes a protein that binds the cap binding complex and plays roles in small RNA biogenesis. It facilitates miRNA processing from primary miRNAs to pre-miRNAs. In addition, it interacts with the product of Dcr-2, modulates its activity and is required for siRNA-mediated silencing and antiviral defense.

Name: inebriated
Description: inebriated (ine) encodes a protein that belongs to the SLC6A family of neurotransmitter transporters. It is involved in the control of photoreceptor potential, perineurial glial growth and the osmotic stress response. It also acts in the peripheral glia to control motor neuron excitability in third instar larvae.

Name: N/A
Description: Acts as component of the retriever complex. The retriever complex is a heterotrimeric complex related to retromer cargo-selective complex (CSC) and essential for retromer-independent retrieval and recycling of numerous cargos. (UniProtKB:Q9VHM2)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloaminopeptidase activity; peptide binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in peptide catabolic process and proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ENPEP (glutamyl aminopeptidase).

Name: RHAU helicase
Description: RHAU helicase (Rhau) encodes a protein involved in G-quadruplex DNA unwinding.

Name: cannonball
Description: cannonball (can) encodes a testis-specific TBP-associated factor essential for spermatogenesis. It is required for the normal level of expression of a large number of spermatogenesis genes and is strongly associated with the nucleolus in primary spermatocytes.

Name: CIN85 and CD2AP related
Description: CIN85 and CD2AP related (cindr) encodes an adaptor protein that links cell surface junctions and adhesion proteins with multiple components of the actin cytoskeleton. It regulates cytoskeletal dynamics, eye patterning and endocytosis. It also cooperates with the product of scra to promote intercellular bridge stability during cytokinesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable potassium:chloride symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in cell volume homeostasis; chloride transmembrane transport; and inorganic ion homeostasis. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior-posterior subdivision of organism; circulatory system; epithelial tube; gut section; and head mesoderm derivative. Orthologous to human SLC12A9 (solute carrier family 12 member 9).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloaminopeptidase activity; peptide binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in peptide catabolic process and proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm.

Name: minus
Description: minus (mi) encodes a protein that can bind to the product of CycE and the SCF-ago ubiquitin-ligase complex. Minus regulates the turnover of the product of CycE and cell proliferation.

Name: suppressor of Hairy wing
Description: Component of the gypsy chromatin insulator complex which is required for the function of the gypsy chromatin insulator and other endogenous chromatin insulators. Chromatin insulators are regulatory elements which establish independent domains of transcriptional activity within eukaryotic genomes. Insulators have two defining properties; they can block the communication between an enhancer and a promoter when placed between them and can also buffer transgenes from position effect variegation (PEV). Insulators are proposed to structure the chromatin fiber into independent domains of differing transcriptional potential by promoting the formation of distinct chromatin loops. This chromatin looping may involve the formation of insulator bodies, where homotypic interactions between individual subunits of the insulator complex could promote the clustering of widely spaced insulators at the nuclear periphery. Within the gypsy insulator complex, this protein binds specifically to a region of the gypsy element located 3' of the 5' long terminal repeat (LTR), and may also mediate interaction with other endogenous insulators at sites distinct from those recognized by Cp190. (UniProtKB:P08970)

Name: Isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Predicted to enable isoleucine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in isoleucyl-tRNA aminoacylation and mitochondrial translation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human IARS2 (isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial).

Name: RNA-binding protein 4F
Description: RNA-binding protein 4F (Rnp4F) encodes an essential evolutionarily-conserved RNA-binding protein. Rnp4F gene expression is post-transcriptionally regulated by interaction with a stable stem-loop structure in the 5'-UTR of the mRNA with trans-acting factors.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly. Predicted to be active in cilium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Joubert syndrome 25 and autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 77. Orthologous to human CEP104 (centrosomal protein 104).

Name: Glutamate receptor IIC
Description: Glutamate receptor IIC (GluRIIC) encodes a subunit of the muscle glutamate receptor that responds to neurotransmitter at the neuromuscular junction. It is required for the synaptic localization of the products of GluRIIA and GluRIIB and for synaptic transmission.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloaminopeptidase activity; peptide binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in peptide catabolic process and proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head and embryonic hindgut.

Name: Dipeptidyl peptidase 10
Description: Enables dipeptidyl-peptidase activity and potassium channel regulator activity. Involved in proteolysis. Part of Kv4.3-DPP10 channel complex. Is active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; asthma; autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 33; and spinal muscular atrophy. Orthologous to several human genes including DPP6 (dipeptidyl peptidase like 6).

Name: scattered
Description: scattered (scat) encodes a component of the Golgi-Associated Retrograde Protein (GARP) complex and is required for spermatid development. It is important for secretory granule maturation and for preventing early degradation of these granules.

Name: Adaptor Protein complex 2, alpha subunit
Description: Adaptor Protein complex 2, alpha subunit (AP-2alpha) encodes a subunit of the AP-2 adaptor complex. It is required for proper intracellular trafficking and secretion. It contributes to asymmetric cell division, Notch signalling, apico-basal polarity and neurogenesis.

Name: smoke alarm
Description: smoke alarm (smal) encodes a protein involved in thermal nociception.

Name: sidestep VII
Description: Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval nervous system; and embryonic/larval tracheal dorsal trunk.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human PDPR (pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphatase regulatory subunit).

Name: SH2 ankyrin repeat kinase
Description: SH2 ankyrin repeat kinase (Shark) encodes a non-receptor tyrosine kinase of the Syk family. It contributes to embryonic dorsal closure, chorion formation and engulfment of dying neurons.

Name: Ubiquitin specific protease 2
Description: Hydrolase that deubiquitinates polyubiquitinated target proteins (PubMed:25027767). Required for preventing the activation of the Toll signaling cascades under unchallenged conditions (PubMed:25027767). Essential for bodily calcium homeostasis (PubMed:26756164). (UniProtKB:Q8IQ27)

Name: jim
Description: jim (jim) encodes a zinc finger C2H2 transcription factor involved in dendrite morphogenesis and regulation of chromatin silencing.

Name: Transmembrane O-mannosyltransferase targeting cadherins 2
Description: Transfers mannosyl residues to the hydroxyl group of serine or threonine residues. (UniProtKB:Q9V3X5)

Name: Shaw-like
Description: Predicted to enable delayed rectifier potassium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in potassium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be part of voltage-gated potassium channel complex. Predicted to be active in axon; dendrite membrane; and neuronal cell body membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy. Orthologous to human KCNC2 (potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily C member 2) and KCNC4 (potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily C member 4).

Name: simjang
Description: simjang (simj) encodes a component of the NURD complex, which couples chromatin remodelling and histone deacetylation to mediate transcriptional repression. The product of simj is involded in cardiogenesis and habituation.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 8a
Description: Ionotropic receptor 8a (Ir8a) encodes a member of the Ionotropic Receptor (IR) family of variant ionotropic glutamate receptors. It functions as a co-receptor together with ligand-specific IRs (in a probable heterotetrameric complex) to detect diverse organic acids.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; larval ventral nerve cord; and organism. Orthologous to several human genes including ZNF721 (zinc finger protein 721).

Name: sarcomere length short
Description: sarcomere length short (sals) encodes an actin binding protein that promotes sarcomeric actin filament elongation from pointed ends during muscle growth.

Name: Zinc finger DHHC-type containing 8
Description: Palmitoyltransferase that catalyzes the addition of palmitate onto various protein substrates and therefore functions in several unrelated biological processes (By similarity). Regulates tissue growth possibly by regulating Ras64B protein stability (PubMed:30735487). May regulate CG34450 mRNA levels (PubMed:30735487). (UniProtKB:Q9W345)

Name: Cullin 3
Description: Cullen-3 homolog acting in protein degradation - loss of function has pleiotropic effects during development, including defects in external sensory organ development, pattern formation and cell growth and survival - targets Cubitus interruptus

Name: TATA element modulatory factor
Description: Predicted to enable small GTPase binding activity. Predicted to be active in Golgi apparatus and endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human TMF1 (TATA element modulatory factor 1).

Name: N/A

Description: 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) receptor 2A (5-HT2A) encodes a 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) GPCR that belongs to the Class A GPCR family. They bind and transmit the signal from the neurotransmitter 5-HT (serotonin). The family can be subdivided into several subclasses based on pharmacology, signal transduction and structure. There are 5 genes encoding serotonin receptors in the Drosophila melanogaster genome: 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT7.

Name: Lysine ketoglutarate reductase/saccharopine dehydrogenase
Description: Lysine ketoglutarate reductase/saccharopine dehydrogenase (LKRSDH) encodes a bifunctional enzyme that catalyzes the first two steps in the lysine degradation pathway. Independently of its enzymatic activity, it also acts as a transcriptional corepressor in ecdysone signaling.

Orthologous to several human genes including SAFB (scaffold attachment factor B).

Name: Striatin interacting protein
Description: Striatin interacting protein (Strip) encodes an intracellular protein and component of the STRIPAK PP2A protein complex. It is involved in Hippo signaling, endosome maturation, and microtubule regulation.

Name: diego
Description: diego (dgo) encodes an ankyrin-repeat protein involved in planar cell polarity.

Name: small conductance calcium-activated potassium channel
Description: small conductance calcium-activated potassium channel (SK) encodes a potassium channel subunit. Four SK subunits together form a voltage-independent potassium channel, which is activated by intracellular calcium levels and is required for normal photoreceptor light response. Contrary to its mammalian counterpart, Drosophila SK channel is not sensitive to apamin, at least not in photoreceptors.

Name: HP1 and insulator partner protein 1
Description: HP1 and insulator partner protein 1 (HIPP1) encodes a chromatin-associated protein, displaying strong protein-protein interaction with the product of Su(var)205. It is localized to pericentric heterochromatin, and potentially has a separate role bound to insulators along with the products of su(Hw), mod(mdg4) and Cp190.

Name: Transmembrane O-mannosyltransferase targeting cadherins 3
Description: Transfers mannosyl residues to the hydroxyl group of serine or threonine residues. (UniProtKB:Q7K4B6)

Name: Tudor staphylococcal nuclease
Description: Endonuclease which shows activity towards both DNA and RNA substrates (PubMed:14508492, PubMed:26808625). Has a role in translation regulation throught its association with the with the RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC) (PubMed:14508492, PubMed:26808625). Plays a role in spermatogenesis probably by negatively regulating piwi expression in the germline (PubMed:26808625). Together with piwi, might be involved in transposon repression in the germline (PubMed:26808625). (UniProtKB:Q9W0S7)

Name: Chromator
Description: Chromator (Chro) encodes a chromodomain protein that is required for proper microtubule spindle formation. It is important for normal cell cycle progression, functioning as a spatial regulator of cell cycle factors.

Name: Origin recognition complex subunit 1
Description: Origin recognition complex subunit 1 (Orc1) encodes the largest subunit of the origin recognition complex (ORC), which is essential for the initiation of DNA replication in eukaryotic cells. The ATPase activity of the product of Orc1 is critical for the formation and function of the pre-replicative complex. The regulated degradation of the product of Orc1 by ubiquitin-mediated proteolysis after initiation of DNA replication helps to prevent re-replication.

Name: Polycystic kidney disease 2
Description: Polycystic kidney disease 2 (Pkd2) encodes a calcium permeable cation channel of the transient receptor potential (TRP) family. Its roles include sperm motility, smooth muscle contraction, larval feeding behavior, detection of mechanical stimuli and cold nociception.

Name: Glucosidase 2 alpha subunit
Description: Predicted to enable glucan 1,3-alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in N-glycan processing. Located in endomembrane system and extracellular region. Is expressed in several structures, including adult heart; anterior endoderm anlage; excretory system; germ layer; and gut section. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in polycystic kidney disease; polycystic kidney disease 3; and polycystic liver disease. Orthologous to several human genes including GANAB (glucosidase II alpha subunit).

Name: alpha actinin
Description: alpha actinin (Actn) encodes an actin cross-linking protein with muscle and non-muscle specific isoforms, which are produced by alternative spicing. The muscle isoform has a role in muscle development while the non-muscle isoform localizes to ovarian ring canals and has a role in cytoskeletal remodeling of follicle cells.

Name: Grp170 co-chaperone
Description: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Is expressed in several structures, including circulatory system; early extended germ band embryo; embryonic epidermis; gut section; and trunk ectoderm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in immunodeficiency 59. Orthologous to human HYOU1 (hypoxia up-regulated 1).

Description: TBP-associated factor 4 (Taf4) encodes a protein that forms part of the multisubunit basal transcription factor TFIIID. It is important in maintaining TFIIID stability for activator dependent transcription. It forms a histone-like pair with the product of Taf12.

Description: Enables RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain phosphoserine binding activity. Involved in wing disc dorsal/ventral pattern formation. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to human PCIF1 (phosphorylated CTD interacting factor 1).

Description: HMG Coenzyme A reductase (Hmgcr) encodes the rate-controlling enzyme of the mevalonate pathway that produces isoprenoids. It is required during heart tube formation, molting regulation and primordial germ cell migration.

Description: dysfusion (dysf) encodes a transcription factor that forms a DNA binding complex with the product of tgo to activate target genes. It is involved in in migration, adhesion, and fusion of tracheal cells, as well as tarsal joint formation during leg development.

Description: lysosomal enzyme receptor protein (Lerp) encodes a protein involved in lysosome function and autophagy.

Name: DNA ligase 4
Description: DNA ligase 4 (DNAlig4) encodes an ATP-dependent DNA ligase responsible for the sealing of DNA double-strand breaks during the canonical non-homologous end joining pathway of DNA repair. It interacts with the product of XRCC4 for stability and DNA ligase activity.

Name: Tubulin tyrosine ligase-like 5
Description: Enables tubulin-glutamic acid ligase activity. Involved in C-terminal protein amino acid modification. Predicted to be active in cilium. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval nervous system; and sensory nervous system primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cone-rod dystrophy 19. Orthologous to human TTLL5 (tubulin tyrosine ligase like 5).

Name: alpha Catenin
Description: Associates with the cytoplasmic domain of a variety of cadherins. The association of catenins to cadherins produces a complex which is linked to the actin filament network, and which seems to be of primary importance for cadherins cell-adhesion properties. (UniProtKB:P35220)

Name: spellchecker1
Description: Involved in postreplication mismatch repair. Binds specifically to DNA containing mismatched nucleotides thus providing a target for the excision repair processes characteristic of postreplication mismatch repair (By similarity). (UniProtKB:P43248)

Name: Gamma-tubulin ring protein 91
Description: Gamma-tubulin ring protein 91 (Grip91) encodes a gamma-tubulin binding protein involved in male meiotic division and the organization of the meiotic spindle.

Name: taranis
Description: taranis (tara) encodes a transcriptional co-regulator that interacts with chromatin remodeling complexes, cell cycle proteins, and the JNK signaling pathway. It contributes to sleep, neural progenitor proliferation, and cell fate maintenance.

Name: RAB3 GTPase activating protein subunit 1
Description: Catalytic subunit of the Rab3 GTPase-activating (Rab3GAP) complex composed of Rab3-GAP and Rab3GAP1, which has both GTPase-activating protein (GAP) activity towards Rab3, and guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF) activity towards Rab18 (Probable). As part of the Rab3GAP complex, required for the rapid induction and sustained expression of synaptic homeostasis at the neuromuscular junction (NMJ) (Probable). Also participates in the regulation of autophagy in tissues such as larval fat cells and adult muscles (Probable). The Rab3GAP complex, acts as a GAP for Rab3 by converting active Rab3-GTP to the inactive form Rab3-GDP (By similarity). At the neuromuscular junction (NMJ), forms a presynaptic signaling mechanism with Rab3 that regulates progression of synaptic homeostasis at a late stage of vesicle release (Probable). Within this mechanism Rab3-GTP acts, directly or indirectly, to inhibit the progression of synaptic homeostasis, and Rab3-GAP functions to inactivate this action of Rab3-GTP (Probable). The Rab3GAP complex, acts as a GEF for Rab18 by promoting the conversion of inactive Rab18-GDP to the active form Rab18-GTP (By similarity). Regulates autophagy as part of a Rab3GAP-Rab18 module (PubMed:32248620). Once Rab18 is activated by the GEF Rab3GAP complex, the Rab3GAP-Rab18 module localizes to autophagosomes, and regulates autolysosome formation and maturation together with the Rab18 interacting effector, the PI3K/Vps34 Complex I (PubMed:32248620). (UniProtKB:Q9VQ26)

Description: ER Membrane protein Complex 1 (EMC1) encodes a subunit of the ER membrane protein complex (EMC). In fly retinas, EMC has been shown to be essential for the biosynthesis of multi-pass membrane proteins, but not for single-pass membrane proteins and secretory proteins.

Description: The coatomer is a cytosolic protein complex that binds to dilysine motifs and reversibly associates with Golgi non-clathrin-coated vesicles, which further mediate biosynthetic protein transport from the ER, via the Golgi up to the trans Golgi network. Coatomer complex is required for budding from Golgi membranes, and is essential for the retrograde Golgi-to-ER transport of dilysine-tagged proteins (By similarity). (UniProtKB:O62621)

Name: Phosphodiesterase 8

Name: Glutamate receptor IIB

Description: Component of the eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 (eIF-3) complex, which is involved in protein synthesis of a specialized repertoire of mRNAs and, together with other initiation factors, stimulates binding of mRNA and methionyl-tRNAi to the 40S ribosome. Description: Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to several human genes including WDR20 (WD repeat domain 20).

Name: Rat1 5'-3' exoribonuclease
Description: Rat1 5'-3' exoribonuclease (Rat1) encodes a member of the 5'-3' exonuclease family. It is required for mRNA processing and mutations cause phenotypes in various cell types, including the nervous system.

Name: beta-Mannosidase
Description: Predicted to enable beta-mannosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in glycoprotein catabolic process. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval digestive system; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in beta-mannosidosis. Orthologous to human MANBA (mannosidase beta).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and phosphatidylinositol phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in endocytic recycling; endocytosis; and regulation of Rab protein signal transduction. Predicted to be located in clathrin-coated vesicle. Predicted to be active in cytosol and intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human DENND1A (DENN domain containing 1A); DENND1B (DENN domain containing 1B); and DENND1C (DENN domain containing 1C).

Name: minibrain
Description: minibrain (mnb) encodes a Ser/Thr protein kinase of the DYRK subfamily. It interacts with several signaling pathways and it is involved in behavior, cell cycle, cytoskeleton dynamics, neural proliferation, neurogenesis, neuronal differentiation, synaptic plasticity, and tissue growth.

Name: RALBP1 associated Eps domain containing
Description: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in endocytosis and endosomal transport. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and plasma membrane. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation. Orthologous to several human genes including REPS1 (RALBP1 associated Eps domain containing 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable kainate selective glutamate receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of synaptic activity. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult CNS glial cell; adult brain; adult head; and transmedullary neuron Tm5c. Orthologous to human GRIK4 (glutamate ionotropic receptor kainate type subunit 4).

Name: BTB-protein-VII
Description: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo.

Name: Glutamate receptor IIA
Description: Glutamate receptor IIA (GluRIIA) encodes a subunit of the muscle glutamate receptor that responds to neurotransmitter at the neuromuscular junction.

Name: Rho GTPase activating protein at 71E
Description: Rho GTPase activating protein at 71E (RhoGAP71E) encodes a Rho GTPase activating protein that is involved in the regulation of actin dynamics during epithelial morphogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space.

Name: Protein Kinase D
Description: Protein Kinase D (PKD) encodes a Ser/Thr kinase of the PKC family of Ca[2+]/calmodulin-dependent protein kinases. It regulates actin-dynamics by controlling the activity of the phosphatase encoded by ssh.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal dorsal trunk; embryonic/larval visceral tracheal branch; and tracheal primordium.

Name: Component of oligomeric golgi complex 3
Description: Involved in ER-Golgi transport. (UniProtKB:Q961G1)

Name: midline fasciclin
Description: midline fasciclin (mfas) encodes a protein involved in axonogenesis and regulation of hemocyte proliferation.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable actin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of actin filament bundle assembly. Located in Z disc. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; embryonic/larval muscle system; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human SYNPO (synaptopodin); SYNPO2 (synaptopodin 2); and SYNPO2L (synaptopodin 2 like).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Orthologous to several human genes including PAXBP1 (PAX3 and PAX7 binding protein 1).

Name: Dopamine 2-like receptor
Description: Dopamine 2-like receptor (Dop2R) encodes a G protein-coupled receptor that is activated by dopamine. Postulated Dop2R-mediated functions include regulation of: aggression, cardiac function, feeding, levels of juvenile hormone and 20-hydroxyecdysone, lifespan, locomotor activity, nocturnal activity, olfactory associative learning, response to stress, sleep and sucrose acceptance.

Name: Bicaudal C
Description: Bicaudal C (BicC) encodes an RNA binding protein that interacts with the deadenylase encoded by twin and negatively regulates target mRNAs. It is required for oogenesis and is a maternally-expressed gene involved in embryonic patterning.

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 100kD subunit 3
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase binding activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton transmembrane transport and vacuolar acidification. Predicted to be part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase, V0 domain. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive cutis laxa type IIA; autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 1; and wrinkly skin syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP6V0A2 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a2).

Name: abrupt
Description: abrupt (ab) encodes a transcription factor that negatively regulates ecdysone signaling, as it binds to the product of tai. It regulates animal survival, organogenesis and multiple tissue morphogenesis, epithelial cell fate, cellular sexual identity, neuron differentiation and neuronal identity switch, cell migration, oncogenesis and germline differentiation. In many cell types, the product of ab is post-transcriptionally repressed by the steroid-induced miRNA let-7.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in RNA-mediated heterochromatin formation. Predicted to be part of nuclear RNA-directed RNA polymerase complex. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary immunodeficiency disease. Orthologous to human ZNFX1 (zinc finger NFX1-type containing 1).

Name: Iron regulatory protein 1A
Description: Iron regulatory protein 1A (Irp-1A) encodes a cytosolic aconitase that under iron deficiency (or if cytosolic superoxide is present) loses its iron-sulfur cluster, changes confirmation and binds iron regulatory elements (so far identified on the products of SdhB and Fer1HCH mRNAs).

Name: Inositol hexakisphosphate kinase
Description: Predicted to enable inositol hexakisphosphate kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in inositol phosphate biosynthetic process and phosphatidylinositol phosphate biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; hypodermal muscle cell of larval abdomen; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system. Orthologous to human IP6K1 (inositol hexakisphosphate kinase 1); IP6K2 (inositol hexakisphosphate kinase 2); and IP6K3 (inositol hexakisphosphate kinase 3).

Name: Glutamate receptor IID
Description: Glutamate receptor IID (GluRIID) encodes a subunit of the muscle glutamate receptor that responds to neurotransmitter at the neuromuscular junction.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ABCF1 (ATP binding cassette subfamily F member 1).

Name: Spindle assembly abnormal 4
Description: Spindle assembly abnormal 4 (Sas-4) encodes  a centriole protein that is essential for centriole assembly. It is recruited to centrioles through an interaction with the centriole protein encoded by ana2, and it helps recruit microtubules to the centriole.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable diphthine-ammonia ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-diphthamide biosynthetic process from peptidyl-histidine. Orthologous to human DPH6 (diphthamine biosynthesis 6).

Name: Rrp6
Description: Rrp6 (Rrp6) encodes an exoribonuclease that forms part of the RNA processing exosome complex. It is involved in the regulation of cell cycle progresion and mRNA surveillance.

Name: Cell division cycle 27
Description: Cell division cycle 27 (Cdc27) encodes a component of the anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome (APC/C). It is important for substrate recruitment and interacts with its co-activators, encoded by fzy and fzr, as well as the mitotic checkpoint proteins, encoded by mad2 and BubR1.

Name: Su(z)12
Description: Su(z)12 (Su(z)12) is a member of the Polycomb group of genes with products involved in transcriptional silencing. Su(z)12 encodes a subunit of Polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2), where it is required for the histone methyltransferase activity that yields trimethylation of histone H3 on lysine 27 (H3-K27me3).

Name: Toll-9
Description: Toll-9 (Toll-9) encodes a transmembrane signalling receptor belonging to the Toll family of protein.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG43759 (FBgn0264090). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:18930335..19028629. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG44434 (FBgn0265626). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:18678680..18684198. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported.

Name: Semaphorin 1a
Description: Semaphorin 1a (Sema1a) encodes a transmembrane protein belonging to the semaphorin protein family. It is a repulsive axon guidance cue, signaling through direct interactions with the receptor encoded by PlexA, and also functions as a receptor to regulate dendrite targeting and axon guidance. Secreted semaphorins encoded by Sema2a and Sema2b can act as the product of Sema1a ligands.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial RNA processing and regulation of mitochondrial mRNA stability. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix and ribonucleoprotein granule. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system; and trunk mesoderm. Orthologous to human FASTKD1 (FAST kinase domains 1).

Name: Iron regulatory protein 1B
Description: Iron regulatory protein 1B (Irp-1B) encodes a cytosolic aconitase highly homologous to the product of Irp-1A.

Name: Peroxin 6
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity. Involved in peroxisome organization. Located in peroxisome. Is expressed in embryonic cortex and yolk. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Heimler syndrome 2; peroxisomal biogenesis disorder; and peroxisome biogenesis disorder 4A. Orthologous to human PEX6 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 6).

Name: Eye-enriched kainate receptor
Description: Eye-enriched kainate receptor (Ekar) encodes an ionotropic receptor that responds to the neurotransmitter glutamate.

Name: Pms2
Description: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity. Predicted to be involved in mismatch repair. Predicted to be part of MutLalpha complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Lynch syndrome; hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer type 4; mismatch repair cancer syndrome; ovarian cancer; and urinary bladder cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including PMS2 (PMS1 homolog 2, mismatch repair system component).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG9861 (FBgn0034844). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:23323659..23326745. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Name: hephaestus
Description: hephaestus (heph) encodes a nucleo-cytoplasmic shuttling protein that regulates osk mRNA translation. It is involved in spermatid individualization and Notch signalling regulation.

Name: CASK
Description: CASK (CASK) encodes a member of the MAGUK family of scaffolding proteins. In epithelial tissues, the product of CASK functions as an adhesion molecule involved in cell proliferation, cytoskeletal remodeling and cell migration. In neurons, the product of CASK serves as a scaffold for a number of signaling and transmembrane molecules and is involved in synaptic development and plasticity.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in GPI anchor biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 1. Orthologous to human PIGN (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class N).

Name: lost boys
Description: Key component of the nexin-dynein regulatory complex (N-DRC), essential for N-DRC integrity. Involved in the regulation of flagellar motility (By similarity). Involved in sperm motility. Required for the sperm to enter in the coiled storage seminal receptacle (SR) tubule (PubMed:21289096). (UniProtKB:Q4V516)

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in copper ion homeostasis. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon.

Name: Glutamate receptor IIE
Description: Glutamate receptor IIE (GluRIIE) encodes an ion channel subunit involved in calcium ion transport.

Name: Sarcolemma associated protein
Description: Enables protein kinase binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of hippo signaling. Part of FAR/SIN/STRIPAK complex. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to several human genes including SLMAP (sarcolemma associated protein).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in GPI anchor biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 1. Orthologous to human PIGN (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class N).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly. Predicted to be active in axonemal microtubule; centriole; and centrosome. Is expressed in central brain primordium; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium. Orthologous to human CEP162 (centrosomal protein 162).

Name: bride of sevenless
Description: Acts as a ligand for sevenless tyrosine-kinase receptor during eye development. (UniProtKB:P22815)

Name: Ubiquitin specific protease 8
Description: Ubiquitin specific protease 8 (Usp8) encodes a protease involved in protein deubiquitination. It contributes to the integrity of ESCRT sorting machinery and the regulation of Hedgehog and Wingless signaling pathways.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables myosin binding activity. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: Chromosome transmission fidelity 4
Description: Predicted to enable chromatin binding activity. Involved in DNA endoreduplication and preblastoderm mitotic cell cycle. Predicted to be active in nuclear replication fork. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human WDHD1 (WD repeat and HMG-box DNA binding protein 1).

Name: Secretory 5
Description: Component of the exocyst complex involved in the docking of exocytic vesicles with fusion sites on the plasma membrane. (UniProtKB:Q9VQQ9)

Name: kekkon 2
Description: Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in central nervous system; embryonic/larval nervous system; head; presumptive embryonic/larval peripheral nervous system; and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in chorion-containing eggshell formation. Predicted to be located in egg chorion.

Name: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class N
Description: Predicted to enable mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in GPI anchor biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 1. Orthologous to human PIGN (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class N).

Name: lethal (2) 37Cb
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and RNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval garland cell; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to human DHX16 (DEAH-box helicase 16).

Name: chaski
Description: Enables monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in export across plasma membrane and monocarboxylic acid transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including blastoderm embryo; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; gut section; and trunk ectoderm. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC16A14 (solute carrier family 16 member 14).

Name: Sarcosine dehydrogenase
Description: Predicted to enable sarcosine dehydrogenase activity. Involved in S-adenosylmethionine cycle and sarcosine catabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in sarcosinemia. Orthologous to human SARDH (sarcosine dehydrogenase).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in nuclear speck and presynaptic active zone. Orthologous to human PNISR (PNN interacting serine and arginine rich protein).

Name: Transportin
Description: Transportin (Tnpo) encodes a protein involved in Hh signalling regulation by mediating the import of the transcription factor encoded by ci into the nucleus.

Name: bruno 2
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA 3'-UTR binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splice site selection; negative regulation of translation; and regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Predicted to be part of ribonucleoprotein complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; anterior endoderm anlage; and germ layer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy. Orthologous to human CELF1 (CUGBP Elav-like family member 1) and CELF2 (CUGBP Elav-like family member 2).

Name: POU domain protein 2
Description: POU domain protein 2 (pdm2) encodes a transcription factor that plays multiple roles in neurogenesis, including acting as a temporal identity gene and a timing gene required for the termination of the Kr temporal identity window.

Name: Chloride channel-c
Description: Chloride channel-c (ClC-c) encodes an intracellular chloride transporter that is involved in endosomal lumen acidification.

Name: Kotsubu
Description: Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium and positive regulation of innate immune response. Located in P granule. Is expressed in several structures, including fat body/gonad primordium; germline cell; and gonad.

Name: Chd3
Description: Chd3 (Chd3) encodes a nuclear ATP-dependent nucleosome remodeler of the CHD family. It associates with active chromatin and utilizes the energy of ATP hydrolysis to move nucleosomes along DNA.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be part of Cul4-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human DCAF15 (DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 15).

Name: Phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate 5-kinase 59B
Description: Phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate 5-kinase at 59B (PIP5K59B) encodes a lipid kinase enzyme that mediates the synthesis of the lipid phosphatidylinositol 4,5 bisphosphate (PIP2) during phospholipase C signalling.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in adult head; adult midgut progenitor cell; embryonic midgut chamber; embryonic/larval midgut; and gastric caecum. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head; anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval midgut; extended germ band embryo; and yolk nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable SH3 domain binding activity. Is expressed in embryonic dorsal apodeme and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable rRNA (cytosine-C5-)-methyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA and rRNA base methylation. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle system; endoderm anlage; germ layer; presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human NOP2 (NOP2 nucleolar protein).

Name: yuri gagarin
Description: yuri gagarin (yuri) encodes a protein involved in gravitaxis, ciliary basal body organization and sperm individualization.

Name: lethal (2) 41Ab
Description: Predicted to be involved in axonemal dynein complex assembly and cilium movement. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in chordotonal neurons and spermatogonium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary ciliary dyskinesia 15. Orthologous to human CCDC40 (coiled-coil domain containing 40).

Name: N(alpha)-acetyltransferase 15/16
Description: Predicted to contribute to peptide alpha-N-acetyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in N-terminal peptidyl-methionine acetylation. Part of NatA complex. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 50. Orthologous to human NAA15 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 15, NatA auxiliary subunit) and NAA16 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 16, NatA auxiliary subunit).

Name: Suppressor of variegation 3-3
Description: Suppressor of variegation 3-3 (Su(var)3-3) encodes a member of the Lysine specific demethylase (LSD1/KDM1) family. It can function both as a transcriptional co-repressor and a co-activator. It demethylates histone H3K4-me2 and -me1 residues, and promotes heterochromatin formation by facilitating H3K9 methylation mediated by the product of Su(var)3-9. It is involved in fertility, wing patterning formation and bristle specification.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human ZNF646 (zinc finger protein 646).

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human KIAA0930 (KIAA0930).

Name: Secretory 3
Description: Component of the exocyst complex involved in the docking of exocytic vesicles with fusion sites on the plasma membrane. (UniProtKB:Q9VVG4)

Name: regular
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; mesoderm; and pole plasm.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human SANBR (SANT and BTB domain regulator of CSR).

Name: CREB-regulated transcription coactivator
Description: CREB-regulated transcription coactivator (Crtc) encodes a highly conserved transcriptional coactivator of cAMP-response element-binding protein (CREB). Its nuclear localization is regulated by several factors including intracellular cAMP or calcium levels, or calcineurin. Sik family kinases also phosphorylate to inhibit the product of Crtc and, consequently, control energy homeostais and lipid metabolism.

Name: quail
Description: quail (qua) encodes a member of the Villin family of F-actin crosslinking proteins. It is involved in wing hair growth and oogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in early extended germ band embryo; embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval central nervous system; embryonic/larval pericardial cell; and embryonic/larval salivary gland.

Name: N/A
Description: CG4733 encodes a protein that is predicted to be the B"/PR72 subunit of Protein Phosphatase 2A (PP2A) regulatory B unit. The B subunits determine the substrate specificity of the enzyme.

Name: spaghetti-squash activator
Description: spaghetti-squash activator (sqa) encodes a myosin light chain kinase-like protein. It is a substrate of the kinase encoded by Atg1 and is required for starvation-induced autophagy.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 53
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 53 (Vps53) encodes a predicted component of the Golgi-Associated Retrograde Protein (GARP) complex. It is important for secretory granule maturation and for preventing early degradation of these granules.

Name: calcium-independent phospholipase A2 VIA
Description: calcium-independent phospholipase A2 VIA (iPLA2-VIA) encodes a protein that localizes to cytosol and mitochondria involved in repairing oxidized mitochondrial lipids, such as cardiolipin, and thus preventing cytochrome c release. It is partially responsible for cardiolipin depletion and monolysocardiolipin accumulation in Taz-deficient flies, which is a model of Barth syndrome.

Name: Minichromosome maintenance 2
Description: Acts as component of the MCM2-7 complex (MCM complex) which is the replicative helicase essential for 'once per cell cycle' DNA replication initiation and elongation in eukaryotic cells. Core component of CDC45-MCM-GINS (CMG) helicase, the molecular machine that unwinds template DNA during replication, and around which the replisome is built. The active ATPase sites in the MCM2-7 ring are formed through the interaction surfaces of two neighboring subunits such that a critical structure of a conserved arginine finger motif is provided in trans relative to the ATP-binding site of the Walker A box of the adjacent subunit. The six ATPase active sites, however, are likely to contribute differentially to the complex helicase activity. Required for the entry in S phase and for cell division. (UniProtKB:P49735)

Name: beta amyloid protein precursor-like
Description: During development, plays a role in the regulation of the neddylation pathway. Appl and APP-BP1 interact antagonistically during development. (UniProtKB:P14599)

Name: Hyperkinetic
Description: Hyperkinetic (Hk) encodes a beta-subunit of Sh K[+] channels and modulates its channel function. It is important in regulating action potentials in neurons and muscles, and transmitter release.

Name: pavarotti
Description: pavarotti (pav) encodes a microtubule motor protein from the Kinesin superfamily. It plays important roles during the mitotic cycle including spindle formation, cortical cytoskeleton reorganization and cytokinesis. It also negatively regulates Wnt activity.

Name: Component of oligomeric golgi complex 1
Description: Required for normal Golgi function. (UniProtKB:Q9VGC3)

Name: rotated abdomen
Description: rotated abdomen (rt) encodes a protein that transfers a mannose to the Ser/Thr residues of the product of Dg, via forming an heterodimer with the product of tw. Its roles include myogenesis, muscle architecture and cell adhesion.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable spectrin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in G2/M transition of mitotic cell cycle. Predicted to be located in apical part of cell. Predicted to be part of stereocilia ankle link complex. Predicted to be active in cilium; plasma membrane; and stereocilium tip. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Usher syndrome; Usher syndrome type 1; Usher syndrome type 1C; and autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 18A. Orthologous to human USH1C (USH1 protein network component harmonin).

Name: Neurotrophin 1
Description: Neurotrophin which may function as a ligand for the Toll-related receptors Toll-7 and Tollo (PubMed:22022271, PubMed:23892553). Binds to Toll-7 and probably acts as its ligand in promoting motor axon targeting and neuronal survival in the central nervous system (CNS) (PubMed:23892553). Involved in synaptic targeting of ISNb/d motorneurons and also some SNa motorneurons (PubMed:19018662). In larvae, involved in the negative regulation of the tracheal immune response to bacterial infection perhaps by acting as a ligand for the Toll-related receptor Tollo (PubMed:22022271). May be involved in the normal development of specific neurons at the neuromuscular junction (PubMed:24124519). (UniProtKB:B7TB45)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic maxillary sensory complex.

Name: Microsomal triacylglycerol transfer protein
Description: Microsomal triacylglycerol transfer protein (Mtp) encodes a phosphatidylcholine transporter involved in lipoprotein metabolism, tracheal system lumen formation and neuron development.

Name: interference hedgehog
Description: interference hedgehog (ihog) encodes a type 1 membrane protein that acts as a co-receptor for the product of hh upstream or at the level of the receptor encoded by ptc. It interacts with the products of disp, dlp, dally and shf. It is involved in imaginal pattern formation and embryonic cuticle pattern formation.

Name: recombination-defective
Description: recombination-defective (rec) interacts with other Mini-Chromosome Maintenance (MCM)-related proteins (encoded by mei-217 and mei-218) to make meiotic crossovers.

Name: DNA polymerase eta
Description: DNA polymerase eta (PolH) encodes a member of the Y-family of DNA translesion polymerases. It operates during the bypass of UV-induced lesions and possibly during homologous recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks.

Name: Zinc-finger protein at 72D
Description: Zinc-finger protein at 72D (Zn72D) encodes a protein involved in the splicing of the mle transcript.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytoskeleton. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 49. Orthologous to human CFAP58 (cilia and flagella associated protein 58).

Name: Female sterile (2) Ketel
Description: Female sterile (2) Ketel (Fs(2)Ket) encodes a protein that functions in nuclear protein import, formation of the spindle apparatus and nuclear envelope assembly. It is also involved in biogenesis of the mitochondria.

Name: Coat Protein (coatomer) gamma
Description: Coat Protein (coatomer) gamma (gammaCOP) encodes a subunit of the coat complex of COPI vesicles, which transport cargo within the Golgi apparatus and from the Golgi apparatus to the endoplasmic reticulum. Its functions include membrane and protein trafficking in the secretory apparatus.

Name: fandango
Description: fandango (fand) encodes a subunit of the NTC/Prp19 complex, which is essential for efficient spliceosome activation. It regulates the efficiency of splicing of zygotic transcripts and their abundance. It is required for normal cellularization, tracheal cell migration, and epidermal morphogenesis in the embryo.

Name: Ecdysone-induced protein 74EF
Description: Ecdysone-induced protein 74EF (Eip74EF) encodes a transcription factor that responds to different concentrations of 20-hydroxyecdysone. It contributes to puparium formation and autophagy.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal section.

Name: Neprilysin 5
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult brain and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in distal arthrogryposis type 5D. Orthologous to human ECEL1 (endothelin converting enzyme like 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of centriole replication. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: sequoia
Description: sequoia (seq) encodes a pan-neuronally expressed zinc-finger transcription factor that governs dendrite and axon outgrowth. It is necessary for the proper development of tracheal branches and dendritic branches of multidendritic neurons, as well as development of the R8 cell in eye development.

Name: down and out
Description: Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; and larval ventral nerve cord.

Name: Mucin 96D
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be located in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in embryonic/larval proventriculus; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and organism.

Name: Hormone-sensitive lipase
Description: Hormone-sensitive lipase (Hsl) encodes a protein involved in lipid storage.

Description: Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cone-rod dystrophy 12 and retinitis pigmentosa 41. Orthologous to human PROM1 (prominin 1).

Name: Nckx30C
Description: May function in the removal and maintenance of calcium homeostasis during signaling in the adult and in signaling events during embryogenesis and patterning of imaginal disks. Transports one Ca(2+) and 1 K(+) in exchange for 4 Na(+). (UniProtKB:Q9U6A0)

Name: lonely heart
Description: lonely heart (loh) encodes a protein involved in larval heart development and regulation of the extracellular matrix assembly.

Name: broad
Description: Broad-complex proteins are required for puffing and transcription of salivary gland late genes during metamorphosis. (UniProtKB:Q24206)

Name: kekkon 1
Description: kekkon 1 (kek1) encodes a transmembrane protein that acts in a negative feedback loop to modulate the activity of the product of Egfr in a number of tissues, including follicle cells and imaginal discs. It also plays a role in axonal outgrowth in the central nervous system.

Name: phtf
Description: Predicted to be located in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval dorsal vessel; and male germline stem cell. Orthologous to human PHTF1 (putative homeodomain transcription factor 1) and PHTF2 (putative homeodomain transcription factor 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein C-terminus binding activity. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hydrocephalus. Orthologous to human MPDZ (multiple PDZ domain crumbs cell polarity complex component).

Name: TFIIF-interacting CTD phosphatase
Description: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in dephosphorylation of RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain. Located in nucleus and polytene chromosome. Is expressed in nurse cell. Orthologous to human CTDP1 (CTD phosphatase subunit 1).

Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Description: Predicted to enable histone deacetylase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in compound eye photoreceptor development. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: gone early
Description: gone early (goe) encodes a non-peptidase homolog of Neprilysin (M13) family metalloendopeptidases. It is expressed in various EGF (epidermal growth factor) ligand-producing cells and can attenuate EGFR signaling. The roles of the procut of goe include regulation of primordial germ cell differentiation and germline stem cell formation.

Name: Paramyosin
Description: Paramyosin (Prm) encodes a muscle protein found only in invertebrates. It dimerizes into a coiled-coil that occupies the interior of the thick filament. Its role is thought to be structural, although it can be phosphorylated and this is important for muscle function.

Name: ebony
Description: ebony (e) encodes a protein that links beta-alanine to biogenic amines like dopamine or histamine. It controls the amount of free biogenic amine, e.g. of dopamine in cuticle formation and of histamine in visual signal transduction of the eye. It is also involved in behavioral rhythmicity.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult brain; embryonic/larval tracheal system; extended germ band embryo; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transcription corepressor activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Part of Sin3-type complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human PHF12 (PHD finger protein 12).

Name: daughter of sevenless
Description: Essential component for signaling from various receptor tyrosine kinases such as Sevenless, TORSO and DER. Required for photoreceptor cell and wing development. (UniProtKB:Q9VZZ9)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in embryonic large intestine; garland cell primordium; organism; and plasmatocyte primordium. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Name: Ecdysone receptor
Description: Ecdysone receptor (EcR) encodes a protein that interacts with the product of usp to form the nuclear ecdysone receptor heterodimer, which modulates, in conjunction with co-activators and co-repressors, the activities of hundreds of genes in a tissue- and stage-specific way. EcR is widely expressed in embryonic and larval tissues and in some adult tissues where its activities (modulated by the hormone ecdysone) trigger both molting and metamorphosis.

Name: Cbl proto-oncogene
Description: Cbl proto-oncogene (Cbl) encodes an E3 protein-ubiquitin ligase for protein post-translational modification in RTK signaling (EGFR, VEGFR, FGF, and RET families) and non-RTK signaling (Src family). After the ubiquitination mediated by the product of Cbl, the substrates will be targeted to protein degradation for controlling cell growth, survival, migration and inflammation.

Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Peak expression observed during late pupal stages, in adult male stages.

Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including RUFY1 (RUN and FYVE domain containing 1).

Name: shibire
Description: Microtubule-associated force-producing protein which is involved in the production of microtubule bundles and which is able to bind and hydrolyze GTP. Implicated in endocytic protein sorting. (UniProtKB:P27619)

Name: Sex comb on midleg
Description: Polycomb group (PcG) protein. PcG proteins act by forming multiprotein complexes, which are required to maintain the transcriptionally repressive state of homeotic genes throughout development. PcG proteins are not required to initiate repression, but to maintain it during later stages of development. They probably act via the methylation of histones, rendering chromatin heritably changed in its expressibility. (UniProtKB:Q9VHA0)

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human CCDC191 (coiled-coil domain containing 191).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatogonium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 51. Orthologous to human CFAP91 (cilia and flagella associated protein 91).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular monovalent inorganic cation homeostasis and inorganic cation transmembrane transport. Predicted to be part of sodium:potassium-exchanging ATPase complex.

Name: peptide O-xylosyltransferase
Description: peptide O-xylosyltransferase (oxt) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the first xylose of the linkage region of glycosaminoglycan (GAG). Through GAG synthesis, the product of oxt is involved in several signaling pathways mediated by GAGs in development.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 39
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 39 (Vps39) encodes a subunit of the homotypic fusion and vacuole protein sorting (HOPS) complex required for autophagosome maturation.

Name: Topoisomerase 3beta
Description: Topoisomerase 3beta (Top3beta) encodes an RNA topoisomerase that participates in both transcription and translation. It promotes transcription by being recruited by the product of Tdrd3, an epigenetic reader recognizing dimethylarginine motifs in core histones. It contributes to translation by complexing with the product of Fmr1, an RNA-binding protein deficient in fragile X mental retardation syndrome.

Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Is expressed in embryonic Malpighian tubule and embryonic/larval midgut. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to human LENG8 (leukocyte receptor cluster member 8).

Name: Son RNA binding protein
Description: RNA-binding protein that protects nascent transcripts containing intronic transposable sequences, known as INE-1, from being degraded by DIP1 (PubMed:31730657). Modulates DIP1 activity by repressing its sumoylation levels (PubMed:31730657). This ensures that intronic sequences will be degradated only after splicing (PubMed:31730657). In the ovaries, regulates germline stem cells (GSCs) self-renewal by repressing the expression of the GSC differentiation-promoting factor Rga (PubMed:29887366). (UniProtKB:Q9VHB0)

Name: aluminum tubes
Description: Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; and organism. Orthologous to human RRBP1 (ribosome binding protein 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human KIAA0825 (KIAA0825).

Name: Fasciclin 2
Description: Fasciclin 2 (Fas2) encodes a member of the immunoglobulin superfamily of cell adhesion molecules, and functions during axon extension and imaginal disc growth. Fas2 promotes EGFR-dependent epithelial cell proliferation in imaginal discs at low and moderate expression levels, whereas it acts as an EGFR repressor at high expression levels.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carbohydrate binding activity and signaling receptor activity. Involved in nervous system development. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: Retinal Homeobox
Description: Retinal Homeobox (Rx) encodes a homeodomain transcription factor required for processes of brain development. It is involved in growth regulation, proliferation and cell survival.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in cell adhesion. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in eye and photoreceptor neurons. Orthologous to human SPON1 (spondin 1).

Name: yata
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein phosphorylation. Is expressed in adult head. Used to study autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 21. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 21. Orthologous to human SCYL1 (SCY1 like pseudokinase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Probable C-mannosyltransferase that mediates C-mannosylation of tryptophan residues on target proteins. (UniProtKB:Q9VWR8)

Name: TATA box-binding protein-associated factor RNA polymerase I subunit B
Description: TATA box-binding protein-associated factor RNA polymerase I subunit B (TAF1B) encodes a protein that associates with the products of TAF1C-like and udd. It helps to regulate pre-rRNA transcription.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human TTC14 (tetratricopeptide repeat domain 14).

Name: Bromodomain containing 8
Description: Involved in double-strand break repair; histone acetylation; and negative regulation of gene expression. Part of NuA4 histone acetyltransferase complex. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human BRD8 (bromodomain containing 8).

Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human IQCA1 (IQ motif containing with AAA domain 1) and IQCA1L (IQ motif containing with AAA domain 1 like).

Name: Patj
Description: Patj (Patj) encodes a PDZ domain-protein that forms an apical protein complex with the products of crb and sdt. It plays supporting roles in apico-basal cell polarity and stability of adherens junction. It is also involved in retinal morphogenesis, maintenance, and planar cell polarity.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic central brain; extended germ band embryo; and lateral cord surface glial cell. Orthologous to human CIP2A (cellular inhibitor of PP2A).

Name: inturned
Description: inturned (in) encodes a cytoplasmic protein that functions as a downstream member of the fz-stan planar cell polarity pathway, which controls hair and bristle polarity in the adult. In directly binds with the products of fy, frtz and mwh and accumulates on the proximal side of wing cells.

Name: Leucyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Predicted to enable leucine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in leucyl-tRNA aminoacylation and mitochondrial translation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; anal pad primordium; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; gut section; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Perrault syndrome. Orthologous to human LARS2 (leucyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial).

Name: wings down
Description: May belong to a complex set of multifingered proteins which play an important role in gene activation or regulation at early embryonic stages through a maximal accumulation of their transcripts (or protein product) in the mature oocyte. (UniProtKB:P15619)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human TMEM245 (transmembrane protein 245).
