Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in transcription by RNA polymerase III. Predicted to be part of transcription factor TFIIIC complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human GTF3C3 (general transcription factor IIIC subunit 3).

Name: Secreted decoy of InR
Description: Secreted decoy of InR (Sdr) encodes a secreted protein that shows extensive sequence similarity to the extracellular domain of the product of InR. It physically binds to insulin-like peptides and thereby modulates the insulin/IGF signaling pathway.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 93a
Description: Integral part of various neural sensory systems in the antenna that provide the neural basis for the response to environmental changes in temperature (thermosensation) and humidity (hygrosensation) (PubMed:27161501, PubMed:27656904). Together with Ir21a and Ir25a, mediates the response of the larval dorsal organ cool cells, a trio of cool-responsive neurons, to cooling and is required for cool avoidance behavior (PubMed:27656904, PubMed:27161501). Together with Ir25a and Ir40a, mediates the response of the hydrosensory sacculus neurons to changes in relative humidity, and is required for dry detection and humidiy preference behavior (PubMed:27656904, PubMed:27161501). (UniProtKB:Q9VDH6)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Argonaute 3
Description: Argonaute 3 (AGO3) encodes a germline-specific Argonaute/Piwi family protein, which interacts with Piwi-interacting RNAs (piRNAs) to form effector complexes. It exhibits piRNA-guided RNA cleavage activity required for both piRNA amplification and transposon silencing, thereby securing germline development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable several functions, including ribosome binding activity; ubiquitin protein ligase activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Involved in mitotic cell cycle. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ZNF598 (zinc finger protein 598, E3 ubiquitin ligase).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human ARMC3 (armadillo repeat containing 3).

Name: Tubulin tyrosine ligase-like 6A
Description: Predicted to enable protein-glycine ligase activity; tubulin binding activity; and tubulin-glutamic acid ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in microtubule cytoskeleton organization; protein polyglutamylation; and protein polyglycylation. Predicted to be active in cilium. Orthologous to human TTLL13 (tubulin tyrosine ligase like 13) and TTLL6 (tubulin tyrosine ligase like 6).

Name: Achilles
Description: Achilles (Achl) is a clock-controlled gene that is expressed in a rhythmic manner in the brain. It regulates wing development and expression of antimicrobial peptides.

Name: missing oocyte
Description: missing oocyte (mio) encodes a component of the GAP Activity Towards Rags 2 (GATOR2) complex, which promotes the activation of the product of mTor and anabolic metabolism. It localizes to lysosomes and autolysosomes and regulates lysosome function independent of the activity of the product of mTor. It is required for the maintenance of the meiotic cycle.

Name: lame duck
Description: lame duck (lmd) encodes a zinc finger transcription factor expressed in the embryonic somatic and visceral mesoderm, where it is essential for the specification of fusion competent myoblasts and for myoblast fusion.

Name: short spindle 6
Description: Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval oenocyte; embryonic/larval visceral tracheal branch; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to several human genes including CYTIP (cytohesin 1 interacting protein).

Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytoskeleton. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 49. Orthologous to human CFAP58 (cilia and flagella associated protein 58).

Name: aubergine
Description: Acts via the piwi-interacting RNA (piRNA) metabolic process, which mediates the repression of transposable elements during meiosis by forming complexes composed of piRNAs and Piwi proteins and governs the methylation and subsequent repression of transposons. Directly binds piRNAs, a class of 24 to 30 nucleotide RNAs that are generated by a Dicer-independent mechanism and are primarily derived from transposons and other repeated sequence elements. In ovary, associates predominantly with antisense piRNAs that contain uridine at their 5' end. In testis, associates with Su(Ste) antisense piRNAs (most abundant class of piRNAs found in complex with aub in testes) and negatively regulates Ste expression, most likely by cleaving its transcripts. Also in testis, may repress translation of vas when associated with a piRNA derived from chromosome X, termed AT-chX-1, whose sequence shows strong complementarity to vas mRNA. Aub-piRNA complexes from ovary and testis possess RNA cleavage activity. Involved in telomere regulation by repressing specialized telomeric retroelements HeT-A and TART; Drosophila telomeres being maintained by transposition of specialized telomeric retroelements. Also involved in telomeric trans-silencing, a repression mechanism by which a transposon or a transgene inserted in subtelomeric heterochromatin has the capacity to repress in trans, in the female germline, a homologous transposon, or transgene located in euchromatin. Involved in the suppression of meiotic drive of sex chromosomes and autosomes. Involved in transposon silencing in the adult brain. Required for dorsal-ventral as well as anterior-posterior patterning of the egg. Required during oogenesis for primordial germ cell formation and activation of RNA interference. During early oogenesis, required for osk mRNA silencing and polarization of the microtubule cytoskeleton. During mid-oogenesis, required for osk mRNA localization to the posterior pole and efficient translation of osk and grk. During embryogenesis, required for posterior localization of nos mRNA, independently of osk, and pole cell formation. Essential for the formation and/or structural integrity of perinuclear nuage particles. Required for the localization of Mael to the meiotic nuage. Forms a complex with smg, twin, AGO3 and specific piRNAs that targets nos mRNA (and probably other maternal mRNAS) for deadenylation promoting its decay during early embryogenesis. (UniProtKB:O76922)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of protein phosphorylation and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval tracheal section; extended germ band embryo; and germ layer. Orthologous to several human genes including FAM43B (family with sequence similarity 43 member B).

Name: disc proliferation abnormal
Description: Acts as component of the Mcm2-7 complex (Mcm complex) which is the putative replicative helicase essential for 'once per cell cycle' DNA replication initiation and elongation in eukaryotic cells. The active ATPase sites in the Mcm2-7 ring are formed through the interaction surfaces of two neighboring subunits such that a critical structure of a conserved arginine finger motif is provided in trans relative to the ATP-binding site of the Walker A box of the adjacent subunit. The six ATPase active sites, however, are likely to contribute differentially to the complex helicase activity. Required for DNA replication and cell proliferation. Essential role in mitotic DNA replication but not in endoreplication. (UniProtKB:Q26454)

Name: Heavy metal tolerance factor 1
Description: Predicted to enable ABC-type heme transporter activity and heme binding activity. Involved in cellular detoxification of cadmium ion. Located in vacuolar membrane. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; embryonic/larval midgut; gastric caecum; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria. Orthologous to human ABCB6 (ATP binding cassette subfamily B member 6 (Langereis blood group)).

Name: Calphotin
Description: Calphotin (Cpn) encodes a glutamic acid-rich protein with a strong negative charge and a highly hydrophobic amino acid composition. It functions as an immobile Ca[2+] buffer along the base of the photoreceptor's microvilli. It protects the photoreceptor cells from Ca[2+] overload and light induced degeneration.

Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 06-12 hour embryonic stages.

Name: Mediator complex subunit 25
Description: Component of the Mediator complex, a coactivator involved in the regulated transcription of nearly all RNA polymerase II-dependent genes. Mediator functions as a bridge to convey information from gene-specific regulatory proteins to the basal RNA polymerase II transcription machinery. Mediator is recruited to promoters by direct interactions with regulatory proteins and serves as a scaffold for the assembly of a functional preinitiation complex with RNA polymerase II and the general transcription factors (By similarity). Required for activated transcription of the MtnA, MtnB and MtnD genes. (UniProtKB:Q9VDR1)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytosol. Orthologous to human ANKS1A (ankyrin repeat and sterile alpha motif domain containing 1A).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cilium organization. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 38. Orthologous to human ARMC2 (armadillo repeat containing 2).

Description: Predicted to enable N-acetylneuraminate 7-O(or 9-O)-acetyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Predicted to be located in Golgi membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human CASD1 (CAS1 domain containing 1).

Name: Ecdysone-induced protein 78C
Description: Induces the early late puff 78C which triggers puparium formation and development. (UniProtKB:P45447)

Name: Tetratricopeptide repeat domain 7
Description: Predicted to be involved in phosphatidylinositol phosphate biosynthetic process and protein localization to plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; organism; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in multiple intestinal atresia. Orthologous to several human genes including TTC7A (tetratricopeptide repeat domain 7A).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metalloexopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in several structures, including circulatory system; esophageal visceral muscle; mesoderm; muscle system; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human ERMP1 (endoplasmic reticulum metallopeptidase 1).

Description: Predicted to enable DNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA duplex unwinding and establishment of sister chromatid cohesion. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Warsaw breakage syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including DDX11 (DEAD/H-box helicase 11).

Name: sugar-free frosting
Description: sugar-free frosting (sff) encodes a protein involved in neuromuscular junction development and protein N-linked glycosylation.

Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG31327 (FBgn0051327). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3R:14157560..14160278. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Peak expression observed during late pupal stages, in adult male stages.

Name: Bromodomain containing 7/9
Description: Predicted to enable lysine-acetylated histone binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Part of brahma complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and germ layer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in acute myeloid leukemia. Orthologous to several human genes including BRD7 (bromodomain containing 7).

Name: SNF related kinase
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in intracellular signal transduction and protein phosphorylation. Orthologous to human SNRK (SNF related kinase).

Name: inscuteable
Description: inscuteable (insc) encodes an adaptor protein required for asymmetric cell division. It interacts with the microtubule binding protein encoded by mud and the adaptor encoded by pins. It also binds to the apical complex proteins encoded by baz, par-6 and aPKC and may recruit microtubule binding proteins to the apical cell cortex to induce apical-basal spindle orientation.

Name: Tarag
Description: Enables acetate transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in acetate transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 64a
Description: Ionotropic receptor 64a (Ir64a) encodes a member of the Ionotropic Receptor (IR) family of variant ionotropic glutamate receptors. It is part of a broad-specificity acid sensor that mediates avoidance behavior.

Name: Transmembrane O-mannosyltransferase targeting cadherins 1
Description: Transfers mannosyl residues to the hydroxyl group of serine or threonine residues. (UniProtKB:Q9VQE9)

Name: lines
Description: lines (lin) encodes a nuclear protein involved in developmental patterning and cell fate specification. The Odd-skipped family protein encoded by bowl binds to and destabilizes the product of lin in the nucleus. Converserly the Odd family protein encoded by drm stabilizes the product of bowl in the nucleus by outcompeting the binding of the product of lin to the product of bowl and localizing the product of lin to the cytoplasm.

Name: FIG4 phosphoinositide 5-phosphatase
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity. Involved in regulation of lysosome organization. Predicted to be located in endosome membrane. Predicted to be part of PAS complex. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in organism. Used to study Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease; Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4J; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 11; and neurodegenerative disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4J; Yunis-Varon syndrome; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 11; and bilateral parasagittal parieto-occipital polymicrogyria. Orthologous to human FIG4 (FIG4 phosphoinositide 5-phosphatase).

Name: Hermansky-Pudlak Syndrome 4
Description: Hermansky-Pudlak Syndrome 4 (HPS4) encodes a tethering factor that regulates gene silencing by small RNAs via endosomal trafficking.

Name: dalmatian
Description: dalmatian (dmt) encodes a nuclear protein that localizes to centromeric heterochromatin and other polytene chromosome bands. It is required to block expression of rpr and hid during the radiation resistant stage of embryonic development, when cells become irreversibly committed to cell fate.

Name: no mechanoreceptor potential B
Description: no mechanoreceptor potential B (nompB) encodes an essential component of the conserved intraflagellar transport mechanism, which is needed to extend cilia above the cell surface. nompB mutants have truncated, nonfunctional sensory cilia with consequent mechanosensory deficits.

Name: POP1 ribonuclease P/MRP subunit
Description: Predicted to enable ribonuclease P RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in RNA phosphodiester bond hydrolysis, endonucleolytic; rRNA processing; and tRNA 5'-leader removal. Predicted to be part of nucleolar ribonuclease P complex and ribonuclease MRP complex. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in anauxetic dysplasia 2. Orthologous to human POP1 (POP1 homolog, ribonuclease P/MRP subunit).

Name: eyeless
Description: eyeless (ey) encodes a transcription factor that is involved in eye development as part of the retinal determination gene network, and contributes to brain formation.

Name: Trehalose transporter 1-1
Description: Low-capacity facilitative transporter for trehalose. Does not transport maltose, sucrose or lactose. Mediates the bidirectional transfer of trehalose. Responsible for the transport of trehalose synthesized in the fat body and the incorporation of trehalose into other tissues that require a carbon source, thereby regulating trehalose levels in the hemolymph. (UniProtKB:A1Z8N1)

Name: seizure
Description: seizure (sei) encodes a protein involved in sound perception.

Name: Silnoon
Description: Silnoon (Sln) encodes a monocarboxylate transporter that mediates active transport of metabolic monocarboxylates such as butyrate and lactate. The product of Lkb1 induces apical trafficking of the product of Sln in polarized cells, which is crucial for triggering apoptosis induced by extracellular butyrate.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 100kD subunit 1
Description: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 100kD subunit 1 (Vha100-1) encodes a subunit of the V0 domain of V-ATPase, which acidifies autophagosomes and lysosomes in neurons. The product of Vha100-1 is involved in autophagosome maturation, tracheal branching and eye development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type peptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; asthma; autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 33; and spinal muscular atrophy. Orthologous to several human genes including DPP10 (dipeptidyl peptidase like 10) and DPP6 (dipeptidyl peptidase like 6).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in endonucleolytic cleavage in ITS1 to separate SSU-rRNA from 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be part of 90S preribosome. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in anterior midgut primordium; organism; posterior midgut primordium; salivary gland body primordium; and trunk mesoderm. Orthologous to human KRI1 (KRI1 homolog).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Orthologous to human PRSS22 (serine protease 22) and PRSS41 (serine protease 41).

Name: Autophagy-related 1
Description: Autophagy-related 1 (Atg1) encodes a protein kinase that functions downstream of the product of mTor in the regulation of autophagy.

Name: Lysine demethylase 3
Description: Lysine demethylase 3 (Kdm3) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the removal of methyl groups from the lysine 9 of the product of His3, and thereby promotes an open chromatin structure.

Name: asteroid
Description: asteroid (ast) encodes an interactor protein of the product of Egfr that is involved in photoreceptor and wing development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in ribosomal small subunit biogenesis. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human NOM1 (nucleolar protein with MIF4G domain 1).

Name: muskelin
Description: Involved in oocyte maturation and positive regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Part of GID complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human MKLN1 (muskelin 1).

Name: wolfram syndrome 1
Description: wolfram syndrome 1 (wfs1) encodes an endoplasmic reticulum-resident transmembrane protein. Neuronal knockdown of wfs1 increases susceptibility to age- and stress-induced neuronal dysfunction and degeneration.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human CCDC170 (coiled-coil domain containing 170).

Name: Extended synaptotagmin-like protein 2
Description: Extended synaptotagmin-like protein 2 (Esyt2) encodes a member of the Synaptotagmin family that localizes to the endoplasmic reticculum (ER). In axonal ER of motorneurons, it may be involved in coordinating intracellular calcium dynamics and constitutive membrane trafficking.

Name: Kainate-type ionotropic glutamate receptor subunit 1D
Description: glutamate channel - kainate family protein - localized to presynaptic terminals of the neuromuscular junction - eya - homeostatic potentiation of synaptic strength

Name: ovarian tumor
Description: Essential for female fertility; germ cell division and differentiation. (UniProtKB:P10383)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable nuclear import signal receptor activity and nuclear localization sequence binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into nucleus. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human TNPO1 (transportin 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable acyltransferase activity, transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups.

Name: Verprolin 1
Description: Verprolin 1 (Vrp1) encodes the sole Drosophila homolog of the conserved Verprolin/WASp-interacting-protein family of actin regulators. It facilitates myoblast fusion in somatic muscles by recruiting the branched-actin polymerization machinery to sites of myoblast-myotube attachment and fusion.

Name: Deubiquitinating apoptotic inhibitor
Description: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Involved in negative regulation of apoptotic process; negative regulation of proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process; and protein deubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human USP35 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 35) and USP38 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 38).

Name: doublesex cognate 73A
Description: doublesex cognate 73A (dsx-c73A) encodes a secreted cuticle protein present in the epidermis, salivary duct and trachea. The epidermal expression is under the control of the product of ovo.

Name: Gamma-tubulin ring protein 84
Description: gamma-tubulin associated protein required for aspects of microtubule nucleation, dynamics and organization both in interphase and mitosis

Name: prage
Description: prage (prage) encodes a protein involved in maternal mRNA destabilization during the maternal/zygotic transition in embryonic development.

Name: AXIN1 up-regulated 1
Description: AXIN1 up-regulated 1 (Axud1) encodes a nuclear protein required to regulate cell proliferation rates and cell growth in the wing disc.

Name: Autophagy-related 9
Description: Autophagy-related 9 (Atg9) encodes an integral membrane protein acting as a membrane carrier for forming autophagosomes. It regulates TOR and JNK signaling pathways via autophagy.

Name: lethal (3) 07882
Description: Involved in nucleolar processing of pre-18S ribosomal RNA. Has a role in the nuclear export of 40S pre-ribosomal subunit to the cytoplasm (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VEJ2)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carbon-carbon lyase activity and pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in carboxylic acid metabolic process. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic epidermis; and gut section. Orthologous to several human genes including PDXDC1 (pyridoxal dependent decarboxylase domain containing 1).

Name: Cullin 5
Description: Cullin 5 (Cul5) is expressed in both neuronal and non-neuronal cells (such as in fusion sites of embryonic trachea). Reduction of the product of Cul5 in neuronal cells results in an increase in number of synaptic boutons in the larval neuromuscular junction.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in Bolwig organ; dorsal head epidermis; embryonic antennal sense organ; embryonic head epidermis; and embryonic head sensory system.

Name: Oculocerebrorenal syndrome of Lowe
Description: Oculocerebrorenal syndrome of Lowe (Ocrl) encodes an inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase that regulates PtdIns(4,5)P2 homeostasis by dephosphorylating PtdIns(4,5)P2 on endocytic compartments. In vitro experiments also suggest a role of the product of Ocrl during cytokinesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: stoned A
Description: Adapter protein involved in endocytic recycling of synaptic vesicles membranes. May act by mediating the retrieval of synaptotagmin protein Syt from the plasma membrane, thereby facilitating the internalization of multiple synaptic vesicles from the plasma membrane. (UniProtKB:Q24211)

Name: minotaur
Description: minotaur (mino) encodes a member of the conserved glycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase family, which converts glycerol-3-phosphate into lysophosphatidic acid. It functions in phosphatidic acid biosynthesis. It is also essential for piRNA biogenesis in gonads, with mino mutants showing transposon de-repression and sterility phenotypes.

Name: Lap1
Description: May have a role in assembling adherens junctions. (UniProtKB:Q9V780)

Name: Neprilysin 1
Description: Neprilysin 1 (Nep1) encodes a plasma membrane bound metallopeptidase considered to cleave and thus inactivate signaling peptides in the extracellular space. It contributes to female and male fertility.

Name: Glucosidase 1
Description: Predicted to enable Glc3Man9GlcNAc2 oligosaccharide glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein N-linked glycosylation. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital disorder of glycosylation type IIb. Orthologous to human MOGS (mannosyl-oligosaccharide glucosidase).

Name: Histidine decarboxylase
Description: Histidine decarboxylase (Hdc) encodes an enzyme involved in photoreceptor synaptic transmission.

Name: hoepel2
Description: Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in actinic keratosis; oculocutaneous albinism type II; pigmentation disease; skin cancer (multiple); and squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human OCA2 (OCA2 melanosomal transmembrane protein).

Name: myospheroid
Description: myospheroid (mys) encodes a beta subunit of the integrin dimer. Integrin transmembrane receptors function as a link for the extracellular matrix and the intracellular actin cytoskeleton. The product of mys acts as adhesion/signaling protein regulating cellular adhesion, migration and survival.

Name: mutagen-sensitive 304
Description: DNA damage checkpoint protein required for chromosome break repair and for genomic stability during development. (UniProtKB:Q9VVN4)

Name: greatwall
Description: greatwall (gwl) encodes a kinase required for mitosis and female meiosis. It phosphorylates the product of endos, which then acts as a stoichiometric inhibitor of the PP2A B-type adaptor subunit encoded by tws.

Name: Neurotactin
Description: May mediate or modulate cell adhesion between embryonic cells during development. (UniProtKB:P23654)

Name: hoepel1
Description: Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in actinic keratosis; oculocutaneous albinism type II; pigmentation disease; skin cancer (multiple); and squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human OCA2 (OCA2 melanosomal transmembrane protein).

Name: Kruppel homolog 1
Description: Kruppel homolog 1 (Kr-h1) encodes a transcriptional regulator involved in axon pathfinding, neurite and axon remodeling as well as pupal photoreceptor maturation. In all cases, the function of the product of Kr-h1 is linked to that of the 20-hydroxyecdysone hormone.

Name: corkscrew
Description: corkscrew (csw) encodes a non receptor tyrosine phosphatase acting downstream of receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs) such as Egfr, tor and FGF RTKs. The product of csw contributes to growth regulation, cell survival and developmental patterning.

Name: Nucleoporin 107kD
Description: Plays a role in nuclear pore complex (NPC) assembly and maintenance (PubMed:20547758). Required for nuclear import of Mad (PubMed:20547758). Mediates the association between the nuclear pore complex and a subset of active chromatin regions adjacent to lamin-associated domains (PubMed:31784359). Plays a role in double strand break repair by relocalizing the heterochromatic double strand breaks (DSBs) to the nuclear periphery as part of the homologous recombination (HR) repair process (PubMed:26502056). Regulates cytokinesis during spermatocyte meiosis by maintaining type-B lamin Lam localization to the spindle envelope (PubMed:27402967). Regulates female gonad development and oogenesis (PubMed:26485283). (UniProtKB:Q9V466)

Name: Retinoblastoma-family protein
Description: Retinoblastoma-family protein (Rbf) encodes a protein that binds to members of the E2F transcription factors and forms the DREAM complex, which regulates genes with diverse biological functions including cell cycle regulators, apoptosis regulators, and DNA replication/repair factors. The product of Rbf can also bind chromosomal proteins and modulate genome stability. It is negatively regulated by CycE-Cdk2 and CycD-Cdk4 cyclin-dependent kinase complexes.

Name: D19A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; extended germ band embryo; larval ventral nerve cord; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Dynein axonemal assembly factor 5
Description: Cytoplasmic protein involved in the delivery of the dynein machinery to the motile cilium. It is required for the assembly of the axonemal dynein inner and outer arms, two structures attached to the peripheral outer doublet A microtubule of the axoneme, that play a crucial role in cilium motility. (UniProtKB:Q8INF7)

Name: shaven
Description: shaven (sv) encodes a transcription factor and a member of the paired box family of genes. It is primarily involved in the terminal differentiation of specific cell types during the development of a variety of sensory organs, including the bristles and the eye.

Name: Etl1
Description: Etl1 (Etl1) encodes a protein belonging to the Etl1 subfamily of the Snf2 family of helicase-related proteins. It mediates nucleosomal H2A acetylation in an ATP-dependent fashion via the product of nej, resulting in transcriptional regulation.

Name: CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 3
Description: CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 3 (Not3) encodes a poly(A)-specific ribonuclease involved in translation inhibition.

Name: eukaryotic translation elongation factor 2
Description: Catalyzes the GTP-dependent ribosomal translocation step during translation elongation. During this step, the ribosome changes from the pre-translocational (PRE) to the post-translocational (POST) state as the newly formed A-site-bound peptidyl-tRNA and P-site-bound deacylated tRNA move to the P and E sites, respectively. Catalyzes the coordinated movement of the two tRNA molecules, the mRNA and conformational changes in the ribosome (By similarity). (UniProtKB:P13060)

Name: FLICE-associated huge protein
Description: FLICE-associated huge protein (FLASH) encodes a metazoan-specific protein that plays an essential role in 3' end processing of replication-dependent histone pre-mRNAs. It localizes to histone locus bodies, which are microscopically detectable nuclear foci that form in the vicinity of histone gene clusters.

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 100kD subunit 4
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase binding activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton transmembrane transport and vacuolar acidification. Predicted to be part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase, V0 domain. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; copper cell primordium; dorsal epidermis primordium; embryonic/larval midgut; and prothoracic gland. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive cutis laxa type IIA; autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 1; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; renal tubular acidosis; and wrinkly skin syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP6V0A1 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a1); ATP6V0A2 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a2); and ATP6V0A4 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a4).

Name: Glycogen phosphorylase
Description: Phosphorylase is an important allosteric enzyme in carbohydrate metabolism. Enzymes from different sources differ in their regulatory mechanisms and in their natural substrates. However, all known phosphorylases share catalytic and structural properties (By similarity). Required for glycogen breakdown in skeletal muscle. (UniProtKB:Q9XTL9)

Name: Ca2+-channel-protein-beta-subunit
Description: Enables voltage-gated calcium channel activity. Involved in calcium ion transmembrane transport; calcium-mediated signaling; and neuron remodeling. Predicted to be part of voltage-gated calcium channel complex. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Uncoordinated 115a
Description: Uncoordinated 115a (Unc-115a) encodes a protein involved in axon pathfinding in the visual system and the CNS.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Ance-3
Description: Predicted to enable metallopeptidase activity and peptidyl-dipeptidase activity. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including avian influenza; cerebral malaria; hypertension (multiple); respiratory syncytial virus infectious disease; and severe acute respiratory syndrome. Orthologous to human ACE2 (angiotensin converting enzyme 2).

Name: kekkon 6
Description: Enables neurotrophin binding activity and neurotrophin receptor activity. Involved in regulation of synaptic plasticity. Located in type I terminal bouton. Is expressed in 3-1M; adult head; and embryonic/larval central nervous system.

Name: P-element induced wimpy testis
Description: Acts via the piwi-interacting RNA (piRNA) metabolic process, which mediates the repression of transposable elements during meiosis by forming complexes composed of piRNAs and Piwi proteins and governs the methylation and subsequent repression of transposons (PubMed:26808625, PubMed:15817569, PubMed:17346786). Directly binds piRNAs, a class of 24 to 30 nucleotide RNAs that are generated by a Dicer-independent mechanism and are primarily derived from transposons and other repeated sequence elements (PubMed:16882972). In ovarian somatic cells, mediates silencing of transposable elements at the transcriptional level in a mael-dependent manner (PubMed:23159368, PubMed:28472469). Involved in silencing of long terminal repeat (LTR) retrotransposons in male germline (PubMed:15817569). In testis, regulates spermatogenesis together with Tudor-SN (PubMed:26808625). In germ cells, mediates silencing at both transcriptional and post-transcriptional levels and is involved in the maintenance of populations of primary and secondary piRNAs. Piwi-mediated transcriptional silencing is accompanied by the formation of His3 'Lys-9' trimethylated (H3K9me3) euchromatin and heterochromatin (PubMed:23434410, PubMed:23392610). In ovary, associates predominantly with antisense piRNAs that contain uridine at their 5' end. Association with sense piRNAs is also observed but to a lesser extent. Mediates a somatic signaling mechanism required for the maintenance of germline stem cells to produce and maintain a daughter germline stem cell (PubMed:9851978, PubMed:10631171, PubMed:9199372, PubMed:16949822). It is not essential for the further differentiation of the committed daughter cell (PubMed:9851978). Acts cell autonomously to promote germline stem cell division (PubMed:9851978, PubMed:10631171). Its role in stem cell maintenance does not seem to require nuclear localization. Required maternally for the posterior localization of osk and vas and for pole cell formation during oogenesis and early embryogenesis (PubMed:16949822). Together with Hop and Hsp83, mediates canalization, also known as developmental robustness, likely via epigenetic silencing of existing genetic variants and suppression of transposon-induced new genetic variation (PubMed:21186352). Shows RNA cleavage activity, although is not required for any of its known functions (PubMed:9199372, PubMed:16882972, PubMed:23297219). In the ovaries, forms a complex with nxf2, Panx and Nxt1 which acts as effectors of cotranscriptional transposon silencing (PubMed:31368590, PubMed:31384064). (UniProtKB:Q9VKM1)

Name: armadillo
Description: armadillo (arm) encodes the Drosophila homolog of beta-catenin. It plays separable roles in cell adhesion and Wingless signaling. It links classic cadherin cell adhesion receptors to alpha-catenin and the actin cytoskeleton, and it acts as the key regulated effector of Wingless signaling, working with TCF/LEF proteins as a transcriptional co-activator.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphatase activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including MTMR10 (myotubularin related protein 10) and MTMR12 (myotubularin related protein 12).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 21a
Description: Integral part of a neural sensory system in the antenna that provides the neural basis for the response to environmental changes in temperature (thermosensation) (PubMed:27126188, PubMed:27656904). Together with Ir25a and Ir93a, mediates the response of the dorsal organ cool cells, a trio of cool-responsive neurons, to cooling and is required for cool avoidance behavior (PubMed:27126188, PubMed:27656904). (UniProtKB:Q9VPI2)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG13272 (FBgn0086673). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:16804884..16816069. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages.

Name: GATAd
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell fate commitment; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: TATA box-binding protein-associated factor RNA polymerase I subunit C-like
Description: Predicted to be involved in nucleolar large rRNA transcription by RNA polymerase I. Located in nucleolus. Part of RNA polymerase transcription factor SL1 complex.

Name: metabotropic GABA-B receptor subtype 1
Description: metabotropic GABA-B receptor subtype 1 (GABA-B-R1) encodes a receptor involved in G protein-coupled receptor and gamma-aminobutyric acid signaling pathways.

Name: nimA-like kinase
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in chromosome segregation and protein phosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cilium. Predicted to be active in centrosome; cytoplasm; and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lethal congenital contracture syndrome; nephronophthisis 9; and renal-hepatic-pancreatic dysplasia. Orthologous to several human genes including NEK9 (NIMA related kinase 9).

Name: light
Description: light (lt) encodes a cellular-protein trafficking protein that forms part of the homotypic fusion and vacuolar protein sorting (HOPS) and class C core vacuole/endosome tethering (CORVET) complexes. It is required for fusion of autophagosomes with lysosomes, endocytic down-regulation of Notch signaling, and eye pigment biogenesis.

Name: nuclear RNA export factor 2
Description: May be involved in the export of mRNA from the nucleus to the cytoplasm (PubMed:11780633). In the ovaries, forms a complex with nxf2, piwi and Nxt1 which acts as effectors of cotranscriptional transposon silencing (PubMed:31219034, PubMed:31368590, PubMed:31570835, PubMed:31384064). On recruitment to a target transcript, interacts with single stranded RNA, thereby anchoring the complex via the nascent target transcript to chromatin and allowing Panx to recruit silencing effectors to establishing repressive heterochromatin at transposon loci (PubMed:31368590, PubMed:31570835, PubMed:31384064). Does not affect piRNA biogenesis (PubMed:31384064). The interaction with Panx stabilizes the nuclear protein complex (PubMed:31384064). Does not bind nucleoporins, but regulates sbr/Nxf1 binding to nucleoporins and, indirectly, transposon exports (PubMed:31570835, PubMed:31384064). (UniProtKB:Q9VV73)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic/larval muscle system and organism. Orthologous to human NFXL1 (nuclear transcription factor, X-box binding like 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-galactosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in N-glycan processing. Is expressed in embryonic antennal sense organ; embryonic brain; and larval ventral nerve cord.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in head segment; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and ventral sensory complex primordium.

Name: septin interacting protein 1
Description: May be involved in pre-mRNA splicing. (UniProtKB:Q9Y103)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in cell adhesion. Predicted to be located in basement membrane. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix. Orthologous to human SPON1 (spondin 1).

Name: Plenty of SH3s
Description: Plenty of SH3s (POSH) encodes a scaffold protein that regulates TNF-JNK signaling pathway.

Name: Visual system homeobox 1
Description: Visual system homeobox 1 (Vsx1) encodes a transcription factor involved in the development of the visual-system.

Name: Heterochromatin protein 5
Description: Heterochromatin protein 5 (HP5) encodes a component of classical heterochromatin that is involved in gene silencing by heterochromatin.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in GPI anchor biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 1. Orthologous to human PIGN (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class N).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in intracellular protein transport. Predicted to be located in Golgi apparatus. Predicted to be active in Golgi medial cisterna; Golgi trans cisterna; and membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy. Orthologous to human HID1 (HID1 domain containing).

Name: Mitf
Description: Mitf (Mitf) encodes a b-HLH-Zip transcription factor that regulates basic cellular processes in part by controlling the expression of the vacuolar (H[+])-ATPase subunits.

Name: nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor alpha5
Description: nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor alpha5 (nAChRalpha5) encodes a subunit of the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor, which is a pentameric neurotransmitter-gated ion channel.

Name: combgap
Description: combgap (cg) encodes a DNA binding protein that can act as a repressor or activator of gene expression depending on context. It binds to Polycomb Response Elements and is necessary to recruit Polycomb protein complexes to some of them.

Name: Heat shock protein 110
Description: Heat shock protein 110 (Hsp110) encodes an HSP110 family protein that interacts physically with the product of DnaJ-1 as a chaperone of misfolded proteins. It functions together with the product of DnaJ-1 to prevent the toxicity of aggregation-prone proteins.

Name: p115
Description: p115 (p115) encodes a key protein of the early secretory pathway where it interacts with the product of GM130 and Rab proteins. p115 depletion from S2 cells leads to a fragmentation of the Golgi but without impairing transport efficiency.

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 44kD subunit
Description: Subunit of the V1 complex of vacuolar(H+)-ATPase (V-ATPase), a multisubunit enzyme composed of a peripheral complex (V1) that hydrolyzes ATP and a membrane integral complex (V0) that translocates protons (By similarity). V-ATPase is responsible for acidifying and maintaining the pH of intracellular compartments and in some cell types, is targeted to the plasma membrane, where it is responsible for acidifying the extracellular environment (By similarity). Subunit C is necessary for the assembly of the catalytic sector of the enzyme and is likely to have a specific function in its catalytic activity (By similarity). In enterocytes, acts as part of a pHCl-2 sensory pathway which mediates Tor-dependent larval growth and metabolism in response to zinc availability (PubMed:32269334). Likely acts in maintaining enterocyte lysosomal acidification which consequently promotes Tor activation at the lysosome membrane (PubMed:32269334). (UniProtKB:Q9V7N5)

Name: Phosphoinositide-dependent kinase 1
Description: Serine/threonine kinase required for embryonic development. Inhibits apoptosis. Acts in the insulin receptor transduction pathway which regulates cell growth and organ size, by phosphorylating and activating Akt1 and S6k. May be involved in axonal pathfinding and synaptogenesis, and in spermatogenesis. (UniProtKB:Q9W0V1)

Name: ALG-2 interacting protein X
Description: ALG-2 interacting protein X (ALiX) encodes an adaptor protein implicated in multiple cellular processes, including positive regulation of mitotic cytokinesis, exosomal secretion and apoptosis.

Name: Tudor domain containing 3
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA processing. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; and organism. Orthologous to human TDRD3 (tudor domain containing 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in RNA processing. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human SUGP1 (SURP and G-patch domain containing 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in arthrogryposis multiplex congenita-4. Orthologous to human SCYL2 (SCY1 like pseudokinase 2).

Name: wacky
Description: wacky (wcy) encodes a protein involved in habituation, autophagy regulation and TORC1 signaling.

Name: 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) receptor 1A
Description: 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) receptor 1A (5-HT1A) encodes a 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) GPCR that belongs to the Class A GPCR family. They bind and transmit the signal from the neurotransmitter 5-HT (serotonin). The family can be subdivided into several subclasses based on pharmacology, signal transduction and structure. There are 5 genes encoding serotonin receptors in the Drosophila melanogaster genome: 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT7. The product of 5-HT1A has been implicated in several aspects of adult behavior, including baseline sleep, aggression, courtship, as well as memory formation.

Name: unextended
Description: Probable metal transporter (By similarity). Acts downstream of PRL-1 and protects the nervous system against olfactory carbon dioxide stimulation (PubMed:31404830). (UniProtKB:A0A0B7P9G0)

Name: stambha A
Description: An essential gene required for embryogenesis; required for cell viability. (UniProtKB:Q8IGJ0)

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 100kD subunit 2
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase binding activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton transmembrane transport and vacuolar acidification. Part of plasma membrane proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex. Is expressed in several structures, including adult Malpighian tubule; adult heart; anterior endoderm; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 1; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; and renal tubular acidosis. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP6V0A1 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a1) and ATP6V0A4 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a4).

Name: Phosphodiesterase 1c
Description: Cyclic nucleotide phosphodiesterase with a dual specificity for the second messengers cAMP and cGMP, which are key regulators of many important physiological processes (PubMed:15673286). Required for male fertility and male mating behavior (PubMed:20551439). (UniProtKB:B7YZV4)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II complex binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA 3'-end processing. Predicted to be located in chromatin. Predicted to be part of RNA polymerase II, holoenzyme. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human RPRD2 (regulation of nuclear pre-mRNA domain containing 2).

Name: Nop17 like
Description: Required for cytoplasmic pre-assembly of axonemal dyneins, thereby playing a central role in motility in cilia and flagella. Involved in pre-assembly of dynein arm complexes in the cytoplasm before intraflagellar transport loads them for the ciliary compartment. (UniProtKB:Q0E9G3)

Name: nanchung
Description: nanchung (nan) encodes a member of the transient Receptor Potential (TRP) channel family. It is involved in the response to different stimuli such as startle, humidity or sound.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 16A
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 16A (Vps16A) encodes a subunit of a heterohexameric tethering complex known as homotypic fusion and protein sorting (HOPS). HOPS roles include promoting the fusion of late endosomes, autophagosomes, biosynthetic vesicles, and lysosomes, and the biogenesis of lysosome-related eye pigment granules. The product of Vps16A is also part of miniCORVET (class C core vacuole/endosome tethering), a tethering complex involved in endosome maturation in nephrocytes and blood cells.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human NSUN7 (NOP2/Sun RNA methyltransferase family member 7).

Name: Delta
Description: Delta (Delta) encodes a single pass transmembrane EGF family protein and one of two ligands of the Notch signaling pathway. It regulates cell fate decisions and cell proliferation. Post transcriptional modification (such as by fucosylation, ubiquitination and proteolysis) of the product of Delta is key for its functions.

Name: Rab11 interacting protein
Description: Rab11 interacting protein (Rip11) encodes a protein that belongs to Rab11 family interacting proteins (FIP family). It binds only to the GTP bound form of the product of Rab11, thus acting as its effector. It regulates Rhodopsin transport and cytokinesis.

Name: Darkener of apricot
Description: Darkener of apricot (Doa) encodes an essential Ser/Thr protein kinase with SR proteins (RNA maturation) and the product of eEF1gamma (microtubule-based organelle transport) as substrates. It contributes to somatic sex determination (splicing of dsx transcript) and development of eye, wing, leg, oocyte and bristles.

Name: salto
Description: Is expressed in adult head; scolopidial dendrite; spermatid; spermatocyte; and spermatozoon.

Name: wech
Description: wech (wech) encodes a member of the RBCC/TRIM family of cytoplasmic multidomain proteins. It is a regulator of integrin-mediated adhesion. It interacts with the products of rhea and Ilk, which are components of the integrin-cytoskeleton link.

Name: ABC transporter expressed in trachea
Description: ABC transporter expressed in trachea (Atet) encodes a protein that is involved in transmembrane transport.

Name: Chondroitin sulfate synthase
Description: Predicted to enable N-acetylgalactosaminyl-proteoglycan 3-beta-glucuronosyltransferase activity and glucuronosyl-N-acetylgalactosaminyl-proteoglycan 4-beta-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in chondroitin sulfate biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in Golgi cisterna membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in temtamy preaxial brachydactyly syndrome. Orthologous to human CHSY1 (chondroitin sulfate synthase 1) and CHSY3 (chondroitin sulfate synthase 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior-posterior subdivision of organism; embryonic/larval garland cell; garland cell primordium; and gut section. Orthologous to human SLC38A10 (solute carrier family 38 member 10).

Name: TAK1-associated binding protein 2
Description: TAK1-associated binding protein 2 (Tab2) encodes a protein with an ubiquitin binding domain. It interacts with the product of Tak1, a MAP kinase kinase kinase involved the activation of the immune deficiency, JNK and Grindelwald-Eiger pathways.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. Is expressed in chordotonal neurons; dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; embryonic head sensory system; sensory nervous system primordium; and ventral sensory complex primordium. Orthologous to human IQCA1 (IQ motif containing with AAA domain 1) and IQCA1L (IQ motif containing with AAA domain 1 like).

Name: p130CAS
Description: p130CAS (p130CAS) encodes an SH3 domain-containing protein phosphorylated by Src kinases. It contributes to integrin-mediated adhesion and in vertebrate cells is phosphorylated in response to mechanical stretch.

Name: liquid facets
Description: liquid facets (lqf) encodes an epsin, which is an endocytic adaptor that contributes to endocytic network stability/regulation and membrane bending. It contributes to endocytosis and regulates the BMP and Notch signaling pathways.

Name: Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 1
Description: Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 1 (Lgr1) encodes a Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor (LGR type A) that shows highest similarity with vertebrate glycoprotein hormone (TSH and Thyrostimulin, FSH, LH ) receptors.

Name: Leucine-rich tendon-specific protein
Description: Leucine-rich tendon-specific protein (Lrt) encodes a transmembrane protein expressed specifically in tendon cells. It binds to the product of robo1 and is required for proper patterning of the muscles.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 11
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 11 (Vps11) encodes a Class C Vps core subunit of HOPS, a heterohexameric tethering complex that consists of the products of car, dor, lt, Vps11, Vps16A and Vps39. HOPS tethers autophagosomes or late endosomes with lysosomes to facilitate fusion. The product of Vps11 roles include autophagosome-lysosome fusion, late endosome-lysosome fusion and biosynthetic trafficking to lysosomes.

Name: cardinal
Description: cardinal (cd) encodes a phenoxazinone synthetase involved in the kynurenine pathway. It contributes to ommochrome biosynthesis, neuron death and siRNA-mediated gene silencing.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo.

Name: roadkill
Description: roadkill (rdx) encodes a protein that functions as a substrate recognition component of Cul3-based E3 ubiquitin ligase complexes. It regulates the Hedgehog signaling pathway by promoting the degradation of the transcription factor encoded by ci.

Name: miranda
Description: miranda (mira) encodes a cytoplasmic and cortical scaffolding protein that binds the products of pros, stau and brat. It is asymmetrically localized to the basal cortex during neuroblast asymmetric cell division, resulting in its partioning into GMC daughter cells, where it is degraded and releases its cargo proteins.

Name: N/A
Description: Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast carcinoma; esophageal cancer; and squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human LZTS1 (leucine zipper tumor suppressor 1); LZTS2 (leucine zipper tumor suppressor 2); and LZTS3 (leucine zipper tumor suppressor family member 3).

Name: Band4.1 inhibitor LRP interactor
Description: Involved in negative regulation of canonical Wnt signaling pathway. Colocalizes with plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior ectoderm anlage; ectoderm; extended germ band embryo; imaginal disc; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to human FRMD8 (FERM domain containing 8) and FRMD8P1 (FERM domain containing 8 pseudogene 1).

Name: Dual-specificity tyrosine phosphorylation-regulated kinase 3
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-serine phosphorylation and peptidyl-threonine phosphorylation. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm; cytoskeleton; and nucleus. Is expressed in eye disc morphogenetic furrow; organism; and third segment of antenna. Orthologous to human DYRK2 (dual specificity tyrosine phosphorylation regulated kinase 2) and DYRK3 (dual specificity tyrosine phosphorylation regulated kinase 3).

Name: Centaurin beta 1A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity and phospholipid binding activity. Involved in cell morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult Dh44 neuron of pars intercerebralis; ectoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; larval ring gland projection neurons; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to several human genes including ACAP1 (ArfGAP with coiled-coil, ankyrin repeat and PH domains 1) and ACAP3 (ArfGAP with coiled-coil, ankyrin repeat and PH domains 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval muscle system; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: Calpain-A
Description: Calpain-A (CalpA) encodes a calcium-dependent modulatory protease that cleaves its substrates in a limited fashion. During patterning and division in the blastoderm embryo, CalpA product cleaves the NF-kappaB inhibitor and the cell cycle regulator encoded by cact and CycB, respectively. CalpA product also regulates dendritic prunning of sensory neurons.

Name: drop dead
Description: drop dead (drd) encodes an integral membrane protein required for female fertility and for proper function of the gut and respiratory tracheae.

Name: Protein tyrosine phosphatase Meg2
Description: Protein tyrosine phosphatase Meg2 (Ptpmeg2) encodes a phosphatase involved in border follicle cell migration.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in rRNA processing. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; gut section; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human DDX54 (DEAD-box helicase 54).

Name: males absent on the first
Description: males absent on the first (mof) encodes a MYST family histone acetyltransferase that acetylates the product of His4 at Lysine 16. It is part of the male-specific lethal complex that mediates dosage compensation by transcriptional upregulation of the male X chromosome. In addition, it is part of the non-specific lethal complex which regulates expression of housekeeping genes in males and females.

Name: hiiragi
Description: hiiragi (hrg) encodes the canonical poly(A) polymerase required for the nuclear poly(A) tail synthesis at the mRNA 3'-end. hrg product is also involved in cytoplasmic polyadenylation of specific mRNAs during early to mid-oogenesis, through its interaction with the CPEB (cytoplasmic polyadenylation element binding) protein encoded by orb.

Name: Rubicon
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of autophagy. Predicted to be located in early endosome. Predicted to be active in intracellular membrane-bounded organelle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 15. Orthologous to several human genes including RUBCN (rubicon autophagy regulator).

Name: Ubiquitin specific protease 5
Description: Ubiquitin specific protease 5 (Usp5) encodes an essential enzyme that cleaves unanchored lysine48-linked polyubiquitin chains. It is involved in photoreceptor differentiation, neuron pathfinding and apoptosis.

Name: lozenge
Description: lozenge (lz) encodes an alpha-subunit of the transcription factor complex core binding factor, which is involved in transcription regulation. It plays an important role during eye development contributing to programmed cell death, eye morphogenesis, eye cone cell differentiation and R7 cell development. It contributes to hemopoiesis and wound healing.

Name: AFG3 like matrix AAA peptidase subunit 2
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Involved in mitochondrial protein processing. Part of m-AAA complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Used to study neurodegenerative disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in optic atrophy 12; spastic ataxia; spastic ataxia 5; and spinocerebellar ataxia type 28. Orthologous to human AFG3L2 (AFG3 like matrix AAA peptidase subunit 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable signaling receptor activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA helicase activity. Involved in larval somatic muscle development. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including adult fat body; embryonic/larval muscle system; foregut primordium; gastrula embryo; and germ layer derivative. Orthologous to human DDX10 (DEAD-box helicase 10).

Name: pink
Description: Has a role in the biogenesis of eye pigment granules. Eye pigment granules are specialized forms of late endosomes or lysosomes. Biogenesis of pigment granules in the eye requires molecular components required for protein delivery to lysosomes. (UniProtKB:Q9VHN9)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in nucleolus.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG7110 (FBgn0032521). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:13398991..13411047. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. 7 alleles are reported. No phenotypic data is available. No phenotypic class data is available. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-12 hour embryonic stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in germline cell; organism; and primordial germ cell.

Name: ben
Description: ben (be) encodes a protein involved in neuromuscular synaptic transmission and long-term memory formation.

Name: Semaphorin 2b
Description: Semaphorin 2b (Sema2b) encodes a member of the Semaphorins family, which are membrane and secreted short-range signaling proteins. The product of Sema2b contributes to the regulation of axon and dendrite guidance as well as cell-matrix adhesion.

Name: Sirtuin 1
Description: Sirtuin 1 (Sirt1) encodes an NAD[+]-dependent deacetylase that functions during euchromatic and heterochromatic gene silencing. Sirt1 product contributes to many biological pathways including neuronal function, apoptosis, metabolism, and development.

Name: Nucleoporin 93kD-1
Description: Nucleoporin 93kD-1 (Nup93-1) encodes a protein that directly interacts with the product of Nup154. However, the product of Nup93-1 is not necessary for the Nup154-dependent organization of the inner nuclear membrane proteins at the nuclear envelope.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable glutathione hydrolase activity. Predicted to be involved in glutathione catabolic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult mushroom body; embryonic/larval circulatory system; extended germ band embryo; midline ventral glial cell; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including GGT1 (gamma-glutamyltransferase 1) and GGT2P (gamma-glutamyltransferase 2, pseudogene).

Name: teiresias
Description: CG17716 encodes a predicted secreted immunoglobulin domain protein expressed in the embryonic central nervous system.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 35
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 35 (Vps35) encodes a component of the retromer complex that acts to recycle membrane proteins to the Golgi or plasma membrane from endocytosed vesicles.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Involved in regulation of defense response to virus. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human DDX23 (DEAD-box helicase 23).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be involved in extracellular matrix organization. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix and extracellular space. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior ectoderm anlage; brain; ectoderm; embryonic epidermis; and extended germ band embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital myasthenic syndrome 19. Orthologous to human COL13A1 (collagen type XIII alpha 1 chain).

Name: Nucleolar complex protein 3
Description: Predicted to enable chromatin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA replication initiation. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human NOC3L (NOC3 like DNA replication regulator).

Name: scrambled
Description: scrambled (sced) encodes a protein that localizes to the mitotic furrows and centrosomes. It is involved in actin reorganization during cell cycle and the assembly of pseudocleavage furrows in syncytial embryos.

Name: Neuropilin and tolloid-like
Description: Neuropilin and tolloid-like (Neto) encodes a transmembrane protein with no catalytic activities. It associates with several inotropic glutamate receptors (iGluRs) and modulates their sub-cellular distribution and function. At the neuromuscular junction, it enables iGluR clustering at the onset of synaptogenesis, and triggers postsynaptic differentiation.

Name: Cullin 4
Description: Cullin 4 (Cul4) encodes the molecular scaffold for the CRL4 E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, which catalyzes the ubiquitylation and subsequent destruction of proteins that function in cell growth and proliferation as well as transcription, replication and repair of the genome.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in poly(A)+ mRNA export from nucleus. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to human IWS1 (interacts with SUPT6H, CTD assembly factor 1).

Name: Ninein
Description: Ninein (Nin) encodes the ortholog of Ninein, a microtubule-anchoring protein in humans. Nin is highly expressed at blastoderm stage embryos and its product localizes to the centrosome periphery.

Name: Chondroitin polymerizing factor
Description: Predicted to enable N-acetylgalactosaminyl-proteoglycan 3-beta-glucuronosyltransferase activity and glucuronosyl-N-acetylgalactosaminyl-proteoglycan 4-beta-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in chondroitin sulfate biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in Golgi cisterna membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including CHPF2 (chondroitin polymerizing factor 2).

Name: roquin
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity; ubiquitin protein ligase activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-dependent decay; protein polyubiquitination; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal epidermis primordium; embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and ventral ectoderm derivative. Orthologous to human RC3H1 (ring finger and CCCH-type domains 1) and RC3H2 (ring finger and CCCH-type domains 2).

Name: Transferrin 2
Description: Transferrin 2 (Tsf2) encodes a protein that requires binding with iron for protein function. It is localised at the paracellular septate junctions in epithelial tissues and is required for junction assembly. Tsf2 mutants show overelongated tracheal tubes.

Name: Paraplegin
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial protein processing and protein-containing complex assembly. Located in mitochondrion. Part of m-AAA complex. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Used to study hereditary spastic paraplegia 7. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary spastic paraplegia 7. Orthologous to human SPG7 (SPG7 matrix AAA peptidase subunit, paraplegin).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Involved in Golgi organization. Is expressed in embryonic/larval garland cell; garland cell primordium; gonad; and organism. Orthologous to human TBCK (TBC1 domain containing kinase).

Name: Minichromosome maintenance 3
Description: Minichromosome maintenance 3 (Mcm3) encodes a component of the MCM2-7 hexamer, which forms part of the CMG complex, together with the product of CDC45L and GINS proteins. The CMG complex is the main DNA helicase that functions during DNA replication.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in embryonic antennal sense organ; embryonic head sensory system; and labral sensory complex.

Name: katanin 80
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Involved in dorsal appendage formation. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain cell body rind; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; endoderm; and nurse cell. Used to study microcephaly. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lissencephaly 6. Orthologous to human KATNB1 (katanin regulatory subunit B1).

Name: HMG-coA reductase degradation 3
Description: Predicted to be involved in ERAD pathway. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pancreatic cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including SEL1L (SEL1L adaptor subunit of ERAD E3 ubiquitin ligase).

Name: Organic anion transporting polypeptide 74D
Description: Transporter that mediates the cellular uptake of ecdysteroids, including ecdysone, from the hemolymph. (UniProtKB:Q9VVH9)

Name: klumpfuss
Description: transcription factor - zinc finger - early growth response family - involved in determination of the identities of secondary precursor cells within neuroblast lineages in the central nervous system - a genetic cascade involving and specifies the abdominal leucokinergic neurons in the Drosophila CNS

Name: CTCF
Description: CTCF (CTCF) encodes a ubiquitous transcription factor that binds to insulators and domain boundaries. It mediates insulator function and blocks enhancers by binding to the product of Cp190. It contributes to long-range chromatin interaction, organizes chromatin domain boundaries and coordinates nuclear architecture.

Name: Mediator complex subunit 16
Description: Component of the Mediator complex, a coactivator involved in the regulated transcription of nearly all RNA polymerase II-dependent genes. Mediator functions as a bridge to convey information from gene-specific regulatory proteins to the basal RNA polymerase II transcription machinery. Mediator is recruited to promoters by direct interactions with regulatory proteins and serves as a scaffold for the assembly of a functional preinitiation complex with RNA polymerase II and the general transcription factors (By similarity). Required for activated transcription of the MtnA, MtnB and MtnD genes. Required for transcriptional activation in response to lipopolysacchardie (LPS). (UniProtKB:Q9W278)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and RNA helicase activity. Predicted to be part of ribonucleoprotein complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including DDX17 (DEAD-box helicase 17).

Name: N/A
Description: May play a role in cilium biogenesis. (UniProtKB:Q9VFH6)

Name: Hillarin
Description: Hillarin (Hil) encodes a W180-domain protein that affects cytokinesis through interactions with the Septin family member encoded by pnut in the developing nervous system.

Name: nbs
Description: nbs (nbs) encodes a component of the conserved MRN complex, which plays an important role in the repair of DNA double strand breaks. The product of nbs is required to prevent chromosome breakage, interacts with the telomere capping complex and prevents telomeric fusions.

Name: Minichromosome maintenance 6
Description: Minichromosome maintenance 6 (Mcm6) encodes a subunit of the hetero-hexameric mini-chromosome maintenance (MCM) Complex, which is the eukaryotic replicative DNA helicase. MCM complex requires association with CDC45L and the GINS complex for full helicase activity.

Name: larval translucida
Description: larval translucida (ltl) encodes a leucine-rich repeat protein involved in wing vein specification.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable rRNA (guanine) methyltransferase activity and rRNA (uridine-2'-O-)-methyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of 5.8S rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA); maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA); and rRNA methylation. Predicted to be part of preribosome, large subunit precursor. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human FTSJ3 (FtsJ RNA 2'-O-methyltransferase 3).

Name: lethal (2) giant discs 1
Description: lethal (2) giant discs 1 (l(2)gd1) encodes a cytosolic protein conserved in Metazoa. It is involved in the transport of proteins such as signaling receptors through the endosomal pathway. It interacts with the ESCRT-III core component encoded by shrb and is probably required for its full activity.

Name: Larval serum protein 1 alpha
Description: Larval storage protein (LSP) which may serve as a store of amino acids for synthesis of adult proteins. (UniProtKB:P11995)

Name: Testin
Description: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Located in actin cytoskeleton and cytoplasm. Is expressed in embryonic/larval central nervous system. Orthologous to human LMCD1 (LIM and cysteine rich domains 1) and TES (testin LIM domain protein).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in monocarboxylic acid transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head; organism; and yolk nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC16A14 (solute carrier family 16 member 14).

Name: Dystrobrevin
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of muscle. Involved in maintenance of presynaptic active zone structure and regulation of neurotransmitter secretion. Located in neuromuscular junction. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval nervous system; embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell; labral sensory complex primordium; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cardiomyopathy and left ventricular noncompaction. Orthologous to several human genes including DTNA (dystrobrevin alpha).

Name: pygopus
Description: pygopus (pygo) encodes a key nuclear component of the Wnt signaling pathway. It facilitates the recruitment of the product of arm to Wnt-responsive genes by interacting with the transcription cofactor encoded by Chi. It also binds the product of lgs and the methylated tail of the product of His3. Together, they associate with the product of arm in a process that may function as a transition from gene silence to Wnt-induced transcription.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable dipeptide transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in oligopeptide transport and transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC15A1 (solute carrier family 15 member 1).

Name: Cuticular protein 50Ca
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of chitin-based larval cuticle. Predicted to be involved in chitin-based cuticle development. Predicted to be located in chitin-based extracellular matrix. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix.

Name: matotopetli
