Description: Required for male meiotic division and spermatid differentiation. Required for accumulation of aly and comr on chromatin. May function as a transcription factor. (UniProtKB:Q9VH70)

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 100kD subunit 5
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase binding activity and proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton transmembrane transport and vacuolar acidification. Predicted to be part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase, V0 domain. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; and gastric caecum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive cutis laxa type IIA; autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 1; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; renal tubular acidosis; and wrinkly skin syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP6V0A1 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a1); ATP6V0A2 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a2); and ATP6V0A4 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a4).

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 67A
Description: Kinesin-like protein at 67A (Klp67A) encodes a microtubule motor protein involved in chromosome congression and mitotic spindle morphogenesis.

Name: Cell division cycle 5
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA binding activity; and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Part of Prp19 complex. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in osteosarcoma. Orthologous to human CDC5L (cell division cycle 5 like).

Name: Organic anion transporting polypeptide 33Eb
Description: Enables transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in organic substance transport. Located in lateral plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic epidermis; extended germ band embryo; gonad; and gut section.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG15548 (FBgn0039812). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3R:30959700..30962307. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: Tsr1 ribosome assembly factor
Description: Required during maturation of the 40S ribosomal subunit in the nucleolus. (UniProtKB:Q9VP47)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA helicase activity. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval midgut; and extended germ band embryo.

Name: Chloride channel-b
Description: Chloride channel-b (ClC-b) encodes a chloride transmembrane transporter involved in phagocytosis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Orthologous to human SLC22A15 (solute carrier family 22 member 15).

Name: Gcn5 acetyltransferase
Description: Gcn5 acetyltransferase (Gcn5) encodes a lysine acetyltransferase subunit of several chromatin modifying complexes. It contributes to oogenesis and metamorphosis.

Name: tramtrack
Description: Binds to a number of sites in the transcriptional regulatory region of ftz. Isoform alpha is required to repress genes that promote the R7 cell fate. Probable repressor of the transcription of the segmentation genes ftz, eve, h, odd, run, and en. May bind to the region 5'-AGGG[CT]GG-3'. Degradation of ttk is directed by binding of sinah or sina, via the adapter molecule phyl which binds to the BTB domain of ttk. (UniProtKB:P42282)

Name: Sine oculis-binding protein
Description: Involved in compound eye development. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in border follicle cell; dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell; embryonic/larval muscle system; embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell; and embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell. Orthologous to human SOBP (sine oculis binding protein homolog).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Ribonucleoside diphosphate reductase large subunit
Description: Provides the precursors necessary for DNA synthesis. Catalyzes the biosynthesis of deoxyribonucleotides from the corresponding ribonucleotides. (UniProtKB:P48591)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 68. Orthologous to human SLC7A14 (solute carrier family 7 member 14).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and germline cell. Orthologous to human ZNF236 (zinc finger protein 236).

Name: chameau
Description: chameau (chm) encodes a histone acetyl transferase involved in epigenetic mechanisms of transcriptional control and regulation of replication origin activity. Its functions include modulation of JNK activity and gene regulation by Polycomb group genes.

Name: capricious
Description: capricious (caps) encodes a transmembrane receptor with leucine-rich repeats that mediates cell interaction in a homophilic or heterophilic manner. caps product contributes to cellular interaction critical for synapse formation and axon guidance, as well as mediating morphogenesis of multiple tissues, including wings, legs and the tracheal system.

Name: alpha-catenin related
Description: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell adhesion. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic antennal sense organ; embryonic brain; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to human CTNNAL1 (catenin alpha like 1).

Name: bruno 1
Description: bruno 1 (bru1) encodes an RNA binding protein acting in multiple forms of post-transcriptional gene regulation including repression and activation of translation and alternative splicing of pre-mRNAs. The product of bru1 is required for gametogenesis, developmental patterning, and muscle organization.

Name: Mitochondrial assembly regulatory factor
Description: Mitochondrial assembly regulatory factor (Marf) encodes a dynamin-family GTPase that mediates outer mitochondrial membrane tethering and fusion. Marf loss causes mitochondrial fragmentation and endoplasmic reticular stress that evoke skeletal muscle, retinal and heart tube dysfunction.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable nucleic acid binding activity and zinc ion binding activity. Orthologous to several human genes including ZCCHC14 (zinc finger CCHC-type containing 14).

Name: Leucine-rich-repeats and calponin homology domain protein
Description: Leucine-rich-repeats and calponin homology domain protein (Lrch) encodes a scaffold protein well conserved across animals that associates with actin-rich structures during cell division. Lack of Lrch results in a reduction of fertility and fitness.

Name: Peroxinectin-like
Description: Peroxinectin-like (Pxt) encodes a cycloxygenase-like enzyme that contributes to the synthesis of prostaglandins. Prostaglandins activate G protein-coupled receptor signaling. Its roles include oogenesis, sperm individualization, morphogenesis, nucleolar structure, temporal control of gene expression, and regulation of gene amplification.

Name: Trehalose-6-phosphate synthase 1
Description: Trehalose-6-phosphate synthase 1 (Tps1) encodes the trehalose synthesis enzyme with an N-terminal trehalose-6-phosphate (T6P) synthase domain that catalyzes the production of T6P using glucose-6-phosphate and UDP-glucose. Its C-terminal T6P phosphatase domain dephosphorylates T6P to generate trehalose.

Name: Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 4
Description: Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 4 (Lgr4) encodes a protein that shows highest similarity with vertebrate receptors for relaxin-like peptides.

Name: Bestrophin 2
Description: Predicted to enable chloride channel activity. Predicted to be involved in chloride transport. Located in peroxisome. Is expressed in several structures, including anlage in statu nascendi; embryonic hindgut; epithelium; hindgut proper primordium; and stage 5 embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant vitreoretinochoroidopathy; bestrophinopathy; macular degeneration; retinitis pigmentosa 50; and vitelliform macular dystrophy. Orthologous to several human genes including BEST1 (bestrophin 1); BEST2 (bestrophin 2); and BEST3 (bestrophin 3).

Name: TRC8 ring finger protein
Description: Plays a role in growth inhibition that is dependent upon COP9 signalosome subunits CSN5 and CSN6. May modulate signalosome levels or compartmentalization. Probably functions in the same or a related pathway to VHL during early midline development. (UniProtKB:Q7KRW1)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human SPATA20 (spermatogenesis associated 20).

Name: regeneration
Description: Predicted to enable DNA N-glycosylase activity; DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity; and carbohydrate binding activity. Involved in tissue regeneration. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in adult heart and prothoracic leg disc.

Name: Hormone receptor-like in 39
Description: Hormone receptor-like in 39 (Hr39) encodes a nuclear hormone receptor protein in subfamily 5. It is a master regulator of female reproductive gland development from the bipotential genital disc, and in adults is required for reproductive gland secretion, ovulation and additional functions.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic precursor of adult hindgut; embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human ABCG1 (ATP binding cassette subfamily G member 1) and ABCG4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily G member 4).

Name: snustorr
Description: Predicted to enable ABC-type transporter activity and ATP binding activity. Involved in cuticle development. Located in apical plasma membrane and cytoplasmic vesicle. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval tracheal section; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Ecotropic viral integration site 5
Description: Functions as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP). During border cell migration in the ovary, acts as a GAP for Rab11 and is necessary for the maintenance of active receptor tyrosine kinases at the leading edge. (UniProtKB:Q9VYY9)

Name: Glyceronephosphate O-acyltransferase
Description: Predicted to enable glycerone-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in ether lipid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in peroxisomal membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 2. Orthologous to human GNPAT (glyceronephosphate O-acyltransferase).

Name: WD repeat domain 33
Description: Predicted to be involved in mRNA polyadenylation. Predicted to be part of mRNA cleavage and polyadenylation specificity factor complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval midgut; germ layer; larval ventral nerve cord; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Used to study primary ovarian insufficiency. Orthologous to human WDR33 (WD repeat domain 33).

Name: N/A
Description: Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of actin filament polymerization. Is expressed in embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; ventral midline of embryo; and yolk nucleus.

Name: Ras association family member
Description: Ras association family member (Rassf) encodes a RASSF (ras-association domain family) protein that binds to the kinase encoded by hpo and promotes its dephosphorylation by the STRIPAK PP2A complex.

Name: barentsz
Description: barentsz (btz) encodes a component of the exon junction complex that is recruited to spliced mRNAs to mark where introns have been removed. It is required for the posterior localization of osk mRNA.

Name: Centrosomal protein 97kDa
Description: Centrosomal protein 97kDa (Cep97) encodes a centriolar protein that localizes to the distal end of both mother and daughter centrioles. It interacts with the product of Cp110, which is also localized to the distal end of the centrioles. Together they seem to prevent the centriole microtubules from extending beyond the distal end of the centriole.

Name: DNA ligase 3
Description: DNA ligase 3 (DNAlig3) encodes an ATP-dependent DNA ligase that is involved in the repair of nuclear and mitochondrial single- and double-strand DNA breaks.

Name: pre-mRNA processing factor 40
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Located in histone locus body. Part of precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to several human genes including PRPF40B (pre-mRNA processing factor 40 homolog B).

Name: arouser
Description: arouser (aru) encodes an SH3 adaptor protein that interacts with Egfr and PI3K pathways. Its roles include regulation of synapse number, memory formation and ethanol sedation sensitivity.

Name: muscarinic Acetylcholine Receptor, A-type
Description: The muscarinic acetylcholine receptor mediates various cellular responses, including inhibition of adenylate cyclase, breakdown of phosphoinositides and modulation of potassium channels through the action of G proteins. Primary transducing effect is Pi turnover. May have a role in the processing of olfactory and mechanosensory signals; regulation of neurosecretion. (UniProtKB:P16395)

Name: E2F transcription factor 1
Description: Transcriptional activator that binds to E2f sites. Required for wild-type growth in mitotic and polytene tissues, Contributes to the expression of replication genes at the G1-S transition and Cyclin E. Activates cell proliferation in wing imaginal disk, which requires expression of vg. (UniProtKB:Q27368)

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 10A
Description: Kinesin-like protein at 10A (Klp10A) encodes a member of the kinesin superfamily of motor proteins (KIF) and of the kinesin-13 family of microtubule depolymerases. It induces microtubule depolymerization to regulate the length and dynamics of microtubules in a variety of cell processes and structures such as the mitotic and meiotic spindles, the centriole and interphase microtubules.

Name: nyobe
Description: Involved in apical constriction and regulation of embryonic cell shape. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; foregut; foregut primordium; posterior ectoderm derivative; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG34382 (FBgn0085411). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:9878985..9884493. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 12-18 embryonic stages, during late pupal stages.

Name: fused
Description: Probable serine/threonine-protein kinase; maternally required for correct patterning in the posterior part of each embryonic metamere. May be involved in control of cell division during metamorphosis and ovarian development. May interact with costal-2. (UniProtKB:P23647)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in activation of GTPase activity. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Orthologous to human SGSM3 (small G protein signaling modulator 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity. Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled receptor internalization. Located in plasma membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable several functions, including NADH dehydrogenase activity; protein disulfide isomerase activity; and protein-disulfide reductase activity. Predicted to be involved in ultradian rhythm. Predicted to be located in external side of plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including ENOX1 (ecto-NOX disulfide-thiol exchanger 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human ADGRG7 (adhesion G protein-coupled receptor G7).

Name: flyers-cup
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; extended germ band embryo; and male germline cyst. Orthologous to human LRRC40 (leucine rich repeat containing 40).

Name: morula
Description: morula (mr) encodes the APC2 subunit of the anaphase promoting complex (APC). mr strong alleles produce lethality, metaphase arrest and neuroblast polyploidy. mr weak alleles result in female sterility, affecting the endocycle in the nurse cells, as well as metaphase arrest in early embryonic mitoses.

Name: Transitional endoplasmic reticulum 94
Description: Transitional endoplasmic reticulum 94 (TER94) encodes a protein that operates as a hexamere, functioning as a ubiquitin-dependent molecular chaperone. The hexamere associates with different co-factors to process nuclear and cytoplasmic substrates marked by ubiquitin.

Name: ER degradation enhancer, mannosidase alpha-like 2
Description: ER degradation enhancer, mannosidase alpha-like 2 (Edem2) encodes a lectin involved in the degradation of proteins during endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, which is generated by the presence of unfolded proteins in the ER.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables myosin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in endocytosis. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human NCKIPSD (NCK interacting protein with SH3 domain).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: cap binding protein 80
Description: Component of the cap-binding complex (CBC), which binds cotranscriptionally to the 5'-cap of pre-mRNAs and is involved in various processes such as pre-mRNA splicing and RNA-mediated gene silencing (RNAi). The CBC complex is involved in miRNA-mediated RNA interference via its interaction with Ars2 and is required for primary microRNAs (miRNAs) processing. Also involved in innate immunity via the short interfering RNAs (siRNAs) processing machinery by restricting the viral RNA production. In the CBC complex, Cbp80 does not bind directly capped RNAs (m7GpppG-capped RNA) but is required to stabilize the movement of the N-terminal loop of Cbp20 and lock the CBC into a high affinity cap-binding state with the cap structure. (UniProtKB:Q7K4N3)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human SPATA5 (spermatogenesis associated 5).

Name: Integrin betanu subunit
Description: Contributes to endodermal integrity and adhesion between the midgut epithelium and the surrounding visceral muscle. Essential for migration of the primordial midgut cells and for maintaining, but not establishing, cell polarity in the midgut epithelium. Can only partially compensate for the loss of beta-PS integrin during primordial midgut cell migration. The two beta subunits mediate midgut migration by distinct mechanisms: beta-PS requires rhea/Talin and beta-nu does not. Integrin alpha-PS3/beta-nu is required for effective phagocytosis of apoptotic cells during embryonic development and for the phagocytic elimination of S.aureus by mediating the binding of S.aureus peptidoglycan to larval hemocytes, which probably activates a signaling pathway involving Rac1 and Rac2. Not required for the production of antimicrobial peptides during S.aureus. Upon activation by LanA, integrin alpha-PS3/beta-nu activates Fak in presynapsis to suppress neuromuscular junction (NMJ) growth during larval development and during low crawling activity, but not during higher-crawling conditions. Mediates, together with LanA, glutamate receptor-modulated NMJ growth. (UniProtKB:Q27591)

Name: scabrous
Description: scabrous (sca) encodes a secreted glycoprotein with partial homology to fibrinogen and its relatives. It is a transcriptional target of proneural bHLH proteins and a useful marker for proneural regions and cells. It contributes to neural patterning and interacts with the Notch pathway.

Name: haywire
Description: haywire (hay) encodes a ATP-dependent 3'-5' DNA helicase based on the similarity with the human gene XPB, which is a subunit of the DNA repair and basal transcription factor TFIIH. The product of hay contributes to response to UV and homeotic gene expression.

Name: AMP deaminase
Description: Predicted to enable AMP deaminase activity. Predicted to be involved in AMP metabolic process and IMP biosynthetic process. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal closure embryo; embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval garland cell; gut section; and hindgut proper primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary spastic paraplegia 63 and pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 9. Orthologous to several human genes including AMPD2 (adenosine monophosphate deaminase 2).

Name: belle
Description: belle (bel) encodes a DEAD-box RNA helicase that functions both as positive and negative translation regulator. It is essential for embryo viability and fertility, and is required for the maintenance of male germ-line stem cells.

Name: Gelsolin
Description: Calcium-regulated, actin-modulating protein that binds to the plus (or barbed) ends of actin monomers or filaments, preventing monomer exchange (end-blocking or capping). It can promote the assembly of monomers into filaments (nucleation) as well as sever filaments already formed. (UniProtKB:Q07171)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; and endoderm. Orthologous to human TTC27 (tetratricopeptide repeat domain 27).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor activity and dopamine neurotransmitter receptor activity, coupled via Gi/Go. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-activating adrenergic receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in organism; spermatozoon; and yolk nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Orthologous to several human genes including FAM13B (family with sequence similarity 13 member B).

Name: P-element somatic inhibitor
Description: P-element somatic inhibitor (Psi) encodes a protein that has dual roles in RNA processing and transcriptional regulation. It is required for activating Myc transcription.

Name: Otopetrin-like b
Description: Predicted to enable proton channel activity. Predicted to be involved in proton transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in embryonic anal pad; embryonic large intestine; and embryonic rectum. Orthologous to human OTOP1 (otopetrin 1); OTOP2 (otopetrin 2); and OTOP3 (otopetrin 3).

Name: tamo
Description: tamo (tamo) encodes a protein with an essential function during oogenesis where it interacts with the product of dl and proteins that are part of the nuclear import machinery.

Name: Choline transporter-like 2
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head and dorsal median cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 72. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC44A2 (solute carrier family 44 member 2) and SLC44A5 (solute carrier family 44 member 5).

Name: Nucleoporin 93kD-2
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of nuclear pore. Predicted to be involved in nuclear pore organization; poly(A)+ mRNA export from nucleus; and protein import into nucleus. Predicted to be part of nuclear pore nuclear basket. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; and extended germ band embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nephrotic syndrome type 12. Orthologous to human NUP93 (nucleoporin 93).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG4631 (FBgn0032590). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:16607370..16610037. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 87a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in embryonic midgut chamber.

Name: uncharacterized nascent polypeptide-associated complex beta subunit
Description: Predicted to be part of nascent polypeptide-associated complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol and polysomal ribosome. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human BTF3L4 (basic transcription factor 3 like 4).

Name: nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor alpha3
Description: nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor alpha3 (nAChRalpha3) encodes a subunit of the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor, which is a pentameric neurotransmitter-gated ion channel.

Name: Tehao
Description: Tehao (Tehao) encodes a homologue of the receptor encoded by Tl. It is involved in the Toll signaling pathway and innate immune response.

Name: Golgi matrix protein 130 kD
Description: Golgi matrix protein 130 kD (GM130) encodes a protein involved in Golgi compartmental organization and regulation of dendrite morphogenesis.

Name: Elongator complex protein 2
Description: Component of the elongator complex which is required for multiple tRNA modifications, including mcm5U (5-methoxycarbonylmethyl uridine), mcm5s2U (5-methoxycarbonylmethyl-2-thiouridine), and ncm5U (5-carbamoylmethyl uridine) (By similarity). The elongator complex catalyzes the formation of carboxymethyluridine in the wobble base at position 34 in tRNAs (By similarity). Involved in the regulation of the STAT pathway (Ref.4). (UniProtKB:Q7K4B3)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable nucleotide binding activity.

Name: spenito
Description: RNA-binding protein that acts as an associated component of the WMM complex, a complex that mediates N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methylation of mRNAs (PubMed:27919077, PubMed:29535189, PubMed:29555755). M6a modification plays a role in the efficiency of mRNA splicing and is required for sex determination (PubMed:27919077, PubMed:29535189, PubMed:29555755). In the WMM complex, may act by binding target RNAs and recruiting the WMM complex (PubMed:29535189). Required for sex determination and dosage compensation via Sxl alternative splicing: m6A methylation acts as a key regulator of Sxl pre-mRNA and promotes female-specific alternative splicing of Sxl, which determines female physiognomy (PubMed:26324914, PubMed:29535189, PubMed:29555755). M6A methylation is also required for neuronal functions (PubMed:27919077). Acts as a positive regulator of canonical Wg signaling during wing disk and eye development (PubMed:16547102, PubMed:18174108). (UniProtKB:Q7KMJ6)

Name: Vav guanine nucleotide exchange factor
Description: Vav guanine nucleotide exchange factor (Vav) encodes a protein that belongs to the Dbl GEF superfamily. It functions as a GDP/GTP exchange factor for the product of Rac1 and an adaptor protein. Both activities are activated by direct tyrosine phosphorylation.

Name: N/A
Description: Serves as substrate adapter subunit in an E3 ubiquitin ligase complex CG12084-cul-2-elongin BC. Targets substrates bearing N-terminal glycine degrons for proteasomal degradation. (UniProtKB:Q9W0E8)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in actin cytoskeleton reorganization. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; embryonic epidermis; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; and stage 5 embryo.

Name: EF-hand domain containing 1.1
Description: Predicted to enable alpha-tubulin binding activity. Involved in regulation of dendrite morphogenesis and synaptic assembly at neuromuscular junction. Located in dendrite; neuronal cell body; and terminal bouton. Colocalizes with microtubule. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human EFHC2 (EF-hand domain containing 2).

Name: Netrin-B
Description: Netrins control guidance of CNS commissural axons and peripheral motor axons (PubMed:8780645, PubMed:8780646, PubMed:11719202). Its association with either fra or unc-5 receptors will lead to axon attraction or repulsion, respectively (PubMed:11719202). While short-range repulsion requires both fra and unc-5 receptors, long-range repulsion only requires unc-5 (PubMed:11719202). (UniProtKB:Q24568)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable pyruvate kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in glycolytic process. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Gaucher's disease; congenital nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia; malaria; pyruvate kinase deficiency of red cells; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human PKLR (pyruvate kinase L/R) and PKM (pyruvate kinase M1/2).

Name: castor
Description: castor (cas) encodes a transcription factor expressed in the latest stage of embryonic neuroblast lineages. It represses the prior redundant genes, pdm2 nub, and precedes the expression of grh.

Name: Decapping protein 2
Description: Decapping protein 2 (DCP2) encodes a m7G(5')pppN diphosphatase involved in gene silencing by miRNA and the regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly.

Name: skittles
Description: skittles (sktl) encodes the major Phosphatidylinositol 4-Phosphate-5 kinase (PI4P5K), catalysing the formation of phosphoinositol-4,5-bisphosphate (PIP4,5). The sktl product is involved in many cellular processes involving (PIP4,5), such as endocytosis. It plays an important role in cell polarity by controlling the localization of the product encoded by baz.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG13731 (FBgn0036717). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:17383636..17388956. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 12-24 hour embryonic stages, at stages throughout the larval period, during early pupal stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cell morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable 5'-nucleotidase activity. Predicted to be involved in nucleotide catabolic process. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval oenocyte; gonad; head segment; sensory nervous system primordium; and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: Wsck
Description: Probably lacks tyrosine-protein kinase activity. (UniProtKB:P83097)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and RNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein localization. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval nervous system; pole plasm; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to human DDX42 (DEAD-box helicase 42).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG17732 (FBgn0036923). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:19981685..19984191. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very low expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed within 06-24 hour embryonic stages, at stages throughout the larval period, at stages throughout the pupal period, in stages of adults of both sexes.

Name: Centrocortin
Description: Centrocortin (Cen) encodes a protein that regulates cleavage furrow assembly in the early embryo. It localizes to centrosomes asymmetrically, and to cortical actin structures.

Name: Poly(A) specific ribonuclease subunit PAN3
Description: Regulatory subunit of the poly(A)-nuclease (PAN) deadenylation complex, one of two cytoplasmic mRNA deadenylases involved in general and miRNA-mediated mRNA turnover. PAN specifically shortens poly(A) tails of RNA and the activity is stimulated by poly(A)-binding protein (PABP). PAN deadenylation is followed by rapid degradation of the shortened mRNA tails by the CCR4-NOT complex. Deadenylated mRNAs are then degraded by two alternative mechanisms, namely exosome-mediated 3'-5' exonucleolytic degradation, or deadenlyation-dependent mRNA decaping and subsequent 5'-3' exonucleolytic degradation by XRN1. PAN3 acts as a positive regulator for PAN activity, recruiting the catalytic subunit PAN2 to mRNA via its interaction with RNA and PABP, and to miRNA targets via its interaction with GW182 family proteins. (UniProtKB:Q95RR8)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including protein phosphorylation; regulation of mRNA processing; and spliceosomal complex assembly. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human SRPK2 (SRSF protein kinase 2).

Name: Mnt
Description: Mnt (Mnt) encodes a protein that belongs to the basic-helic-loop-helix-zipper class of transcription factors, which form heterodimers with the protein encoded by Max. Mnt product acts as a repressor of transcription by recruiting a co-repressor complex to its genomic binding sites. It antagonizes cell growth promoting functions of the product encoded by Myc and its depletion produces flies with larger cells, increased weight, and decreased lifespan.

Name: Larval serum protein 1 beta
Description: Larval storage protein (LSP) which may serve as a store of amino acids for synthesis of adult proteins. (UniProtKB:P11996)

Name: Cadherin 96Cb
Description: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity. Involved in open tracheal system development. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in spiracular chamber. Orthologous to human PCDHB7 (protocadherin beta 7).

Name: Organic anion transporting polypeptide 58Dc
Description: Organic anion transporting polypeptide 58Dc (Oatp58Dc) encodes a membrane transporter implicated in renal elimination of organic compounds including ouabain and methotrexate. In the perineural glia of the blood brain barrier, the product of Oatp58Dc protects the brain from potentially toxic organic anions in the hemolymph.

Name: Mahogunin ring finger 1
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human MGRN1 (mahogunin ring finger 1) and RNF157 (ring finger protein 157).

Name: Fish-lips
Description: Fish-lips (Fili) encodes a leucine-rich repeat family transmembrane protein. It regulates autonomous and nonautonomous apoptosis caused by the dioxin receptor homolog encoded by ss.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase signaling pathway. Predicted to be part of receptor complex. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including arteriovenous malformation; basal ganglia calcification; hematologic cancer (multiple); infantile myofibromatosis; and multiple cutaneous and mucosal venous malformations. Orthologous to human TEK (TEK receptor tyrosine kinase); PDGFRA (platelet derived growth factor receptor alpha); and PDGFRB (platelet derived growth factor receptor beta).

Name: Phosphofructokinase
Description: Catalyzes the phosphorylation of D-fructose 6-phosphate to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate by ATP, the first committing step of glycolysis. (UniProtKB:P52034)

Name: Cap methyltransferase 1
Description: S-adenosyl-L-methionine-dependent methyltransferase that mediates mRNA cap1 2'-O-ribose methylation to the 5'-cap structure of mRNAs (PubMed:32504809). Methylates the ribose of the first nucleotide of a m(7)GpppG-capped mRNA to produce m(7)GpppNmp (cap1) (PubMed:32504809). Positively regulates the Ago2-dependent small RNA pathway, with roles in both siRNA biogenesis and RISC assembly (PubMed:32504809). Involved in facilitating conversion of pre-RISC into holo-RISC, possibly by promoting the unwinding of Ago2-bound siRNA duplexes and thus the retention of the guide strand in holo-RISC (PubMed:32504809). (UniProtKB:Q9W4N2)

Name: Stubble
Description: Hormone dependent protease required for epithelial morphogenesis, including the formation of bristles, legs, and wings. Has a dual function, detaches imaginal disk cells from extracellular matrices through its extracellular proteolytic domain and transmits an outside-to-inside signal to its intracellular domain to modify the cytoskeleton during morphogenesis. (UniProtKB:Q05319)

Name: Synaptotagmin 12
Description: Predicted to enable several functions, including calcium ion binding activity; phospholipid binding activity; and syntaxin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in calcium-ion regulated exocytosis; cellular response to calcium ion; and regulation of secretion by cell. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in exocytic vesicle and plasma membrane. Is expressed in indirect flight muscle cell. Orthologous to human SYT12 (synaptotagmin 12).

Name: Splicing factor 1
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Located in nucleus. Part of precatalytic spliceosome. Orthologous to human SF1 (splicing factor 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity, acting on the aldehyde or oxo group of donors, NAD or NADP as acceptor. Predicted to be involved in protein homooligomerization. Is expressed in anterior endoderm; anterior midgut primordium; organism; posterior endoderm; and posterior midgut primordium. Orthologous to human SHKBP1 (SH3KBP1 binding protein 1) and KCTD3 (potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 3).

Name: Glycoprotein 93
Description: Glycoprotein 93 (Gp93) encodes a heat shock protein Hsp90 family member that is involved in midgut development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable U3 snoRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in endonucleolytic cleavage in 5'-ETS of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and endonucleolytic cleavage to generate mature 5'-end of SSU-rRNA from (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be part of 90S preribosome. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human TBL3 (transducin beta like 3).

Name: Guanylyl cyclase beta-subunit at 100B
Description: Guanylyl cyclase beta-subunit at 100B (Gycbeta100B) encodes an enzyme that synthesizes cyclic GMP and is activated by nitric oxide.

Name: Mitochondrial aconitase 1
Description: Mitochondrial aconitase 1 (mAcon1) encodes an enzyme that harbors an iron-sulfur cluster and catalyses the first step of the Krebs Cycle in mitochondria, converting citrate into isocitrate.

Name: NAD synthetase
Description: Catalyzes the ATP-dependent amidation of deamido-NAD to form NAD. Uses L-glutamine as a nitrogen source (By similarity). Because of its role in energy metabolism, involved in the modulation of aged-related cardiac function, mobility, and lifespan (PubMed:27448710). (UniProtKB:Q9VYA0)

Name: Phospholipase A2 activator protein
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process and ubiquitin recycling. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to human PLAA (phospholipase A2 activating protein).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable lipoprotein particle binding activity and low-density lipoprotein particle receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in receptor-mediated endocytosis. Predicted to be active in early endosome and plasma membrane. Is expressed in early extended germ band embryo; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Neprilysin 3
Description: Metalloendoprotease which is required in the dorsal paired medial neurons for the proper formation of long-term (LTM) and middle-term memories (MTM). Also required in the mushroom body neurons where it functions redundantly with neprilysins Nep2 and Nep4 in normal LTM formation. (UniProtKB:Q9W5Y0)

Name: Dipeptidyl aminopeptidase III
Description: Degrades neuropeptide proctolin (RYLPT) by cleavage between Tyr and Leu residues. (UniProtKB:Q9VHR8)

Name: Bruton tyrosine kinase
Description: Bruton tyrosine kinase (Btk) encodes a non-receptor tyrosine kinase with diverse roles including cellularization, morphogenesis, patterning and germ cell proliferation.

Name: espinas
Description: espinas (esn) encodes a LIM domain protein that binds to the seven-pass transmembrane cadherin encoded by stan. This stan-esn interplay elicits repulsion between dendritic branches of sensory neurons.

Name: Splicing factor 3a subunit 1
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Involved in spermatogenesis. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; larval ventral nerve cord; and organism. Orthologous to human SF3A1 (splicing factor 3a subunit 1).

Name: Oxysterol binding protein
Description: Oxysterol binding protein (Osbp) encodes a protein important for sperm development.

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 68D
Description: Kinesin-like protein at 68D (Klp68D) encodes the kinesin-2beta motor subunit of the heterotrimeric kinesin-2. It associates with the products of Klp64D and Kap3. It plays an essential role in the sensory cilia assembly, microtubule organization in dendrites, and axonal transport.

Name: N(alpha)-acetyltransferase 35
Description: Probable auxillary component of a complex displaying alpha (N-terminal) acetyltransferase activity. (UniProtKB:Q9W1A2)

Name: straw
Description: Predicted to enable catechol oxidase activity and tyrosinase activity. Involved in chitin-based cuticle development. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Bestrophin 1
Description: Bestrophin 1 (Best1) encodes a Ca-activated Cl channel. In Drosophila S2 cells, the current of the product of Best1 is activated by calcium and by cell swelling and plays a role in cell volume regulation.

Name: okra
Description: okra (okr) encodes a helicase involved in homologous DNA repair. It functions in meiotic recombination.

Name: Sox box protein 15
Description: Sox box protein 15 (Sox15) encodes a transcription factor that regulates cell proliferation and cell death in the wing disc.

Name: Uncoordinated 115b
Description: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity. Predicted to be involved in lamellipodium assembly. Located in nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic Malpighian tubule; extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to human ABLIM1 (actin binding LIM protein 1); ABLIM2 (actin binding LIM protein family member 2); and ABLIM3 (actin binding LIM protein family member 3).

Name: N/A
Description: CG10383 encodes a hydrolase involved in the regulation of glycosylphosphatidylinositol metabolism, determination of lifespan and sleep.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sterol binding activity and sterol transporter activity. Predicted to be active in cytosol; intracellular membrane-bounded organelle; and membrane. Is expressed in adult head; wing hinge primordium; and wing pouch. Orthologous to human OSBPL9 (oxysterol binding protein like 9).

Name: N/A
Description: Required for maturation of ribosomal RNAs and formation of the large ribosomal subunit. (UniProtKB:Q7K0Y1)

Name: Rho-related BTB domain containing
Description: Rho-related BTB domain containing (RhoBTB) encodes a protein involved in anti-parasitoid immune response.

Name: Mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha subunit
Description: Mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha subunit (Mtpalpha) encodes a subunit of the mitochondrial trifunctional protein. It possesses 3-enoyl-CoA hydratase and 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase activities, which catalyze the second and third steps,respectively, of the beta-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids.

Name: Xe7
Description: Xe7 (Xe7) encodes a protein that contributes to axon guidance and lateral inhibition.

Name: Mitochondrial aconitase 2
Description: Predicted to enable 4 iron, 4 sulfur cluster binding activity and aconitate hydratase activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; organism; spermatozoon; and testis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in infantile cerebellar-retinal degeneration and optic atrophy 9. Orthologous to human ACO2 (aconitase 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Retinoblastoma-family protein 2
Description: cell cycle and developmental regulator - functions in concert with E2F2 to repress the expression of differentiation markers in ovaries and embryos where RBF2 is highly expressed

Name: capulet
Description: capulet (capt) encodes a conserved actin binding protein that functions across eukaryotes to negatively regulate actin filament assembly. Different types of actin filament formation are differentially affected by the loss of capt.

Name: Bicaudal D
Description: Bicaudal D (BicD) encodes a cytoplasmic protein that links diverse cargo to the dynein/dynactin motor. Cargos like mRNAs, proteins and organelles are transported along microtubules. Through this mechanism the product of BicDcontrols spatial aspects of gene expression and polarity formation during development. Additionally, it supports physiology of differentiated polar cells and the function of the nervous system.

Name: Rs1
Description: Predicted to enable RNA helicase activity. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; and gut section. Orthologous to human DDX27 (DEAD-box helicase 27).

Name: UFM1 specific ligase 1
Description: E3 UFM1-protein ligase that mediates ufmylation of target proteins. (UniProtKB:Q9VI55)

Name: proboscipedia
Description: proboscipedia (pb) encodes a conserved homeodomain transcription factor. Its role in regional head development, from insects to mammals, likely involves combinatorial regulation both of cell-specific targets and of multiple signaling pathways.

Name: withered
Description: withered (whd) encodes a carnitine O-palmitoyltransferase involved in oxidative stress.

Name: Spindly
Description: Spindly (Spindly) encodes a key regulator of dynein recruitment to kinetochores and is involved in the spindle assembly checkpoint during the cell cycle. It also contributes to cell morphology and migration.

Name: maroon-like
Description: Sulfurates the molybdenum cofactor. Sulfation of molybdenum is essential for xanthine dehydrogenase (XDH) and aldehyde oxidase (ADO) enzymes in which molybdenum cofactor is liganded by 1 oxygen and 1 sulfur atom in active form. (UniProtKB:Q9VRA2)

Name: p120 catenin
Description: p120 catenin (p120ctn) encodes an important modulator of cell adhesion. It binds to and stabilizes classic cadherin cell adhesion receptors at the cell surface. Unlike its mammalian homologs, it is non-essential but becomes essential if the levels of the product of shg are reduced.

Name: Secretory 23
Description: Secretory 23 (Sec23) encodes a COPII vesicle-coating component that functions in vesicle transport from the ER to the Golgi apparatus. It is involved in cell polarity maintenance and extracellular matrix secretion.

Name: sosondowah
Description: Orthologous to several human genes including SOWAHB (sosondowah ankyrin repeat domain family member B).

Name: lethal (3) 80Fg
Description: Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human DNAJC16 (DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member C16).

Name: pasilla
Description: pasilla (ps) encodes a nuclear RNA binding protein implicated in splicing. It is expressed at high levels in the embryonic salivary gland and other tissues. Loss of function results in a significant reduction in secretory volume and secretory vesicles in the salivary gland and irregular gland morphology.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal system; extended germ band embryo; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Glutaminyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Predicted to enable glutamine-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in dendrite morphogenesis. Part of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase multienzyme complex. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human QARS1 (glutaminyl-tRNA synthetase 1).

Name: trabid
Description: trabid (trbd) encodes a OTU family member that interacts with the product of Apc when ubiquitinated. It affects the activity of the product of Apc in transcription.

Name: N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase
Description: Predicted to enable alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity. Is expressed in adult fat body; adult head; and adult heart. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease axonal type 2V; mucopolysaccharidosis III; and mucopolysaccharidosis type IIIB. Orthologous to human NAGLU (N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase).

Name: zinc finger protein 30C
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; gastrula embryo; and wing disc.

Name: imaginal discs arrested
Description: imaginal discs arrested (ida) encodes a ubiquitin ligase that regulates the mitotic metaphase/anaphase transition.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable BMP binding activity and BMP receptor binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of BMP signaling pathway. Predicted to be active in extracellular space.

Name: oskyddad
Description: Predicted to enable ABC-type transporter activity and ATP binding activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Located in apical plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult fat body; adult head; embryonic epidermis; and spermatozoon. Used to study autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis.

Name: Transglutaminase
Description: Transglutaminase (Tg) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the isopeptide bond formation of epsilon-(gamma-glutamyl)lysine bonds in a Ca[2+]-dependent manner. It maintains the homeostasis of gut microbiota and promotes peritrophic matrix formation, as well as mediating cuticular morphogenesis and haemolymph coagulation.

Name: Golgin 104
Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in vesicle cytoskeletal trafficking. Located in trans-Golgi network. Orthologous to human CCDC186 (coiled-coil domain containing 186).

Name: WD repeat domain 24
Description: WD repeat domain 24 (Wdr24) encodes a component of the GATOR2 complex that promotes activation of the Crtc product and anabolic metabolism. It localizes to lysosomes and autolysosomes and regulates lysosome function independent of the activity of the Crtc product.

Name: Minichromosome maintenance 10
Description: Proposed to be involved in DNA replication and to participate in the activation of the pre-replication complex (pre-RC). May be involved in chromosome condensation. (UniProtKB:Q9VIE6)

Name: Keap1
Description: Keap1 (Keap1) encodes a protein that interacts with the product of cnc to regulate the activation of genes by oxidative stress.

Name: Delta[1]-pyrroline-5-carboxylate synthase
Description: Enables glutamate 5-kinase activity and glutamate-5-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity. Predicted to be involved in proline biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval midgut; and yolk nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cataract; cutis laxa (multiple); enterocele; and hereditary spastic paraplegia (multiple). Orthologous to human ALDH18A1 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 18 family member A1).

Name: Component of oligomeric golgi complex 4
Description: Required for normal Golgi function. (UniProtKB:Q95TN4)

Name: martik
Description: Enables transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of chromatin organization. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic/larval central nervous system; embryonic/larval salivary gland; endocrine system; and spermatozoon.

Name: nervous fingers 2
Description: Is expressed in central brain primordium and embryonic brain. Orthologous to human INSM1 (INSM transcriptional repressor 1) and INSM2 (INSM transcriptional repressor 2).

Name: Rtf1
Description: Rtf1 (Rtf1) encodes a transcription elongation factor that acts downstream of the products of Ubc6 and Bre1 in regulating the histone modification activity of the Set1/COMPASS complex. It regulates Notch signaling.

Name: Anaphase Promoting Complex subunit 4
Description: Involved in protein catabolic process. Predicted to be part of anaphase-promoting complex. Predicted to be active in nuclear periphery. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human ANAPC4 (anaphase promoting complex subunit 4).

Name: Glutaminase
Description: Predicted to enable glutaminase activity. Predicted to be involved in glutamate biosynthetic process and glutamine catabolic process. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; central nervous system; extended germ band embryo; spermatozoon; and ventral midline of embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 71. Orthologous to several human genes including GLS (glutaminase).

Name: Outer segment 5
Description: Involved in cilium assembly. Located in non-motile cilium. Is expressed in Johnston organ neurons; chordotonal neurons; eo neurons; and wing disc. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in asphyxiating thoracic dystrophy 2. Orthologous to human IFT80 (intraflagellar transport 80).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG13954 (FBgn0033405). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:9309296..9389467. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 12-24 hour embryonic stages, during early larval stages.

Name: Ada2a-containing complex component 2
Description: Ada2a-containing complex component 2 (Atac2) encodes a protein involved in chromatin organization, intestinal stem cell homeostasis, and histone acetylation.

Name: morpheyus
Description: Involved in apical constriction and regulation of embryonic cell shape. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval salivary gland common duct; embryonic/larval tracheal system; extended germ band embryo; labral sensory complex; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: D19B
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Adenosine receptor
Description: Adenosine receptor (AdoR) encodes a protein belongsING to the G protein-coupled receptor family (Class A) that functions via cAMP and PKA activation. It is involved in response to metabolic stress and neuromodulation.

Name: Catalytic subunit 3B of the oligosaccharyltransferase complex
Description: Predicted to enable dolichyl-diphosphooligosaccharide-protein glycotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in post-translational protein modification and protein N-linked glycosylation via asparagine. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval fat body; extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; gut section; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital disorder of glycosylation Ix. Orthologous to human STT3B (STT3 oligosaccharyltransferase complex catalytic subunit B).

Name: Neprilysin 2
Description: Metalloendoprotease which cleaves peptides such as tachykinin peptide TK-2 at the amino side of hydrophobic residues (PubMed:15554877, PubMed:17157960). Functions in female fertility, embryogenesis and memory formation (PubMed:24395329, PubMed:27629706). Required in females for normal patterns of egg laying, probably due to its function in sperm retention and preventing sperm displacement by rival ejaculates (PubMed:24395329). Also required for normal patterns of hatching due to its important role in early embryonic development (PubMed:24395329). Required in the dorsal paired medial neurons for the proper formation of middle-term memory (PubMed:27629706). Also required in the mushroom body neurons where it functions redundantly with neprilysins Nep3 and Nep4 in normal long-term memory formation (PubMed:27629706). (UniProtKB:A0A0B4K692)

Name: Cullin 1
Description: Core component of multiple SCF (SKP1-CUL1-F-box protein) E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complexes which mediate the ubiquitination of proteins involved in cell cycle progression, signal transduction and transcription. In the SCF complex, serves as a rigid scaffold that organizes the SKP1-F-box protein and RBX1 subunits. May contribute to catalysis through positioning of the substrate and the ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme. During early metamorphosis, part of the SCF-slmb complex that negatively regulates the InR/PI3K/TOR pathway to activate the pruning of unnecessary larval ddaC dendrites and mushroom body axons (PubMed:24068890). The SCF-slmb complex also regulates asymmetrical division of neuroblasts and inhibits ectopic neuroblast formation partly through SAK and Akt1 (PubMed:24413555). Also part of an SCF complex required for caspase activation during sperm differentiation (PubMed:20392747). Necessary for auditory transduction: plays a role in Johnston's organ organization by acting in the regulation of zip and ck function in scolopidial apical attachment (PubMed:27331610). May function by acting in a Ubr3-mediated pathway that negatively regulates the ubiquitination of zip, consequently affecting its interaction with ck (PubMed:27331610). (UniProtKB:Q24311)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be part of Cul4-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human DCAF5 (DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 5).

Name: Cadherin 96Ca
Description: Cadherin 96Ca (Cad96Ca) encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) that is a direct target of the transcription factor encoded by grh and is required for epidermal wound healing. It cooperates with the product of InR during wing growth.

Name: Nopp140
Description: Nopp140 (Nopp140) encodes a nucleolar and Cajal body protein. It is predicted to function as a chaperone in the assembly of small nucleolar ribonucleoprotein particles within Cajal bodies, their transit to nucleoli, and their association with pre-ribosomal RNA within nucleolar dense fibrillar regions.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to several human genes including FAM110A (family with sequence similarity 110 member A); FAM110B (family with sequence similarity 110 member B); and FAM110C (family with sequence similarity 110 member C).

Name: male-specific lethal 2
Description: male-specific lethal 2 (msl-2) encodes the key male-specific subunit of the male-specific-lethal dosage compensation complex. It induces or stabilizes all other components. Homozygous mutant males die, while msl-2 ectopic expression kills females.

Name: F-box and leucine-rich repeat protein 7
Description: F-box and leucine-rich repeat protein 7 (Fbxl7) encodes a ubiquitin ligase that regulates Hippo signaling.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human CCDC142 (coiled-coil domain containing 142).

Name: Larval serum protein 1 gamma
Description: Larval storage protein (LSP) which may serve as a store of amino acids for synthesis of adult proteins. (UniProtKB:P11997)

Name: Medea
Description: Medea (Med) encodes a protein that belongs to the highly conserved Smad family. It can bind its siblings encoded by Mad or Smox to facilitate signal transduction for the product of dpp or Activin ligands in the TGF-beta family. Med-complexes function as transcriptional regulators. Many developmental roles include dorsal-ventral patterning, patterning and proliferation of the wing disc and gene expression in the mushroom body of the larval brain.

Name: Polynucleotide phosphorylase
Description: Polynucleotide phosphorylase (PNPase) encodes an enzyme involved in the regulation of mitochondrial mRNA stability.

Name: Sirtuin 7
Description: NAD-dependent protein deacetylase. (UniProtKB:Q9VAQ1)

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in mushroom body development. Predicted to be part of small-subunit processome. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in adult head; anterior midgut primordium; embryonic/larval midgut; organism; and posterior midgut primordium. Orthologous to human UTP14A (UTP14A small subunit processome component) and UTP14C (UTP14C small subunit processome component).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in rRNA processing. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human ESF1 (ESF1 nucleolar pre-rRNA processing protein homolog).

Name: branchless
Description: branchless (bnl) encodes a fibroblast growth factor (FGF) ligand for the transmembrane tyrosine kinase receptor encoded by btl that utilizes the intracellular Ras-MAP kinase pathway. It contributes to embryonic tracheal migration.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables myosin binding activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; amnioserosa; gut section; procephalic segment; and yolk nucleus. Orthologous to human GPCPD1 (glycerophosphocholine phosphodiesterase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG3651 (FBgn0032974). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:22121338..22126614. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of moderate expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-06 hour embryonic stages.

Name: fussel
Description: fussel (fuss) encodes a protein that belongs to the highly conserved Sno/Ski family of Smad binding proteins. fuss mutant phenotypes in the larval brain phenocopy babo and Smox mutants, suggesting a role in Activin signaling. fuss overexpression antagonizes both Dpp and Activin signaling.

Name: Semaphorin 1b
Description: Predicted to enable chemorepellent activity and semaphorin receptor binding activity. Involved in embryonic development via the syncytial blastoderm. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; germ layer; mesectoderm anlage; ovariole; and ventral midline of embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in progressive myoclonus epilepsy. Orthologous to several human genes including SEMA6A (semaphorin 6A); SEMA6B (semaphorin 6B); and SEMA6C (semaphorin 6C).

Name: Xeroderma pigmentosum D
Description: Xeroderma pigmentosum D (Xpd) encodes a DNA helicase that is a subunit of the basal transcription and DNA repair factor TFIIH.

Name: Sak kinase
Description: Sak kinase (SAK) encodes a serine/threonine protein kinase member of the Polo-like kinase family. It phosphorylates centrosomal proteins and self-regulates by autophosphorylation. It is required for centriole biogenesis and formation of the basal bodies of cilia and flagella.

Name: male sterile (3) 76Ba
Description: Involved in spermatogenesis.

Name: lethal-(2)-denticleless
Description: lethal-(2)-denticleless (l(2)dtl) encodes the Cdt2 protein, which functions as a substrate receptor for a Cul4-based E3 ubiquitin ligase. The ubiquitylation and subsequent destruction of Cdt2 substrates depends on DNA synthesis that occurs during S phase or after DNA damage and includes proteins involved in genome function and maintenance.

Name: bobby sox
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human BBX (BBX high mobility group box domain containing).

Name: Protein kinase, cGMP-dependent at 21D
Description: Protein kinase, cGMP-dependent at 21D (Pkg21D) encodes a Mg[+] dependent-kinase that is activated by cGMP. It contributes to somatic muscle development, salivary gland morphogenesis and epithelial fluid transport.

Name: Follistatin
Description: Follistatin (Fs) encodes a secreted protein that inhibits activin and decapentaplegic receptor signaling pathways but enhances signaling mediated by the Activin-like protein encoded by daw.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in membrane. Orthologous to human DCST2 (DC-STAMP domain containing 2).

Name: SLo interacting protein 1
Description: May selectively reduce calcium-activated potassium channel (Slo) currents by reducing the number of Slo channels in the plasma membrane. (UniProtKB:Q8MR31)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase D activity. Predicted to be involved in ceramide biosynthetic process; glycerophospholipid catabolic process; and sphingomyelin catabolic process. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human SMPD4 (sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase 4).

Name: kelch like family member 10
Description: kelch like family member 10 (klhl10) encodes a protein that functions in spermatogenesis. It recruits substrates for a testis specific Cullin-3-based E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, which is required for caspase activation during the non-apoptotic process of spermatid terminal differentiation.

Name: Secretory 15
Description: Component of the exocyst complex involved in the docking of exocytic vesicles with fusion sites on the plasma membrane. (UniProtKB:Q9VDE6)

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Predicted to be located in extracellular space.

Name: eyes absent
Description: eyes absent (eya) encodes a transcriptional cofactor that physically interacts with several other retinal determination proteins, including those encoded by ey, dac, and so. The product of eya regulates eye, gonad, and brain development as well as axon pathfinding.

Name: Nuclear factor I
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell; embryonic dorsal epidermis; embryonic ventral epidermis; embryonic/larval muscle system; and larval ventral nerve cord. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Marshall-Smith syndrome; NFIA-related disorder; and Sotos syndrome 2. Orthologous to several human genes including NFIC (nuclear factor I C).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in triglyceride metabolic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain; ectodermal derivative; embryonic central brain neurons; mushroom body extrinsic neurons; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to human ABCG1 (ATP binding cassette subfamily G member 1) and ABCG4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily G member 4).

Name: pyramus
Description: pyramus (pyr) encodes a Fibroblast growth factor (FGF) and ligand for the FGF receptor encoded by htl. It regulates the development of somatic and visceral muscle in the mesoderm, cardioblasts and glial cells. Its roles include acting as a chemoattractant in directional cell migration, and regulating adhesion, differentiation, and cell survival.

Name: Ribonuclease Z
Description: Ribonuclease Z (RNaseZ) is a highly conserved gene that encodes the endoribonuclease RNase Z, which cleaves pre-tRNA molecules directly 3' to the discriminator. It has at least two biological roles - nuclear pre-tRNA processing and mitochondrial primary transcript processing.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable translation activator activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of translational initiation. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human CTIF (cap binding complex dependent translation initiation factor).

Name: Nucleolar complex protein 2
Description: Predicted to enable histone binding activity and transcription corepressor activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of histone acetylation; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and ribosomal large subunit biogenesis. Predicted to be part of Noc1p-Noc2p complex and Noc2p-Noc3p complex. Predicted to be active in nucleolus and nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human NOC2L (NOC2 like nucleolar associated transcriptional repressor).

Name: suppressor of forked
Description: suppressor of forked (su(f)) is an essential gene that encodes a protein involved in mRNA 3'-end processing (the nuclear cleavage/polyadenylation reaction) and alternative poly(A) site utilization. su(f) product accumulates in dividing cells where it is required for mitosis progression.

Name: EF-hand domain containing 1.2
Description: Predicted to enable alpha-tubulin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cilium assembly; cilium-dependent cell motility; and mitotic spindle organization. Predicted to be active in axoneme and mitotic spindle. Predicted to colocalize with microtubule. Is expressed in embryonic head sensory system; hindgut; sensory nervous system primordium; and ventral sensory complex primordium. Orthologous to human EFHC2 (EF-hand domain containing 2).

Name: dally-like
Description: dally-like (dlp) encodes a glypican that regulates the signaling strength and range of the morphogens encoded by hh and wg.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable potassium channel regulator activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of muscle contraction and regulation of potassium ion transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane and striated muscle dense body. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; and ventral nerve cord primordium.

Name: Glycyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Glycyl-tRNA synthetase (GlyRS) encodes a protein involved in dendrite morphogenesis and larval lymph gland hemopoiesis.

Name: twisted
Description: twisted (tw) encodes a protein that transfers a mannose to the Ser/Thr residues of dystroglycan, via forming an heterodimer with the product of rt. Its roles include myogenesis, muscle architecture and cell adhesion.

Name: Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 3
Description: Leucine-rich repeat-containing G protein-coupled receptor 3 (Lgr3) encodes a protein activated by the relaxin-like hormone encoded by Ilp8, which coordinates organ growth.

Name: Dynein intermediate chain at 61B
Description: Dynein intermediate chain at 61B (Dic61B) encodes an axonemal dynein intermediate chain protein expressed specifically in male germ cells. It is required for the development and precise assembly of sperm axonemes, thus it is essential for male fertility.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle cell; embryonic/larval tracheal system; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Niemann-Pick disease; Niemann-Pick disease type A; and Niemann-Pick disease type B. Orthologous to human SMPD1 (sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase 1).

Name: roughest
Description: roughest (rst) encodes a multi-purpose transmembrane protein that is well studied in the fly eye and muscle during development. It interacts with the transmembrane ligand encoded by hbs to guide cell movement.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG11227 (FBgn0031139). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:20930972..20933559. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Name: forkhead domain 3F
Description: forkhead domain 3F (fd3F) encodes a trancription factor that contributes to the specialization of mechanosensory cilium.

Name: Mov10 RISC complex RNA helicase
Description: Enables RISC complex binding activity and sequence-specific mRNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of miRNA-mediated gene silencing. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in germline cell; gonad; organism; and primordial germ cell.

Name: Menin 1
Description: Menin 1 (Mnn1) encodes a protein that regulates the response of several stresses including hypoxia, hyperosmolarity, heat shock, and oxidative stress. It is important during the mitotic G1 DNA damage checkpoint in a process mediated by the product of CHES-1-like.

Name: Snm1
Description: Predicted to enable 5'-3' exodeoxyribonuclease activity and damaged DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining; interstrand cross-link repair; and protection from non-homologous end joining at telomere. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human DCLRE1A (DNA cross-link repair 1A).

Name: Suv3 helicase
Description: Major helicase player in mitochondrial RNA metabolism and maintenance (PubMed:26152302). Likely component of the mitochondrial degradosome (mtEXO) complex, that degrades 3' overhang double-stranded RNA with a 3'-to-5' directionality in an ATP-dependent manner (By similarity). ATPase and ATP-dependent multisubstrate helicase, able to unwind double-stranded (ds) DNA and RNA, and RNA/DNA heteroduplexes in the 5'-to-3' direction (By similarity). Regulates mRNA stability and is required for the correct processing and maturation of mitochondrial transcripts (PubMed:26152302). (UniProtKB:Q9VN03)

Name: fat-spondin
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in cell adhesion. Located in extracellular region. Is expressed in embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval plasmatocyte; fat body/gonad primordium; plasmatocyte primordium; and yolk nucleus. Orthologous to human SPON1 (spondin 1).
