Orthologous to several human genes including ACOX1 (acyl-CoA oxidase 1).

Name: Transmembrane protein 214
Description: Involved in response to hyperoxia. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in several structures, including adult heart; embryonic/larval salivary gland; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and ventral ectoderm. Orthologous to human TMEM214 (transmembrane protein 214).

Name: Kinesin-like protein at 64D
Description: Kinesin-like protein at 64D (Klp64D) encodes the kinesin-2alpha motor subunit of the heterotrimeric kinesin-2. It associates with the products of Klp68D and Kap3. It plays an essential role in sensory cilia assembly and axonal transport.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ABCG1 (ATP binding cassette subfamily G member 1) and ABCG4 (ATP binding cassette subfamily G member 4).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable acyltransferase activity, transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups. Is expressed in embryonic dorsal apodeme; embryonic epidermis; foregut; sensory nervous system primordium; and ventral sensory complex primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable triglyceride lipase activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid catabolic process. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including cardiovascular system disease (multiple); familial hyperlipidemia (multiple); hypotrichosis 7; obesity; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to several human genes including LIPC (lipase C, hepatic type); LIPG (lipase G, endothelial type); and LIPH (lipase H).

Name: biniou
Description: biniou (bin) encodes a forkhead domain transcription factor that forms visceral mesoderm that differentiates into gut musculature.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of cilium assembly. Predicted to be active in centrosome. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sulfate transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human SLC26A11 (solute carrier family 26 member 11).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain phosphoserine binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be part of Cdc73/Paf1 complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus.

Name: Adenosine deaminase acting on RNA
Description: Adenosine deaminase acting on RNA (Adar) encodes an RNA editing enzyme. It is involved in behaviour, glucose metabolism and response to several stresses such as heat, hypoxia and oxidative stress.

Name: methuselah-like 1
Description: methuselah-like 1 (mthl1) encodes a G protein coupled receptor (GPCR) in the Methuselah clade of GPCRs. It interacts with the secreted morphogen encoded by fog to specify patterns of epithelial tissue folding during gastrulation and wing imaginal disc folding. Upon binding to the product of fog, the product of mthl1 activates apical constriction through the Concertina-RhoGEF2-Rho pathway.

Name: Guanylyl cyclase alpha-subunit at 99B
Description: Guanylyl cyclase alpha-subunit at 99B (Gycalpha99B) encodes a guanylate cyclase involved in cyclic GMP biosynthesis and phototaxis mediated by rhodopsin.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in maintenance of protein localization in endoplasmic reticulum and positive regulation of cilium assembly. Predicted to be active in ciliary basal body and endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human TAPT1 (transmembrane anterior posterior transformation 1).

Name: brown
Description: brown (bw) encodes a member of the traffic ATPase (or ABC) family of membrane transporters. It is believed to heterodimerize with the product of w. bw and w are necessary to import guanine, a precursor for the red pteridine pigments, into pigment cells of the eyes, Malpighian tubules and testis sheath.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to human LRP11 (LDL receptor related protein 11).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 75d
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity and signaling receptor activity. Involved in detection of chemical stimulus involved in sensory perception. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult antennal segment; adult olfactory receptor neuron Ir75d; and spermatozoon.

Name: Ndc80
Description: Ndc80 (Ndc80) encodes a protein involved in mitotic metaphase plate congression.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG9289 (FBgn0032058). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:8681325..8684376. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed during early larval stages.

Name: testis-specifically expressed bromodomain containing protein-2
Description: testis-specifically expressed bromodomain containing protein-2 (tbrd-2) encodes a protein required for male fertility. It interacts with the products of tbrd-1, tbrd-3 and testis-specific TAFs.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable inositol hexakisphosphate binding activity and phosphate ion transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to phosphate starvation and phosphate ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in Golgi apparatus and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; foregut primordium; posterior ectoderm derivative; presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in basal ganglia calcification. Orthologous to human XPR1 (xenotropic and polytropic retrovirus receptor 1).

Name: Glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor attachment 1
Description: Glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor attachment 1 (GAA1) encodes a subunit of glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI) transamidase, which mediates GPI anchoring in the endoplasmic reticulum. GPI anchor attachment serves as a general mechanism for linking proteins to the cell surface membrane.

Name: Nucleostemin 2
Description: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in compound eye morphogenesis and ribosomal large subunit export from nucleus. Located in nucleolus. Colocalizes with nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; gastrula embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human GNL2 (G protein nucleolar 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly. Predicted to be active in axoneme and ciliary basal body.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; and gut section.

Name: SCAR
Description: SCAR (SCAR) encodes a primary regulator of the Arp2/3 complex, which promotes actin polymerization and influences cell shape and motility. It is involved in myoblast fusion, eye morphogenesis and axogenesis.

Name: Death-associated protein kinase related
Description: Death-associated protein kinase related (Drak) encodes a protein serine/threonine kinase belonging to the Death-associated protein kinase family. It promotes phosphorylation of the product of sqh at sites known to stimulate actomyosin contractility. Its main characterized function is to shape epithelial tissues during development.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable propionate-CoA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty acid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix. Is expressed in adult fat body and adult head. Orthologous to human ACSS3 (acyl-CoA synthetase short chain family member 3).

Name: inactivation no afterpotential D
Description: inactivation no afterpotential D (inaD) encodes a scaffolding protein that functions in the localization of the signaling proteins encoded by trp, inaC, and norpA to the rhabdomere. It also functions in the fast light-induced signaling of photoreceptors.

Name: Carcinine transporter
Description: Carcinine transporter (CarT) encodes a transporter belonging to the SLC22A transporter family that is involved in the photoreceptor histamine-carcinine cycle. Histamine neurotransmitter is released by photoreceptors and cleared by uptake into glia, where it is converted to carcinine. The product of CarT transports carcinine back to photoreceptors, where it is hydrolysed by the product of t to restore the pool of histamine.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human NOL11 (nucleolar protein 11).

Name: N/A
Description: Dual methyltransferase. It catalyzes N-terminal methylation of target proteins via its C-terminus. It catalyzes dimethylation on lysine residues of target proteins via its N-terminus. (UniProtKB:Q9VIK9)

Name: Cholecystokinin-like receptor at 17D1
Description: Cholecystokinin-like receptor at 17D1 (CCKLR-17D1) encodes a neuropeptide receptor involved in locomotion and neuromuscular junction growth.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in central brain primordium; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary autosomal recessive microcephaly 10. Orthologous to human ZFP64 (ZFP64 zinc finger protein) and ZNF335 (zinc finger protein 335).

Name: katanin p60-like 1
Description: katanin p60-like 1 (kat-60L1) encodes a microtubule-severing protein that regulates dendrite morphogenesis.

Name: drongo
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of GTPase activity. Located in cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm; ectoderm anlage; embryonic epidermis; extended germ band embryo; and lateral cord neurons. Orthologous to human AGFG1 (ArfGAP with FG repeats 1) and AGFG2 (ArfGAP with FG repeats 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in multicellular organism reproduction. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: gamma-glutamyl carboxylase
Description: gamma-glutamyl carboxylase (GC) encodes an enzyme involved in peptidyl-glutamic acid carboxylation.

Name: Dpr-interacting protein kappa
Description: Predicted to be involved in establishment of synaptic specificity at neuromuscular junction. Predicted to be located in neuron projection membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ovarian cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including IGLON5 (IgLON family member 5); LSAMP (limbic system associated membrane protein); and NEGR1 (neuronal growth regulator 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in membrane. Orthologous to human DCST2 (DC-STAMP domain containing 2).

Name: Exocyst 84
Description: Exocyst 84 (Exo84) encodes an exocyst component involved in epithelial polarity. It mediates the apical localization of the transmembrane protein encoded by crb.

Name: small bristles
Description: Mediates the export of the majority of mRNAs from the nucleus to the cytoplasm (PubMed:11779805, PubMed:11780633, PubMed:11780634, PubMed:27016737). In ovarian follicle cells, plays a role in transposable element silencing regulation by enabling the nuclear export of flamenco (flam) transcripts and subsequent piRNA biogenesis (PubMed:33856346). (UniProtKB:Q9U1H9)

Name: beta galactosidase
Description: beta galactosidase (Gal) encodes a putative digestive enzyme that hydrolyses beta-galactosides into monosaccharides. Gal is highly expressed and enriched in the midgut, an organ involved in digestion.

Name: Monopolar spindle 1
Description: Monopolar spindle 1 (Mps1) encodes a conserved protein kinase that is associated with kinetochores and is required for the mitotic and meiotic spindle assembly checkpoints.

Name: fascetto
Description: fascetto (feo) encodes a protein that binds the central spindle microtubules and is required for proper midbody formation and cytokinesis. It also has roles in centrosome duplication and neurogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex.

Name: Notum
Description: Notum (Notum) encodes an enzyme that cleaves glycophosphatidylinositol anchors. It acts via the product of dlp to influence the range and activity of secreted signaling proteins that interact with proteoglycans in the imaginal discs.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human GGNBP2 (gametogenetin binding protein 2).

Name: Protein kinase C delta
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity and protein kinase C activity. Predicted to be involved in protein phosphorylation. Is expressed in adult brain.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable inositol hexakisphosphate binding activity and phosphate ion transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to phosphate starvation and phosphate ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in Golgi apparatus and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in basal ganglia calcification. Orthologous to human XPR1 (xenotropic and polytropic retrovirus receptor 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in intracellular signal transduction. Is expressed in organism and pole plasm.

Name: Neprilysin-like 19
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in distal arthrogryposis type 5D. Orthologous to human ECEL1 (endothelin converting enzyme like 1).

Name: HBS1
Description: HBS1 (HBS1) encodes an elongation factor class G protein that is implicated in messenger RNA quality control, by forming a protein complex with the product of pelo to promote decay of mRNAs with ribosomal stalls.

Name: eyegone
Description: eyegone (eyg) encodes a Pax family transcription factor that acts as a transcriptional repressor. In eye development, the product of eyg promotes cell proliferation in the larval eye disc through activation of Jak/STAT pathway. It also plays both positive and negative roles in head vortex development.

Name: partner of numb
Description: partner of numb (pon) encodes a protein that functions upstream of the cell fate determinant encoded by numb during asymmetric cell divisions. It contributes to asymmetric localization of the numb product and the subsequent suppression of Notch signaling.

Name: Acetyl Coenzyme A synthase
Description: Activates acetate so that it can be used for lipid synthesis or for energy generation. (UniProtKB:Q9VP61)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable beta-glucuronidase activity and carbohydrate binding activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval fat body; extraembryonic structure; midline ventral glial cell; ventral midline of embryo; and yolk nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Sly syndrome. Orthologous to human GUSB (glucuronidase beta).

Name: Cullin 6
Description: Predicted to enable protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process and protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Lynch syndrome and mismatch repair cancer syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC22A10 (solute carrier family 22 member 10); SLC22A11 (solute carrier family 22 member 11); and SLC22A12 (solute carrier family 22 member 12).

Name: moody
Description: Isoform A and isoform B are required in glia to regulate the acute sensitivity to cocaine and to continuously maintain the proper blood-brain barrier (BBB) function. A moody-mediated signaling pathway functions in glia to regulate nervous system insulation and drug-related behaviors. Galphai and Galphao, and the regulator of G protein signaling, loco, are required in the surface glia to achieve effective insulation. The components function by regulating the cortical actin and thereby stabilizing the extended morphology of the surface glia, which in turn is necessary for the formation of septate junctions of sufficient length to achieve proper sealing of the nerve cord. (UniProtKB:Q9W534)

Name: Tyramine beta hydroxylase
Description: Tyramine beta hydroxylase (Tbh) encodes a monooxygenase and the key limiting enzyme in octopamine synthesis. It regulates egg laying, positive associative olfactory learning and memory, aggression, flight initiation and maintenance, locomotor activity and attraction to ethanol containing food sources.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; nervous system; and ventral midline of embryo. Orthologous to human SLC7A4 (solute carrier family 7 member 4).

Name: Sox box protein 14
Description: Sox box protein 14 (Sox14) encodes a transcription factor involved in neurogenesis and metamorphosis.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B subunit epsilon
Description: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B subunit epsilon (eIF2Bepsilon) encodes a guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor.

Name: gudu
Description: Important for spermatogenesis where it may have a role in sperm individualization. (UniProtKB:Q9VM21)

Name: Dek
Description: Dek (Dek) encodes a DNA binding protein involved in DNA repair and heterochromatin integrity.

Name: Pigment-dispersing factor receptor
Description: Pigment-dispersing factor receptor (Pdfr) encodes a G-Protein Coupled Receptor in the Family B class of GPCRs (Secretin Receptor-like) that can be activated by the product of Pdf. It has been implicated in regulation of circadian physiology, development of the flight motor system, and regulation of mating.

Name: Guanylyl cyclase at 89Db
Description: Guanylyl cyclase at 89Db (Gyc89Db) encodes an atypical soluble guanylyl cyclase. It heterodimerizes with the product of Gyc88E to form an oxygen-sensitive soluble guanylyl cyclase, which likely functions as a neuronal oxygen detector, activated at reduced oxygen levels.

Name: Trissin receptor
Description: G-protein coupled receptor which is activated by the Trissin peptide in vitro, leading to increased intracellular calcium ion levels. (UniProtKB:Q9VML9)

Name: pleiohomeotic like
Description: pleiohomeotic like (phol) encodes a zinc-finger protein that is 80% identical in the zinc-finger region to the product of pho. The product of phol plays a role in Polycomb group protein recruitment to Polycomb response elements, but it has additional roles, most likely as a transcriptional activator.

Name: Dgp-1
Description: Predicted to enable translation elongation factor activity. Predicted to be involved in translational elongation. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human GTPBP1 (GTP binding protein 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of ERAD pathway. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to several human genes including RNFT2 (ring finger protein, transmembrane 2).

Name: Neprilysin-like 7
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human KEL (Kell metallo-endopeptidase (Kell blood group)).

Name: F box and leucine-rich-repeat gene 4
Description: Involved in several processes, including deactivation of rhodopsin mediated signaling; negative regulation of GABAergic synaptic transmission; and negative regulation of circadian sleep/wake cycle, sleep. Located in neuron projection and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in eye and retina. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 13. Orthologous to human FBXL4 (F-box and leucine rich repeat protein 4).

Name: acyl-CoA oxidase 1
Description: Catalyzes the desaturation of acyl-CoAs to 2-trans-enoyl-CoAs. First enzyme of the fatty acid beta-oxidation pathway. (UniProtKB:Q7KML2)

Name: hippo
Description: hippo (hpo) encodes a kinase in the Salvador-Warts-Hippo pathway. It controls tissue growth by controlling cell growth, proliferation and apoptosis. It has several roles in post-mitotic cells including fate specification of photoreceptors and tiling of dendritic neurons.

Name: Autophagy-related 4b
Description: Autophagy-related 4b (Atg4b) encodes a cysteine protease that cleaves the precursor product of Atg8a at the C-terminal region, thereby initiating autophagosome formation.

Name: N/A
Description: Regulator of deubiquitinating complexes. Activates deubiquitination by increasing the catalytic turnover without increasing the affinity of deubiquitinating enzymes for the substrate (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q1LZ08)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in multicellular organism reproduction.

Name: Nucleoporin 75kD
Description: Component of the nuclear pore complex (NPC) that seems to be required for NPC assembly and maintenance (By similarity). Required for nuclear import of phosphorylated Mad via importin msk (PubMed:20547758). Has no role in classical nuclear localization signal (cNLS)-dependent nuclear import via importin-beta (PubMed:20547758). Facilitates the interaction between Nup93 and sec13 with msk (PubMed:20547758). (UniProtKB:A1YK02)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG14190 (FBgn0030979). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:19056911..19067792. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: Xrp1
Description: Xrp1 (Xrp1) encodes an AT-Hook, bZip DNA binding protein involved in genome stability maintenance. It heterodimerizes with the product of Irbp18 to bind to P element sequences contributing to transposition. It is induced by p53 following X-irradiation and by mutations or knockdown of caz or ribosomal protein (Rp) encoding genes. It contributes to the slow growth of Minute (Rp+/-) mutants cell-autonomously by inhibiting translation and non-autonomously through regulation of the product of Ilp8.

Name: Equilibrative nucleoside transporter 3
Description: Predicted to enable monoamine transmembrane transporter activity and nucleoside transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in nucleoside transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human SLC29A4 (solute carrier family 29 member 4).

Name: Na[+]-dependent inorganic phosphate cotransporter type III
Description: Na[+]-dependent inorganic phosphate cotransporter type III (NaPi-III) encodes a transporter involved in sodium-dependent phosphate transmembrane transport.

Name: F-box protein 42
Description: Enables ubiquitin ligase-substrate adaptor activity. Involved in positive regulation of synaptonemal complex assembly. Part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Orthologous to human FBXO42 (F-box protein 42).

Name: alpha-Mannosidase class I a
Description: Involved in the maturation of Asn-linked oligosaccharides. Progressively trim alpha-1,2-linked mannose residues from Man(9)GlcNAc(2) to produce Man(5)GlcNAc(2). (UniProtKB:P53624)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; head segment; presumptive embryonic/larval nervous system; and sensory nervous system primordium.

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 3
Description: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 3 (Pgant3) encodes a member of the UDP-GalNAc:polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase family. It catalyzes the transfer of a GalNAc sugar onto the hydroxyl groups of serine and threonine in secreted or membrane-bound proteins. Pgant3 product modulates secretion of extracellular matrix proteins and influences integrin-mediated cell adhesion during development.

Name: Carnitine palmitoyltransferase 2
Description: Carnitine palmitoyltransferase 2 (CPT2) encodes an enzyme required for the beta-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids.

Name: Guanylyl cyclase at 89Da
Description: Guanylyl cyclase at 89Da (Gyc89Da) encodes an atypical soluble guanylyl cyclase. It heterodimerizes with the product of Gyc88E to form an oxygen-sensitive soluble guanylyl cyclase, which likely functions as a neuronal oxygen detector, activated at reduced oxygen levels.

Name: Dorsal-related immunity factor
Description: Dorsal-related immunity factor (Dif) encodes a transcription factor that contributes to zygotic function of the Toll pathway, notably the regulation of antimicrobial peptides, but it is not involved in dorsoventral patterning of the embryo.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG11369 (FBgn0029951). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:7574290..7576767. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Name: scarlet
Description: ATP-dependent transporter of the ATP-binding cassette (ABC) family which transports various molecules including bioamines, neurotransmitters and metabolic intermediates (PubMed:812484, PubMed:18931318, PubMed:33820991). In the eye and probably in association with w/white, required for the transport of the eye brown pigment precursors, kynurenine and probably tryptophan, into pigment cell granules (PubMed:812484, PubMed:10407069). In Malpighian tubules and pupal eyes, involved in kynurenine transport (PubMed:812484). Probably in association with w/white, plays a role in zinc storage granule biogenesis in Malpighian tubule principal epithelial cells (PubMed:29367274). (UniProtKB:P45843)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Orthologous to human FBXL16 (F-box and leucine rich repeat protein 16).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable acid sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase activity. Predicted to be involved in ceramide biosynthetic process and sphingomyelin catabolic process. Predicted to be active in extracellular space and lysosome. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Centriolar coiled coil protein 110kDa
Description: Centriolar coiled coil protein 110kDa (Cp110) encodes a centriolar protein that localizes to the distal end of both mother and daughter centrioles. It seems to prevent the centriole microtubules from extending beyond the distal end of the centriole. It interacts with the product of Cep97, another protein localized to the distal end of the centrioles.

Name: no distributive disjunction
Description: no distributive disjunction (nod) encodes a kinesin-like protein that is important for nonexchange chromosome biology. The nod product is necessary for chromosome segregation during meiosis and for proper chromosome alignment along the meiotic spindle.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG46026 (FBgn0267690). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3R:6306884..6309030. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported.

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 6
Description: Glycopeptide transferase involved in O-linked oligosaccharide biosynthesis, which catalyzes the transfer of an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue to an already glycosylated peptide (PubMed:12829714). In contrast to other proteins of the family, it does not act as a peptide transferase that transfers GalNAc onto serine or threonine residue on the protein receptor, but instead requires the prior addition of a GalNAc on a peptide before adding additional GalNAc moieties (PubMed:12829714). Some peptide transferase activity is however not excluded, considering that its appropriate peptide substrate may remain unidentified (PubMed:12829714). Prefers the diglycosylated Muc5AC-3/13 as substrate (PubMed:12829714). Might have a role in protein O-glycosylation in the Golgi and thereby in establishing and/or maintaining a proper secretory apparatus structure (PubMed:20807760). (UniProtKB:Q6WV16)

Name: bubblegum
Description: Mediates activation of long-chain fatty acids for both synthesis of cellular lipids, and degradation via beta-oxidation (PubMed:10373116, PubMed:26893370, PubMed:29739804). Probably by regulating lipid storage and catabolism, plays a role in neuronal function (PubMed:25409104). (UniProtKB:Q9V3S9)

Name: N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate transferase subunits alpha and beta
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-lysosomal-enzyme N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in N-glycan processing to lysosome and carbohydrate phosphorylation. Predicted to be active in Golgi membrane. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mucolipidosis II alpha/beta and mucolipidosis III alpha/beta. Orthologous to human GNPTAB (N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate transferase subunits alpha and beta).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval plasmatocyte; and embryonic/larval tracheal dorsal trunk.

Name: Tryptophanyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Tryptophanyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial (TrpRS-m) encodes a protein predicted to function within mitochondria to catalyze the ligation of tryptophan to its cognate tRNA to form tryptophanyl-tRNA.

Name: Cdc42-interacting protein 4
Description: Cdc42-interacting protein 4 (Cip4) encodes an F-BAR protein that functions as an adaptor protein regulating membrane curvature and dynamics.

Name: Daughters against dpp
Description: Daughters against dpp (Dad) encodes the inhibitory SMAD in the BMP/Dpp pathway. It is involved in growth regulation and developmental patterning.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; peptidyl-serine phosphorylation; and signal transduction. Part of Dbf4-dependent protein kinase complex. Orthologous to human CDC7 (cell division cycle 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in ribosome biogenesis. Predicted to be part of 90S preribosome and preribosome, small subunit precursor. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval midgut; and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to human NOP9 (NOP9 nucleolar protein).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal ectoderm; extended germ band embryo; larval foregut atrium; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and yolk nucleus.

Name: Arginyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Forms part of a macromolecular complex that catalyzes the attachment of specific amino acids to cognate tRNAs during protein synthesis. (UniProtKB:Q9VXN4)

Name: Cyclic nucleotide-gated ion channel subunit A
Description: Cyclic nucleotide-gated ion channel subunit A (CngA) encodes a non-selective cation channel related to the superfamily of voltage-gated ion channels. It is involved in both excitation and adaptation of sensory cells, as well as in Ca[2+] response in the mushroom bodies.

Name: ATP binding cassette subfamily D member 3
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity; ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity; and long-chain fatty acid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty acid catabolic process; long-chain fatty acid import into peroxisome; and peroxisome organization. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in peroxisomal membrane. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Zellweger syndrome and congenital bile acid synthesis defect 5. Orthologous to human ABCD3 (ATP binding cassette subfamily D member 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Substrate-recognition component of a Cul2-RING (CRL2) E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex of the DesCEND (destruction via C-end degrons) pathway, which recognizes a C-degron located at the extreme C terminus of target proteins, leading to their ubiquitination and degradation. The C-degron recognized by the DesCEND pathway is usually a motif of less than ten residues and can be present in full-length proteins, truncated proteins or proteolytically cleaved forms. (UniProtKB:Q9VFD5)

Name: Mlh1
Description: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity. Predicted to be involved in mismatch repair. Predicted to be part of MutLalpha complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Lynch syndrome (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung cancer; mismatch repair cancer syndrome; and sporadic breast cancer. Orthologous to human MLH1 (mutL homolog 1).

Name: defective proboscis extension response 17
Description: Involved in synapse organization. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval circulatory system; embryonic/larval oenocyte; embryonic/larval salivary gland; extended germ band embryo; and yolk nucleus.

Name: orion
Description: Enables chemokine activity. Involved in astrocyte chemotaxis; mushroom body development; and positive regulation of neuron remodeling. Is active in extracellular region. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; apoptotic amnioserosa; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm; ectoderm anlage; embryonic stomatogastric nervous system; endoderm anlage; and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to human ZNF212 (zinc finger protein 212) and ZNF671 (zinc finger protein 671).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable acyltransferase activity, transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: short wing
Description: short wing (sw) encodes the non-catalytic intermediate chain subunit of the cytoplasmic dynein motor complex. It contributes to wing development, eye development, oocyte development and polarity, mitotic cell division, and neuronal transport and neurogenesis.

Name: CXXC finger protein 1
Description: CXXC finger protein 1 (Cfp1) encodes a protein that is thought to help target the Set1/COMPASS histone methyltransferase complex to CpG rich regions of the genome, including gene promoters.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in actin cytoskeleton organization. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in embryonic/larval muscle system and embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell.

Name: Runt related A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in dendrite morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in circular visceral muscle fiber and visceral muscle primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including breast cancer (multiple); female reproductive organ cancer (multiple); lung non-small cell carcinoma; pancreatic cancer; and urinary bladder cancer. Orthologous to human RUNX3 (RUNX family transcription factor 3).

Name: Pif1 DNA helicase
Description: Predicted to enable DNA helicase activity. Involved in double-strand break repair via break-induced replication. Predicted to be active in replication fork. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human PIF1 (PIF1 5'-to-3' DNA helicase).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in multicellular organism reproduction. Is expressed in amnioserosa.

Name: SET and MYND domain containing, class 4, member 2
Description: SET and MYND domain containing, class 4, member 2 (Smyd4-2) encodes a histone deacetylase involved in photoreceptor development, eclosion, and gene expression regulation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and procephalic neuroblast. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency. Orthologous to human C2orf69 (chromosome 2 open reading frame 69).

Name: Runt related B
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including breast cancer (multiple); female reproductive organ cancer (multiple); lung non-small cell carcinoma; pancreatic cancer; and urinary bladder cancer. Orthologous to human RUNX3 (RUNX family transcription factor 3).

Name: Carnitine O-Acetyl-Transferase
Description: Predicted to enable carnitine O-acetyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in carnitine metabolic process, CoA-linked. Located in peroxisome. Is expressed in adult brain cell body rind; adult gnathal ganglion; adult head; adult heart; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation. Orthologous to human CRAT (carnitine O-acetyltransferase).

Name: Cell division cycle 6
Description: Cell division cycle 6 (Cdc6) encodes an essential component of the pre-Replication complex (preRC) together with the origin recognition complex, the product of dup and MCM2-7 proteins. The preRC is present at all chromosomal origins of replication and is required for the initiation of DNA replication. The product of Cdc6 also functions in the co-ordination of DNA replication with mitosis, and may contribute to apoptosis and transcription.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult fat body and adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in acute kidney failure. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC22A1 (solute carrier family 22 member 1); SLC22A2 (solute carrier family 22 member 2); and SLC22A23 (solute carrier family 22 member 23).

Name: Brf RNA polymerase III subunit
Description: Brf (Brf) encodes a transcription factor binding protein involved in transcription mediated by RNA polymerase III.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cell differentiation. Is expressed in embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable nucleic acid binding activity. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal ectoderm anlage; embryonic/larval deutocerebrum; germ layer; local interneuron of adult antennal lobe; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to several human genes including R3HCC1L (R3H domain and coiled-coil containing 1 like).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in rRNA processing. Predicted to be part of Mpp10 complex and small-subunit processome. Orthologous to human MPHOSPH10 (M-phase phosphoprotein 10).

Name: N/A
Description: CG42663 encodes a Nck-associated protein 5-like protein involved in determination of lifespan.

Name: defective proboscis extension response 15
Description: Involved in synapse organization. Predicted to be active in neuron projection membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity and transcription coactivator activity. Predicted to be involved in dendrite morphogenesis and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in microtubule. Predicted to be part of RNA polymerase II transcription regulator complex. Is expressed in adult head and embryonic ventral epidermis.

Name: N/A
Description: DNA-binding protein involved in single-strand DNA break repair, double-strand DNA break repair and base excision repair. Resolves abortive DNA ligation intermediates formed either at base excision sites, or when DNA ligases attempt to repair non-ligatable breaks induced by reactive oxygen species. Catalyzes the release of adenylate groups covalently linked to 5'-phosphate termini, resulting in the production of 5'-phosphate termini that can be efficiently rejoined (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q8MSG8)

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 52
Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Involved in endocytic recycling. Located in trans-Golgi network. Part of GARP complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human VPS52 (VPS52 subunit of GARP complex).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human PPM1G (protein phosphatase, Mg2+/Mn2+ dependent 1G).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable flavin adenine dinucleotide binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial tRNA wobble uridine modification and tRNA methylation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 10. Orthologous to human MTO1 (mitochondrial tRNA translation optimization 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human ZBED1 (zinc finger BED-type containing 1).

Name: Succinate dehydrogenase, subunit A (flavoprotein)
Description: Succinate dehydrogenase, subunit A (flavoprotein) (SdhA) encodes the FAD-containing subunit of the succinate dehydrogenase complex. It directly oxidizes succinate to fumarate and transfers the electrons to other subunits and eventually to quinones.

Name: retinal degeneration C
Description: retinal degeneration C (rdgC) encodes a serine/threonine phosphatase that binds Ca2+/calmodulin and contains 2 Ca2+-binding EF-hand motifs. It promotes the dephosphorylation of the product of ninaE, which prevents its internalization. It also promotes the dephosphorylation of the product of trp at specific site affecting the frequency response to modulated light.

Name: Coenzyme Q8
Description: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity; lipid binding activity; and protein kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in ubiquinone biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be extrinsic component of mitochondrial inner membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; foregut primordium; posterior endoderm; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system. Used to study coenzyme Q10 deficiency disease; nephrotic syndrome; nephrotic syndrome type 9; and primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 4. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nephrotic syndrome type 9 and primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 4. Orthologous to human COQ8A (coenzyme Q8A) and COQ8B (coenzyme Q8B).

Name: Sphingosine kinase 2
Description: Sphingosine kinase 2 (Sk2) encodes a D-erythro-sphingosine kinase that contributes to sphingolipid metabolism, flight performance and ovulation.

Name: vasa
Description: vasa (vas) encodes Vasa (Vas) is a DEAD-box RNA helicase protein. It interacts with eIF5B and promotes translation of grk and mei-P26 mRNAs. Vas also functions in piRNA biogenesis as a component of an Amplifier complex. Maternally-expressed vas is required for oogenesis, transposon silencing in the female germ line, anterior-posterior embryonic patterning, and germ cell specification.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic microtubule organization and non-motile cilium assembly. Predicted to be active in centriolar satellite. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human CCDC13 (coiled-coil domain containing 13).

Name: Zinc transporter 49B
Description: Predicted to enable cation transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport and zinc ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; germline cell; and gonad. Orthologous to human SLC30A9 (solute carrier family 30 member 9).

Name: Pyrokinin 2 receptor 1
Description: Pyrokinin 2 receptor 1 (PK2-R1) encodes a G protein-coupled receptor that binds the neuropeptide encoded by Hug with high affinity. After binding, a second messenger cascade is initiated in cells that are target for the product of Hug (mainly neurons of the central nervous system).

Name: SET and MYND domain containing, class 4, member 3
Description: Predicted to enable histone deacetylase binding activity. Involved in compound eye photoreceptor development. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell and mesoderm. Orthologous to human SMYD4 (SET and MYND domain containing 4).

Name: Golgi-localized, gamma-adaptin ear containing, ARF binding protein
Description: Golgi-localized, gamma-adaptin ear containing, ARF binding protein (Gga) encodes a clathrin binding protein involved in post-Golgi vesicle-mediated transport.

Name: H15
Description: H15 (H15) encodes a T-box transcription factor that regulates the specification of cell fate in the heart and central nervous system.

Name: fused lobes
Description: Involved in brain restructurization via hormonal control during metamorphosis. Implicated in N-glycan processing. (UniProtKB:Q8WSF3)

Name: Transmembrane 9 superfamily protein member 2
Description: Involved in negative regulation of peptidoglycan recognition protein signaling pathway. Located in cytoplasmic vesicle and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval digestive system; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to human TM9SF2 (transmembrane 9 superfamily member 2).

Name: real-time
Description: Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including SEC14L5 (SEC14 like lipid binding 5).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG13992 (FBgn0031756). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:5965391..5967752. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed in adult female stages.

Name: no individualized sperm
Description: Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spermatogenic failure 35. Orthologous to human QRICH2 (glutamine rich 2).

Name: slouch
Description: slouch (slou) encodes a homeodomain transcription factor that is involved in the specification of a subset of somatic muscle progenitors and muscle founder cells.

Name: monkey king protein
Description: Predicted to enable RNA uridylyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA polyadenylation. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metallocarboxypeptidase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Orthologous to human AGBL4 (AGBL carboxypeptidase 4).

Name: Radial spoke head protein 3
Description: Involved in axoneme assembly and sperm individualization. Located in cytosol; nucleus; and sperm flagellum. Is expressed in Bolwig organ; chordotonal neurons; embryonic head sensory system; spermatogonium; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary ciliary dyskinesia 32. Orthologous to human RSPH3 (radial spoke head 3).

Name: Deubiquitinating enzyme A
Description: Deubiquitinating enzyme A (Duba) encodes a de-ubiquitylating enzyme of the OTU-family that cleaves preferentially K11- and K63-linked poly-ubiquitin chains. Its catalytic activity is required for spermatogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable group II metabotropic glutamate receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled glutamate receptor signaling pathway and regulation of glutamatergic synaptic transmission. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: lamina ancestor
Description: Putative phospholipase (By similarity). Involved in the regulation of cellular plasticity in imaginal disks. (UniProtKB:Q9VRK8)

Name: hermes
Description: Predicted to enable monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in plasma membrane pyruvate transport. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; and organism. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC16A5 (solute carrier family 16 member 5).

Name: Na,K-ATPase Interacting
Description: Induces a small but significant sodium conductance when expressed in Xenopus oocytes. (UniProtKB:A6MHQ4)

Name: partner of inscuteable
Description: partner of inscuteable (pins) encodes a GDP-dissociation inhibitor involved in asymmetric cell division and mitotic spindle orientation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity. Predicted to be involved in actin filament bundle assembly. Located in nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain cell body rind and extended germ band embryo. Orthologous to human ANKRD12 (ankyrin repeat domain 12).

Name: Lasp
Description: Lasp (Lasp) encodes a member of the nebulin family. It plays subtle roles in modulating the actin cytoskeleton in ovaries, testes, and muscles, by serving as a scaffold protein binding multiple partners, especially actin and myosin. In indirect flight muscles, it contributes to I-band and A-band architecture.

Name: trailer hitch
Description: trailer hitch (tral) encodes a protein required for oocyte dorsoventral patterning via actin and microtubule cytoskeleton organization.

Name: septin interacting protein 2
Description: Involved in mitotic cytokinesis and protein localization. Colocalizes with microtubule plus-end; midbody; and mitotic spindle midzone. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior ectoderm; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo.

Name: Ecdysone oxidase
Description: Ecdysone oxidase (Eo) encodes an enzyme involved in ecdysone metabolism.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG42284 (FBgn0259179). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:22821430..22828903. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 12-24 hour embryonic stages.

Name: PAPS synthetase
Description: PAPS synthetase (Papss) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the synthesis of 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate (PAPS), the sulfate donor compound in all sulfotransferase reactions. Maternally provided Papss product is required for the formation of the embryonic dorsal-ventral axis mediated by the sulfotransferase encoded by pip.

Name: Myb oncogene-like
Description: Myb oncogene-like (Myb) encodes a transcription factor that activates the transcription of genes involved in the G2/M phases of the cell cycle. This activation occurs by inhibition of the highly conseved MuvB multi-protein repressor complex.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be part of ribonucleoprotein complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alopecia, neurologic defects, and endocrinopathy syndrome. Orthologous to human RBM28 (RNA binding motif protein 28).

Name: tectonic
Description: Probable component of the tectonic-like complex (also named MKS complex), a complex localized at the transition zone of primary cilia (PubMed:27646273). Has a role in ciliary structure and function (PubMed:27646273). (UniProtKB:Q9VMH0)

Name: target of brain insulin
Description: Predicted to enable hydrolase activity, hydrolyzing O-glycosyl compounds. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult gut; adult head; and fat cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in basal ganglia calcification. Orthologous to human MYORG (myogenesis regulating glycosidase (putative)).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable acyltransferase activity, transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in ubiquitin-dependent ERAD pathway. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to human UBXN4 (UBX domain protein 4).

Name: Heat shock protein 70 cognate 3
Description: Endoplasmic reticulum chaperone that plays a key role in protein folding and quality control in the endoplasmic reticulum lumen. Involved in the correct folding of proteins and degradation of misfolded proteins (By similarity). Acts as a key repressor of the unfolded protein response (UPR) (By similarity). (UniProtKB:P29844)

Name: F-box and WD repeat domain containing 5
Description: F-box and WD repeat domain containing 5 (Fbw5) encodes a protein that targets proteins for destruction via its role as a substrate receptor for the CRL4 E3 ubiquitin ligase. A key target of the product of Fbw5 is the subunit of the tuberous sclerosis complex encoded by gig, an important negative regulator of cellular growth via inhibition of the TOR kinase pathway.

Name: Endo-beta-N-acetylglucosaminidase
Description: Enables myosin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein deglycosylation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human ENGASE (endo-beta-N-acetylglucosaminidase).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 7b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of terminal organ; gustatory receptor neuron of the hypophysis; terminal organ; and wing.

Name: Shaker
Description: Shaker (Sh) encodes the structural alpha subunit of a voltage-gated potassium channel. It plays a key role in maintaining electrical excitability in neurons and muscle cells, as well as regulating neurotransmitter release at the synapse.

Name: Neprilysin-like 6
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in distal arthrogryposis type 5D. Orthologous to human ECEL1 (endothelin converting enzyme like 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Probable chloride channel. (UniProtKB:Q9W5A5)

Name: Neprilysin 6
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in distal arthrogryposis type 5D. Orthologous to human ECEL1 (endothelin converting enzyme like 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA double-strand break processing. Predicted to be active in nucleus and site of double-strand break. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human WDR70 (WD repeat domain 70).

Name: scarface
Description: Inactive serine protease that plays a role in germ-band retraction and dorsal closure morphogenesis in embryogenesis; contributes to amnioserosa attachment and epithelial apico-basal polarity by regulating the localization of laminin LanA on the apical side of the amnioserosa epithelium (PubMed:28628612, PubMed:20379222). Contributes to epithelial morphogenesis probably by regulating the bsk/JNK pathway, as part of a negative-feedback loop, and by modulating the cross-talk between the Egfr, bsk/JNK and dpp signal transduction pathways (PubMed:28628612, PubMed:20379222). In larval development, antagonizes the morphogenetic movements controlled by the bsk/JNK signaling including male genitalia formation and thorax development (PubMed:20379222, PubMed:20530545, PubMed:25737837). (UniProtKB:Q7K5M0)

Name: twin of eyeless
Description: twin of eyeless (toy) encodes a transcription factor that is involved in eye development as part of the retinal determination gene network, and contributes to formation of the central nervous system.

Name: outsiders
Description: outsiders (out) encodes a monocarboxylate transporter involved in programmed cell death of primordial germ cell/pole cells.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG2278 (FBgn0030017). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:8165833..8170266. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed within 12-18 embryonic stages.

Name: Tetratricopeptide repeat domain 30
Description: Required for polyglutamylation of axonemal tubulin in sensory cilia. Plays a role in anterograde intraflagellar transport (IFT), the process by which cilia precursors are transported from the base of the cilium to the site of their incorporation at the tip. (UniProtKB:Q9VK41)

Name: granny smith
Description: granny smith (grsm) encodes a member of the M17 family of leucine aminopeptidases, a family of proteases broadly involved in a number of cellular processes. High throughput transcriptomic and proteomic analyses have implicated the product of grsm in the regulation of immune-, nervous- and immune-related processes.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in protein ubiquitination. Is expressed in amnioserosa; organism; and yolk nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including KLHL5 (kelch like family member 5).

Name: N/A
Description: Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human MOSPD2 (motile sperm domain containing 2).

Name: Epidermal stripes and patches
Description: Epidermal stripes and patches (Esp) encodes a protein involved in female remating receptivity.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity; amino acid:cation symporter activity; and neurotransmitter transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport; neurotransmitter transport; and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in anterior-posterior subdivision of organism and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: amontillado
Description: amontillado (amon) encodes a member of the Prohormone Convertase (PC) family of proteolytic enzymes. PCs generally recognize conserved basic amino acid sequences within protein precursors to direct catalysis of specific cleavage. amon product directly cleaves sli protein and may also target the propeptide encoded by Akh. It is also required for the production of bioactive neuropeptide hormones (e.g. those encoded by Hug, Crz, Ms, Capa and sNPF).

Name: Integrator 9
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). Involved in the 3'-end processing of the U7 snRNA, and also the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). May mediate recruitment of cytoplasmic dynein to the nuclear envelope, probably as component of the INT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q95TS5)

Name: dim gamma-tubulin 6
Description: As part of the augmin complex, plays a role in centrosome-independent generation of spindle microtubules (PubMed:18443220). The complex is required for mitotic spindle assembly through its involvement in localizing gamma-tubulin to spindle microtubules (PubMed:17412918). dgt6 is required for kinetochore fiber formation, mediating nucleation and/or initial stabilization of chromosome-induced microtubules (PubMed:19836241). (UniProtKB:Q9VAP2)

Name: TBC1 domain family member 5
Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in activation of GTPase activity. Located in Golgi apparatus. Is expressed in adult fat body and organism. Orthologous to human TBC1D5 (TBC1 domain family member 5).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of phosphorylation of RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in head mesoderm; organism; and trunk mesoderm. Orthologous to human PPIL4 (peptidylprolyl isomerase like 4).

Name: mextli
Description: mextli (mxt) encodes a protein that promotes translation. It binds to the products of eIF4E1 and eIF3h. It contributes to maintenance of germline stem cells and it is also involved in early embryogenesis.

Name: Nucleolar protein 66
Description: Oxygenase that can act as both a histone lysine demethylase and a ribosomal histidine hydroxylase. Specifically demethylates 'Lys-4' (H3K4me) and 'Lys-36' (H3K36me) of histone H3, thereby playing a central role in histone code (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q7K4H4)

Name: lethal (3) malignant blood neoplasm
Description: lethal (3) malignant blood neoplasm (l(3)mbn) is a tumor suppressor gene with mutants showing abnormal proliferation of blood cells, differentiation of lamellocytes and melanotic nodule formation in the larva.

Name: scratch
Description: scratch (scrt) encodes a zinc finger C2H2 transcription factor involved in the negative regulation of genes promoting non-neuronal cell fates.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG17364 (FBgn0036391). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. It has one annotated transcript and one polypeptide. Gene sequence location is 3L:13977905..13993400. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. 3 alleles are reported. No phenotypic data is available. The phenotypic classes of alleles include: viable; lethal - all die during embryonic stage; lethal; fertile. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 18-24 hour embryonic stages, during early larval stages, during late pupal stages, in adult male stages.

Name: doublefault
Description: Predicted to enable nucleic acid binding activity and zinc ion binding activity. Is expressed in gonad and testis. Orthologous to human ZMAT3 (zinc finger matrin-type 3); ZMAT4 (zinc finger matrin-type 4); and ZNF346 (zinc finger protein 346).

Name: Ephrin
Description: Ephrin (Ephrin) encodes the ligand of the product of Eph. It is involved in nervous system development.

Name: Nuclear protein localization 4
Description: May be part of a complex that binds ubiquitinated proteins and that is necessary for the export of misfolded proteins from the ER to the cytoplasm, where they are degraded by the proteasome. (UniProtKB:Q9VBP9)

Name: Inwardly rectifying potassium channel 1
Description: Inwardly rectifying potassium channel 1 (Irk1) encodes a K[+] channel involved in transepithelial ion transport in the renal tubule and in regulating excitability of the LNv subset of circadian pacemaker neurons.

Name: Novel nucleolar protein 1
Description: Involved in the biogenesis of the 60S ribosomal subunit (By similarity). Required for normal assembly of the mitotic spindle (PubMed:24255106). May be involved in both centrosome-dependent and centrosome-independent spindle assembly programs (PubMed:24255106). Acts as TP53 repressor, preventing TP53 stabilization and cell cycle arrest (PubMed:20308539, PubMed:35413237). (UniProtKB:Q9V411)

Name: Mitochondrial Rho
Description: Mitochondrial Rho (Miro) encodes an atypical GTPase and Ca[2+] sensor on the outer mitochondrial membrane that is vital for mitochondrial homeostasis and microtubule-based mitochondrial transport. It mediates linkage to kinesin and dynein motors through interactions with Milton/TRAK adaptor proteins.

Name: Cleavage and polyadenylation specific factor 6
Description: May play a role in pre-mRNA 3'-processing. (UniProtKB:Q9VSH4)

Name: Neprilysin-like 9
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Mitochondrial protein that may have a role in mitochondrial translation. (UniProtKB:A1Z9A8)

Name: Neprilysin-like 4
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in dorsal ectoderm anlage and ventral ectoderm anlage. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in distal arthrogryposis type 5D. Orthologous to human ECEL1 (endothelin converting enzyme like 1).

Name: Hydroxymethylbilane synthase
Description: Predicted to enable hydroxymethylbilane synthase activity. Predicted to be involved in heme biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval central nervous system; embryonic/larval digestive system; eye disc; nephrocyte; and ring gland. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in acute intermittent porphyria and sickle cell anemia. Orthologous to human HMBS (hydroxymethylbilane synthase).

Name: Fasciclin 1
Description: Neural cell adhesion molecule. (UniProtKB:P10674)

Name: Transient receptor potential cation channel, mucolipin
Source: Enables cation channel activity; intracellular ligand-gated ion channel activity; and phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate binding activity. Involved in several processes, including autophagosome maturation; positive regulation of TOR signaling; and positive regulation of synaptic assembly at neuromuscular junction. Located in endolysosome membrane; late endosome membrane; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glycoproteinosis and mucolipidosis type IV. Orthologous to human MCOLN1 (mucolipin TRP cation channel 1); MCOLN2 (mucolipin TRP cation channel 2); and MCOLN3 (mucolipin TRP cation channel 3).
