Involved in several processes, including autophagosome maturation; positive regulation of TOR signaling; and positive regulation of synaptic assembly at neuromuscular junction. Located in endolysosome membrane; late endosome membrane; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glycoproteinosis and mucolipidosis type IV. Orthologous to human MCOLN1 (mucolipin TRP cation channel 1); MCOLN2 (mucolipin TRP cation channel 2); and MCOLN3 (mucolipin TRP cation channel 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary autosomal recessive microcephaly 10. Orthologous to human ZFP64 (ZFP64 zinc finger protein) and ZNF335 (zinc finger protein 335).

Name: Heat shock protein 70 cognate 4
Description: Heat shock protein cognate 4 (Hsc70-4) encodes a protein involved in protein folding. It contributes to clathrin-mediated endocytosis, neurotransmitter exocytosis and RNAi response.

Name: trivet
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Involved in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Orthologous to human TIA1 (TIA1 cytotoxic granule associated RNA binding protein).

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in response to endoplasmic reticulum stress. Predicted to be part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human FBXL2 (F-box and leucine rich repeat protein 2) and FBXL20 (F-box and leucine rich repeat protein 20).

Name: PDGF- and VEGF-related factor 3
Description: PDGF- and VEGF-related factor 3 (Pvf3) encodes a ligand for the receptor tyrosine kinase encoded by Pvr. It has roles in embryonic plasmatocyte survival and migration, and in the proliferation of adult midgut intestinal stem cells.

Name: Succinate dehydrogenase, subunit A (flavoprotein)-like
Description: Predicted to enable electron transfer activity; flavin adenine dinucleotide binding activity; and succinate dehydrogenase (ubiquinone) activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial electron transport, succinate to ubiquinone. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial respiratory chain complex II, succinate dehydrogenase complex (ubiquinone). Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable dynein heavy chain binding activity and dynein light chain binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cilium movement and outer dynein arm assembly. Predicted to be part of outer dynein arm. Is expressed in spermatogonium and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary ciliary dyskinesia 9. Orthologous to human DNAI2 (dynein axonemal intermediate chain 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable phosphoprotein phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to several human genes including PPM1J (protein phosphatase, Mg2+/Mn2+ dependent 1J).

Name: Grip75
Description: Gamma-tubulin complex is necessary for microtubule nucleation at the centrosome. (UniProtKB:Q9VKU7)

Name: Fem-1
Description: Substrate-recognition component of a Cul2-RING (CRL2) E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex of the DesCEND (destruction via C-end degrons) pathway, which recognizes a C-degron located at the extreme C terminus of target proteins, leading to their ubiquitination and degradation. The C-degron recognized by the DesCEND pathway is usually a motif of less than ten residues and can be present in full-length proteins, truncated proteins or proteolytically cleaved forms. (UniProtKB:A1ZBY1)

Name: Signal recognition particle 72
Description: Predicted to enable 7S RNA binding activity. Predicted to contribute to ribosome binding activity. Involved in dsRNA transport. Predicted to be part of signal recognition particle, endoplasmic reticulum targeting. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to human SRP72 (signal recognition particle 72).

Name: MAN1
Description: MAN1 (MAN1) encodes a protein that functions as a tissue-specific antagonist of BMP signaling.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG32437 (FBgn0052437). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:21357683..21359867. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in multicellular organism reproduction. Is expressed in adult fat body and adult head.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic brain; embryonic stomatogastric nervous system; and larval ventral nerve cord.

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 9
Description: Catalyzes the initial reaction in O-linked oligosaccharide biosynthesis, the transfer of an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue to a serine or threonine residue on the protein receptor (PubMed:30158631). It can both act as a peptide transferase that transfers GalNAc onto unmodified peptide substrates, and as a glycopeptide transferase that requires the prior addition of a GalNAc on a peptide before adding additional GalNAc moieties (PubMed:30158631). (UniProtKB:Q8MRC9)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable inositol hexakisphosphate binding activity and phosphate ion transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in synaptic target recognition. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in Golgi apparatus and plasma membrane.

Name: Serpin 100A
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal system; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including bone disease (multiple); brain edema; eye disease (multiple); leukostasis; and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. Orthologous to human SERPINF1 (serpin family F member 1).

Name: mitoshell
Description: mitoshell (mtsh) encodes a protein with a bromodomain-related region. It is required during spermatogenesis for proper temporal coordination of meiotic divisions with the morphogenetic events that usually follow meiosis.

Name: kekkon 4
Description: Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 64 and glaucoma. Orthologous to human LINGO1 (leucine rich repeat and Ig domain containing 1) and LINGO2 (leucine rich repeat and Ig domain containing 2).

Name: teflon
Description: teflon (tef) encodes a protein required for the maintenance of pairing between homologs at meiosis I, specifically in males. It is required for the localization of the product of mod(mdg4) to paired autosomal bivalents.

Name: mRNA-capping-enzyme
Description: Enables mRNA guanylyltransferase activity. Involved in 7-methylguanosine mRNA capping and positive regulation of smoothened signaling pathway. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human RNGTT (RNA guanylyltransferase and 5'-phosphatase).

Name: Kinesin family member 3C
Description: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity; microtubule binding activity; and plus-end-directed microtubule motor activity. Predicted to be involved in anterograde dendritic transport of neurotransmitter receptor complex and cell projection organization. Predicted to be part of kinesin complex. Predicted to be active in cilium; microtubule cytoskeleton; and neuron projection. Orthologous to human KIF17 (kinesin family member 17).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in apoptotic process involved in development; engulfment of apoptotic cell; and phosphatidylserine exposure on apoptotic cell surface. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human XKR4 (XK related 4); XKR6 (XK related 6); and XKR7 (XK related 7).

Name: Acetylcholine esterase
Description: Acetylcholine esterase (Ace) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine to acetate and choline, thus resetting the neurotransmission mechanism at neuromuscular junctions.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable peroxidase activity. Predicted to be involved in response to oxidative stress. Located in egg chorion. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: discontinuous actin hexagon
Description: discontinuous actin hexagon (dah) encodes a protein required for cortical furrows during early embryogenesis that is recruited to the membrane in a process dependent on the product of nuf.

Name: Na[+]/H[+] hydrogen exchanger 1
Description: Predicted to enable potassium:proton antiporter activity and sodium:proton antiporter activity. Predicted to be involved in potassium ion transmembrane transport and regulation of intracellular pH. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in Golgi apparatus. Is expressed in adult Malpighian tubule; adult head; adult hindgut; adult visceral muscle cell; and male reproductive system. Orthologous to human SLC9A8 (solute carrier family 9 member A8).

Name: Synaptotagmin 14
Description: Predicted to enable phospholipid binding activity. Predicted to be located in membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 11. Orthologous to several human genes including SYT16 (synaptotagmin 16).

Name: Basigin
Description: Basigin (Bsg) encodes an IgG family glycoprotein that promotes cytoskeletal rearrangements and lamellipodia formation in cultured insect cells. It contributes to photoreceptor cell morphogenesis, sarcomere organization and spermatid development.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 31a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Involved in detection of chemical stimulus involved in sensory perception. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult olfactory receptor neuron Ir31a; antennal coeloconic sensillum ac1; and antennal lobe glomerulus VL2p.

Name: Derailed 2
Description: Derailed 2 (Drl-2) is a member of the RYK gene family encoding a receptor tyrosine kinase that transduces Wnt5 signaling. It regulates salivary gland positioning, muscle attachment site selection and olfactory system development. The products of Drl-2 and drl can play both cooperative and opposing roles, depending on the cells where they are differentially expressed.

Name: Heat shock protein 60B
Description: Prevents misfolding and promotes the refolding and proper assembly of unfolded polypeptides generated under stress conditions. (UniProtKB:Q9VPS5)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG8100 (FBgn0036410). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:14083615..14086421. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. 2 alleles are reported. No phenotypic data is available. No phenotypic class data is available. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed during early pupal stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 41a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult olfactory receptor neuron Ir41a and antennal lobe glomerulus VM6.

Name: Actin-related protein 5
Description: Proposed core component of the chromatin remodeling Ino80 complex which is involved in transcriptional regulation, DNA replication and probably DNA repair. (UniProtKB:Q9VEC3)

Name: Regulator of G-protein signaling 7
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of GTPase activity and regulation of G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and neuron projection. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human RGS6 (regulator of G protein signaling 6) and RGS7 (regulator of G protein signaling 7).

Name: Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 1
Description: Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 1 (Pepck1) encodes an enzyme that converts oxaloacetate into phosphoenolpyruvate. It catalyzes the first committed step in gluconeogenesis and thus plays an essential role in glucose metabolism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human BUD13 (BUD13 homolog).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in monocarboxylic acid transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult fat body; embryonic epidermis; extended germ band embryo; gonad; and ventral ectoderm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cataract 47. Orthologous to human SLC16A12 (solute carrier family 16 member 12); SLC16A3 (solute carrier family 16 member 3); and SLC16A5 (solute carrier family 16 member 5).

Name: Rabaptin-5
Description: Rabaptin-5 (Rbpn-5) encodes a Rab GTPase binding protein involved in regulation of endosome size.

Name: Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 4
Description: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction and positive regulation of stress fiber assembly. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including CNS glial cell; anterior ectoderm; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and primary tracheal branch. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4H. Orthologous to human FGD4 (FYVE, RhoGEF and PH domain containing 4) and ARHGEF39 (Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 39).

Name: PAR-domain protein 1
Description: PAR-domain protein 1 (Pdp1) encodes a member of the PAR domain bZip family of sequence-specific transcription factors. it regulates gene expression in muscles and in circadian clock neurons.

Name: knirps-like
Description: knirps-like (knrl) encodes an orphan nuclear hormone receptor with a C4 zinc finger motif, without ligand-binding domain. It is a target gene of the Hedgehog, Wingless and Notch signaling pathways. It controls endoreduplication domains and epithelial morphogenesis in the fore- and hindgut.

Name: Myosuppressin receptor 2
Description: Myosuppressin receptor 2 (MsR2) encodes a G protein coupled receptor activated by the product of Ms (TDVDHVFLRFamide). It elevates neurotransmitter release in motor neurons and aids larval escape responses to light.

Name: N/A
Description: Putative ferric-chelate reductases reduce Fe(3+) to Fe(2+) before its transport from the endosome to the cytoplasm. (UniProtKB:Q8MSU3)

Name: Abnormal X segregation
Description: Abnormal X segregation (Axs) encodes a member of transmembrane proteins with calcium-activated chloride activity. Axs product localizes to a membranous sheath that surrounds the oocyte meiosis I spindle. A dominant mutation in Axs results in barrel-shaped meiosis I spindles, cell cycle defects, and missegregation of nonexchange chromosomes in oocytes.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG7320 (FBgn0036782). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:18201494..18203637. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed during late larval stages, during early pupal stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable UMP kinase activity and cytidylate kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in CDP biosynthetic process and UDP biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human AK5 (adenylate kinase 5).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity; actin binding activity; and phosphatidylinositol binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of ATP-dependent activity and negative regulation of ion transport. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic antennal sense organ; embryonic brain; extended germ band embryo; germline cell; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to human PXK (PX domain containing serine/threonine kinase like).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable inositol hexakisphosphate binding activity and phosphate ion transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to phosphate starvation and phosphate ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in Golgi apparatus and plasma membrane.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 76a
Description: Contributes to olfactory receptor activity. Involved in detection of chemical stimulus involved in sensory perception of smell and transmission of nerve impulse. Located in sensory dendrite. Part of receptor complex. Is expressed in adult olfactory receptor neuron Ir76a; antennal coeloconic sensillum ac4; and antennal lobe glomerulus VM4.

Name: fezzik
Description: Predicted to enable ecdysone oxidase activity. Involved in mesoderm development. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Grip71
Description: Enables gamma-tubulin binding activity. Involved in microtubule cytoskeleton organization; mitotic cell cycle; and regulation of cell cycle. Located in cytoplasm; meiotic spindle midzone; and meiotic spindle pole. Part of gamma-tubulin ring complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human NEDD1 (NEDD1 gamma-tubulin ring complex targeting factor).

Name: Vesicular monoamine transporter
Description: Vesicular monoamine transporter (Vmat) encodes a protein responsible for packaging the neurotransmitters dopamine, serotonin and octopamine into secretory vesicles.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable Hsp70 protein binding activity and ribosome binding activity. Predicted to be involved in 'de novo' cotranslational protein folding. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; gut section; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human DNAJC2 (DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member C2).

Name: eye transformer
Description: eye transformer (et) encodes a type 1 cytokine receptor in the JAK/STAT pathway that behaves as a dominant negative receptor. It plays a key role in the larval hematopoietic organ the lymph gland under wasp parasitism.

Name: Visual system homeobox 2
Description: Visual system homeobox 2 (Vsx2) encodes a transcription factor involved in the development of the visual-system.

Name: Multicopper oxidase 4
Description: Predicted to enable ferroxidase activity. Predicted to be involved in iron ion homeostasis and iron ion transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: BarH2
Description: B-H1 and B-H2 are regulated by members of the wg signaling pathway; wg and dpp. B-H1 and B-H2 are coexpressed and functionally required in R1 and R6 receptor cells and primary pigment cells for normal eye development. Coexpression is also required for the fate determination of external sensory organs, formation of notal microchaetae, formation of presutural macrochaetae, antennal development and for distal leg morphogenesis; segmentation and specification of tarsal segments 3-5. (UniProtKB:Q24256)

Name: Octopamine receptor in mushroom bodies
Description: Receptor for octopamine (OA) which is a neurotransmitter, neurohormone and neuromodulator in invertebrates (PubMed:9570796, PubMed:15816867). Stimulates intracellular accumulation of cAMP and Ca(2+) following ligand binding (PubMed:9570796, PubMed:15816867). Required for ovulation (PubMed:14623240, PubMed:19262750). Following activation on mature follicle cells by OA, induces activity of the metalloprotease Mmp2 which leads to breakdown of the posterior follicle wall, resulting in ovulation (PubMed:26473732). Ligand binding probably also leads to activation of CamKII which is also required for ovulation (PubMed:19262750). Modulates sleep/wake behavior by acting in neurons of the pars intercerebralis to promote wakefulness (PubMed:20223202). Plays a role in courtship conditioning where the courtship behavior of males rejected by already mated females is inhibited with further females (PubMed:23055498). Required in the mushroom body for appetitive olfactory learning (PubMed:23103875, PubMed:23345239). Specifically conveys the short-term reinforcing effects of sweet taste (PubMed:23103875, PubMed:25728694). In insulin-producing cells of the brain, plays a role in inhibiting transcription of insulin-like peptide Ilp3 (PubMed:24923784). Also plays a role in social behavior by modulating male agression (PubMed:24923784). (UniProtKB:Q7JQF1)

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: cueball
Description: Has a role in spermatogenesis and oogenesis (PubMed:8244010). Might have a role in triglyceride homeostasis (PubMed:25409104). Probably by regulating lipid storage and catabolism, plays a role in neuronal function (PubMed:25409104). (UniProtKB:Q95RU0)

Name: blown fuse
Description: blown fuse (blow) encodes a cytoplasmic protein required for myoblast fusion. It regulates actin cytoskeletal dynamics via modulating the stability of the WASp-Vrp1 complex.

Name: buttonhead
Description: buttonhead (btd) encodes a triple C(2)H(2) zinc finger protein structurally and functionally related to the human transcription factors Sp5, Sp8, and Sp9. The product of btd contributes to embryonic head segmentation, leg development, embryonic hematopoiesis, PNS formation, and maintenance of the functional heterogeneity of brain neural stem cells.

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 4
Description: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 4 (Pgant4) encodes a member of the UDP-GalNAc:polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase family. It catalyzes the transfer of a GalNAc sugar onto the hydroxyl groups of serine and threonine in secreted or membrane-bound proteins. It is essential and is involved in secretory vesicle formation by protecting the cargo receptor encoded by Tango1 from the proteolysis mediated by the product of Fur1.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 84a
Description: Ionotropic receptor 84a (Ir84a) encodes a member of the Ionotropic Receptor (IR) family of variant ionotropic glutamate receptors. It functions in detection of phenylacetic acid and controls male courtship behavior.

Name: Corazonin receptor
Description: Corazonin receptor (CrzR) encodes a member of the Class A family of G-protein-coupled receptor that transduces the siganl of the neuropeptide encoded by Crz. It is involved in ethanol-induced behavior and ethanol metabolism.

Name: Elongin A
Description: Elongin A (EloA) encodes a transcription elongation factor that enhances the catalytic rate of RNA Polymerase II by suppressing its transient pausing. It associates with the products of EloB and EloC.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human C2orf42 (chromosome 2 open reading frame 42).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable translation elongation factor activity. Predicted to be involved in translational elongation. Orthologous to human GTPBP2 (GTP binding protein 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carnitine O-acetyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in carnitine metabolic process, CoA-linked and fatty acid metabolic process. Predicted to be active in peroxisome. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation. Orthologous to human CRAT (carnitine O-acetyltransferase).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: curled
Description: curled (cu) encodes a NADP/NADPH phosphatase. It is involved in NADP metabolism, mRNA poly(A) tail shortening and response to light. cu mutants has wings curved upward.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable pyruvate kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in glycolytic process. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 11a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Involved in sensory perception of taste. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; epiphysis; gustatory receptor neurons; and proboscis.

Name: Bulli
Description: Involved in positive regulation of guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Part of Mon1-Ccz1 complex. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human RMC1 (regulator of MON1-CCZ1).

Name: Heat shock protein 70 Aa
Description: Heat-shock-protein-70Aa (Hsp70Aa) encodes a protein involved in response to heat shock and hypoxia.

Name: tango
Description: Heterodimers of tgo/trh are involved in the control of breathless expression. Plays a role in the cellular or tissue response to oxygen deprivation. (UniProtKB:O15945)

Name: Heat shock protein 70 Ab
Description: Heat-shock-protein-70Ab (Hsp70Ab) encodes a protein involved in response to heat shock and hypoxia.

Name: Germinal centre kinase III
Description: Germinal centre kinase III (GckIII) encodes a serine/threonine kinase of the STE20 superfamily. It is the sole Drosophila germinal center kinase type 3 family member. Loss of GckIIII results in tube dilation defects that are specific to the terminal cells of the tracheal system.

Name: Veneno
Description: Veneno (Veneno) encodes a protein belonging to the TDRD1 family that is predicted to have a role in the piRNA pathway.

Name: Mediator complex subunit 17
Description: Component of the Mediator complex, a coactivator involved in the regulated transcription of nearly all RNA polymerase II-dependent genes. Mediator functions as a bridge to convey information from gene-specific regulatory proteins to the basal RNA polymerase II transcription machinery. Mediator is recruited to promoters by direct interactions with regulatory proteins and serves as a scaffold for the assembly of a functional preinitiation complex with RNA polymerase II and the general transcription factors. Required for activated transcription of the MtnA, MtnB and MtnD genes. Negatively regulates sex comb development. (UniProtKB:Q9VEC1)

Name: partner of drosha
Description: partner of drosha (pasha) encodes a protein involved in oogenesis and miRNA processing.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in multicellular organism reproduction.

Name: Transferrin 1
Description: Transferrin 1 (Tsf1) encodes an iron binding protein induced during the immune response. Iron sequestration is a classical host defense mechanism to combat bacterial infection.

Name: Sur-8
Description: Acts as a Ras effector and participates in MAPK pathway activation. Probably acts as a regulatory subunit of protein phosphatase that specifically dephosphorylates Raf kinase and stimulate Raf activity at specialized signaling complexes upon Ras activation (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VEK6)

Name: Zwilch
Description: Zwilch (Zwilch) encodes a subunit of the RZZ complex located at the kinetochores of chromosomes. The RZZ complex plays an essential role in the spindle assembly checkpoint that ensures proper connections between chromosomes and the mitotic spindle.

Name: Nutrient Amino Acid Transporter 1
Description: Unusual broad substrate spectrum amino acid:sodium cotransporter that promotes absorption of the D isomers of essential amino acids. Neutral amino acids are the preferred substrates, especially methionine and phenylalanine. (UniProtKB:Q9W4C5)

Name: Fimbrin
Description: Fimbrin (Fim) encodes an actin crosslinking protein involved in the remodelling and organisation of the actin cytoskeleton that occurs in processes such as cellularization and cell migration.

Name: Heat shock protein 70 Ba
Description: Heat-shock-protein-70Ba (Hsp70Ba) encodes a protein involved in response to heat shock and hypoxia.

Name: Heat shock protein 70 Bbb
Description: Hsp70Bbb (Hsp70Bbb) encodes a protein involved in response to heat shock and hypoxia.

Name: Sphingosine kinase 1
Description: Sphingosine kinase 1 (Sk1) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the phosphorylation of sphingosine to sphingosine 1-phosphate, a bioactive lipid mediator. It regulates cell proliferation, differentiation, endolysosomal trafficking and muscle cell repair.

Name: Heat shock protein 70 Bc
Description: Heat-shock-protein-70Bc (Hsp70Bc) encodes a protein involved in response to heat shock, hypoxia and drugs.

Name: N/A
Description: Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human CLPTM1 (CLPTM1 regulator of GABA type A receptor forward trafficking).

Name: Heat shock protein 70 Bb
Description: Heat-shock-protein-70Bb (Hsp70Bb) encodes a protein involved in response to hypoxia heat shock and .

Name: Heat shock protein 70 cognate 1
Description: Predicted to enable several functions, including ATP binding activity; ATP hydrolysis activity; and misfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cellular response to unfolded protein; chaperone cofactor-dependent protein refolding; and protein refolding. Predicted to be active in cytosol; nucleus; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Kawasaki disease; autoimmune disease of musculoskeletal system (multiple); cystic fibrosis; schizophrenia (multiple); and toxic shock syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including HSPA2 (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable gamma-aminobutyric acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity and neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in neurotransmitter transport and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; and adult thorax. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in creatine transporter deficiency and intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC6A11 (solute carrier family 6 member 11); SLC6A12 (solute carrier family 6 member 12); and SLC6A13 (solute carrier family 6 member 13).

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in wound healing. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Ets96B
Description: Required in dopaminergic neurons to regulate expression of genes involved in dopamine signaling. Decreases expression of the dopamine transporter DAT and increases expression of the dopamine transporter Vmat and the tyrosine 3-monooxygenase ple which is involved in dopamine biosynthesis. Also involved in negatively regulating the expression of a group of endoplasmic reticulum proteins, the molecular chaperone Calr and the protein disulfide isomerases CaBP1 and ERp60. (UniProtKB:Q8MRW5)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sulfate transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; amnioserosa; embryonic large intestine; and yolk nucleus. Orthologous to human SLC26A11 (solute carrier family 26 member 11).

Name: Serpin 85F
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Fabry disease; Henoch-Schoenlein purpura; artery disease (multiple); heart conduction disease (multiple); and hydronephrosis. Orthologous to human AGT (angiotensinogen); HMSD (histocompatibility minor serpin domain containing); and SERPINH1 (serpin family H member 1).

Name: LIM homeobox transcription factor 1 alpha
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in neuron differentiation and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and germ layer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 7; focal segmental glomerulosclerosis; and nail-patella syndrome. Orthologous to human LMX1A (LIM homeobox transcription factor 1 alpha) and LMX1B (LIM homeobox transcription factor 1 beta).

Name: twin of eyg
Description: twin of eyg (toe) encodes a Pax6(5a) transcription factor that functions during thorax and eye development as a transcription repressor.

Name: Suppressor of variegation 2-10
Description: Suppressor of variegation 2-10 (Su(var)2-10) encodes a member of the PIAS protein family that regulates chromosome structure and function. As a JAK/STAT pathway regulator, it contributes to eye formation and eye determination.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 33B
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 33B (Vps33B) encodes a member of the family of SM proteins, which in conjunction with SNARE proteins catalyze membrane fusion events. The product of Vps33B, together with its binding partner encoded by Vps16B, forms a complex that is necessary for fusions between phagosomes and lysosomes.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity; amino acid:cation symporter activity; and neurotransmitter transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport; neurotransmitter transport; and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; and adult thorax.

Name: mushroom bodies tiny
Description: Involved in neurogenesis of the adult central nervous system, and together with Cdc42, regulates photoreceptor cell morphogenesis. Phosphorylates exogenous substrates when activated by Cdc42. (UniProtKB:Q9VXE5)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and germ layer.

Name: Calnexin 14D
Description: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity and unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding and ubiquitin-dependent ERAD pathway. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head; peripheral nervous system; and presumptive embryonic/larval central nervous system. Orthologous to human CLGN (calmegin) and CANX (calnexin).

Name: SLY-1 homologous
Description: Non-vital for development. (UniProtKB:Q24179)

Name: lethal (2) k05911
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Predicted to be active in extracellular space.

Name: Enigma
Description: Enigma (Egm) encodes a mitochondrial oxidoreductase involved in oxidative stress response and lipid homeostasis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in anlage in statu nascendi; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and organism.

Name: Cylindromatosis
Description: N/A

Name: Rabphilin
Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in intracellular protein transport; neurotransmitter secretion; and regulation of calcium ion-dependent exocytosis. Predicted to be located in secretory granule and synaptic vesicle membrane. Predicted to be active in synapse. Used to study cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to several human genes including RPH3A (rabphilin 3A).

Name: IGF-II mRNA-binding protein
Description: IGF-II mRNA-binding protein (Imp) encodes a protein that regulates the stability, translation and/or transport of its associated mRNAs, a large number of them encoding F-actin regulators. It is an essential protein required for neural and germline stem cell maturation, neuronal remodeling, as well as the expression modulation of asymmetrically localized maternal mRNAs.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2A
Description: Functions in the early steps of protein synthesis of a small number of specific mRNAs. Acts by directing the binding of methionyl-tRNAi to 40S ribosomal subunits. In contrast to the eIF-2 complex, it binds methionyl-tRNAi to 40S subunits in a codon-dependent manner, whereas the eIF-2 complex binds methionyl-tRNAi to 40S subunits in a GTP-dependent manner. (UniProtKB:Q9VNX8)

Name: Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 2
Description: Predicted to enable manganese ion binding activity and phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (GTP) activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cellular response to glucose stimulus; gluconeogenesis; and monocarboxylic acid metabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut primordium; extended germ band embryo; gastrula embryo; posterior ectoderm anlage; and yolk. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to several human genes including PCK1 (phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sulfate transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in Bolwig organ; adult head; embryonic epidermis; embryonic head sensory system; and integumentary specialization. Orthologous to human SLC26A11 (solute carrier family 26 member 11).

Name: N/A
Description: Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including Bolwig organ; adult head; embryonic/larval nervous system; germ layer derivative; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to several human genes including ANKRD13B (ankyrin repeat domain 13B).

Name: half pint
Description: half pint (hfp) encodes a single stranded nucleic acid binding protein with roles in transcription and RNA splicing. It functions in Myc transcriptional repression and cell growth control, via interaction with the transcription factor encoded by hay.

Name: jiangshi
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Tyrosine decarboxylase 2
Description: catalyze directly the biosynthesis of the neuromodulator tyramine and indirectly the biosynthesis of octopamine - Tdc1 acts to synthesize tyramine, a potent diuretic factor in the Malpighian tubule - Tdc2 is required neurally for egg deposition

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway and response to pheromone. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human TMEM145 (transmembrane protein 145).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of gene expression. Predicted to be part of ribonucleoprotein complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human RO60 (Ro60, Y RNA binding protein).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be part of MLL1 complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human TEX10 (testis expressed 10).

Name: Hayan
Description: Hayan (Hayan) encodes a hemolymphatic serine protease involved in the activation of the melanization cascade. It is thought to directly cleave the prophenoloxidases encoded by PPO1 and/or PPO2.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein peptidyl-prolyl isomerization. Predicted to be part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human PPWD1 (peptidylprolyl isomerase domain and WD repeat containing 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human KIAA2013 (KIAA2013).

Name: Ectoderm-expressed 3
Description: Predicted to enable beta-galactosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Predicted to be active in vacuole. Is expressed in several structures, including circulatory system; cuboidal/columnar epithelium; ectoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; and germ layer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in GM1 gangliosidosis (multiple) and mucopolysaccharidosis IV (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including GLB1L (galactosidase beta 1 like).

Name: Huntingtin-interacting protein 14
Description: Probable palmitoyltransferase which is required for photoreceptor synaptic transmission and for the correct expression and localization of palmitoylated protein Csp and synaptosomal-associated protein Snap25 (PubMed:18158335, PubMed:18032660). Probably palmitoylates Csp (PubMed:18158335). Probably also palmitoylates the dorsal-ventral patterning protein Sog and promotes its secretion and activity and the stabilization of the membrane-bound form (PubMed:20599894). Required for synaptic vesicle exocytosis (PubMed:18158335). (UniProtKB:Q9VUW9)

Name: Quiescin sulfhydryl oxidase 1
Description: Predicted to enable flavin-linked sulfhydryl oxidase activity and protein disulfide isomerase activity. Involved in protein folding in endoplasmic reticulum. Predicted to be active in Golgi membrane and extracellular space. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic primordium of adult eye; epithelium; and gut section. Orthologous to human QSOX1 (quiescin sulfhydryl oxidase 1) and QSOX2 (quiescin sulfhydryl oxidase 2).

Name: MLF1-adaptor molecule
Description: May play a role in subcellular trafficking between the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi apparatus. (UniProtKB:Q9Y0Y6)

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 316 member A1
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcoholic pancreatitis; bilirubin metabolic disorder (multiple); cholecystolithiasis; cholelithiasis; and female reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including UGT1A1 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A1); UGT1A10 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A10); and UGT1A3 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A3).

Name: varicose
Description: varicose (vari) encodes a protein involved in tracheal system development and septate junction assembly.

Name: pxb
Description: pxb (pxb) encodes a protein involved in response to ethanol, long-term memory and regulation of hemocyte proliferation.

Name: GABA transporter
Description: GABA transporter (Gat) encodes a protein belonging to the SLC family that is expressed primarily in astrocytes, where it is thought to be required for uptake of GABA and other small molecules. It likely plays an important role in setting the excitatory/inhibitory balance of the CNS.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 76b
Description: Ionotropic receptor 76b (Ir76b) encodes a member of the Ionotropic Receptor (IR) family of variant ionotropic glutamate receptors. It functions in chemosensory detection of various amines and salt, as a probable co-receptor subunit.

Name: alpha-L-iduronidase
Description: Essential lysosomal hydrolase responsible for the degradation of the glycosaminoglycans (GAG) heparan sulfate and dermatan sulfate (Probable). Required for lysosome function and autophagy (PubMed:35011691). Consequently, has an essential role in the development, maintenance and function of various cells, tissues, and organs, including the muscles and the central nervous system (CNS) (PubMed:35011691). (UniProtKB:Q9VKJ8)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be part of cullin-RING ubiquitin ligase complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; larval ventral nerve cord; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in arteriovenous malformation and glomus tumor. Orthologous to human GLMN (glomulin, FKBP associated protein).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 68b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in larval abdomen.

Name: CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 10
Description: Component of the CCR4-NOT complex which is one of the major cellular mRNA deadenylases and is linked to various cellular processes including bulk mRNA degradation, miRNA-mediated repression, translational repression during translational initiation and general transcription regulation. Additional complex functions may be a consequence of its influence on mRNA expression. Is not required for association of CNOT7 to the CCR4-NOT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9V3G6)

Name: visceral mesodermal armadillo-repeats
Description: visceral mesodermal armadillo-repeats (vimar) encodes a protein involved in regulation of muscle homeostasis and rhabdomere development. Its expression in the visceral mesoderm is controlled by the product of bap.

Name: Suppressor of variegation 3-9
Description: Histone methyltransferase that specifically trimethylates 'Lys-9' of histone H3 using monomethylated H3 'Lys-9' as substrate. H3 'Lys-9' trimethylation represents a specific tag for epigenetic transcriptional repression by recruiting Su(var)205/HP1 to methylated histones. Mainly functions in heterochromatin regions, thereby playing a central role in the establishment of constitutive heterochromatin at pericentric regions. Involved in heterochromatic gene silencing including the modification of position-effect-variegation. (UniProtKB:P45975)

Name: stepping stone
Description: stepping stone (sstn) encodes an adaptor protein that forms a complex with the plasma membrane encoded by step through direct coil-coil domain interactions. It functions with the product of step to antagonize actomyosin networks during cleavage of the Drosophila embryo.

Name: Merlin
Description: Merlin (Mer) encodes a FERM domain containing protein that promotes assembly of a functional Hippo signaling complex at the apical cell cortex. It has also been associated with cell junctions and endocytic compartments.

Name: labial
Description: labial (lab) encodes the anterio-most expressed member of the Antennapedia complex (ANT-C), one of two Hox gene complexes. Members of the ANT-C control the identity of segments that contribute to the head and the anterior thorax. The product of lab specifies the identity of the intercalary segment and also functions in the development of copper cells in the midgut.

Name: Heat shock protein 68
Description: Heat shock protein 68 (Hsp68) encodes a protein involved in lifespan determination and response to heat shock and  starvation.

Name: starvin
Description: starvin (stv) encodes a BAG family member that binds heat shock proteins. It plays roles in somatic muscles and is involved in the chaperone pathway essential for muscle maintenance. It also  acts as co-chaperone of Hsp70 proteins during recovery from stress, including cold stress.

Name: Pinkman
Description: Is expressed in adult head; eye; mesoderm anlage; organism; and ventral ectoderm anlage.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metallocarboxypeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Predicted to be active in extracellular space.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in multicellular organism reproduction.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary autosomal recessive microcephaly 10. Orthologous to human ZFP64 (ZFP64 zinc finger protein) and ZNF335 (zinc finger protein 335).

Name: Separase
Description: Separase (Sse) encodes an endoprotease. Together with the product of thr, it forms a complex which cleaves a subunit of the cohesin complex during meiosis, thereby allowing separation of the sister chromatids.

Name: sprite
Description: Predicted to enable actin binding activity and phospholipid binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell projection assembly and membrane organization. Predicted to be active in actin cytoskeleton and cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; embryonic/larval circulatory system; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and stage 5 embryo.

Name: poly(A) binding protein
Description: Binds the poly(A) tail of mRNA (PubMed:2125288). Since it interacts with the cap-associating translation initiation factor eIF4G, it is likely that it functions by linking Atx2 to the cap-binding complex (PubMed:28388438). Forms a complex with tyf and Atx2 which functions in adult circadian pacemaker neurons to sustain circadian rhythms likely by switching between activator and repressor modes of post-transcriptional regulation via interaction with Lsm12a or me31B, respectively (PubMed:28388438). The activator complex (Atx2-tyf activator complex) activates the TYF-dependent translation of per to maintain 24 hour periodicity in circadian locomotor behaviors, whereas the repressor complex (Atx2-Not1 repressor complex) promotes Not1-dependent post-transcriptional gene silencing and supports high-amplitude circadian rhythms in a per-independent manner (PubMed:28388438). In 0-1 hour embryos, forms a ribonucleoprotein complex (RNP) with me31B, eIF4E1, tral and cup which binds to various mRNAs including maternal mRNAs, and down-regulates their expression during the maternal-to-zygotic transition (PubMed:28875934). (UniProtKB:P21187)

Name: coilin
Description: coilin (coil) encodes a protein required for Cajal body formation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be extrinsic component of mitochondrial inner membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human MSS51 (MSS51 mitochondrial translational activator).

Name: musashi
Description: musashi (msi) encodes an RNA binding protein that binds to the 3' UTR region of target mRNAs, including ttk and sima, thus it positively regulates neural differentiation and negatively regulates the HIF pathway. It contributes to cell fate determination, as well as cellular response to normoxic/hypoxic conditions.

Name: Oligosaccharide transferase Delta subunit
Description: Oligosaccharide transferase Delta subunit (OstDelta) encodes a protein involved in the cellular encapsulation response.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in central brain primordium; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Predicted to be active in recycling endosome. Orthologous to human DENND6A (DENN domain containing 6A) and DENND6B (DENN domain containing 6B).

Name: Heat shock protein 70 cognate 2
Description: Heat shock protein cognate 2 (Hsc70-2) encodes a member of the heat shock protein 70 family. It functions as chaperone protein in facilitating the proper folding of proteins.

Name: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class T
Description: Predicted to be involved in attachment of GPI anchor to protein. Part of GPI-anchor transamidase complex. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum and nuclear membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic midline of ventral nerve cord; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval nervous system; gonad; and larval tagma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 3 and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria. Orthologous to human PIGT (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class T).

Name: N/A
Description: May function in the removal and maintenance of calcium homeostasis. Transports one Ca(2+) and 1 K(+) in exchange for 4 Na(+) (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VN12)

Name: Neprilysin-like 10
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in distal arthrogryposis type 5D. Orthologous to human ECEL1 (endothelin converting enzyme like 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NADP+) activity. Predicted to be involved in malate metabolic process and pyruvate metabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human ME1 (malic enzyme 1) and ME3 (malic enzyme 3).

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 2
Description: Catalyzes the initial reaction in O-linked oligosaccharide biosynthesis, the transfer of an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue to a serine or threonine residue on the protein receptor (PubMed:12829714, PubMed:18669915). It can both act as a peptide transferase that transfers GalNAc onto unmodified peptide substrates, and as a glycopeptide transferase that requires the prior addition of a GalNAc on a peptide before adding additional GalNAc moieties. Prefers the monoglycosylated Muc5AC-3 as substrate (PubMed:12829714). O-glycosylation modification of proteins by this enzyme might be important for cytokinesis (PubMed:20807760). (UniProtKB:Q6WV19)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity. Predicted to be involved in ecdysteroid metabolic process. Located in egg chorion. Orthologous to human CHDH (choline dehydrogenase).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process.

Name: Mau2 sister chromatid cohesion factor
Description: Mau2 sister chromatid cohesion factor (Mau2) encodes a protein that interacts with the product of Nipped-B to form the kollerin complex, which loads the cohesin complex onto chromosomes. The product of Mau2 and cohesin participate in transcriptional regulation and DNA repair.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including CNS glial cell; amnioserosa; embryonic Malpighian tubule; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and ventral midline of embryo. Orthologous to several human genes including SV2A (synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A).

Name: Vesicular glutamate transporter
Description: Vesicular glutamate transporter (VGlut) encodes a glutamate transporter belonging to SLC family of transporters. It localizes to synaptic vesicles in either glutamatergic or dopaminergic nerve terminals. It has been associated with neurodegenerative processes, regulation of basal and stimulant-induced locomotion, as well as the loading of glutamate and dopamine neurotransmitters into synaptic vesicles and vesicle co-transmission.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 56d
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult integumentary system; carbon dioxide sensitive neurons; gustatory receptor neurons; and tarsal segment.

Name: rumpelstiltskin
Description: rumpelstiltskin (rump) encodes the Drosophila hnRNP M homolog. It binds to nanos and osk mRNAs and plays a role in mRNA localization to the germ plasm by diffusion/entrapment during late stages of oogenesis. It also binds to exonic splicing enhancers on pre-mRNA targets, implicating it as a splicing factor.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Orthologous to human SLC22A15 (solute carrier family 22 member 15).

Name: Polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 35A
Description: Polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 35A (Pgant35A) encodes a member of the UDP-GalNAc:polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase family. It catalyzes the transfer of a GalNAc sugar onto the hydroxyl groups of serine and threonine in secreted or membrane-bound proteins. The product of Pgant35A is an essential protein involved in epithelial tube polarity.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable asparaginase activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid metabolic process. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human ASPG (asparaginase).

Name: cropped
Description: cropped (crp) encodes a transcription factor that controls cellular branching of the terminal cells at the ends of tracheal tubes. As a downstream target gene of the product of Myc, it affects cell growth, organ size and survival.

Name: Dopamine transporter
Description: Dopamine transporter (DAT) encodes a dopamine transporter that mediates uptake of dopamine from the synaptic cleft. Its loss increases extracellular dopamine and is associated with behavioral phenotypes including increased activity and decreased sleep.

Name: PNGase-like
Description: Specifically deglycosylates the denatured form of N-linked glycoproteins in the cytoplasm and assists their proteasome-mediated degradation. Cleaves the beta-aspartyl-glucosamine (GlcNAc) of the glycan and the amide side chain of Asn, converting Asn to Asp. Prefers proteins containing high-mannose over those bearing complex type oligosaccharides. Can recognize misfolded proteins in the endoplasmic reticulum that are exported to the cytosol to be destroyed and deglycosylate them, while it has no activity toward native proteins. Deglycosylation is a prerequisite for subsequent proteasome-mediated degradation of some, but not all, misfolded glycoproteins (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q7KRR5)

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space.

Name: Tyramine receptor
Description: Tyramine receptor (TyrR) encodes a Tyramine 2 class receptor. When heterologously expressed it shows a very high specificity for the release of intercellular calcium by tyramine.

Name: Alkylglycerone phosphate synthase
Description: Catalyzes the exchange of an acyl for a long-chain alkyl group and the formation of the ether bond in the biosynthesis of ether phospholipids. (UniProtKB:Q9V778)

Name: Inverted repeat-binding protein
Description: Inverted repeat-binding protein (Irbp) encodes a protein that, together with the product of Ku80, forms part of the Ku protein complex, which is involved in double-strand break repair via non-homologous end joining and telomere maintenance.

Name: Integrator 10
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). May be involved in the 3'-end processing of the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 but is probably not essential for 3'-end processing of the snRNA U7 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). (UniProtKB:Q9VZM7)

Name: Protein interacting with Ttk69 and Sin3A
Description: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in regulation of gene expression. Located in cytoplasm and nuclear periphery. Colocalizes with polytene chromosome. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain cell body rind; adult cerebral ganglion; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; and presumptive embryonic/larval central nervous system. Used to study nervous system disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in common variable immunodeficiency 14. Orthologous to several human genes including IRF2BP1 (interferon regulatory factor 2 binding protein 1) and IRF2BPL (interferon regulatory factor 2 binding protein like).

Name: Maltase A5
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: nonA-like
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 34. Orthologous to human NONO (non-POU domain containing octamer binding); PSPC1 (paraspeckle component 1); and SFPQ (splicing factor proline and glutamine rich).

Name: N/A
Description: G-beta-like protein involved in cell signal transduction (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q7K0L4)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-lysine transmembrane transporter activity and L-ornithine transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in L-arginine import across plasma membrane and L-ornithine transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior-posterior subdivision of organism; dorsal pharyngeal muscle primordium; embryonic/larval muscle cell; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human SLC7A1 (solute carrier family 7 member 1); SLC7A2 (solute carrier family 7 member 2); and SLC7A3 (solute carrier family 7 member 3).

Name: Angiotensin-converting enzyme-related

Description: 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) receptor 1B (5-HT1B) encodes a 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin) GPCR that belongs to the Class A GPCR family. They bind and transmit the signal from the neurotransmitter 5-HT (serotonin). The family can be subdivided into several subclasses based on pharmacology, signal transduction and structure. Description: debris buster (dsb) encodes a double-span transmembrane protein of the CD36 family residing in late endosomes and lysosomes. It is required for late stage phagosome maturation.

Description: Anaphase Promoting Complex subunit 7 (APC7) encodes a protein that  associates with the anaphase promoting complex/cyclosome (APC/C). It shows synergistic genetic interaction with the essential APC/C subunit encoded by Cdc23. Name: Angiotensin converting enzyme
Description: Angiotensin converting enzyme (Ance) encodes a member of the peptidyl-dipeptidase A family of zinc metallopeptidases. Ance product is an extracellular glycosylated enzyme with a broad substrate specificity, cleaving dipeptides from the carboxy terminus of oligopeptides.

Name: Signal recognition particle receptor alpha
Description: Component of the SRP (signal recognition particle) receptor (By similarity). Ensures, in conjunction with the signal recognition particle, the correct targeting of the nascent secretory proteins to the endoplasmic reticulum membrane system (By similarity). Forms a guanosine 5'-triphosphate (GTP)-dependent complex with the SRP subunit Srp54 (By similarity). SRP receptor compaction and GTPase rearrangement drive SRP-mediated cotranslational protein translocation into the ER (By similarity). May have a role in axonogenesis (PubMed:8360279). (UniProtKB:Q9U5L1)

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 68 kDa subunit 2
Description: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 68 kDa subunit 2 (Vha68-2) encodes a component of the V1 subunit of the vacuolar ATPase, which acidifies endosomal compartments including the lysosome and influences the activity of several signaling pathways.

Name: Vacuolar H[+] ATPase 68kD subunit 1
Description: Catalytic subunit of the V1 complex of vacuolar(H+)-ATPase (V-ATPase), a multisubunit enzyme composed of a peripheral complex (V1) that hydrolyzes ATP and a membrane integral complex (V0) that translocates protons (By similarity). V-ATPase is responsible for acidifying and maintaining the pH of intracellular compartments and in some cell types, is targeted to the plasma membrane, where it is responsible for acidifying the extracellular environment (By similarity). (UniProtKB:P48602)

Name: XRCC1
Description: Predicted to enable damaged DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in base-excision repair. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); hematologic cancer (multiple); reproductive organ cancer (multiple); respiratory system cancer (multiple); and urinary system cancer (multiple). Orthologous to human XRCC1 (X-ray repair cross complementing 1).

Name: Coiled-coil domain containing protein 151
Description: Involved in negative gravitaxis. Located in several cellular components, including cell body; ciliary rootlet; and ciliary tip. Is expressed in chordotonal neurons and chordotonal organ. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary ciliary dyskinesia 30. Orthologous to human ODAD3 (outer dynein arm docking complex subunit 3).

Name: kairos
Description: Involved in locomotor rhythm. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Peroxin 5
Description: Predicted to enable peroxisome matrix targeting signal-1 binding activity. Involved in peroxisome organization and response to anesthetic. Located in cytosol and peroxisome. Is expressed in embryonic cortex and yolk. Used to study peroxisomal biogenesis disorder and peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2A. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2A; peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2B; and rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 5. Orthologous to several human genes including PEX5 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 5).

Is expressed in dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell; embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell; embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell; organism; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: magu
Description: magu (magu) encodes a secreted protein that binds glypicans and regulates BMP signaling. It contributes to the regulation of growth and patterning of the wing, germ-line stem cell maintenance and adult life span.

Name: forkhead box, sub-group O
Description: Transcription factor involved in the regulation of the insulin signaling pathway. Consistently activates both the downstream target Thor\d4EBP and the feedback control target InR. Involved in negative regulation of the cell cycle, modulating cell growth and proliferation. In response to cellular stresses, such as nutrient deprivation or increased levels of reactive oxygen species, foxo is activated and inhibits growth through the action of target genes such as Thor. Foxo activated in the adult fat body can regulate lifespan in adults; an insulin peptide itself may function as one secondary messenger of insulin-regulated aging. Also regulates Lip4, homolog of human acid lipases, thereby acting as a key modulator of lipid metabolism by insulin signaling and integrates insulin responses to glucose and lipid homeostasis. (UniProtKB:Q95V55)

Name: Activating transcription factor 3
Description: Activating transcription factor 3 (Atf3) encodes a transcription factor whose levels are tightly controlled during development. It forms homodimers or heterodimerizes with the product of Jra. It contributes to abdominal morphogenesis, and immune system and metabolic homeostasis.

Name: mitochondrial DNA helicase
Description: mitochondrial DNA helicase (mtDNA-helicase) encodes the replicative mitochondrial DNA helicase, which is responsible for NTPase-dependent double-stranded DNA unwinding during mitochondrial DNA replication. It has roles in mitochondrial genome maintenance, and mitochondrial function.

Name: mitochondrial poly(A) polymerase
Description: Polymerase that creates the 3' poly(A) tail of mitochondrial transcripts. This is not required for transcript stability or translation but may maintain mRNA integrity by protecting 3' termini from degradation. (UniProtKB:O46102)

Name: reversed polarity
Description: reversed polarity (repo) encodes a homeodomain transcription factor specifically expressed in glial cells. It is is a direct target of the pan-glial fate determinant encoded by gcm and is required for acquisition of glial fate and subsequent terminal glial differentiation.

Predicted to be involved in several processes, including chemical synaptic transmission; chloride transmembrane transport; and regulation of membrane potential. Name: Autophagy-related 16
Description: Autophagy-related 16 (Atg16) encodes a protein that forms an E3-like protein complex. This complex contributes to the the covalent binding of the lipid phosphatidylethanolamine to the product of Atg8a, a key autophagy protein involved in autophagosome biogenesis. The product of Atg16 is involved in autophagosome biogenesis, maintenance of proper neuromuscular function, lifespan, ethanol sedation, and enteroendocrine cell function in the intestine.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 94e
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult subesophageal zone; gustatory system; labral sense organ neurons; terminal organ; and wing.

Name: earmuff
Description: earmuff (erm) encodes a transcriptional repressor that functions as a cell fate regulator by restricting responses to various signaling mechanisms including the Notch pathway during neurogenesis. Name: dusky-like
Description: dusky-like (dyl) encodes a plasma membrane protein involved in actin filament organization. It is involved in apical constriction, cell-matrix adhesion and hair morphogenesis.

Name: spatzle 3
Description: Neurotrophin which may function as a ligand to the Toll-related receptor Tollo. Involved in a Tollo and JNK signaling pathway that positively regulates neuromuscular junction (NMJ) growth in presynaptic motorneurons. May function by activating Tollo to promote the phosphorylation of JNK. (UniProtKB:Q9VLV7)

Name: fra mauro
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Involved in negative regulation of female receptivity, post-mating. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in distal arthrogryposis type 5D. Orthologous to human ECEL1 (endothelin converting enzyme like 1).

Description: CG4669 encodes a protein which contains two copies of a VTD-type deubiquitinase domain. It is most likely inactive, since crucial active site residues are missing.

Name: halfway
Description: Has a role in the ecdysone induced cascade; probably indirect control of 'late' ecdysone genes. (UniProtKB:Q9W568)

Name: Akt kinase
Description: Akt kinase (Akt) encodes the core kinase component of the insulin/insulin-like growth factor pathway. It functions downstream of the product of Pi3K92E and is activated by phosphatidylinositol binding and phosphorylation. It regulates cell growth and survival, stress responses and ageing.

Name: Tif-IA
Description: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase I core binding activity and RNA polymerase I general transcription initiation factor activity. Involved in female germ-line stem cell population maintenance and nucleolar large rRNA transcription by RNA polymerase I. Predicted to be located in nucleolus. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Essential for the nuclear import of nuclear localization signal (NLS)-containing proteins in an importin alpha/importin beta-dependent manner (PubMed:17682050). Together with Nup58, required for transposable element silencing regulation in ovarian follicle cells (PubMed:33856346). By interacting with the nuclear (Nxf1/Nxt1) and cytosolic (fs(1)Yb) components of the flamenco (flam) transcripts processing pathway, enables export and subsequent piRNA production (PubMed:33856346). (UniProtKB:Q9V6B9)

Name: Nitrogen permease regulator-like 3
Description: Nitrogen permease regulator-like 3 (Nprl3) encodes a component of the highly conserved GAP activity towards rags 1 (GATOR1) complex, which inhibits the product of mTor activity in response to amino acid starvation. The product of Nprl3, as well as the other GATOR1 components encoded by Nprl2 and Iml1, regulates early meiotic progression.

Name: modifier of mdg4
Description: modifier of mdg4 (mod(mdg4)) encodes a nuclear protein that specifically interacts with various DNA binding proteins. It is involved in processes including chromosome condensation and segregation, regulation of transcription and enhancer blocking.

Name: Malic enzyme like-1
Description: Predicted to enable malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NADP+) activity. Predicted to be involved in malate metabolic process and pyruvate metabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: capsuleen
Description: capsuleen (csul) encodes a protein arginine methyltransferase that carries out symmetric dimethylation of arginine residues. It forms a complex with the product of vls, which is the substrate recognition subunit. Primary substrates for this complex include the spliceosomal Sm proteins. The products of csull and vls function in germline specification and are required for proper localization of the product of tud to the posterior pole of the oocyte.

Name: Wee1 kinase
Description: Wee1 kinase (Wee1) encodes a tyrosine kinase required for triggering entry into mitosis. The activity of the Wee1 product contributes to spindle assembly and alignment and separation of the chromosomes.

Name: Nausicaa

Functions by slowing the dissociation of Cortactin from Arp2/3 nucleated branches thereby increasing branch nucleation and junction stability. (UniProtKB:Q8SX68)

Name: DNA polymerase alpha subunit 2
Description: Accessory subunit of the DNA polymerase alpha complex (also known as the alpha DNA polymerase-primase complex) which plays an essential role in the initiation of DNA synthesis (PubMed:6773966, PubMed:6403945, PubMed:6409898, PubMed:7592543). During the S phase of the cell cycle, the DNA polymerase alpha complex (composed of a catalytic subunit PolA1, an accessory subunit PolA2 and two primase subunits, the catalytic subunit Prim1 and the regulatory subunit Prim2) is recruited to DNA at the replicative forks (By similarity). The primase subunit of the polymerase alpha complex initiates DNA synthesis by oligomerising short RNA primers on both leading and lagging strands. These primers are initially extended by the polymerase alpha catalytic subunit and subsequently transferred to polymerase delta and polymerase epsilon for processive synthesis on the lagging and leading strand, respectively (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VB62)

Name: odd paired
Description: odd paired (opa) encodes a transcription factor that acts as a pair rule gene during early embryogenesis, as well as being involved in midgut morphogenesis. After embryogenesis, it contributes to adult head morphogenesis, neural stem cell development, and circadian rhythm.

Name: Protein phosphatase 4 regulatory subunit 2-related protein
Description: Regulatory subunit of serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 4 (PP4) (By similarity). The probable PP4 complex Pp4-19C-PPP4R2r-flfl (PPP4C-PPP4R2-PPP4R3) is required to prevent caspase induced cell death (in vitro). (UniProtKB:Q9W2U4)

Name: Ance-4
Description: Predicted to enable metallopeptidase activity and peptidyl-dipeptidase activity. Predicted to be active in extracellular space and plasma membrane. Is expressed in amnioserosa; embryonic/larval crystal cell; and procrystal cell.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in olfactory behavior. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 10a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; dorsal cibarial sense organ neurons; larval abdomen; and wing.

Name: mutagen-sensitive 302
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be located in nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm.

Name: N/A
Description: Required for the quantitative accumulation of H/ACA ribonucleoproteins (RNPs). (UniProtKB:Q9VI74)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG17005 (FBgn0032109). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:9327744..9330332. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Name: Methyltransferase like 3
Description: Methyltransferase like 3 (Mettl3) encodes an RNA N6-methyladenosine transferase that contributes to oogenesis, lifespan and behaviour, including flight, locomotion and grooming.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 7e
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of terminal organ and terminal organ.

Name: Van Gogh
