Description: Van Gogh (Vang) encodes a four-pass transmembrane protein that localizes to cell junctions. It is part of the Frizzled-dependent planar polarity pathway that establishes planar polarity in epithelia. It is also implicated in nervous system patterning.

Name: salvador
Description: salvador (sav) encodes a scaffold protein involved in the Hippo signalling pathway. It promotes membrane recruitment of the kinase encoded by hpo and its assembly with the product of wts.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval fat body; head mesoderm; and head mesoderm derivative. Orthologous to human TMEM184C (transmembrane protein 184C).

Name: flare
Description: flare (flr) encodes the Drosophila Actin Interacting protein 1. It functions with the product of tsr (cofillin) to promote F-actin disassembly.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable methylated histone binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of signal transduction and regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 30. Orthologous to human ZMYND11 (zinc finger MYND-type containing 11).

Name: Mannosyl (alpha-1,6-)-glycoprotein beta-1,2-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase
Description: Mannosyl (alpha-1,6-)-glycoprotein beta-1,2-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase (Mgat2) encodes an enzyme involved in protein N-linked glycosylation.

Name: Reticulon-like1
Description: Reticulon-like1 (Rtnl1) encodes a reticulon family member, with predicted intramembrane hairpin domains that can insert into the cytosolic face of the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), thereby curving it and promoting ER tubule formation. It is enriched on tubular ER, including axons and egg chamber fusomes.

Name: Lysyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Predicted to enable lysine-tRNA ligase activity and tRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in lysyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Part of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase multienzyme complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval lymph gland; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease recessive intermediate B and autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 89. Orthologous to human KARS1 (lysyl-tRNA synthetase 1).

Name: UFM1 specific peptidase 2
Description: Thiol protease which recognizes and hydrolyzes the peptide bond at the C-terminal Gly of UFM1, a ubiquitin-like modifier protein bound to a number of target proteins. Does not hydrolyze SUMO1 or ISG15 ubiquitin-like proteins. (UniProtKB:Q9VUR0)

Name: Actin-related protein 8
Description: Plays an important role in the functional organization of mitotic chromosomes. Exhibits low basal ATPase activity, and unable to polymerize (By similarity). Proposed core component of the chromatin remodeling INO80 complex which is involved in transcriptional regulation, DNA replication and probably DNA repair. Strongly prefer nucleosomes and H3-H4 tetramers over H2A-H2B dimers, suggesting it may act as a nucleosome recognition module within the complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VX09)

Name: Ionotropic receptor 7g
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in embryonic/larval gustatory receptor neurons; larval abdomen; and terminal organ.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: spoonbill
Description: Predicted to enable protein kinase A regulatory subunit binding activity. Involved in several processes, including follicle cell of egg chamber development; long-term memory; and positive regulation of cytoplasmic translation. Is active in mitochondrial outer membrane. Colocalizes with Golgi apparatus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; ovary; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human AKAP1 (A-kinase anchoring protein 1).

Name: Ras association domain family member 8
Description: Ras association domain family member 8 (RASSF8) encodes a member of the N-terminal RASSF protein family. It localises with the product of ASPP at the adherens junctions of epithelial cells where it promotes junction stability by repressing Src activity via C-terminal Src kinase.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal system; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and primary segmental tracheal branch primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in RNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; embryonic epidermis; extended germ band embryo; foregut; and germ layer. Orthologous to several human genes including CCDC85C (coiled-coil domain containing 85C).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human ZNF311 (zinc finger protein 311) and ZNF578 (zinc finger protein 578).

Name: sister of feo
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitotic spindle midzone assembly. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and mitotic spindle midzone. Is expressed in wing hinge primordium and wing pouch. Orthologous to human PRC1 (protein regulator of cytokinesis 1).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 62a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in labellum; leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; and tarsal segment 5.

Name: pickpocket 28
Description: pickpocket 28 (ppk28) encodes a member of the degenerin/epithelial Na[+] channel (pickpocket) gene family. It is an osmosensitive ion channel that mediates water taste detection.

Name: Nucleostemin 3
Description: GTPase required for the nuclear export of the 60S ribosomal subunit. Probably acts by mediating the release of Nmd3 from the 60S ribosomal subunit after export into the cytoplasm. Regulator of body size; acts in serotonergic neurons to regulate insulin signaling and thus exerts global growth control. (UniProtKB:Q9W590)

Name: oskar
Description: Organizes the germ plasm and directs localization of the posterior determinant nanos. Oskar protein is required to keep nos RNA and staufen protein at the posterior pole. (UniProtKB:P25158)

Name: Resistant to dieldrin
Description: Resistant to dieldrin (Rdl) encodes a widely-expressed ligand-gated chloride channel which mediates the fast inhibitory effects of GABA. It has been shown to have roles in the circuits underlying visual processing, odor coding, learning and memory, sleep and courtship behavior.

Name: pickpocket
Description: pickpocket (ppk) encodes an acid-sensing sodium channel from the degenerin/epithelial sodium channel (DEG/ENaC) family. It contributes to mechanical nociception, larval behavior and dendrite morphogenesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable acetylcholine receptor binding activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cholinergic synaptic transmission and positive regulation of neuromuscular synaptic transmission. Predicted to be active in neuromuscular junction and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital myasthenic syndrome 11 and fetal akinesia deformation sequence syndrome 2. Orthologous to human RAPSN (receptor associated protein of the synapse).

Name: couch potato
Description: couch potato (cpo) is most strongly expressed in nuclei of the central and peripheral nervous systems and the ring gland, where its product may regulate gene transcription to control complex neurological and neuroendocrine functions. It is required for normal synaptic transmission, climate adaptation, olfaction, diapause and  behavioral responses.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG31664 (FBgn0051664). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:1824172..1826500. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed within 18-24 hour embryonic stages, during early larval stages, in adult female stages.

Name: TBP-associated factor 6
Description: TBP-associated factor 6 (Taf6) encodes a protein that forms part of the multisubunit basal transcription factor TFIID, and it might be important for its stability. It forms a histone-like pair with the product of e(y)1. It is required during all stages of development, but particularly during imaginal disc development and gametogenesis.

Name: Dpr-interacting protein theta
Description: Involved in synapse organization. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection. Is expressed in optic lobe intrinsic neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ovarian cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including IGLON5 (IgLON family member 5); LSAMP (limbic system associated membrane protein); and NTM (neurotrimin).

Name: gcm2
Description: gcm2 (gcm2) encodes an atypical zinc finger transcription factor. It has a redudant role with the product of gcm in the differentiation of glial cells, plasmatocytes and tendon cells differentiation.

Name: atypical protein kinase C
Description: atypical protein kinase C (aPKC) encodes a member of the conserved Par complex and is asymmetrically localized to the apical cortex, where it phosphorylates and thus excludes the basal determinants encoded by mira and numb. It is involved in neuroblast proliferation and self-renewal.

Name: spinster
Description: spinster (spin) encodes a conserved transmembrane protein and a putative late-endosomal/lysosomal efflux permease. It is essential for mTOR reactivation and lysosome reformation following prolonged starvation and for regulation of TGF-beta/BMP pathways in motoneuron and eye development.

Name: Katanin 60
Description: Katanin 60 (Kat60) encodes a microtubule depolymerase involved in multiple microtubule-related processes including chromatid segregation, cell migration and dendrite development.

Name: N/A
Description: CG13204 encodes a protein predicted to be a transcriptional regulator. CG13204 overexpression can partially rescue hng1 loss of function, suggesting either epistasis or an overlaping function between hng1 and CG13204.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 85a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in larval abdomen.

Name: Bardet-Biedl syndrome 1
Description: Predicted to enable patched binding activity and smoothened binding activity. Involved in cilium assembly. Predicted to be located in cilium. Predicted to be part of BBSome. Predicted to be active in axoneme and centrosome. Is expressed in antenno-maxillary complex; chordotonal neurons; and eo neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Bardet-Biedl syndrome and Bardet-Biedl syndrome 1. Orthologous to human BBS1 (Bardet-Biedl syndrome 1).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 75b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Involved in detection of chemical stimulus involved in sensory perception. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in antennal coeloconic sensillum ac3.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and organism.

Name: Heparan sulfate 3-O sulfotransferase-A
Description: Heparan sulfate 3-O sulfotransferase-A (Hs3st-A) encodes a heparan sulfate modifying enzyme that transfers a sulfate group to the 3-O position of glucosamine residues of heparan sulfate. It regulates adult midgut homeostasis by repressing EGFR signaling.

Name: N/A
Description: Associated component of the MCM complex that acts as a regulator of DNA replication. Binds to the MCM complex during late S phase and may act by promoting the disassembly of the MCM complex from chromatin (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VM60)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable asparaginase activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid metabolic process. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; extended germ band embryo; larval ventral nerve cord; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human ASPG (asparaginase).

Name: vulcan
Description: vulcan (vlc) is induced above a basal level by 20-hydroxyecdysone in late third instar larvae. Its mutants die primarily as pharate adults with defects in ecdysone-induced leg morphogenesis.

Name: Calnexin 99A
Description: Calnexin 99A (Cnx99A) encodes an endoplasmic reticulum chaperone that colocalizes and genetically interacts with the sodium channel subunit encoded by para.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 94c
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in ventral cibarial sense organ neurons.

Name: slimfast
Description: Amino acid transporter - downregulation within the fat body causes a global growth defect involving TSC/TOR signaling in the fat body and a remote inhibition of organismal growth

Name: Sugar baby
Description: Sugar baby (Sugb) encodes a protein that determines lifespan.

Name: belphegor
Description: Required to maintain the proper number of mitochondria in neurons and muscles. (UniProtKB:Q9VEX6)

Name: Beta-alanine transporter
Description: Beta-alanine transporter (Balat) is predicted to encode a carnitine transporter, which catalyzes the movement of acyl-carnitine across the inner mitochondrial membrane. It is essential for metabolism of long-chain fatty acids.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; and endoderm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hypothyroidism and thyroid dyshormonogenesis 1. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC5A6 (solute carrier family 5 member 6).

Name: hemingway
Description: Involved in assembly and/or maintenance of motile cilia. Required during spermatogenesis for axoneme elongation. Necessary for optimal function of the chordotonal (hearing) organs. (UniProtKB:Q9VE87)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be part of ATP-binding activity cassette (ABC) transporter complex. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal ectoderm; early extended germ band embryo; embryonic/larval tracheal section; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in arteriosclerosis and sitosterolemia. Orthologous to human ABCG5 (ATP binding cassette subfamily G member 5).

Name: Chronologically inappropriate morphogenesis
Description: Chronologically inappropriate morphogenesis (chinmo) encodes a putative BTB-zinc finger transcription factor. It is essential for neuronal temporal patterning. It also plays a role in the regulation of eye development, tumor formation, and the self-renewal and/or sexual identity of male somatic cyst stem cells by acting downstream of JAK-STAT signaling.

Name: glass
Description: glass (gl) encodes a zinc finger transcription factor involved in cell fate specification. It is primarily transcribed in photoreceptors, where its expression is activated by the retinal determination member encoded by so. gl is required for correctly patterning the retina, rhabdomere formation, and for the expression of phototransduction proteins

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG33003 (FBgn0053003). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:4400953..4403142. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed within 12-18 embryonic stages, during early larval stages.

Name: Electron transfer flavoprotein-ubiquinone oxidoreductase
Description: Electron transfer flavoprotein-ubiquinone oxidoreductase (Etf-QO) encodes a mitochondrial membrane bound protein that acts as a hub with the product of wal and fuels electrons from fatty acid oxidation by matrix dehydrogenases into the respiratory chain.

Name: Dihydrouridine synthase 3
Description: Predicted to enable tRNA dihydrouridine synthase activity. Predicted to be involved in tRNA processing. Orthologous to human DUS3L (dihydrouridine synthase 3 like).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: Signal recognition particle 68
Description: Component of the signal recognition particle (SRP) complex, a ribonucleoprotein complex that mediates the cotranslational targeting of secretory and membrane proteins to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) (By similarity). The SRP complex interacts with the signal sequence in nascent secretory and membrane proteins and directs them to the membrane of the ER (By similarity). The SRP complex targets the ribosome-nascent chain complex to the SRP receptor (SR), which is anchored in the ER, where SR compaction and GTPase rearrangement drive cotranslational protein translocation into the ER (By similarity). Binds the signal recognition particle RNA (7SL RNA), Srp72 binds to this complex subsequently (By similarity). The SRP complex possibly participates in the elongation arrest function (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VSS2)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of chitin-based cuticle. Predicted to be involved in cell morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in membrane.

Name: Diuretic hormone 31 Receptor
Description: Diuretic hormone 31 Receptor (Dh31-R) encodes a protein that exhibits diuretic hormone receptor activity. It is involved in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathwayS.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in intraciliary transport. Located in axoneme. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leber congenital amaurosis 5. Orthologous to several human genes including LCA5L (lebercilin LCA5 like).

Name: KP78b
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity and tau-protein kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in intracellular signal transduction; microtubule cytoskeleton organization; and protein phosphorylation. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in mesoderm.

Name: dampened
Description: dampened (dmpd) encodes a nuclear F-box protein that acts as a co-activator of the product of bcd in modulating the expression level of its target gene hb.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable neurexin family protein binding activity and signaling receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including neuron cell-cell adhesion; synapse assembly; and synaptic vesicle endocytosis. Predicted to be active in cell surface and postsynaptic membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Asperger syndrome and autistic disorder. Orthologous to human NLGN4X (neuroligin 4 X-linked) and NLGN4Y (neuroligin 4 Y-linked).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval posterior spiracle and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Replication protein A1
Description: As part of the heterotrimeric replication protein A complex (RPA/RP-A), binds and stabilizes single-stranded DNA intermediates, that form during DNA replication or upon DNA stress. It prevents their reannealing and in parallel, recruits and activates different proteins and complexes involved in DNA metabolism. Thereby, it plays an essential role both in DNA replication and the cellular response to DNA damage. (UniProtKB:Q24492)

Name: Ionotropic receptor 100a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Involved in sensory perception of taste. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in dorsal cibarial sense organ neurons; gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis; gustatory receptor neuron of the hypopharyngeal organ; hypopharyngeal organ; and labral sense organ neurons.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA and protein phosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Predicted to be part of preribosome, small subunit precursor. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; gastrula embryo; germline cell; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and wing disc. Orthologous to human RIOK3 (RIO kinase 3).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 56a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in abdomen; adult external thorax; gustatory system; and labral sense organ neurons.

Name: Concentrative nucleoside transporter 2
Description: Predicted to enable nucleoside:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in nucleoside transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; amnioserosa; gut section; and yolk nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC28A1 (solute carrier family 28 member 1) and SLC28A2 (solute carrier family 28 member 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human SLC22A7 (solute carrier family 22 member 7).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sulfate transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human SLC26A11 (solute carrier family 26 member 11).

Name: Amphiphysin
Description: Amphiphysin (Amph) encodes a BAR and SH3 domain containing protein that regulates muscle transverse tubule formation. It exhibits post-synaptic localization at the neuromuscular junction and its mutants show locomotion defects.

Name: defective proboscis extension response 9
Description: Involved in behavioral response to ethanol and synapse organization. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection membrane. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: l(3)mbt interacting protein 1
Description: l(3)mbt interacting protein 1 (Lint-1) encodes a nuclear protein that associates with the product of l(3)mbt in the LINT complex. It is involved in the repression of malignant brain tumor signature (MBTS) genes.

Name: nessun dorma
Description: Required during male meiosis for completion of spermatocyte cytokinesis and possibly also required in female germline cells. Also involved in ring canal formation in male and female germline cells. Not essential for cleavage furrow ingression but is required for contractile ring stability and the attachment of the furrowing membrane to the actomyosin ring in late telophase. Displays high binding affinity for beta-galactosides. (UniProtKB:Q9VIP0)

Name: portabella
Description: portabella (prt) encodes an orphan vesicular transporter expressed in a discrete number of cells in larvae and adults, including Kenyon cells of the mushroom bodies. prt depletion produces male mating behavior defects and a modest learning deficit.

Name: Synaptotagmin beta
Description: Predicted to enable several functions, including calcium ion binding activity; phospholipid binding activity; and syntaxin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to calcium ion; regulated exocytosis; and regulation of secretion by cell. Predicted to be located in membrane and synaptic vesicle. Predicted to be active in exocytic vesicle and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult brain. Orthologous to human SYT13 (synaptotagmin 13).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable snoRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be part of Pwp2p-containing subcomplex of 90S preribosome and small-subunit processome. Orthologous to human UTP6 (UTP6 small subunit processome component).

Name: Nucleosome-destabilizing factor
Description: Nucleosome-destabilizing factor (Ndf) encodes a putative H3K36me3 binding protein, which binds active gene bodies.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable nucleic acid binding activity. Orthologous to human AGGF1 (angiogenic factor with G-patch and FHA domains 1).

Name: nubbin
Description: nubbin (nub) encodes a POU/homeodomain transcription factor that is expressed in the nascent wing primordium and is required for wing formation.

Name: schumacher-levy
Description: Is expressed in adult head; elongation stage spermatid; gonad; and primary spermatocyte.

Name: Hormone-receptor-like in 78
Description: Hormone-receptor-like in 78 (Hr78) encodes a protein induced above a basal level by 20-hydroxyecdysone. Hr78 mutants die during mid-larval stages with defects in molting of the tracheal cuticle.

Name: Octopamine-Tyramine receptor
Description: Octopamine-Tyramine receptor (Oct-TyrR) encodes a Tyramine 1 class receptor. When heterologously expressed it shows agonist specific coupling, with tyramine being more potent than octopamine in the inhibition of adenylyl cyclase activity and octopamine being more potent than tyramine in the release of calcium from internal stores.

Name: M-spondin
Description: Involved in regulation of myoblast fusion. Located in collagen-containing extracellular matrix. Is expressed in several structures, including adult external thorax; anlage in statu nascendi; embryonic/larval circulatory system; embryonic/larval muscle system; and presumptive embryonic/larval nervous system. Orthologous to human SPON2 (spondin 2).

Name: ken and barbie
Description: ken and barbie (ken) encodes a transcription factor involved in genital formation.

Name: Nuclear factor Y-box C
Description: Nuclear factor Y-box C (Nf-YC) encodes a transcription factor involved in axon guidance.

Name: ceramide transfer protein
Description: ceramide transfer protein (cert) encodes a protein involved in determination of lifespan. Mutant flies present accelerated aging due to oxidative stress.

Name: rumpel
Description: Enables solute:sodium symporter activity. Involved in organic substance transport. Is active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; adult main segment of Malpighian tubule; larval ventral nerve cord; and lateral cord neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hypothyroidism and thyroid dyshormonogenesis 1. Orthologous to human SLC5A12 (solute carrier family 5 member 12); SLC5A5 (solute carrier family 5 member 5); and SLC5A8 (solute carrier family 5 member 8).

Name: Maltase A6
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: N/A
Source: Predicted to be a structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly; flagellated sperm motility; and microtubule nucleation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in microtubule cytoskeleton. Is expressed in spermatozoon and testis. Orthologous to human TEKT3 (tektin 3) and TEKT5 (tektin 5).
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly; flagellated sperm motility; and microtubule nucleation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in microtubule cytoskeleton. Is expressed in spermatozoon and testis. Orthologous to human TEKT3 (tektin 3) and TEKT5 (tektin 5).

Name: cinnamon
Description: Catalyzes two steps in the biosynthesis of the molybdenum cofactor. In the first step, molybdopterin is adenylated. Subsequently, molybdate is inserted into adenylated molybdopterin and AMP is released. (UniProtKB:P39205)

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 1
Description: Catalyzes the initial reaction in O-linked oligosaccharide biosynthesis, the transfer of an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue to a serine or threonine residue on the protein receptor (PubMed:12829714). It can both act as a peptide transferase that transfers GalNAc onto unmodified peptide substrates, and as a glycopeptide transferase that requires the prior addition of a GalNAc on a peptide before adding additional GalNAc moieties. Prefers the monoglycosylated Muc5AC-3 as substrate (PubMed:12829714). (UniProtKB:Q6WV20)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; and gut section. Orthologous to human SLC46A2 (solute carrier family 46 member 2).

Name: cookie monster
Description: cookie monster (comr) encodes a protein involved in spermatogenesis and transcription regulation.

Name: short neuropeptide F receptor
Description: short neuropeptide F receptor (sNPF-R) encodes the G-protein-coupled receptor for the  neuropeptide ligand encoded by sNPF, which utilizes the intracelluar ERK pathway or PKA-CREB pathway. It contributes to the regulation of growth, food intake, food-search behavior, appetitive memory, and sleep.

Name: lethal (3) 05822
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval garland cell; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo.

Name: Sodium/solute co-transporter-like 5A11
Description: Sodium/solute co-transporter-like 5A11 (SLC5A11) encodes a protein involved in behavioral response to nutrient.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 48b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis.

Name: Sphingomyelin synthase related
Description: A phosphatidylethanolamine (PE)/ceramide ethanolamine phosphotransferase that catalyzes the synthesis of ceramide phosphoethanolamines (CPE), a class of lipids that is a sphingomyelin analog and a major membrane constituent in Drosophila. Transfers the head group from PE (1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine) on to different ceramides such as N-acylsphinganine (dihydroceramide) and N-acyl-(4R)-hydroxysphinganine (phytoceramide) to form N-acyl-sphinganine-1-phosphoethanolamine and N-acyl-(4R)-hydroxysphinganine-1-phosphoethanolamine, respectively. Operates as a ceramide sensor to control ceramide homeostasis in the endoplasmic reticulum, which is critical for the integrity of the early secretory pathway. (UniProtKB:Q9VS60)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Orthologous to several human genes including GPR75-ASB3 (GPR75-ASB3 readthrough); ASB14 (ankyrin repeat and SOCS box containing 14); and ASB15 (ankyrin repeat and SOCS box containing 15).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in microtubule cytoskeleton organization; mitochondrial transport; and plasma membrane bounded cell projection organization. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Goldberg-Shprintzen syndrome. Orthologous to human KIFBP (kinesin family binding protein).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in monocarboxylic acid transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cataract 47. Orthologous to human SLC16A12 (solute carrier family 16 member 12); SLC16A3 (solute carrier family 16 member 3); and SLC16A5 (solute carrier family 16 member 5).

Name: Malic enzyme like-2
Description: Predicted to enable malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NADP+) activity. Predicted to be involved in malate metabolic process and pyruvate metabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transcription corepressor activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human SCAI (suppressor of cancer cell invasion).

Name: forkhead domain 102C
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in anatomical structure morphogenesis; cell differentiation; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior ectoderm; anterior ectoderm anlage; embryonic pars intercerebralis; extended germ band embryo; and foregut. Orthologous to human FOXJ2 (forkhead box J2) and FOXJ3 (forkhead box J3).

Name: Potassium channel modulatory factor 1
Description: Has intrinsic E3 ubiquitin ligase activity and promotes ubiquitination. Involved in the negative regulation of the Ras/MAPK signaling pathway in the wing by acting with the E2 enzyme Unc6 and the putative E3 ligases poe and Ufd4 to mediate the ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of rl/MAPK. (UniProtKB:Q95RX5)

Name: Maltase A7
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: unkempt
Description: unkempt (unk) encodes a highly conserved protein with roles in mRNA binding and ubiquitination. Together with the product of heca, it acts downstream of the product of mTor to regulate photoreceptor differentiation during eye development.

Name: ballchen
Description: ballchen (ball) encodes a nuclear serine/threonine kinase that regulates chromatin organization through phosphorylation of the product of baf. It contributes to stem cell maintenance in various tissues, as well as chromosome condensation and segregation in meiosis.

Name: Solute carrier family 45 member 1
Description: Solute carrier family 45 member 1 (Slc45-1) encodes a proton/sucrose symporter occuring in apical membranes of the late embryonic hindgut as well as in vesicular membranes of ovarian follicle cells. It may either serve as an osmolyte transporter or be responsible for the resorption of sucrose.

Name: pickpocket 9
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 52c
Description: Ionotropic receptor 52c (Ir52c) encodes a protein involved in male mating behavior.

Name: refractory to sigma P
Description: Required for selective autophagy activation by ubiquitinated proteins (PubMed:22622177). Implicated in sigma rhabdovirus multiplication and necessary for male fertility. Involved in activating transcription of Drs (PubMed:12446795, PubMed:2510997). (UniProtKB:P14199)

Name: Ionotropic receptor 52a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult external thorax; adult gustatory receptor neurons; and spermatozoon.

Name: Pyrokinin 2 receptor 2
Description: Pyrokinin 2 receptor 2 (PK2-R2) encodes a G protein-coupled receptor that binds the neuropeptide encoded by Hug with high affinity. After binding, a second messenger cascade is initiated in cells that are target for the product of Hug (mainly neurons of the central nervous system).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary folate malabsorption. Orthologous to human SLC46A1 (solute carrier family 46 member 1) and SLC46A3 (solute carrier family 46 member 3).

Name: veil
Description: veil (veil) encodes a GPI-linked protein that functions as a 5'-nucleotidase.

Name: Scavenger receptor class C, type II
Description: Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in central brain primordium; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in dendrite morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: peroxisomal Multifunctional enzyme type 2
Description: peroxisomal Multifunctional enzyme type 2 (Mfe2) encodes a multifunctional protein harboring two separate enzyme activities: 2-enoyl-CoA hydratase 2 and 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase. They function in the peroxisomal fatty acid breakdown spiral of beta-oxidation utilizing the (R)-isomer of the CoA-containing substrate.

Name: Precursor RNA processing 3
Description: Precursor RNA processing 3 (Prp3) encodes a protein that regulates chromatin silencing.

Name: myoglianin
Description: myoglianin (myo) encodes a protein expressed primarily in muscle and glia cells. Mutations in myo affect neuronal remodeling during metamorphosis by failing to activate EcR expression in the remodeling neurons.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Predicted to be active in ciliary basal body. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human CFAP157 (cilia and flagella associated protein 157).

Name: spatzle 4
Description: Predicted to enable Toll binding activity and growth factor activity. Predicted to be involved in central nervous system formation; innate immune response; and regulation of Toll signaling pathway. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Star
Description: Star (S) encodes a type II transmembrane protein that facilitates trafficking of transmembrane Egfr ligands from the endoplasmic reticulum to the late secretory compartment. It is involved in growth regulation, cell survival and developmental patterning.

Name: lace
Description: lace (lace) encodes a serine C-palmitoyltransferase involved in sphingolipid biosynthesis.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon.

Name: supernumerary limbs
Description: supernumerary limbs (slmb) encodes an essential, conserved F-box protein and a component of the SCF (Skp/Cullin/F-box) E3 ubiquitin-ligase, providing substrate specificity to the SCF. It negatively regulates multiple signaling pathways and cellular processes by promoting the proteasome-mediated degradation or cleavage of its targets, including the products of arm and ci (Wg and Hh signaling), SAK, per and Cap-H2.

Name: pudgy
Description: pudgy (pdgy) encodes an acyl-CoA synthetase that activates fatty acids by conjugating them to CoA. It is a FOXO transcriptional target that preferentially activates fatty acids destined for beta-oxidation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable scavenger receptor activity. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval circulatory system; embryonic/larval digestive system; embryonic/larval fat body; extended germ band embryo; and yolk nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in progressive myoclonus epilepsy 4. Orthologous to human SCARB1 (scavenger receptor class B member 1) and SCARB2 (scavenger receptor class B member 2).

Name: Integrator 11
Description: Catalytic component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing (By similarity). Mediates the snRNAs 3' cleavage (By similarity). Involved in the 3'-end processing of the U7 snRNA, and also the spliceosomal snRNAs U1, U2, U4 and U5 (PubMed:21078872, PubMed:23097424). May mediate recruitment of cytoplasmic dynein to the nuclear envelope, probably as component of the INT complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VAH9)

Name: Cuticular protein 73D
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of chitin-based larval cuticle. Predicted to be involved in chitin-based cuticle development. Predicted to be active in chitin-based extracellular matrix. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic salivary gland duct; and embryonic ventral epidermis.

Name: pickpocket 26
Description: pickpocket 26 (ppk26) encodes a member of the Degenerin/epithelial sodium channel family. In the larva, it regulates locomotion behavior and participates in mechanical nociception together with the product of ppk.

Name: ZC3H3
Description: Required for the export of polyadenylated mRNAs from the nucleu; binds to polyadenylated mRNA, and is involved in the regulation of mRNA polyadenylation. (UniProtKB:Q9VSK8)

Name: Ras opposite
Description: May be a component of one of the vesicle trafficking pathways. May interact functionally with Ras2 protein. (UniProtKB:Q07327)

Name: Ionotropic receptor 51b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in acute kidney failure. Orthologous to human SLC22A1 (solute carrier family 22 member 1); SLC22A2 (solute carrier family 22 member 2); and SLC22A3 (solute carrier family 22 member 3).

Name: Alkaline phosphatase 4
Description: Important role in neural and renal epithelial function. (UniProtKB:Q24238)

Name: Chip
Description: Chip (Chi) encodes a transcriptional co-factor that regulates gene expression. It contributes to the regulation of Notch signaling, leg development and axon guidance.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-galactosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in N-glycan processing. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Ran GTPase activating protein
Description: GTPase activator for the nuclear Ras-related regulatory protein Ran, converting it to the putatively inactive GDP-bound state (By similarity). Trans-acting factor necessary for meiotic distortion (PubMed:10073941). Distortion is only seen in individuals that carry the RanGAP tandem duplication and express a RanGAP truncated protein. Binding of truncated RanGAP product to the Responder(RSP) locus initiates events that lead to sperm dysfunction (PubMed:10073941). During oogenesis, plays a role in the biogenesis of annulate lamellae containing nuclear pore complex components (PubMed:31626769). (UniProtKB:Q9VIW3)

Name: Hermansky-Pudlak Syndrome 1
Description: Predicted to contribute to guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in negative regulation of post-transcriptional gene silencing by RNA. Part of BLOC-3 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome 1 and oculocutaneous albinism. Orthologous to human HPS1 (HPS1 biogenesis of lysosomal organelles complex 3 subunit 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human ITFG1 (integrin alpha FG-GAP repeat containing 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable inositol monophosphate 1-phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in inositol metabolic process; inositol phosphate dephosphorylation; and signal transduction. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia. Orthologous to human IMPA2 (inositol monophosphatase 2).

Name: Alkaline phosphatase 12
Description: Predicted to enable alkaline phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cell surface. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 52b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in mesothoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; metathoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; prothoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; and wing.

Name: Thioredoxin reductase 1
Description: Thioredoxin system is a major player in glutathione metabolism, due to the demonstrated absence of a glutathione reductase. Functionally interacts with the Sod/Cat reactive oxidation species (ROS) defense system and thereby has a role in preadult development and life span. Lack of a glutathione reductase suggests antioxidant defense in Drosophila, and probably in related insects, differs fundamentally from that in other organisms. (UniProtKB:P91938)

Name: Trehalase
Description: Trehalase (Treh) encodes an enzyme that hydrolyzes the the disaccharide trehalose to two molecules of glucose in either the cytoplasm or the extracellular space.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon.

Name: Malvolio
Description: Malvolio (Mvl) encodes a member of the SLC11 family of metal ion transporters that transports divalent metal cations, including Mn[2+] and Fe[2+]. Its function has been linked to feeding-related decisions, possibly via modulation of dopaminergic signaling.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable phosphotransferase activity, alcohol group as acceptor. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glycerol kinase deficiency. Orthologous to human GK (glycerol kinase); GK2 (glycerol kinase 2); and GK3P (glycerol kinase 3 pseudogene).

Name: Chitinase 5
Description: Chitinase 5 (Cht5) encodes an enzyme involved in the formation of chitin-based extracellular matrix at barrier tissues.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable cobalamin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cobalamin transport. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital intrinsic factor deficiency and pernicious anemia. Orthologous to human CBLIF (cobalamin binding intrinsic factor) and TCN1 (transcobalamin 1).

Name: La related protein 7
Description: La related protein 7 (Larp7) encodes an obligate component of the 7SK snRNP. The 7SK snRNP plays an essential role in RNA polymerase II elongation control by regulating the activity of the positive transcription elongation factor complex encoded by Cdk9 and CycT.

Name: fidipidine
Description: Predicted to be involved in Golgi to plasma membrane transport. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human CCDC93 (coiled-coil domain containing 93).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable gamma-aminobutyric acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity and neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in neurotransmitter transport and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; adult thorax; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in creatine transporter deficiency and intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC6A11 (solute carrier family 6 member 11); SLC6A12 (solute carrier family 6 member 12); and SLC6A13 (solute carrier family 6 member 13).

Name: pickpocket 24
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: menage a trois
Description: menage a trois (metro) encodes controls the expansion of larval neuromuscular junctions (NMJs) and the proper establishment of synaptic boutons. At NMJs Metro associates with the adaptor protein encoded by veli to stabilize the product of dlg1 in a trimeric scaffold complex that limits the size of active zones and glutamate receptor fields.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sulfate transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; inclusive hindgut primordium; integumentary system; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human SLC26A11 (solute carrier family 26 member 11).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 94a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis; labral sense organ neurons; and ventral cibarial sense organ neurons.

Name: Collapsin Response Mediator Protein
Description: Collapsin Response Mediator Protein (CRMP) encodes a protein that contributes to pyrimidine catabolism, beta-alanine biosynthesis, neurogenesis and behavior.

Name: ryder cup
Description: Is expressed in elongation stage spermatid and primary spermatocyte.

Name: aramis
Description: Part of a translational control module, also containing pths/DDX47 and ath/DHX33, which coordinates germline stem cell differentiation with ribosome biogenesis during oogenesis. This module allows for coregulation of ribosomal proteins and non1/GTPBP4, a p53 repressor, preventing p53 stabilization, cell cycle arrest and loss of stem cell differentiation (PubMed:35413237). Controls cell cycle progression by regulating translation of mRNAs that contain a terminal oligo pyrimidine (TOP) motif in their 5' UTRs, such as non1 (PubMed:35413237). (UniProtKB:Q9VVK8)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be involved in extracellular matrix organization. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix and extracellular space.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable histone H3K79 methyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA damage checkpoint signaling; DNA repair; and regulation of transcription regulatory region DNA binding activity. Predicted to be active in nucleus.

Name: NELF-B
Description: Essential component of the NELF complex, a complex that negatively regulates the elongation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. (UniProtKB:Q9Y113)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable gamma-aminobutyric acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity and neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in neurotransmitter transport and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior-posterior subdivision of organism; extraembryonic structure; and yolk nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in creatine transporter deficiency and intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC6A11 (solute carrier family 6 member 11); SLC6A12 (solute carrier family 6 member 12); and SLC6A13 (solute carrier family 6 member 13).

Name: Suppressor of Hairless
Description: Transcriptional regulator that plays a central role in Notch signaling, a signaling pathway involved in cell-cell communication that regulates a broad spectrum of cell-fate determinations (PubMed:21262215, PubMed:1617729, PubMed:8674407, PubMed:10673509). Binds directly the 5'-GTGRGAR-3' DNA consensus sequence, which is present in the regulatory region of several genes (PubMed:10673509). Acts as a transcriptional repressor when it is not associated with Notch proteins (PubMed:10673509). When associated with some Notch protein, it acts as a transcriptional activator that activates transcription of Notch target genes (PubMed:10673509). Required for transcription of Sim (PubMed:10673509). Specifically binds to the immunoglobulin kappa-type J segment recombination signal sequence (PubMed:1744127, PubMed:1617730, PubMed:1617729). Required for neurogenesis in imaginal disks (PubMed:1617730, PubMed:7813798). In the larval brain, might play a role as a transducer of Notch signaling during type II neuroblast development (PubMed:21262215). Also functions independently of the Notch pathway, in the development of the bristle sensory organ precursor cell (PubMed:12642500). (UniProtKB:P28159)

Name: Ionotropic receptor 7d
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of terminal organ; larval abdomen; and terminal organ.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 52d
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Involved in reproductive behavior. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in mesothoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; metathoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; prothoracic leg; prothoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; and prothoracic tarsal bristle.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including labral sensory complex and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: wntless
Description: wntless (wls) encodes a multiple-pass transmembrane protein specifically required for the secretion of Wnt proteins. Its roles include growth regulation, cell survival and developmental patterning.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in embryonic dorsal epidermis; embryonic head epidermis; and embryonic ventral epidermis.

Name: Arginyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Predicted to enable arginine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in arginyl-tRNA aminoacylation and mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 6. Orthologous to human RARS2 (arginyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial).

Name: Caper
Description: Caper (Caper) encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing.

Name: az2
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in nurse cell; oocyte; organism; and ovary.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 47a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult integumentary system and gustatory receptor neurons.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including adult fat body; embryonic leading edge cell; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system; and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human AIFM3 (apoptosis inducing factor mitochondria associated 3).

Name: Acyl-CoA synthetase family member 2
Description: Predicted to enable medium-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty acid metabolic process. Predicted to be located in peroxisome. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ACSF2 (acyl-CoA synthetase family member 2).

Name: Allatostatin C receptor 2
Description: Allatostatin C receptor 2 (AstC-R2) encodes G-protein coupled receptor for the neuropeptide encoded by AstC.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 94d
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in larval abdomen.

Name: Neprilysin-like 11
Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and embryonic/larval fat body.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable glutathione hydrolase activity. Predicted to be involved in glutathione catabolic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase deficiency. Orthologous to human GGT1 (gamma-glutamyltransferase 1); GGT2P (gamma-glutamyltransferase 2, pseudogene); and GGT5 (gamma-glutamyltransferase 5).

Name: Transmembrane 9 superfamily protein member 3
Description: Predicted to be involved in protein localization to membrane. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and organism. Orthologous to human TM9SF3 (transmembrane 9 superfamily member 3).

Name: diamond
Description: Involved in chromosome organization. Located in cytosol and nucleoplasm. Colocalizes with chromatin. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; embryonic/larval muscle system; and germ layer.

Name: ichor
Description: Transcriptional activator. In tracheal terminal cells, regulates the transcription of factors involved in the formation of a mature apical extracellular matrix (aECM) which is essential for the integrity and shape of seamless tubes. (UniProtKB:Q9VHJ6)

Name: deformed wings
Description: deformed wings (dwg) encodes an architectural chromatin protein essential for embryonic development that organizes open chromatin in regulatory regions (predominantly promoters). dwg product binding site was found in the insulator encoded by scs, and its functions include enhancer blocking, support of distant interactions and recruitment of transcription factors.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 94b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis; labellar taste bristle; scolopidial ligament cell; spermatozoon; and ventral cibarial sense organ neurons.

Name: Sac1 phosphatase
Description: Sac1 phosphatase (Sac1) encodes a lipid phosphatase that dephosphorylates phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate to generate phosphatidylinositol. It is involved in dorsal closure, Hedgehog signaling and axon guidance.

Name: N/A
Description: Catalyzes RNA cleavage releasing a product with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate at the 3'-end. (UniProtKB:Q9VZ49)

Name: H6-like-homeobox
Description: Transcription factor involved in specification of neuronal cell types. (UniProtKB:Q9VEI9)

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 7
Description: Glycopeptide transferase involved in O-linked oligosaccharide biosynthesis, which catalyzes the transfer of an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue to an already glycosylated peptide (PubMed:11925450, PubMed:12829714). In contrast to other proteins of the family, it does not act as a peptide transferase that transfers GalNAc onto serine or threonine residue on the protein receptor, but instead requires the prior addition of a GalNAc on a peptide before adding additional GalNAc moieties (PubMed:11925450). Some peptide transferase activity is however not excluded, considering that its appropriate peptide substrate may remain unidentified. Prefers the monoglycosylated Muc5AC-3 as substrate (PubMed:11925450). Might have a role in protein O-glycosylation in the Golgi and thereby in establishing and/or maintaining a proper secretory apparatus structure (PubMed:20807760). (UniProtKB:Q8MV48)

Name: Sodium-dependent multivitamin transporter
Description: Sodium-dependent multivitamin transporter (Smvt) encodes a transmembrane protein responsible for translocation of vitamins, and other essential cofactors such as biotin, pantothenate and lipoate, in the presence of sodium.

Name: Protein phosphatase 2A at 29B
Description: Protein phosphatase 2A at 29B (Pp2A-29B) encodes the structural A subunit of the trimeric PP2A phosphatase enzyme. It links the catalytic C subunit encoded by mts and a variable regulatory B family subunit, which directs the enzyme to distinct substrates. The roles of Pp2A-29B product include centriole duplication, chromosome segregation, autophagy, axonal transport, growth regulation, and active zone stabilization.

Name: Spitting Image
Description: Spitting Image (Spt) encodes an F-actin binding and stabilizing protein. Spt and Sry-alpha represent a novel clade of the Vinculin/alpha-Catenin superfamily. The product of Spt is maternally provided in early embryos, and it positively regulates F-actin levels during cellularization.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG44405 (FBgn0265578). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2L:16340392..16342324. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported.

Name: pickpocket 23
Description: pickpocket 23 (ppk23) encodes a gustatory-specific putative non-voltage gated cation channel that belongs to the Degenerin/Epithelial sodium channel (DEG/ENaC) family. It contributes to pheromone perception and male courtship behavior.

Name: Lysine demethylase 4B
Description: Lysine (K)-specific demethylase 4B (Kdm4B) encodes a histone demethylase that removes methyl groups from histone 3 lysines 9 and 36. It participates in DNA repair and transcription regulation.

Name: alan shepard
Description: alan shepard (shep) encodes an evolutionarily conserved RNA/DNA binding protein that regulates alternative splicing and gypsy insulator activities. It regulates neural development during the embryonic and larval stages, and neuronal remodeling during metamorphosis.

Name: CoRest
Description: CoRest (CoRest) encodes a DNA binding factor that controls transcription in cooperation with other transcriptional regulators. It positively modulates Notch signaling as well as showing co-repressor activity via histone modification regulation.

Name: I'm not dead yet
Description: I'm not dead yet (Indy) encodes a plasma membrane transporter of Krebs cycle intermediates (citrate, succinate, fumarate, alpha-ketoglutarate) of the SLC13A family that is important in organismal intermediary metabolism. Mutations in Indy create a favorable metabolic state, similar to calorie restriction, and extend life span.

Name: Concentrative nucleoside transporter 1
Description: Predicted to enable nucleoside:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in nucleoside transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human SLC28A1 (solute carrier family 28 member 1); SLC28A2 (solute carrier family 28 member 2); and SLC28A3 (solute carrier family 28 member 3).

Name: stargazin-like protein
Description: stargazin-like protein (stg1) encodes a channel regulator that modulates both AMPA receptor activity and glutamatergic synaptic transmission.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable IMP cyclohydrolase activity and phosphoribosylaminoimidazolecarboxamide formyltransferase activity. Involved in wound healing. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including early extended germ band embryo; embryonic Malpighian tubule; foregut primordium; gut section; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in purine-pyrimidine metabolic disorder. Orthologous to human ATIC (5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase/IMP cyclohydrolase).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hypothyroidism and thyroid dyshormonogenesis 1. Orthologous to human SLC5A12 (solute carrier family 5 member 12); SLC5A5 (solute carrier family 5 member 5); and SLC5A8 (solute carrier family 5 member 8).

Name: abdominal A
Description: abdominal A (abd-A) encodes a homeobox-containing transcription factor component of the bithorax complex. It contributes to the developmental fate of embryonic segments.

Name: Neurotransmitter transporter-like
Description: Neurotransmitter transporter-like (Ntl) encodes a glycine transporter of the SLC6 class, closely related to neurotransmitter transporters and other amino acid transporters. Ntl expression is testes-specific and its mutants are male-sterile, producing sperm with a significant reduction in glycylated tubulin.

Name: Polypeptide N-Acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 8
Description: Catalyzes the initial reaction in O-linked oligosaccharide biosynthesis, the transfer of an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue to a serine or threonine residue on the protein receptor. It can both act as a peptide transferase that transfers GalNAc onto unmodified peptide substrates, and as a glycopeptide transferase that requires the prior addition of a GalNAc on a peptide before adding additional GalNAc moieties. Prefers both EA2 and the diglycosylated Muc5AC-3/13 as substrates, albeit at very low levels fro Muc5AC-3/13. (UniProtKB:Q9VUT6)

Name: ectodermal
Description: Involved in cuticle development and tube development. Is expressed in embryonic/larval gut; epithelium; foregut primordium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Cytochrome P450 49a1
Description: May be involved in the metabolism of insect hormones and in the breakdown of synthetic insecticides. (UniProtKB:Q9V5L3)

Name: Translocase of outer membrane 70
Description: Translocase of outer membrane 70 (Tom70) encodes a mitochondrial protein that may act as a receptor of the TOM complex based on orthology. TOM complex is involved in protein import into mitochondria. The product of Tom70 modulates cell death induced by the expression of the mouse Bax protein.

Name: meiosis I arrest
Description: meiosis I arrest (mia) encodes a paralog of the generally expressed TBP-associated factor encoded by Taf6. mia is expressed only in differentiating male germ cells, starting in the spermatocyte stage. Along with four other testis-specific TBP-associated factors, the product of mia is required for full levels of transcript production from multiple genes expressed in primary spermatocytes in preparation for meiotic cell cycle progression and spermatid differentiation.

Name: dim gamma-tubulin 1
Description: Located in nucleus. Part of NSL complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human KANSL2 (KAT8 regulatory NSL complex subunit 2).

Name: sprouty
Description: Inhibitor of tracheal branching that restricts branch budding by antagonizing the BNL-FGF pathway (BNL: branchless, an fgf inducer of branching). Acts as an antagonist of EGFR-mediated signaling in the eye (where it is important for cell determination) midline glia, chordotonal organs, wing and ovarian follicle cells. (UniProtKB:O44783)

Name: Phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase, beta-subunit
Description: Phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase, beta-subunit (beta-PheRS) encodes a cytoplasmic aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase that catalyzes the ligation of Phenylalanine to its cognate tRNAPhe. Together with the alpha-subunit it forms a tetrameric enzyme complex. This subunit plays a role in recognition and binding of tRNAPhe and it provides the editing site that hydrolyzes wrongfully activated or ligated compounds.

Name: Intraflagellar transport 54
Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Involved in cilium assembly. Predicted to be located in cilium. Predicted to be part of intraciliary transport particle B. Predicted to be active in axoneme; centrosome; and ciliary basal body. Is expressed in antenno-maxillary complex; chordotonal neurons; and eo neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Senior-Loken syndrome. Orthologous to human TRAF3IP1 (TRAF3 interacting protein 1).

Name: decapentaplegic
Description: decapentaplegic (dpp) encodes a ligand of the transforming growth factor-beta signaling pathway that signals through Smad transcription factors. It acts as a morphogen that contributes to growth regulation, patterning and stem cell fate.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-galactosyltransferase activity.

Name: unc-4
Description: unc-4 (unc-4) encodes a homeodomain transcription factor expressed in distinct subsets of neurons in the embryonic and post-embryonic CNS. It regulates neuronal development and differentiation at least in part via repressing the expression of HGTX. It contributes to neuronal specification and differentiation, specifically axonal pathfinding and axongenesis.

Name: Enhancer of variegation 3-9
Description: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Involved in chromatin organization. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Maltase A8
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hypothyroidism and thyroid dyshormonogenesis 1. Orthologous to human SLC5A12 (solute carrier family 5 member 12); SLC5A5 (solute carrier family 5 member 5); and SLC5A8 (solute carrier family 5 member 8).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable glycoprotein-N-acetylgalactosamine 3-beta-galactosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in O-glycan processing, core 1. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in nurse cell and testis. Orthologous to human C1GALT1 (core 1 synthase, glycoprotein-N-acetylgalactosamine 3-beta-galactosyltransferase 1).

Name: transcriptional Adaptor 3
Description: transcriptional Adaptor 3 (Ada3) encodes subunit of some chromatin modifying complexes.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in chorion-containing eggshell formation. Predicted to be located in egg chorion.

Name: Dorsal root ganglia homeobox
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Is expressed in central brain primordium; embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; organism; and ventral nerve cord primordium. Orthologous to human DRGX (dorsal root ganglia homeobox).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable lysophosphatidic acid phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human PXYLP1 (2-phosphoxylose phosphatase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in clypeo-labral anlage in statu nascendi; dorsal ectoderm; extended germ band embryo; and larval foregut atrium.

Name: nord
Description: Secretory protein that acts as a feedback regulator of dpp/BMP, wg and hh signaling pathways (PubMed:35609633, PubMed:35037619). In the developing wing, is a dosage-dependent modulator of dpp/BMP signaling involved in wing growth and crossvein patterning; low levels promote and high levels inhibit dpp/BMP signaling (PubMed:35609633, PubMed:35037619). In the early pupal wing, inhibits dpp/BMP signaling activity to prevent the formation of ectopic crossveins in the posterior compartment (PubMed:35609633, PubMed:35037619). Binds to dpp and gbb to modulate their release and activity decreasing dpp/BMP signaling in the responding cells (PubMed:35609633, PubMed:35037619). During wing development regulates dpp/BMP coreceptor dally availability on the cell surface (PubMed:35609633). Might have a role in testis development (PubMed:35609633). (UniProtKB:Q9W192)

Name: skywalker
Description: skywalker (sky) encodes a RabGAP that genetically interacts with and activates GTPase activity of the product of Rab35 through an unconventional mechanism. It restricts the ability of synaptic vesicles to fuse into a synaptic endosomal compartment, thereby limiting synaptic vesicle associated protein sorting at synaptic endosomes. In line with this function, sky also genetically interacts with components of the ESCRT and HOPS complexes.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult brain cell body rind; adult brain perineurial glial cell; adult head; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hypothyroidism and thyroid dyshormonogenesis 1. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC5A6 (solute carrier family 5 member 6).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in anterior spiracle primordium; embryonic anal pad; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; organism; and posterior spiracle primordium.

Name: HGTX
Description: HGTX (HGTX) encodes a homeodomain transcription factor that acts in parallel with the product of exex to promote the development and differentiation of motor neurons that innervate ventral body wall muscles. Its major roles include neuronal specification and differentiation.

Name: alpha-Esterase-9
Description: Predicted to enable carboxylic ester hydrolase activity. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human CES2 (carboxylesterase 2).

Name: alpha-1,3-mannosyl-glycoprotein 4-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase a
Description: Predicted to enable acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein N-linked glycosylation. Predicted to be active in Golgi stack; endoplasmic reticulum; and endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi intermediate compartment. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to several human genes including MGAT4A (alpha-1,3-mannosyl-glycoprotein 4-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase A) and MGAT4B (alpha-1,3-mannosyl-glycoprotein 4-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase B).

Name: brother of rumpel
Description: Enables solute:sodium symporter activity. Involved in organic substance transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; larval ventral nerve cord; and lateral cord. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hypothyroidism and thyroid dyshormonogenesis 1. Orthologous to human SLC5A12 (solute carrier family 5 member 12); SLC5A5 (solute carrier family 5 member 5); and SLC5A8 (solute carrier family 5 member 8).

Name: Sox21b
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in anatomical structure morphogenesis; cell differentiation; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Is expressed in several structures, including ectodermal derivative; epidermal cell; imaginal disc; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Orthologous to several human genes including SOX21 (SRY-box transcription factor 21).

Name: Integrator 14
Description: Component of the Integrator complex, a complex involved in the transcription of small nuclear RNAs (snRNA) and their 3'-box-dependent processing. Involved in the 3'-end processing of the U7 snRNA, and also the spliceosomal snRNAs U1 and U5. (UniProtKB:Q9VPY0)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic brain and larval ventral nerve cord.

Name: Tyrosine decarboxylase 1
Description: Tyrosine decarboxylase 1 (Tdc1) encodes a protein involved in behavioral response to ethanol.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG15252 (FBgn0030167). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:9978153..9980564. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very low expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed within 12-24 hour embryonic stages, during early larval stages, at stages throughout the pupal period.

Name: Transport and Golgi organization 10
Description: Involved in protein secretion. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human BTBD17 (BTB domain containing 17).

Name: pickpocket 20
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in wing disc.

Name: Deformed
