Description: Deformed (Dfd) encodes a homeobox-containing transcription factor mainly involved in proper morphological identity of the maxillary segment and the posterior half of the mandibular segment.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in protein import into nucleus. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm.

Name: glorund
Description: glorund (glo) encodes a hnRNP F/H family RNA-binding protein that binds directly to nanos mRNA and regulates its translation during late stages of oogenesis. The functions of the product of glo include nurse cell nuclear chromatin organization, axis patterning as well as being required for viability to adulthood.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human CNBD2 (cyclic nucleotide binding domain containing 2).

Name: dawdle
Description: dawdle (daw) encodes an Activin- like ligand of the TGF beta superfamily that is required for proper tricarboxylic acid cycle function in the fat body and also regulates insulin release from IPC neurons.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable histone deacetylase binding activity and transcription corepressor activity. Predicted to be involved in histone deacetylation and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm anlage; embryonic brain; extended germ band embryo; and gonad. Orthologous to several human genes including MIER1 (MIER1 transcriptional regulator).

Name: Tyramine receptor II
Description: Tyramine receptor II (TyrRII) encodes a Tyramine 3 class receptor. When heterologously expressed it shows a high affinity for both tyramine and phenylethylamine, and a lower affinity for a range of other related biogenic amines, in both the inhibition of adenylyl cyclase activity and in the release of calcium from internal stores.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human NME9 (NME/NM23 family member 9).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 54a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane.

Name: Tektin A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cilium assembly and cilium movement involved in cell motility. Predicted to be active in microtubule cytoskeleton. Is expressed in several structures, including chordotonal organ precursor cell; embryonic head sensory system; male germline cell; sensory nervous system primordium; and ventral sensory complex primordium. Orthologous to human TEKT4 (tektin 4).

Name: methuselah-like 10
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; determination of adult lifespan; and response to starvation. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including central nervous system; embryonic/larval crystal cell; gut; integumentary system; and larval imaginal tissue.

Name: NtR
Description: Predicted to enable excitatory extracellular ligand-gated ion channel activity and transmitter-gated ion channel activity involved in regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including chemical synaptic transmission; ion transmembrane transport; and regulation of membrane potential. Predicted to be active in neuron projection; plasma membrane; and synapse. Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal imaginal tissue; embryonic/larval plasmatocyte; extended germ band embryo; labral sensory complex primordium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Transcription factor B1
Description: Transcription factor B1 (Tfb1) encodes a subunit of the Transcription factor II H complex (TFIIH). TFIIH operates in RNA polymerase I and II-mediated transcription, DNA repair and cell cycle regulation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle cell; extended germ band embryo; spermatozoon; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human GSTCD (glutathione S-transferase C-terminal domain containing).

Name: lethal (3) 04053
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; and germ layer.

Name: ohgata
Description: ohgata (ohgt) encodes a protein that controls growth by negatively regulating insulin signaling. It also has a role in maintaining presynaptic function in third-instar neuromuscular junction synapses.

Name: RIO kinase 1
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in positive regulation of glial cell proliferation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Predicted to be part of preribosome, small subunit precursor. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in anterior midgut primordium; embryonic/larval midgut; organism; and posterior midgut primordium. Orthologous to human RIOK1 (RIO kinase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable gamma-aminobutyric acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity and neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in neurotransmitter transport and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in creatine transporter deficiency and intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC6A11 (solute carrier family 6 member 11); SLC6A12 (solute carrier family 6 member 12); and SLC6A13 (solute carrier family 6 member 13).

Name: Ecto-5'-nucleotidase 2
Description: Ecto-5'-nucleotidase 2 (NT5E-2) encodes a glycosyl phosphatidylinositol (GPI)-linked membrane-bound glycoprotein with 5'-nucleotidase activity that converts extracellular AMP to adenosine.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sulfuric ester hydrolase activity. Involved in defense response to bacterium. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mucopolysaccharidosis VI. Orthologous to human ARSB (arylsulfatase B); ARSI (arylsulfatase family member I); and ARSJ (arylsulfatase family member J).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Lynch syndrome and mismatch repair cancer syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC22A10 (solute carrier family 22 member 10); SLC22A11 (solute carrier family 22 member 11); and SLC22A12 (solute carrier family 22 member 12).

Name: Zyxin
Description: Zyxin (Zyx) encodes an actin cytoskeleton regulator found at cell-matrix junctions and cell-cell adherens junctions. Its roles include mechanotransduction and regulation of the Hippo signaling pathway.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-galactose:beta-N-acetylglucosamine beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase activity. Involved in synaptic target recognition. Predicted to be active in Golgi membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; blastoderm embryo; ectoderm anlage; embryonic epipharynx; and trunk ectoderm. Orthologous to human B3GALT1 (beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase 1); B3GALT2 (beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase 2); and B3GALT5 (beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase 5).

Name: dynein, axonemal, intermediate chain 2
Description: dynein, axonemal, intermediate chain 2 (Dnai2) encodes a subunit of the axonemal dynein complex. It is involved in the perception of sound and sperm competititon.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human ANKRD13C (ankyrin repeat domain 13C).

Name: Regena
Description: Component of the CCR4-NOT complex which is one of the major cellular mRNA deadenylases and is linked to various cellular processes including bulk mRNA degradation, miRNA-mediated repression, translational repression during translational initiation and general transcription regulation (PubMed:20504953, PubMed:23303381). Additional complex functions may be a consequence of its influence on mRNA expression (PubMed:23303381). Essential for viability (PubMed:9475742). Acts as a suppressor of position effect variegation (PEV) at the white locus and regulates the expression of several unrelated genes (PubMed:9475742). Plays a role in germline stem cell differentiation in the ovaries (PubMed:29887366). (UniProtKB:Q94547)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable glutathione hydrolase activity. Predicted to be involved in glutathione catabolic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including GGT1 (gamma-glutamyltransferase 1) and GGT2P (gamma-glutamyltransferase 2, pseudogene).

Name: Matrix metalloproteinase 1
Description: Matrix metalloproteinase 1 (Mmp1) encodes a proteinase that cleaves proteins in the extracellular matrix. It is involved in tissue histolysis and remodeling during metamorphosis, tracheal remodeling, wound healing, wing regeneration, neoplastic growth, and circadian behavior. It has been used as a reporter for JNK signaling since it is upregulated by the pathway.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in AMP catabolic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary arterial and articular multiple calcification syndrome. Orthologous to human NT5E (5'-nucleotidase ecto).

Name: Cholecystokinin-like receptor at 17D3
Description: Cholecystokinin-like receptor at 17D3 (CCKLR-17D3) encodes a class A transmembrane G protein coupled receptor that binds the neuropeptide ligand encoded by Dsk. It acts through the cAMP-PKA-CREB pathway and it is needed for the growth of neuromuscular junctions. It regulates food ingestion, satiety, hyperactivity, aggression and escape-related locomotion.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in anterior ectoderm; anterior ectoderm anlage; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; extended germ band embryo; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Maltase B1
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult fat body and adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: doughnut on 2
Description: doughnut on 2 (dnt) encodes a Ryk family Wnt receptor-tyrosine kinase-related protein. It can form homo- and heterodimers with the other two Ryks (encoded by Drl-2 and drl) via binding the ligand encoded by Wnt5. dnt and drl products act during embryonic muscle attachment site selection.

Name: Calcineurin A at 14F
Description: Calcium-dependent, calmodulin-stimulated protein phosphatase. This subunit may have a role in the calmodulin activation of calcineurin. (UniProtKB:Q9VXF1)

Name: Ionotropic receptor 67a
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of the ventral organ; mesothoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; metathoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons; and prothoracic leg taste bristle chemosensory neurons.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG42272 (FBgn0259167). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:5803033..5805749. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages.

Name: Pak3
Description: Pak3 (Pak3) encodes a Ser/Thr kinase implicated in myoblast fusion, synapse development, wound healing and border cell migration. It functions downstream of the small Rac GTPases to regulate actin cytoskeletal organization.

Name: Exonuclease 3'-5' domain-containing 2
Description: 3'-5' exoribonuclease required for mitochondrial metabolism. (UniProtKB:Q9VGN7)

Name: Short Calcium-binding Mitochondrial Carrier
Description: Short Calcium-binding Mitochondrial Carrier (SCaMC) encodes a mitochondrial carrier family protein with calcium-binding motifs. SCaMC transcripts are strongly detected in the corpora allata, suggesting its potential role in juvenile hormone biosynthesis.

Name: Start1
Description: May bind to and transport cholesterol and may play a role in ecdysteroid biosynthesis. (UniProtKB:Q9W145)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carboxylic ester hydrolase activity. Orthologous to human CES3 (carboxylesterase 3) and CES4A (carboxylesterase 4A).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Meiotic central spindle
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytoplasm; nucleus; and spindle microtubule. Is expressed in dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell; embryonic/larval muscle system; head mesoderm; organism; and trunk mesoderm. Orthologous to human ZNF254 (zinc finger protein 254); ZNF726 (zinc finger protein 726); and ZNF93 (zinc finger protein 93).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable polyamine oxidase activity. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lung non-small cell carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including PAOX (polyamine oxidase).

Name: N/A
Description: Potential regulator of CDK5 activity. (UniProtKB:Q9VGZ1)

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 305 member A1
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in osteoporosis. Orthologous to several human genes including UGT2A1 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member A1 complex locus); UGT2A2 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member A2); and UGT2A3 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member A3).

Name: Maltase B2
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable gamma-aminobutyric acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity and neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in neurotransmitter transport and sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection and plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; adult thorax; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in creatine transporter deficiency and intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC6A11 (solute carrier family 6 member 11); SLC6A12 (solute carrier family 6 member 12); and SLC6A13 (solute carrier family 6 member 13).

Name: Protein kinase, cAMP-dependent, catalytic subunit 3
Description: Does not have an essential role in development. (UniProtKB:P16912)

Name: four-jointed
Description: four-jointed (fj) encodes a type II transmembrane kinase. Through phosphorylation of the atypical cadherins encoded by ft and ds, it regulates control of planar polarity in epithelia and also growth via the Hippo/Warts pathway.

Name: Ada2a-containing complex component 3
Description: Ada2a-containing complex component 3 (Atac3) encodes a protein involved in chromatin remodeling and histone acetylation.

Name: Hormone receptor 51
Description: Hormone receptor 51 (Hr51) encodes a chromatin binding protein that regulates gene expression and contributes to axon guidance, neuron remodeling, mushroom body development and circadian rhythm regulation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable FMN binding activity; flavin adenine dinucleotide binding activity; and oxidoreductase activity. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell; germ layer; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human NDOR1 (NADPH dependent diflavin oxidoreductase 1).

Name: AMP-activated protein kinase alpha subunit
Description: AMP-activated protein kinase alpha subunit (AMPKalpha) encodes the alpha subunit of the AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) complex. In general AMPK helps cells conserve energy through inhibition of energy consuming processes (fatty acid synthesis, protein synthesis). AMPK is usually active when the TOR pathway is inhibited.

Name: axundead
Description: Predicted to be involved in neurogenesis. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in adult brain; adult head; larval ventral nerve cord; and yolk nucleus.

Name: pineapple eye
Description: pineapple eye (pie) encodes a protein that contributes to viability of imaginal disc cells and affects germline stem cell renewal. It interacts genetically with the Jak/Stat and BMP pathways.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Orthologous to human SLC22A1 (solute carrier family 22 member 1) and SLC22A3 (solute carrier family 22 member 3).

Name: saxophone
Description: saxophone (sax) encodes a type I BMP receptor. Together with the BMP receptors encoded by tkv and put, it transduces signaling of the BMP ligands encoded by dpp, gbb and scw, in a wide variety of developmental processes including embryonic and imaginal disc patterning.

Name: RhoU
Description: Predicted to enable GTP binding activity and GTPase activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including Cdc42 protein signal transduction; actin cytoskeleton organization; and endocytosis. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; ectoderm; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system; and ventral ectoderm anlage.

Name: Methionyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Predicted to enable methionine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in methionyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial matrix. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Used to study mitochondrial metabolism disease and neurodegenerative disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 25 and spastic ataxia 3. Orthologous to human MARS2 (methionyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable glutathione oxidoreductase activity. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; epithelium; and larval foregut atrium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 25. Orthologous to human GRXCR1 (glutaredoxin and cysteine rich domain containing 1).

Name: frizzled
Description: frizzled (fz) encodes the founding member of the Fz family of receptors for Wnt ligands. It is part of Wnt signaling and planar cell polarity pathways.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG7730 (FBgn0036689). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:17027515..17029814. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-06 hour embryonic stages, in adult female stages.

Name: alpha-Esterase-10
Description: Enables serine hydrolase activity. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval central nervous system; embryonic/larval circulatory system; embryonic/larval digestive system; fat body; and photoreceptor neurons. Orthologous to human CES3 (carboxylesterase 3) and CES4A (carboxylesterase 4A).

Name: Paxillin
Description: Paxillin (Pax) encodes an adaptor protein that is generally associated with integrins. It is not required for most integrin-mediated adhesion or migration events, but is required for viability beyond pupal stages. It controls the size of some muscles by regulating the rate of cell fusion.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity and histone binding activity. Predicted to be involved in nucleosome assembly and regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human SPTY2D1 (SPT2 chromatin protein domain containing 1).

Name: Trithorax-like
Description: Trithorax-like (Trl) encodes a GAGA transcription factor involved in chromatin modification. It contributes to cell division, dosage compensation and gametogenesis.

Name: earthbound 1
Description: earthbound 1 (ebd1) encodes a transcription cofactor that functions in the Wingless/Wnt signal transduction pathway. It promotes the interaction between the products of arm and pan and helps recruit the product of arm to chromatin. The product of ebd1 functions in a context-specific manner and is important for the development of indirect flight muscles.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in gravitaxis. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Nucleostemin 1
Description: Nucleostemin 1 (Ns1) encodes a GTPase that is enriched in the peripheral granular components of nucleoli of most larval and adult cells. It is required for nucleolar release of the large ribosomal subunit. Depletion of the Ns1 product reduces viability of midgut imaginal island cells and ribosome abundance in polyploid cells.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of cysteine-type endopeptidase activity involved in apoptotic signaling pathway. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; extended germ band embryo; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to human CAAP1 (caspase activity and apoptosis inhibitor 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: Rho GTPase activating protein at 16F
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Involved in imaginal disc-derived leg morphogenesis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in primary tracheal branch. Orthologous to human ARHGAP12 (Rho GTPase activating protein 12); ARHGAP27 (Rho GTPase activating protein 27); and ARHGAP9 (Rho GTPase activating protein 9).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of apoptotic process. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of spliceosomal complex. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer; morbid obesity; and primary immunodeficiency disease. Orthologous to human CTNNBL1 (catenin beta like 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: frizzled 3
Description: Receptor for Wnt proteins. Most of frizzled receptors are coupled to the beta-catenin canonical signaling pathway, which leads to the activation of disheveled proteins, inhibition of GSK-3 kinase, nuclear accumulation of beta-catenin and activation of Wnt target genes. A second signaling pathway involving PKC and calcium fluxes has been seen for some family members, but it is not yet clear if it represents a distinct pathway or if it can be integrated in the canonical pathway, as PKC seems to be required for Wnt-mediated inactivation of GSK-3 kinase. Both pathways seem to involve interactions with G-proteins. Required to coordinate the cytoskeletons of epidermal cells to produce a parallel array of cuticular hairs and bristles. (UniProtKB:O77438)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG14223 (FBgn0031053). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is X:19659442..19663971. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of very low expression.  Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity. Predicted to be involved in proline catabolic process to glutamate. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hyperprolinemia type 2. Orthologous to human ALDH4A1 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 4 family member A1).

Name: ninaG
Description: ninaG (ninaG) encodes a glucose-methanol-choline oxidoreductase required for the biogenesis of the rhodopsin chromophore (3S)-3-hydroxyretinal, likely by stimulating conversion between the two enantiomers of 3-hydroxyretinal.

Name: midline
Description: T-box transcription factors that participate in cardiac fate specificity - regulates wing development by repressing and

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Orthologous to human NOL8 (nucleolar protein 8).

Name: walker cup
Description: Is expressed in elongation stage spermatid and primary spermatocyte.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human CNBD2 (cyclic nucleotide binding domain containing 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Orthologous to human NUDCD1 (NudC domain containing 1).

Name: glaikit
Description: glaikit (gkt) encodes a member of the phospholipase D superfamily. It is essential for the formation of epithelial polarity and nervous system development.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in wing disc. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer and gastrointestinal system cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including CES1 (carboxylesterase 1); CES2 (carboxylesterase 2); and CES3 (carboxylesterase 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hypothyroidism and thyroid dyshormonogenesis 1. Orthologous to human SLC5A12 (solute carrier family 5 member 12); SLC5A5 (solute carrier family 5 member 5); and SLC5A8 (solute carrier family 5 member 8).

Name: Juvenile hormone esterase
Description: Juvenile hormone esterase (Jhe) encodes a juvenile-hormone esterase involved in response to ethanol, juvenile hormone catabolism and male mating behavior.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sulfuric ester hydrolase activity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mucopolysaccharidosis VI. Orthologous to several human genes including ARSB (arylsulfatase B).

Name: Maltase A4
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: Spermitin
Description: Spermitin (Sprn) encodes a testis-specific mitochondrial lumen protein that first appears during the spermatocyte stage of spermatogenesis, and persists until late stages but is absent from mature sperm.

Name: gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase
Description: gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase (Ggt-1) encodes an enzyme that transfers the gamma-glutamyl moiety from donors to substrates, e.g. transfer to water generates glutamate. The roles of the product of Ggt-1 include glutathione metabolism, reproduction and light avoidance.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: Excitatory amino acid transporter 2
Description: Excitatory amino acid transporter 2 (Eaat2) encodes a transmembrane protein involved in aspartate and taurine transport.

Name: Hemomucin
Description: Transmembrane mucin that may be involved in cellular adhesion and the innate immune response (PubMed:8662683, PubMed:12769978). Membrane-tethered mucins are involved in many cell surface functions and form a physical barrier around cells to regulate cell-cell and/or cell-substrate interactions, and protect against pathogens or harmful extracellular conditions (PubMed:8662683, PubMed:12769978, PubMed:11164341). This mucin likely acts in hemocyte adhesion as it is released from hemocytes during coagulation and is also able to bind lipophorin particles which form part of the hemocyte coagulogen (PubMed:12769978). Able to induce expression of the antibacterial proteins in the presence of GalNAc-specific lectins and so probably also functions in the innate immune response (PubMed:8662683). (UniProtKB:Q9VB46)

Name: pale
Description: pale (ple) encodes a tyrosine hydroxylase, the first and rate-limiting step in the synthesis of dopamine (and eventually, melanin). Dopamine has critical roles in system development.

Name: Methylcrotonoyl-CoA carboxylase 2
Description: Carboxyltransferase subunit of the 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA carboxylase, an enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA to 3-methylglutaconyl-CoA, a critical step for leucine and isovaleric acid catabolism (By similarity). Vital for adult survival. (UniProtKB:Q9V9A7)

Name: Moesin
Description: Moesin (Moe) encodes an Ezrin, Radixin, Moesin (ERM) protein involved in cortical cytoskeleton stability. It regulates the products of crb and Rho1. The product of Moe contributes to apical-basal polarity, mitotic spindle organisation and epithelial integrity.

Name: TH1
Description: TH1 (TH1) encodes one of four subunits that constitutes the NELF complex. The NELF complex along with DSIF causes RNA polymerase II to pause 20 to 50 nucleotides downstream from the transcription start site of most and possibly all actively transcribed genes in a process commonly called promoter proximal pausing.

Name: N/A
Description: Enables DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary autosomal recessive microcephaly 10. Orthologous to human ZFP64 (ZFP64 zinc finger protein) and ZNF335 (zinc finger protein 335).

Name: Vitelline membrane-like
Description: Vitelline membrane-like (Vml) encodes a structural component of the vitelline membrane. It forms part of a localized structural signal that controls the formation and polarity of the dorsal-ventral axis of the embryo.

Name: Mucin related 82C
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be located in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Reduction in Cnn dots 5
Description: Reduction in Cnn dots 5 (Rcd5) encodes a protein that belongs to the family of forkhead-associated domain proteins. As part of the non-specific lethal complex, it regulates transcription of housekeeping genes by facilitating recruitment of RNA polymerase II to promoters. During mitosis it plays a key role in chromosomal-dependent microtubule assembly, centriole duplication and pericentriolar material maturation.

Name: Nuclear division cycle 1
Description: Component of the nuclear pore complex (NPC), which plays a key role in de novo assembly and insertion of NPC in the nuclear envelope. (UniProtKB:Q9VCG4)

Name: Vesicular acetylcholine transporter
Description: Vesicular acetylcholine transporter (VAChT) encodes a vesicular transport protein necessary for packaging the neurotransmitter acetylcholine into synaptic vesicles.

Name: Male-specific transcript 84B
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: tRNA methyltransferase 1
Description: Dimethylates a single guanine residue at position 26 of most tRNAs using S-adenosyl-L-methionine as donor of the methyl groups. (UniProtKB:Q9VK89)

Name: sister of odd and bowl
Description: Pair-rule protein that determines both the size and polarity of even-numbered as well as odd-numbered parasegments during embryogenesis. DNA-binding transcription factor that acts primarily as a transcriptional repressor but can also function as a transcriptional activator, depending on the stage of development and spatial restrictions (By similarity). May function redundantly with odd and drm in leg joint formation during the larval stages, acting downstream of Notch activation. (UniProtKB:Q9VQS7)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Orthologous to human SLC22A15 (solute carrier family 22 member 15).

Name: Ionotropic receptor 60b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in chemosensory neuron of adult labral sensillum 7; gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis; gustatory receptor neuron of the hypophysis; and labral sense organ neurons.

Name: fondue
Description: fondue (fon) encodes a protein produced by the fat body that is involved in the clotting reaction.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-serine phosphorylation and peptidyl-threonine phosphorylation. Is expressed in dorsal pharyngeal muscle cell; embryonic/larval muscle system; and embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell. Orthologous to several human genes including SBK1 (SH3 domain binding kinase 1).

Name: Transcription factor IIFalpha
Description: TFIIF is a general transcription initiation factor that binds to RNA polymerase II and helps to recruit it to the initiation complex in collaboration with TFIIB. It promotes transcription elongation. (UniProtKB:Q05913)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Protein interacting with C kinase 1
Description: Predicted to enable membrane curvature sensor activity; phospholipid binding activity; and protein kinase C binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to sucrose stimulus; positive regulation of developmental growth; and regulation of postsynapse organization. Located in neuronal cell body. Is expressed in head; larval ventral nerve cord; and neurosecretory cell of pars intercerebralis. Orthologous to human PICK1 (protein interacting with PRKCA 1).

Name: Chitin and LDLR binding deacetylase 3
Description: Predicted to enable chitin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in embryonic/larval posterior spiracle and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Maltase A1
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: papi
Description: Involved in the piwi-interacting RNA (piRNA) metabolic process, which mediates the repression of transposable elements during meiosis by forming complexes composed of piRNAs and Piwi proteins, and governs the methylation and subsequent repression of transposons which is essential for germline integrity (PubMed:21447556, PubMed:29531043). Likely to act by recruiting Piwi proteins such as AGO3 and piwi to the piRNA biogenesis machinery in the nuage (PubMed:21447556, PubMed:29531043). Required for the final steps of primary piRNA biogenesis by participating in the 3' end-trimming of piwi-bound intermediates into mature piRNAs (PubMed:29531043). (UniProtKB:Q9VQ91)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of cilium beat frequency. Predicted to be active in axoneme and ciliary basal body. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human CFAP206 (cilia and flagella associated protein 206).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in intracellular signal transduction and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation. Orthologous to human STK32A (serine/threonine kinase 32A); STK32B (serine/threonine kinase 32B); and STK32C (serine/threonine kinase 32C).

Name: Heparan-alpha-glucosaminide N-acetyltransferase
Description: Predicted to enable acyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in lysosomal transport. Predicted to be located in lysosomal membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mucopolysaccharidosis type IIIC and retinitis pigmentosa 73. Orthologous to human HGSNAT (heparan-alpha-glucosaminide N-acetyltransferase).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; and nervous system.

Name: polo
Description: May play a role in regulating both nuclear and cytoplasmic aspects of the mitotic cycle (PubMed:1660828). Regulates localization of the augmin complex during mitosis by ensuring its location on mitotic spindles (PubMed:24829288). Also regulates augmin complex localization during male meiosis by promoting its placement at kinetochores while preventing its association with spindle microtubules (PubMed:24829288). (UniProtKB:P52304)

Name: Heat shock protein 60C
Description: Heat shock protein 60C (Hsp60C) encodes one of the four Hsp60 family chaperone proteins. It is widely expressed and essential for embryonic viability and tracheal formation. It has essential roles in spermatogenesis and oogenesis, possibly through interaction with F-Actin.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 15. Orthologous to human CDC40 (cell division cycle 40).

Name: invected
Description: invected (inv) encodes a homeodomain transcription factor that is closely related to, co-expressed with, and functionally redundant with the product of en. Although dispensable in the laboratory, the product of inv is a transcriptional repressor important for segmentation in the embryo and formation of the posterior compartment in imaginal discs.

Name: Deformed epidermal autoregulatory factor-1
Description: Transcription factor that binds the homeotic Deformed (Dfd) response element. High affinity binding sites contain at least 1 TTCG motif surrounded by additional TCG sequences. May be involved in the selective action of Dfd on these sites without binding directly to the Dfd protein. Requirement of DEAF1 activity may be a common feature of enhancers targeted by Dfd. (UniProtKB:Q24180)

Name: Glycerol kinase 2
Description: Enables glycerol kinase activity. Involved in glycerol-3-phosphate biosynthetic process and phosphorylation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Used to study glycerol kinase deficiency. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glycerol kinase deficiency. Orthologous to human GK (glycerol kinase); GK2 (glycerol kinase 2); and GK3P (glycerol kinase 3 pseudogene).

Name: nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor alpha2
Description: After binding acetylcholine, the AChR responds by an extensive change in conformation that affects all subunits and leads to opening of an ion-conducting channel across the plasma membrane. (UniProtKB:P17644)

Name: thickveins
Description: thickveins (tkv) encodes a transforming growth factor beta type I receptor. Together with the product of put, it functions as a receptor of the product of dpp and therefore contributes to the BMP signaling pathway.

Name: Kelch like family member 18
Description: Enables protein homodimerization activity. Involved in imaginal disc fusion, thorax closure and protein autoubiquitination. Part of Cul3-RING ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human KLHL18 (kelch like family member 18).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-alanine:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in biosynthetic process. Located in cytosol and mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including adult brain; adult heart; extended germ band embryo; gonad; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to human GPT (glutamic--pyruvic transaminase) and GPT2 (glutamic--pyruvic transaminase 2).

Name: black
Description: black (b) encodes an aspartate 1-decarboxylase. Mutations of b result in viable flies with a cuticular melanization phenotype.

Name: Cyclin B3
Description: Cyclin B3 (CycB3) encodes a protein that binds to the product of Cdk1, presumably promoting Cdk1's protein kinase activity. The complex CycB3-Cdk1 cooperates with other Cdk1 complexes (CycA-Cdk1 and CycB-Cdk1) to promote the G2/M transition. Like the products of CycA and CycB, the product of CycB3 is also rapidly degraded during exit from mitosis and during G1. It appears to have a specific role in activating the APC/C-dependent degradation pathway.

Name: Nucleostemin 4
Description: Predicted to enable GTPase activity. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human GNL1 (G protein nucleolar 1 (putative)).

Name: knot
Description: knot (kn) encodes a transcription factor required for somatic and alary muscle specification and embryonic head segmentation. In larvae, it is required for wing disc patterning and plays a key role in the lymph gland, both under normal conditions and under immune stress.

Name: zeste
Description: zeste (z) encodes a sequence-specific DNA-binding protein. It is often found in the proximal promoter region of many genes where it helps to recruit the BRM nucleosome remodeling complex. It is best known for the pairing-dependent repressive effects produced by some of its mutants on target genes, especially the w gene.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in larval ventral nerve cord and spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable serine-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis.

Name: Cell division cycle 45
Description: Cell division cycle 45 (Cdc45) encodes a protein that contributes to 3'-5' DNA helicase activity of the Cdc45/Mcm2-7/GINS complex. It is involved in chromosome condensation and the regulation of the mitotic G1/S transition.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG13700 (FBgn0036785). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:18298742..18301260. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages, in adult male stages.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 67b
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis and larval abdomen.

Name: misato
Description: misato (mst) encodes a conserved protein that acts as a co-factor of the TCP-1 tubulin chaperone complex. It is required for mitotic spindle assembly and viability and for tubulin polymerization and stability.

Name: Slu7
Description: Required for pre-mRNA splicing as component of the spliceosome. Participates in the second catalytic step of pre-mRNA splicing, when the free hydroxyl group of exon I attacks the 3'-splice site to generate spliced mRNA and the excised lariat intron. Required for holding exon 1 properly in the spliceosome and for correct AG identification when more than one possible AG exists in 3'-splicing site region. May be involved in the activation of proximal AG. Probably also involved in alternative splicing regulation. (UniProtKB:Q9VAQ7)

Name: alpha-Esterase-8
Description: Predicted to enable carboxylic ester hydrolase activity. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer and gastrointestinal system cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including CES1 (carboxylesterase 1); CES2 (carboxylesterase 2); and CES3 (carboxylesterase 3).

Name: Maltase A3
Description: Predicted to enable maltose alpha-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in embryonic midgut chamber; embryonic/larval midgut; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC3A1 (solute carrier family 3 member 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: Cytochrome P450 4g15
Description: Probably involved in steroid hormones biosynthesis. (UniProtKB:Q9VYY4)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: Vacuolar protein sorting 45
Description: Vacuolar protein sorting 45 (Vps45) encodes an SM protein that is activated by the product of Rab5 and binds to the product of Rbsn-5 to control entry of endocytosed cargo into the early endosome.

Name: delta-1-Pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase 1
Description: delta-1-Pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase 1 (P5CDh1) encodes a conserved, nuclear-encoded mitochondrial matrix enzyme. It is a member of the aldehyde dehydrogenase superfamily involved in proline degradation.

Name: Ionotropic receptor 60d
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in detection of chemical stimulus. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in gustatory receptor neuron of the epiphysis; labellar taste bristle; and labral sense organ neurons.

Name: phantom
Description: phantom (phtm) encodes a cytochrome P450 involved in ecdysteroid biosynthesis. It is an endoplasmic reticulum protein that catalyzes the addition of a hydroxyl group to the 25 carbon of the cholesterol side chain. phtm mutants fail to undergo head involution, dorsal closure and cuticle secretion.

Name: SET and MYND domain containing, class 4, member 4
Description: Predicted to enable histone deacetylase binding activity. Involved in compound eye photoreceptor development. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic/larval central nervous system; embryonic/larval gut; embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell; midgut primordium; and procephalic segment. Orthologous to human SMYD4 (SET and MYND domain containing 4).

Name: Heat shock protein 60A
Description: Prevents misfolding and promotes the refolding and proper assembly of unfolded polypeptides generated under stress conditions. (UniProtKB:O02649)

Name: ric8a
Description: ric8a (ric8a) encodes a guanine nucleotide-exchange factor for the product of Galphai. Its function is necessary to ensure cortical localization of the heterotrimeric subunits encoded by Galphai and Gbeta13F, thereby regulating spindle orientation during asymmetric cell division in the sensory lineage.

Name: pickpocket 7
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in embryonic/larval dorsal tracheal branch; embryonic/larval tracheal dorsal trunk; embryonic/larval tracheal transverse connective; and tracheal tip cell.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Is expressed in adult head and seminal receptacle. Orthologous to human SLC22A15 (solute carrier family 22 member 15).

Name: shopper
Description: Required in ensheathing glial cells for normal larval locomotion. Oxidizes sulfite which is required to maintain glutamate homeostasis and as a consequence, neuronal network function. (UniProtKB:Q9VWP4)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-ascorbate:sodium symporter activity. Predicted to be involved in L-ascorbic acid transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult brain cell body rind; adult head; and organism. Orthologous to human SLC23A1 (solute carrier family 23 member 1) and SLC23A2 (solute carrier family 23 member 2).

Name: N/A

Name: spookier
Description: spookier (spok) encodes a cytochrome P450 involved in ecdysteroid biosynthesis that is expressed primarily in the prothoracic gland and is localized in the endoplasmic reticulum. Genetic evidence suggests that the product of spok acts with the products of sro and Cyp6t3 to catalyze conversion of 7 dehydrocholesterol to delta4, diketol during the ecdysone biosynthetic pathway.

Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic brain; larval ventral nerve cord; and organism.

Name: natalisin
Description: natalisin (natalisin) encodes five signaling peptides with potent agonist activities toward the product of TkR86C.

Name: spartin
Description: spartin (spartin) encodes a multi-functional protein associated with organelle membranes, including endosomes, lipid droplets, and mitochondria. It participates in cytokinesis, BMP receptor trafficking, lipid droplet turnover, and mitochondrial Ca[2+] homeostasis.

Name: Adenosine deaminase-related growth factor A
Description: Adenosine deaminase-related growth factor A (Adgf-A) encodes an extracellular deaminase that regulates the level of extracellular adenosine by converting adenosine to inosine. This activity is important for regulation of systemic metabolism, especially during stress and infection.

Name: SET and MYND domain containing, arthropod-specific, member 5
Description: Predicted to enable histone deacetylase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of gene expression.

Description: Scaffolding subunit of the trimeric nuclear exosome targeting (NEXT) complex, a complex that directs a subset of non-coding short-lived RNAs for exosomal degradation. The RNA exosome is fundamental for the degradation of RNA in eukaryotic nuclei. May be involved in pre-mRNA splicing. (UniProtKB:Q2PE14)

Name: alpha actinin 3
Description: Predicted to be involved in actin cytoskeleton organization. Predicted to be part of filamentous actin. Predicted to be active in microtubule organizing center.

Name: elbow B
Description: May negatively regulate Notch-induced cell proliferation in the eye-head primordium. May act in leg and wing primordia to negatively regulate body-wall specifying genes and thereby promote appendage formation. Required for tracheal development. (UniProtKB:Q9VJS8)

Name: Cytochrome P450 301a1
Description: Cyp301a1 (Cyp301a1) encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 family, which have both mitochondrial and cytosolic roles in the detoxification of compounds.

Name: Biotinidase
Description: Biotinidase (Btnd) encodes an enzyme that cleaves biocytin (biotin-epsilon-lysine), a normal product of carboxylase degradation, resulting in regeneration of free biotin. It has also been shown to have biotinyl transferase activity.

Name: ADP-ribosylation factor GTPase activating protein 3
Description: ADP-ribosylation factor GTPase activating protein 3 (ArfGAP3) a GTPase activating proteins for Arf family GTPases. Arf proteins regulate actin dynamics, cell shape, and cell positioning within epithelia such as the eye.

Name: meso18E
Description: Involved in mesoderm development. Is expressed in embryonic/larval muscle system; esophageal visceral muscle; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: U4-U6 small nuclear riboprotein factor 60K
Description: Enables U4 snRNA binding activity and U6 snRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and precatalytic spliceosome. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 70. Orthologous to human PRPF4 (pre-mRNA processing factor 4).

Name: brummer
Description: brummer (bmm) encodes a triglyceride lipase involved in glycerolipid metabolism, regulation of lipid storage and triglyceride homeostasis.

Name: pickpocket 18
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Is expressed in embryonic/larval anterior spiracle; embryonic/larval garland cell; and testis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in progressive myoclonus epilepsy 4. Orthologous to human SCARB2 (scavenger receptor class B member 2).

Name: bruno 3
Description: bruno 3 (bru3) encodes an RNA binding protein that binds to the EDEN element and mediates maternal mRNA translational repression.

Name: engrailed
Description: engrailed (en) encodes a homeodomain-containing transcription factor that is essential for posterior compartment identity and for compartment boundary formation and maintenance. It positively regulates the hh gene and negatively regulates the Hedgehog targets encoded by ci, ptc and dpp.

Name: Quiescin sulfhydryl oxidase 2
Description: Predicted to enable flavin-linked sulfhydryl oxidase activity and protein disulfide isomerase activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head and male accessory gland. Orthologous to human QSOX1 (quiescin sulfhydryl oxidase 1) and QSOX2 (quiescin sulfhydryl oxidase 2).

Name: Sperm-Leucylaminopeptidase 2
Description: Predicted to enable manganese ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head; spermatogonium; spermatozoon; and testis. Orthologous to human LAP3 (leucine aminopeptidase 3).

Name: Elongator complex protein 3
Description: Elongator complex protein 3 (Elp3) encodes a Lysine (K) acetyltransferase (KAT) that resides primarily in the cytoplasm of neurons. It acetylates the product of brp in an opposite reaction to the product of HDAC6 to regulate T-bar morphology and function, and unlike most  KATs it does not acetylate histones.

Name: Src oncogene at 64B
Description: Src oncogene at 64B (Src64B) encodes a Src family nonreceptor tyrosine kinase. It has many biological roles, including ring canal morphogenesis in oogenesis and the male germline, microfilament ring constriction during cellularization, and modulation of growth and apoptosis. Some of its roles overlap with those of the product of Src42A.

Name: bellwether
Description: bellwether (blw) encodes the alpha subunit of the mitochondrial F1F0 ATP synthase complex (complex V), the final enzyme of the oxidative phosphorylation pathway. Complex V catalyzes the synthesis of ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate using the electrochemical proton gradient across the inner mitochondrial membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human CPN2 (carboxypeptidase N subunit 2).

Description: Catalyzes the methylthiolation of N6-threonylcarbamoyladenosine (t(6)A), leading to the formation of 2-methylthio-N6-threonylcarbamoyladenosine (ms(2)t(6)A) at position 37 in tRNAs that read codons beginning with adenine. (UniProtKB:Q7K4W1)

Name: smooth
Description: smooth (sm) encodes an RNA binding, heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein involved in axon guidance, mRNA processing, chemosensation, determination of lifespan and feeding behavior.

Name: sarcoplasmic calcium-binding protein
Description: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium. Located in cytosol and nucleoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm; extended germ band embryo; mesoderm anlage; and ventral ectoderm anlage.

Name: Synapse-associated protein 47kD
Description: Synapse-associated protein 47kD (Sap47) encodes a conserved protein associated with synaptic vesicles. It is required for intact synaptic and behavioural plasticity.

Name: Sensory neuron membrane protein 1
Description: Sensory neuron membrane protein 1 (Snmp1) encodes a member of the CD36 family of lipoprotein receptors. It is expressed in a subset of olfactory neurons. It is required for a normal olfactory response to the male-specific pheromone 11-cis vaccenyl acetate.

Name: epithelial membrane protein
Description: Predicted to enable scavenger receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in recognition of apoptotic cell. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including adult heart; embryonic/larval tracheal system; epidermis; gut section; and imaginal disc. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including blood platelet disease (multiple); hemolytic-uremic syndrome; osteoarthritis; progressive myoclonus epilepsy 4; and pulmonary tuberculosis. Orthologous to several human genes including SCARB2 (scavenger receptor class B member 2).

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit d2
Description: mRNA cap-binding component of the eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 (eIF-3) complex, which is involved in protein synthesis of a specialized repertoire of mRNAs and, together with other initiation factors, stimulates binding of mRNA and methionyl-tRNAi to the 40S ribosome. The eIF-3 complex specifically targets and initiates translation of a subset of mRNAs involved in cell proliferation. In the eIF-3 complex, eif3d specifically recognizes and binds the 7-methylguanosine cap of a subset of mRNAs. (UniProtKB:Q9VGC7)

Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval tracheal section; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and trunk ectoderm. Orthologous to human BLMH (bleomycin hydrolase).

Description: wampa (wam) encodes a component of the outer dynein arm docking complex that is required for attaching outer dynein arms to the axoneme of the sperm flagellum. It is involved in axonemal assembly, nuclear shaping, and mitochondrial remodeling during spermatogenesis.

Name: Amun
Description: Involved in chaeta development; compound eye development; and wing disc development. Located in nucleus.

Name: prolyl-4-hydroxylase-alpha EFB
Description: Predicted to enable procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-proline hydroxylation to 4-hydroxy-L-proline. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic epidermis; embryonic/larval muscle system; embryonic/larval plasmatocyte; extended germ band embryo; and follicle cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in myopia. Orthologous to several human genes including P4HA1 (prolyl 4-hydroxylase subunit alpha 1).

Name: corto
Description: corto (corto) encodes an Enhancer of Trithorax and Polycomb (ETP) protein that physically interacts with several Polycomb proteins (encoded by Pc, ph-d, ph-p, esc, E(z)) and ETP (encoded by Trl, Dsp1). It also interacts with the product of CycG, with the methylated product of RpL12 (RPL12K3me3), and co-regulates the transcription of genes involved in ribosome biogenesis.

Name: Vesicular GABA Transporter
Description: Vesicular GABA Transporter (VGAT) encodes an essential transporter that is responsible for packaging the neurotransmitter GABA into synaptic vesicles.

Name: doublesex
Description: Controls somatic sexual differentiation. Binds directly and specifically to the FBE (fat body enhancer) of the yolk protein 1 and 2 genes (Yp1 and Yp2). This enhancer is sufficient to direct the female-specific transcription characteristic of the Yp genes in adult fat bodies. Involved in regulation of male-specific expression of takeout in brain-associated fat body. (UniProtKB:P23023)

Description: Enables cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. Involved in positive regulation of Toll signaling pathway and zymogen activation. Is active in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; germline cell; organism; and primordial germ cell.

Name: FMRFamide Receptor
Description: FMRFamide Receptor (FMRFaR) encodes a G protein coupled receptor activated by all FMRFamide peptides. It contributes to neurotransmitter release, muscle contraction, and larval escape responses to light.

Name: Sperm-Leucylaminopeptidase 5
Description: Predicted to enable manganese ion binding activity and metalloaminopeptidase activity. Involved in mesoderm development. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult head; spermatogonium; spermatozoon; and testis. Orthologous to human LAP3 (leucine aminopeptidase 3).

Name: nesthocker
Description: nesthocker (nst) encodes a phospho-acetylglucosamine mutase, an essential enzyme in the biosynthetic pathway of N-Acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc). In the embryo, it is required for normal GlcNAc levels and affects Fibroblast-Growth-Factor signaling.

Name: Bardet-Biedl syndrome 8
Description: Involved in cilium assembly. Predicted to be located in cilium. Predicted to be part of BBSome. Predicted to be active in ciliary basal body and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in antenno-maxillary complex; chordotonal neurons; and eo neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Bardet-Biedl syndrome; Bardet-Biedl syndrome 8; and retinitis pigmentosa 51. Orthologous to human TTC8 (tetratricopeptide repeat domain 8).

Name: DNA fragmentation factor-related protein 2
Description: DNA fragmentation factor-related protein 2 (Drep2) encodes a protein involved in neuron death regulation.

Description: Predicted to enable D-ribulokinase activity. Involved in response to endoplasmic reticulum stress. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human FGGY (FGGY carbohydrate kinase domain containing).

Name: NAD kinase 1a
Description: Enables NAD+ kinase activity. Involved in NADP biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult brain. Orthologous to human NADK (NAD kinase).

Name: Organic cation transporter
Description: Probably transports organic cations. (UniProtKB:Q9VCA2)

Name: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 61F
Description: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 61F (Ptp61F) encodes a non-receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase. It is known to act as a negative regulator of various kinase-dependent signalling pathways, including the JAK-STAT, Insulin-like Receptor, EGFR, and Pvr pathways in a wide variety of contexts.

Name: swallow
Description: Has a role in localizing bicoid mRNA at the anterior margin of the oocyte during oogenesis, and a poorly characterized role in nuclear divisions in early embryogenesis. (UniProtKB:P40688)

Name: Kinetochore and EB1 associated basic protein
Description: Enables kinetochore binding activity and microtubule binding activity. Located in kinetochore; perinuclear region of cytoplasm; and spindle microtubule. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Glucosidase 2 beta subunit
Description: Predicted to be involved in N-glycan processing. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; embryonic proventriculus; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in liver disease and polycystic liver disease. Orthologous to human PRKCSH (protein kinase C substrate 80K-H).

Name: worniu
Description: worniu (wor) encodes a zinc finger C2H2 transcription factor involved in nervous system development. It contributes to neuroblast asymmetric cell division and brain development.

Name: Dpr-interacting protein lambda
Description: Predicted to be involved in establishment of synaptic specificity at neuromuscular junction. Predicted to be located in neuron projection membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection. Is expressed in wing disc. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ovarian cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including IGLON5 (IgLON family member 5); LSAMP (limbic system associated membrane protein); and NTM (neurotrimin).

Name: 5' nucleotidase C
Description: Predicted to enable 5'-nucleotidase activity and single-stranded DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to DNA damage stimulus. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; adult heart; and embryonic/larval muscle system. Orthologous to human NT5DC2 (5'-nucleotidase domain containing 2) and NT5DC3 (5'-nucleotidase domain containing 3).

Description: Predicted to enable pseudouridine synthase activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium and positive regulation of innate immune response. Is expressed in larval dorsal multidendritic neurons and organism. Orthologous to human RPUSD2 (RNA pseudouridine synthase domain containing 2).

Name: Ubiquilin
Description: Ubiquilin (Ubqn) encodes a protein containing an N-terminal ubiquitin-like domain and a C-terminal ubiquitin-associated domain. It binds and delivers ubiquitinated, misfolded or no longer functionally required proteins to the ubiquitin-proteasome system and/or autophagy.

Name: Regulator of chromosome condensation 1
Description: Regulator of chromosome condensation 1 (Rcc1) encodes the guanine-nucleotide exchange factor for the product of Ran. It promotes the nucleo-cytoplasmic shuttling of specific proteins and regulates chromatin condensation. The roles of Rcc1 product include cell proliferation, cell survival, apoptosis, epigenetic regulation, and neuronal specification.

Description: Bx42 (Bx42) encodes a nuclear protein that acts as a cofactor in Notch signalling pathway.

Name: Phosphoribosylamidotransferase 2
Description: Phosphoribosylamidotransferase 2 (Prat2) encodes a type-2 glutamine amidotransferase that is essential in the pathway for de novo synthesis of inosine monophosphate (IMP). IMP is the precursor for purine nucleotides that are required for nucleic acids, energy transfer, cell signaling, and coenzymes.

Description: Predicted to enable long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty-acyl-CoA biosynthetic process and long-chain fatty acid metabolic process. Is expressed in embryonic hindgut; embryonic precursor of adult hindgut; and yolk nucleus.

Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Located in postsynaptic density membrane. Is expressed in adult head; plasmatocyte primordium; and ventral epidermis primordium. Used to study neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 7. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 7. Orthologous to human MFSD8 (major facilitator superfamily domain containing 8).

Name: phurba tashi
Description: Predicted to enable alkaline phosphatase activity. Involved in response to hypoxia and response to nicotine. Predicted to be located in cell surface. Is expressed in several structures, including blastoderm embryo; ectoderm anlage; embryonic/larval circulatory system; extended germ band embryo; and germ layer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in adult hypophosphatasia; childhood hypophosphatasia; hypophosphatasia; infantile hypophosphatasia; and inflammatory bowel disease. Orthologous to several human genes including ALPG (alkaline phosphatase, germ cell); ALPI (alkaline phosphatase, intestinal); and ALPP (alkaline phosphatase, placental).

Name: Nucleoporin 58kD
Description: Component of the nuclear pore complex, a complex required for the trafficking across the nuclear membrane (PubMed:15086791). Together with Nup54, required for transposable element silencing regulation in ovarian follicle cells (PubMed:33856346). By interacting with the nuclear (Nxf1/Nxt1) and cytosolic (fs(1)Yb) components of the flamenco (flam) transcripts processing pathway, enables export and subsequent piRNA production (PubMed:33856346). (UniProtKB:Q9VDV3)

Name: Phosphoribosylamidotransferase
Description: Phosphoribosylamidotransferase (Prat) encodes a type-2 glutamine amidotransferase that converts phosphoribosylpyrophosphate to phosphoribosylamine using glutamine. It is an essential enzyme in the pathway for de novo synthesis of the purine nucleotide inosine monophosphate (IMP). IMP is the precursor for purine nucleotides required for nucleic acids, energy transfer, cell signaling, and coenzymes.

Name: Chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 8
Description: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human CCT8 (chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 8).

Description: Predicted to enable acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity. Predicted to be located in membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Peters plus syndrome. Orthologous to human B3GLCT (beta 3-glucosyltransferase).

Description: klingon (klg) encodes a homophilic cell adhesion molecule that is regulated by Notch signalling. It is involved in long term memory formation and photoreceptor cell commitment.

Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nephronophthisis-like nephropathy 1. Orthologous to human XPNPEP3 (X-prolyl aminopeptidase 3).

Orthologous to human CWF19L1 (CWF19 like cell cycle control factor 1).

Description: Cleaves phosphorylated sphingoid bases (PSBs), such as sphingosine-1-phosphate, into fatty aldehydes and phosphoethanolamine. Sphingolipid catabolism is required for normal development including viability, reproduction and muscle development. (UniProtKB:Q9V7Y2)

Name: Zinc transporter 63C
Description: Zinc transporter 63C (ZnT63C) encodes a plasma membrane resident zinc transporter belonging to the zinc transporter family that is mainly responsible for zinc export from the cell or into organelles. It plays a key role in effluxing zinc from enterocytes into circulation during dietary zinc absorption.

Name: Proctolin receptor
Description: Enables proctolin receptor activity. Involved in neuropeptide signaling pathway. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in head.

Predicted to be involved in neuron differentiation and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; extended germ band embryo; larval ventral nerve cord; and ventral midline of embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis and nail-patella syndrome. Orthologous to human LMX1B (LIM homeobox transcription factor 1 beta).

Name: Sterol carrier protein X-related thiolase
Description: Predicted to enable phospholipid transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in phospholipid transport and positive regulation of intracellular cholesterol transport. Predicted to be located in peroxisome. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval fat body; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human SCP2 (sterol carrier protein 2).

Name: Hyccin
Description: Predicted to be involved in phosphatidylinositol phosphate biosynthetic process and protein localization to plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Used to study hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 5. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 5. Orthologous to human HYCC1 (hyccin PI4KA lipid kinase complex subunit 1) and HYCC2 (hyccin PI4KA lipid kinase complex subunit 2).

Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval plasmatocyte; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; and extended germ band embryo.

Name: Chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 7
Description: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in adult brain; adult brain cell body rind; adult head; and adult heart. Used to study intrinsic cardiomyopathy and sensory peripheral neuropathy. Orthologous to human CCT7 (chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 7).

Name: mulder
Description: mulder (mldr) encodes a protein involved in mitochondrial tRNA processing.

Name: Sperm-specific dynein intermediate chain C
Description: Predicted to enable dynein heavy chain binding activity and dynein light chain binding activity. Predicted to be involved in transport along microtubule. Predicted to be part of cytoplasmic dynein complex. Orthologous to human DYNC1I1 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 1) and DYNC1I2 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 2).

Name: Esterase P
Description: Enables carboxylic ester hydrolase activity. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer and gastrointestinal system cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including CES1 (carboxylesterase 1); CES2 (carboxylesterase 2); and CES3 (carboxylesterase 3).

Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal ectoderm; embryonic Malpighian tubule; extended germ band embryo; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and yolk nucleus.

Name: Esterase 6
Description: Transferred from the ejaculatory bulbs of males to the female genitals upon copulation, plays an important role in the reproductive biology. (UniProtKB:P08171)

Name: BarH1
Description: B-H1 and B-H2 are regulated by members of the wg signaling pathway; wg and dpp. B-H1 and B-H2 are coexpressed and functionally required in R1 and R6 receptor cells and primary pigment cells for normal eye development. Coexpression is also required for the fate determination of external sensory organs, formation of notal microchaetae, formation of presutural macrochaetae, antennal development and for distal leg morphogenesis; segmentation and specification of tarsal segments 3-5. (UniProtKB:Q24255)

Name: Chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 3
Description: Molecular chaperone; assists the folding of proteins upon ATP hydrolysis. Known to play a role, in vitro, in the folding of actin and tubulin. (UniProtKB:P48605)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty-acyl-CoA biosynthetic process and long-chain fatty acid metabolic process. Is expressed in anal pad primordium; embryonic anal pad; and hindgut proper primordium.

Description: Predicted to enable clathrin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Predicted to be active in endosome and membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval nervous system; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary immunodeficiency disease. Orthologous to several human genes including TOM1L2 (target of myb1 like 2 membrane trafficking protein) and TOM1 (target of myb1 membrane trafficking protein).

Name: spook
Description: spook (spo) encodes a cytochrome P450 involved in ecdysteroid biosynthesis in the embryo. spo mutants fail to undergo head involution, dorsal closure or to secrete cuticle.
