Description: Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Predicted to be part of spliceosomal complex. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human GPKOW (G-patch domain and KOW motifs).

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 37 member D1
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval crystal cell; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; and extended germ band embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcoholic pancreatitis; bilirubin metabolic disorder (multiple); cholecystolithiasis; cholelithiasis; and female reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including UGT1A1 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A1); UGT1A10 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A10); and UGT1A3 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A3).

Name: alpha-Esterase-5
Description: Enables carboxylic ester hydrolase activity. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic midgut chamber; embryonic/larval midgut; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer and gastrointestinal system cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including CES1 (carboxylesterase 1); CES2 (carboxylesterase 2); and CES3 (carboxylesterase 3).

Name: karyopherin alpha1
Description: karyopherin alpha1 (Kap-alpha1) encodes a protein that is involved in spermatogenesis and the nuclear import of the product of yki.

Name: Sperm-specific dynein intermediate chain 2
Description: Predicted to enable dynein heavy chain binding activity and dynein light chain binding activity. Predicted to be involved in microtubule-based movement. Predicted to be located in sperm flagellum. Predicted to be part of cytoplasmic dynein complex. Orthologous to human DYNC1I1 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 1) and DYNC1I2 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 2).

Name: WD repeat domain 79
Description: WD repeat domain 79 (WDR79) encodes a protein that binds to the CAB box of the Small Cajal body-specific RNAs (scaRNAs). It is a component of the nuclear Cajal body (CB) and is required for CB formation.

Name: alpha-Esterase-3
Description: Enables serine hydrolase activity. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer and gastrointestinal system cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including CES1 (carboxylesterase 1); CES2 (carboxylesterase 2); and CES3 (carboxylesterase 3).

Name: Alkaline phosphatase 7
Description: Predicted to enable alkaline phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cell surface. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in inflammatory bowel disease. Orthologous to human ALPG (alkaline phosphatase, germ cell); ALPI (alkaline phosphatase, intestinal); and ALPP (alkaline phosphatase, placental).

Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human SMOX (spermine oxidase).

Name: N/A
Description: Catalyzes the reduction of C16 or C18 fatty acyl-CoA to fatty alcohols. (UniProtKB:A1ZAI3)

Name: cryptochrome
Description: Blue light-dependent regulator that is the input of the circadian feedback loop. Has no photolyase activity for cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers or 6-4 photoproducts. Regulation of expression by light suggests a role in photoreception for locomotor activity rhythms. Functions, together with per, as a transcriptional repressor required for the oscillation of peripheral circadian clocks and for the correct specification of clock cells. Genes directly activated by the transcription factors Clock (Clk) and cycle (cyc) are repressed by cry. Necessary for light-dependent magnetosensitivity, an intact circadian system is not required for the magnetoreception mechanism to operate. Required for both the naive and trained responses to magnetic field, consistent with the notion that cry is in the input pathway of magnetic sensing. (UniProtKB:O77059)

Name: prolyl-4-hydroxylase-alpha NE2
Description: Predicted to enable procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity. Involved in cell migration and sexual reproduction. Predicted to be located in extracellular space. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in adult head. Used to study prostate cancer. Orthologous to human P4HA3 (prolyl 4-hydroxylase subunit alpha 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Orthologous to human MFSD14A (major facilitator superfamily domain containing 14A) and MFSD14B (major facilitator superfamily domain containing 14B).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human TMEM209 (transmembrane protein 209).

Name: ocelliless
Description: Transcriptional regulator involved in pattern formation and cell determination in the embryonic CNS and larval imaginal disks. Also later in development to coordinate the expression of regulatory and structural genes required for photoreceptor cell fate in the ocelli. Has a dual role in the terminal differentiation of subtypes of photoreceptors by regulating rhodopsin (rh) expression: essential for establishing the expression of rh genes in the pale subset of ommatidia as well as repressing Rh6 in outer photoreceptors. (UniProtKB:P22810)

Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; ectoderm; ectoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Leucokinin receptor
Description: Leucokinin receptor (Lkr) encodes a 7-transmembrane domain G-protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) with the product of Lk as a ligand. It signals through intracellular calcium, and is implicated in ion regulation by the Malpighian tubules and in feeding control.

Name: zydeco
Description: zydeco (zyd) encodes a potassium-dependent sodium/calcium exchanger found in cortex glia. It is thought to serve as a key calcium export pathway to control calcium oscillations that occur in membrane microdomains of the glial cell.

Name: Acyl-CoA synthetase X2
Description: Predicted to enable long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty-acyl-CoA biosynthetic process and long-chain fatty acid metabolic process.

Name: modulo
Description: modulo (mod) encodes a nucleolar protein that is required for growth of proliferative cells through its association with the proto-oncogene Myc. The mod protein is essential for transcription of spermatid-differentiation genes and for high expression of meiotic arrest genes. The product of mod is phosphorylated, which in turn regulates its localization.

Name: Chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 5
Description: Chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 5 (CCT5) encodes a component of the TCP-1 ring complex (TRiC) chaperonin. It is involved in myofibril organization maintenance, cardiac physiological rhythm and lifespan determination.

Name: Hexokinase A
Description: Hexokinase A (Hex-A) encodes a hexokinase involved in glucose homeostasis.

Name: sobremesa
Description: Predicted to enable L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport. Located in cell cortex. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; and adult thorax. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cystinuria. Orthologous to human SLC7A9 (solute carrier family 7 member 9).

Name: Tat interactive protein 60kDa
Description: Tat interactive protein 60kDa (Tip60) encodes a lysine acetyltransferase that acetylates histone proteins to regulate chromatin packaging and epigenetic gene control. It also acetylates non-histone proteins, and plays a role in apoptosis, DNA repair and various neural processes.

Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Lynch syndrome and mismatch repair cancer syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC22A10 (solute carrier family 22 member 10); SLC22A11 (solute carrier family 22 member 11); and SLC22A12 (solute carrier family 22 member 12).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable endonuclease activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of 5.8S rRNA and maturation of LSU-rRNA. Predicted to be part of preribosome, large subunit precursor. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Wilson-Turner syndrome. Orthologous to human LAS1L (LAS1 like ribosome biogenesis factor).

Name: Peptidyl-alpha-hydroxyglycine-alpha-amidating lyase 1
Description: Peptidyl-alpha-hydroxyglycine-alpha-amidating lyase 1 (Pal1) encodes a peptidylamidoglycolate lyase that regulates adult wing size.

Name: yellow
Description: yellow (y) is the founding gene of the Yellow family. Lack of y function results in an abnormal male courtship behavior and a characteristic yellow color of the adult cuticle and larval mouthparts.

Name: Presenilin
Description: Probable catalytic subunit of the gamma-secretase complex, an endoprotease complex that catalyzes the intramembrane cleavage of integral membrane proteins such as Notch receptor. Required for S3 cleavage of Notch, which releases activated Notch protein from the cell membrane. Involved in the patterning of the optic lobes. (UniProtKB:O02194)

Name: serpentine
Description: serpentine (serp) encodes a putative chitin deacetylase. It is expressed by the epidermal and tracheal cells and is secreted into the apical extracellular space. Its activity maintains the strength of cuticles and restricts tracheal tube length.

Name: alpha-Esterase-4
Description: Predicted to enable carboxylic ester hydrolase activity. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic midgut chamber; embryonic/larval midgut; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal cancer and gastrointestinal system cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including CES1 (carboxylesterase 1); CES2 (carboxylesterase 2); and CES3 (carboxylesterase 3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable beta-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Is expressed in embryonic proventriculus and gastric caecum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital lactase deficiency; coronary artery disease; intracranial embolism; and spondylosis. Orthologous to several human genes including LCTL (lactase like).

Name: nuclear fallout
Description: nuclear fallout (nuf) encodes a cytoplasmic, coiled-coil protein that acts as an adaptor between the product of Rab11 and motor proteins in the recycling endosome pathway. It is required for early embryo cellularization, and for subsequent Rab11-dependent processes.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell and organism. Orthologous to human GPR84 (G protein-coupled receptor 84).

Name: Panoramix
Description: Panoramix (Panx) encodes a nuclear protein with an essential role in piRNA-guided transcriptional silencing, interacting directly or indirectly with the product of piwi. It is required for fertility.

Name: atlastin
Description: atlastin (atl) encodes a dynamin-like membrane-bound GTPase that mediates endoplasmic reticulum membrane fusion in a GTP-dependent fashion. It is required for normal growth of muscles and synapses at the neuromuscular junction.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; embryonic dorsal epidermis; embryonic head sensory system; sensory nervous system primordium; and ventral sensory complex primordium.

Name: senseless
Description: senseless (sens) encodes a transcription factor that stimulates expression of proneural gene expression. It regulates differentiation of the peripheral nervous system and the R8 photoreceptor.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable nucleic acid binding activity and zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in spermatozoon. Orthologous to human DNAJC21 (DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member C21).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in axonemal dynein complex assembly; cilium-dependent cell motility; and regulation of cilium movement. Predicted to be part of axonemal dynein complex. Predicted to be active in axoneme. Is expressed in chordotonal neurons and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary ciliary dyskinesia 27. Orthologous to human CCDC65 (coiled-coil domain containing 65).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in dorsal closure embryo; embryonic head epidermis; and embryonic/larval posterior spiracle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in myeloid neoplasm. Orthologous to human MECOM (MDS1 and EVI1 complex locus).

Name: Dynein axonemal assembly factor 3
Description: Required for the assembly of axonemal inner and outer dynein arms (PubMed:34553759). Involved in the cytoplasmic preassembly of dyneins into complexes before their transport into cilia (PubMed:34553759). Essential for the development of axonemal dynein motors in the sensory cilium of mechanosensory chordotonal (Ch) neurons and sperm flagellum, and consequently, is required for the mechanotransduction process of hearing and sperm mobility (PubMed:34553759). (UniProtKB:A1ZB91)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable triglyceride lipase activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid catabolic process. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic optic lobe primordium; embryonic/larval gut; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and wing disc. Orthologous to several human genes including PNLIPRP2 (pancreatic lipase related protein 2 (gene/pseudogene)) and PNLIPRP3 (pancreatic lipase related protein 3).

Name: prolyl-4-hydroxylase-alpha SG1
Description: prolyl-4-hydroxylase-alpha SG1 (PH4alphaSG1) encodes an enzyme that hydroxylates prolines in collagens and other secreted matrix proteins. It is required for proper salivary gland development.

Name: Myocyte enhancer factor 2
Description: Myocyte enhancer factor 2 (Mef2) encodes a protein that belongs to the MADS-box family of transcription factors and is required for muscle development. It directly activates a large number of muscle protein genes. It also regulates gene expression in other tissues, including the fat body and neural tissue.

Name: Regnase 1
Description: Predicted to enable endoribonuclease activity and mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in RNA phosphodiester bond hydrolysis, endonucleolytic. Predicted to be active in cytoplasmic ribonucleoprotein granule and nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hepatitis B. Orthologous to several human genes including ZC3H12A (zinc finger CCCH-type containing 12A); ZC3H12B (zinc finger CCCH-type containing 12B); and ZC3H12C (zinc finger CCCH-type containing 12C).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in anion transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: (6-4)-photolyase
Description: (6-4)-photolyase (phr6-4) encodes an enzyme that repairs DNA damage induced by ultraviolet light. It uses blue light and cofactor FADH to reverse the pyrimidine(6-4)pyrimidone photoproduct.

Name: Chondroitin sulfate N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase
Description: Predicted to enable glucuronosyl-N-acetylgalactosaminyl-proteoglycan 4-beta-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity and glucuronylgalactosylproteoglycan 4-beta-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity. Involved in wound healing. Predicted to be located in Golgi cisterna membrane. Orthologous to human CSGALNACT1 (chondroitin sulfate N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 1) and CSGALNACT2 (chondroitin sulfate N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase 2).

Name: Putative Achaete Scute Target 1
Description: Putative Achaete Scute Target 1 (Past1) encodes a protein that associates predominantly with the plasma membrane and genetically interacts with N. It contributes to endocytosis, male sterility, temperature sensitivity, life span and differentiation of photoreceptors R1/R6/R7 and cone cells.

Name: Aldehyde dehydrogenase 7 family member A1
Description: Predicted to enable aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; border follicle cell; embryonic/larval fat body; and yolk nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pyridoxine-dependent epilepsy. Orthologous to human ALDH7A1 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 7 family member A1).

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 303 member B2
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Orthologous to human UGT2B11 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member B11) and UGT2B4 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member B4).

Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of neuron differentiation. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to human CASZ1 (castor zinc finger 1).

Name: pannier
Description: pannier (pnr) encodes a transcription factor that acts as an activator of proneural achaete-scute complex genes. Its roles include dorsal cell fate determination, nervous system development and lymph gland development.

Name: Gdap2
Description: Involved in response to oxidative stress and response to starvation. Is expressed in adult head. Used to study autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 27. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 27. Orthologous to human GDAP2 (ganglioside induced differentiation associated protein 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Orthologous to human SLC22A23 (solute carrier family 22 member 23).

Name: shade
Description: shade (shd) encodes 20-hydroxylase and is responsible for converting Ecdysone into 20-hydroxyecdysone, the active form of the steroid. It is required in all tissues that produce active Ecdysone and thus contributes to larval moulting, metamorphosis, growth, neuroblast diversity and egg chamber maturation.

Description: Predicted to enable dehydroascorbic acid transmembrane transporter activity; fructose transmembrane transporter activity; and glucose transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in dehydroascorbic acid transport; fructose transmembrane transport; and glucose transmembrane transport. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including circulatory system; embryonic/larval digestive system; extended germ band embryo; larval ventral nerve cord; and ventral midline of embryo. Orthologous to human SLC2A8 (solute carrier family 2 member 8).

Name: nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor alpha4
Description: nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor alpha4 (nAChRalpha4) encodes a four-pass transmembrane channel that is part of a nicotinic acetycholine receptor complex. It promotes sleep and its expression level peaks when sleep need is high. Its activity is inhibited by the product of qvr.

Name: mushroom body miniature
Description: mushroom body miniature (mbm) encodes a zinc finger containing protein that localizes in the nucleolus. It plays a role in ribosome biogenesis.

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 37 member E1
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcoholic pancreatitis; bilirubin metabolic disorder (multiple); cholecystolithiasis; cholelithiasis; and female reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including UGT1A1 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A1); UGT1A10 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A10); and UGT1A3 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A3).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit l
Description: Component of the eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 (eIF-3) complex, which is involved in protein synthesis of a specialized repertoire of mRNAs and, together with other initiation factors, stimulates binding of mRNA and methionyl-tRNAi to the 40S ribosome. The eIF-3 complex specifically targets and initiates translation of a subset of mRNAs involved in cell proliferation. (UniProtKB:Q9VTU4)

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 303 member B3
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Is expressed in embryonic small intestine and embryonic/larval midgut. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcoholic pancreatitis; bilirubin metabolic disorder (multiple); cholecystolithiasis; cholelithiasis; and female reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including UGT1A1 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A1); UGT1A10 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A10); and UGT1A3 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A3).

Name: abnormal oocyte
Description: abnormal oocyte (abo) encodes a negative regulator of histone transcription genes by its binding to their regulatory regions. abo mutations cause a maternal-effect lethality that can be rescued by specific regions of heterochromatin during early embryogenesis.

Name: Dopamine 1-like receptor 2
Description: Receptor for dopamine. The activity of this receptor is mediated by G proteins which activate adenylyl cyclase. Also capable of generating a calcium signal. In terms of antagonist responses, would be classed with the D1-like dopamine receptor group. This receptor is an attractive candidate for initiating biochemical cascades underlying olfactory learning. (UniProtKB:Q24563)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human AIFM3 (apoptosis inducing factor mitochondria associated 3).

Name: Wnt oncogene analog 4
Description: Binds as a ligand to a family of frizzled seven-transmembrane receptors and acts through a cascade of genes on the nucleus. Acts downstream of homeotic complex genes in the visceral mesoderm and is required for embryonic segmentation. Also required for cell movement and FAK regulation during ovarian morphogenesis. (UniProtKB:P40589)

Name: Aminolevulinate synthase
Description: Aminolevulinate synthase (Alas) encodes a mitochondrial enzyme involved in cuticle barrier formation and thought to have a role in Heme biosynthesis.

Description: Predicted to be involved in inosine biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Sneddon syndrome. Orthologous to human ADA2 (adenosine deaminase 2).

Name: aurora borealis
Description: aurora borealis (bora) encodes a binding partner of the product of aurA. It is required for spindle orientation and asymmetric cell division.

Name: Acyl-CoA synthetase X4
Description: Predicted to enable long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty-acyl-CoA biosynthetic process and long-chain fatty acid metabolic process. Is expressed in embryonic epipharynx; embryonic hindgut; and embryonic/larval midgut.

Name: peanut
Description: peanut (pnut) encodes a protein that belongs to the septin family of polymerizing GTPases. Together with the products of Septin1 and Septin2, it forms the septin complex. It participates in cytokinesis and other processes that involve organization of the cell cortex.

Description: Is expressed in organism.

Description: Predicted to enable potassium channel regulator activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of muscle contraction and regulation of potassium ion transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane and striated muscle dense body. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human UNC93A (unc-93 homolog A).

Name: Alkaline phosphatase 2
Description: Enables alkaline phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cell surface. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in inflammatory bowel disease. Orthologous to human ALPG (alkaline phosphatase, germ cell); ALPI (alkaline phosphatase, intestinal); and ALPP (alkaline phosphatase, placental).

Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Cytochrome P450 309a2
Description: May be involved in the metabolism of insect hormones and in the breakdown of synthetic insecticides. (UniProtKB:P82713)

Name: hyrax
Description: hyrax (hyx) encodes a protein recruited by signaling pathway specific transcriptional regulators such as the products of arm and ci and is important for the output of Wingless and Hedgehog pathways.

Name: Acyl-CoA synthetase X3
Description: Predicted to enable long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty-acyl-CoA biosynthetic process and long-chain fatty acid metabolic process. Is expressed in adult head and yolk nucleus.

Name: Glycerol kinase 1
Description: Enables glycerol kinase activity. Involved in glycerol-3-phosphate biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; and spermatozoon. Used to study glycerol kinase deficiency. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glycerol kinase deficiency. Orthologous to human GK (glycerol kinase); GK2 (glycerol kinase 2); and GK3P (glycerol kinase 3 pseudogene).

Name: Cytochrome P450 18a1
Description: Cytochrome P450-18a1 (Cyp18a1) encodes a P450 enzyme that inactivates the hormone 20 hydroxy ecdysone through addition of an OH group to the 26 carbon of the hormone molecule. It is expressed in many larval tissues. Cyp18a1 mutants result in prepupal lethality due to improper activation kinetics of the transcription factor encoded by ftz-f1.

Name: RIO kinase 2
Description: Predicted to enable protein kinase activity. Involved in positive regulation of glial cell proliferation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of preribosome, small subunit precursor. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Orthologous to human RIOK2 (RIO kinase 2).

Name: Ecdysone-induced protein 63E
Description: Ecdysone-induced protein 63E (Eip63E) encodes a cyclin-dependent kinase that interacts with the product of CycY. It contributes to embryogenesis, larval development and metamorphosis.

Name: presidents-cup
Description: Is expressed in elongation stage spermatid and primary spermatocyte.

Description: antimeros (atms) encodes a component of the PAF1 complex (together with the products of Atu, hyx, Rtf1 and Ctr9). The PAF1 complex physically interacts with components of the basal transcription machinery and sequence-specific transcription factors to control histone modifications and pause release.

Name: Serine hydroxymethyl transferase
Description: Serine hydroxymethyl transferase (Shmt) encodes a conserved pyridoxal phosphate-containing enzyme that converts serine into glycine and N5,N10-methylentetrahydrofolate. This reaction represents a major source for activated C1 units and tetrahydrofolate-mediated C1 metabolism.

Name: Myd88
Description: Myd88 (Myd88) encodes an adaptor protein involved in in the Toll pathway functioning downstream of the product of Tl and upstream of the product of tub. Toll pathway is a signaling cascade that plays a key role in various developmental and immune processes, notably embryonic dorsoventral patterning and regulation of antimicrobial peptides.

Name: Glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase 4
Description: Glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase 4 (Gpat4) encodes a de novo synthase of lysophosphatidic acid.

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 36 member A1
Description: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 36 member A1 (Ugt36A1) encodes a member of the superfamily of UDP glycosyltransferase enzymes, which are found across all kingdoms and are involved in detoxification of endogenous and xenobiotic compounds.

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 35 member A1
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic midgut chamber; embryonic/larval midgut; leg; and third segment of antenna. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcoholic pancreatitis; bilirubin metabolic disorder (multiple); cholecystolithiasis; cholelithiasis; and female reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including UGT1A1 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A1); UGT1A10 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A10); and UGT1A3 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 1 member A3).

Name: no ocelli
Description: May negatively regulate Notch-induced cell proliferation in the eye-head primordium. Required for development of the supraesophageal ganglion and ocelli. May act in leg and wing primordia to negatively regulate body-wall specifying genes and thereby promote appendage formation. Plays a role in tracheal development. (UniProtKB:Q24423)

Name: UDP-glycosyltransferase family 37 member B1
Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human UGT2B11 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member B11) and UGT2B4 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member B4).

Name: prolyl-4-hydroxylase-alpha NE1
Description: Predicted to enable procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-proline hydroxylation to 4-hydroxy-L-proline. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human P4HA3 (prolyl 4-hydroxylase subunit alpha 3).

Name: raspberry
Description: Catalyzes the conversion of inosine 5'-phosphate (IMP) to xanthosine 5'-phosphate (XMP), the first committed and rate-limiting step in the de novo synthesis of guanine nucleotides, and therefore plays an important role in the regulation of cell growth. (UniProtKB:Q07152)

Name: SET domain containing 3
Description: Protein-histidine N-methyltransferase that specifically mediates 3-methylhistidine (tele-methylhistidine) methylation of actin at 'His-74'. (UniProtKB:Q9W3U1)

Name: gilgamesh
Description: gilgamesh (gish) encodes a plasma membrane-associated kinase that regulates Hedgehog and Wingless signaling activity. It is involved in planar cell polarity via regulation of Rab11-mediated vesicle trafficking

Name: Cytochrome P450 12a4
Description: Has a role in resistance to insecticide lufenuron, but no other insecticides. (UniProtKB:Q9VE00)

Description: May be involved in the metabolism of insect hormones and in the breakdown of synthetic insecticides. (UniProtKB:Q9VYQ5)

Name: Serpin 28Dc
Description: Serpin 28Dc (Spn28Dc) encodes a hemolymphatic Serpin that negatively regulates an uncharacterized serine protease in the melanization cascade.

Name: godzilla E3 ubiquitin protein ligase
Description: godzilla E3 ubiquitin protein ligase (gzl) encodes a protein that ubiquitylates the SNARE protein encoded by Syb. It also promotes apico-basal transcytosis of the product of wg in the wing imaginal disc.

Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval central nervous system; endocrine system component; and eye disc. Used to study Parkinson's disease 1.

Name: DEAD box protein 21E2
Description: DEAD box protein 21E2 (Dbp21E2) encodes an essential protein and a member of a family of DEAD box RNA helicases. Photoreceptors lacking Dbp21E2 function show defects in rhodopsin biogenesis and the maintenance of photoreceptors, leading to cell degeneration.

Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human P4HA3 (prolyl 4-hydroxylase subunit alpha 3).

Name: sudestada1
Description: sudestada1 (sud1) encodes a prolyl hydroxylase that modifies a specific prolyl residue of the small ribosomal subunit protein encoded by RpS23. Lack of sud1 affects growth, triggers the unfolded protein response, as well as apoptosis and autophagy.

Name: Cytochrome P450 12a5
Description: Predicted to enable several functions, including heme binding activity; iron ion binding activity; and monooxygenase activity. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval midgut; and gastric caecum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autoimmune disease (multiple); bone disease (multiple); cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); and lung cancer (multiple). Orthologous to human CYP24A1 (cytochrome P450 family 24 subfamily A member 1); CYP27A1 (cytochrome P450 family 27 subfamily A member 1); and CYP27B1 (cytochrome P450 family 27 subfamily B member 1).

Name: Octopamine beta2 receptor
Description: Autoreceptor for octopamine (OA), which is a neurotransmitter, neurohormone, and neuromodulator in invertebrates (PubMed:15998303, PubMed:21186359). Essential for ovulation and fertilization (PubMed:25099506, PubMed:25353988). During ovulation it mediates the OA-induced relaxation of the oviduct visceral muscles, by increasing cAMP levels and activating effectors such as calmodulin-dependent kinase II (CaMKII) and cAMP-dependent protein kinase A (PKA) pathways (PubMed:25353988). Positively regulates synaptic growth; an action that is antagonized by Octbeta1R (PubMed:21186359, PubMed:22553037). (UniProtKB:Q4LBB9)

Name: female lethal d
Description: Associated component of the WMM complex, a complex that mediates N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methylation of mRNAs, a modification that plays a role in the efficiency of mRNA splicing and is required for sex determination (PubMed:27919077). Required for sex determination and dosage compensation via Sxl alternative splicing: m6A methylation acts as a key regulator of Sxl pre-mRNA and promotes female-specific alternative splicing of Sxl, which determines female physiognomy (PubMed:1695150, PubMed:27919077). M6A methylation is also required for neuronal functions (PubMed:27919077). Required for proper inclusion of regulated exons in Ubx transcripts, leading to isoforms Ia/b and IIa/b (PubMed:10101174). (UniProtKB:Q9Y091)

Name: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class S
Description: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class S (PIG-S) encodes a subunit of glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI) transamidase, which mediates GPI anchoring in the endoplasmic reticulum. GPI anchor attachment serves as a general mechanism for linking proteins to the cell surface membrane.

Is expressed in adult head; embryonic somatic muscle cell; and embryonic/larval somatic muscle cell. Orthologous to human UNC93A (unc-93 homolog A).

Name: cassowary
Description: Antiapoptotic factor. Also known to efficiently suppress E2F1-induced apoptosis. (UniProtKB:Q9V431)

Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase I. Predicted to be part of t-UTP complex. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human UTP15 (UTP15 small subunit processome component).

Name: Rad17
Description: Predicted to enable chromatin binding activity. Predicted to contribute to DNA clamp loader activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA damage checkpoint signaling; DNA repair; and mitotic DNA replication checkpoint signaling. Predicted to be part of Rad17 RFC-like complex. Orthologous to human RAD17 (RAD17 checkpoint clamp loader component).

Name: Coronin
Description: Involved in adult somatic muscle development and defense response to fungus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; visceral muscle primordium; and wing disc. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in coronin-1A deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including CORO1A (coronin 1A); CORO1B (coronin 1B); and CORO1C (coronin 1C).

Name: Tondu-domain-containing Growth Inhibitor
Description: Tondu-domain-containing Growth Inhibitor (Tgi) encodes a protein that interacts with both components of the sd-yki transcriptional complex to inhibit its activity and thus restrict tissue growth.

Description: Is expressed in embryonic/larval muscle system; embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell; organism; somatic muscle primordium; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: Nach
Description: Nach (Nach) encodes a predicted member of the Degenerin/Epithelial Sodium Channel family of proteins. It is mainly expressed in the tracheal system and functions in liquid clearance during tracheal development.

Name: Cytochrome P450 4c3
Description: May be involved in the metabolism of insect hormones and in the breakdown of synthetic insecticides. (UniProtKB:Q9VA27)

Description: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including circulatory system; embryonic/larval muscle system; gut section; presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system; and trunk mesoderm. Orthologous to human CCT2 (chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 2).

Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Description: Predicted to enable procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-proline hydroxylation to 4-hydroxy-L-proline. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum.

Orthologous to human CYP24A1 (cytochrome P450 family 24 subfamily A member 1); CYP27A1 (cytochrome P450 family 27 subfamily A member 1); and CYP27B1 (cytochrome P450 family 27 subfamily B member 1).

Name: Bestrophin 3
Description: Bestrophin 3 (Best3) encodes a paralog of the product of Best1, a Ca-activated Cl channel. A C-terminal domain inhibits the Cl channel function so that the product of Best3 does not produce current at physiological transmembrane voltages.

Is expressed in adult head; spermatogonium; spermatozoon; and testis. Orthologous to human LAP3 (leucine aminopeptidase 3).

Name: tailup
Description: tailup (tup) encodes a transcription factor that regulates neuronal sub-type identity, including motor, serotonergic and dopaminergic neuron identity. It regulates germ band retraction, dorsal closure, muscle and heart development.

Name: beaten path Ic
Description: beaten path Ic (beat-Ic) encodes a protein involved in axon guidance.

Name: lariat debranching enzyme
Description: Cleaves the 2'-5' phosphodiester linkage at the branch point of lariat intron pre-mRNAs after splicing and converts them into linear molecules that are subsequently degraded. It thereby facilitates ribonucleotide turnover. (UniProtKB:Q9VSD7)

Name: Ubiquitin-5E
Description: Predicted to enable protein tag and ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein ubiquitination and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in polytene chromosome band. Is expressed in organism and testis.

Description: spaghetti (spag) encodes a TPR domain-containing co-chaperone that associates with Hsp70 and Hsp90 to regulate their activity in macromolecular complexes like RNA polymerase, ribonucleoproteins and Phosphatidyl-Inositol 3-kinase-related kinases. It has been shown to regulate the product of dco levels, with consequences for circadian rhythms and apoptosis.

Name: Diacyl glycerol kinase epsilon
Description: Diacyl glycerol kinase epsilon (Dgkepsilon) encodes a kinase that plays a key role in the metabolism of diacylglycerol by converting diacylglycerol into phosphatidic acid.

Name: 5' nucleotidase A
Description: Predicted to enable 5'-nucleotidase activity. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human NT5DC1 (5'-nucleotidase domain containing 1).

Description: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding. Located in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; foregut primordium; germ layer; and gut section. Used to study intrinsic cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to human CCT4 (chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 4).

Name: D-2-hydroxyglutaric acid dehydrogenase
Description: D-2-hydroxyglutaric acid dehydrogenase (D2hgdh) encodes an enzyme involved in oxidation-reduction metabolism.

Name: pippin
Description: Enables glucose transmembrane transporter activity and trehalose transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in glucose transmembrane transport and trehalose transport. Is active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult fat body and adult head.

Name: Myt1
Description: Acts as a negative regulator of entry into mitosis (G2 to M transition) by phosphorylation of Cdk1 specifically when Cdk1 is complexed to cyclins (PubMed:11882391, PubMed:12072468, PubMed:15581871). Mediates phosphorylation of Cdk1 predominantly on 'Thr-14' (PubMed:11882391). Also involved in Golgi fragmentation (PubMed:11882391). May be involved in phosphorylation of Cdk1 on 'Tyr-15' to a lesser degree, however tyrosine kinase activity is unclear and may be indirect (PubMed:11882391). May be a downstream target of Notch signaling pathway during eye development (PubMed:12072468). (UniProtKB:Q9NI63)

Name: Lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase
Description: Lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase (LPCAT) encodes an enzyme involved in the synthesis of the major membrane lipid phosphatidylcholine. Combined with the activity of the phospholipase encoded by Pla2, it allows exchange of fatty acids on the sn-2 position, which is the major pathway to introduce polyunsaturated fatty acids into membrane phospholipids.

Name: Chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 6
Description: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in centriole replication. Predicted to be part of chaperonin-containing T-complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; germline cell; and gut section. Used to study intrinsic cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to several human genes including CCT6B (chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 6B).

Description: Predicted to enable alkaline phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in cell surface. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in inflammatory bowel disease. Orthologous to human ALPG (alkaline phosphatase, germ cell); ALPI (alkaline phosphatase, intestinal); and ALPP (alkaline phosphatase, placental).

Orthologous to several human genes including SLC22A10 (solute carrier family 22 member 10); SLC22A11 (solute carrier family 22 member 11); and SLC22A12 (solute carrier family 22 member 12).

Name: DNA primase subunit 2
Description: DNA primase subunit 2 (Prim2) encodes a regulatory subunit of the DNA polymerase alpha-primase complex, which synthesizes short RNA-DNA primers on the lagging strand during DNA synthesis.

Name: Pyruvate kinase
Description: Pyruvate kinase (PyK) encodes an enzyme involved in muscle development, glycolysis and glucose homeostasis.

Name: Osiris 24
Description: Is expressed in presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Source: Orthologous to human DYNC1I1 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 1) and DYNC1I2 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 2).
Description: Orthologous to human DYNC1I1 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 1) and DYNC1I2 (dynein cytoplasmic 1 intermediate chain 2).

Description: Predicted to enable UDP-glycosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be located in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to several human genes including UGT2B11 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member B11) and UGT2B4 (UDP glucuronosyltransferase family 2 member B4).

Name: Coat Protein (coatomer) delta
Description: Coat Protein (coatomer) delta (deltaCOP) mutants show narrow tracheal tubes due to defective luminal extracellular matrix secretion.

Name: Dpr-interacting protein zeta
Description: Involved in synapse organization. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in neuron projection. Is expressed in proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm2; transmedullary Y neuron TmY10; and transmedullary neuron Tm20. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ovarian cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including IGLON5 (IgLON family member 5); LSAMP (limbic system associated membrane protein); and NTM (neurotrimin).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval garland cell; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human TRABD (TraB domain containing).

Name: methuselah-like 11
Description: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; determination of adult lifespan; and response to starvation. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in amnioproctodeal invagination; cephalic furrow; and mesoderm.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in establishment of meiotic spindle orientation. Predicted to be located in condensed chromosome and spindle pole. Orthologous to human CCDC6 (coiled-coil domain containing 6).

Name: exuperantia
Description: Ensures the proper localization of the mRNA of the bicoid gene to the anterior regions of the oocyte thus playing a fundamental role in the establishment of the polarity of the oocyte. May bind the bcd mRNA. (UniProtKB:P28750)

Name: SET and MYND domain containing, arthropod-specific, member 4
Description: Predicted to enable histone deacetylase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of gene expression. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus.

Name: Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase (AspRS) is an essential gene that is predicted to encode an aspartate-tRNA ligase. It functions as a Sxl dosage-sensitive maternal modifier.

Name: Actin binding protein 1
Description: Actin binding protein 1 (Abp1) encodes an F-actin-binding protein. It plays important roles in cytoskeletal functions of both Scar/WAVE- and wasp-mediated Arp2/3 complex activation during synapse formation, bristle formation and eye development.

Name: gastrulation-defective
Description: gastrulation-defective (gd) encodes a secreted serine protease. It is a member of the protease cascade that generates the ligand that activates the receptor encoded by Tl. It contributes to establishment of the dorsal-ventral embryonic axis.

Name: homer

However, via hetero-multimerization, the products of AhcyL1 and AhcyL2 can suppress the activity of the enzyme encoded by Ahcy, which catalyzes the hydrolysis of S-Adenosylhomocysteine. The presence of a N-terminal IRBIT domain confers AhcyL1 and AhcyL2 proteins new functions in Ca[2+] signaling, intracellular pH regulation and production of deoxyribonucleotides.

Name: Histone deacetylase 1
Description: Catalyzes the deacetylation of lysine residues on the N-terminal part of the core histones (H2A, H2B, H3 and H4) (PubMed:11571273, PubMed:28245922, PubMed:12408863). Histone deacetylation may constitute a tag for epigenetic repression and plays an important role in transcriptional regulation, cell cycle progression and developmental events (PubMed:11571273, PubMed:8955276, PubMed:15545624, PubMed:15306652). For instance, deacetylation of histone H3 may be a prerequisite for the subsequent recruitment of the histone methyltransferase Su(var)3-9 to histones (PubMed:11571273). Involved in position-effect variegation (PEV) (PubMed:11571273). In the larval brain, part of a regulatory network including the transcriptional repressors klu, dpn and E(spl)mgamma-HLH which is required for type II neuroblast self-renewal and for maintaining erm in an inactive state in intermediate neural progenitors (INP) (PubMed:28245922). (UniProtKB:Q94517)

Name: Aldehyde dehydrogenase

Description: Seryl-tRNA synthetase (SerRS) encodes a protein that aminoacylates transfer RNAs (tRNA) for their use by the ribosome during protein synthesis.

Description: Cytochrome P450-6a17 (Cyp6a17) encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 (CYP) family of proteins involved in the oxidation of diverse organic substrates. Description: Predicted to enable histone deacetylase binding activity and protein-lysine N-methyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of gene expression. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: cactus

Toll signaling promotes the destruction of cact protein, which allows the products of dl and Dif to enter the nucleus and regulate gene expression.

Name: Juvenile hormone Inducible-21

Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cholangiocarcinoma; colon cancer; hepatocellular carcinoma; and lung squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC7A5 (solute carrier family 7 member 5).

Name: rasp
Description: rasp (rasp) encodes an acyltransferase enzyme that adds essential N-terminal palmitate modifications to the secreted signaling domains of the products of hh and spi. The modification of the product of spi appears to increase the local concentration of the ligand by restricting its diffusion.

Name: wrapper

It functions as a downstream effector of the product of Rho1 in a context dependent manner. It is involved in nuclear and cytoplasmic cytoskeleton related cellular processes, including ooplasmic streaming, endosome recycing, hemocyte migration, and global nuclear organization.

Name: Tyrosylprotein sulfotransferase
Description: Catalyzes the O-sulfation of tyrosine residues within acidic motifs of polypeptides (By similarity). Has a role in protein secretion. (UniProtKB:Q9VYB7)

Name: apontic
Description: apontic (apt) encodes a DNA-binding protein that acts as a transcriptional regulator and can function in translational repression. It plays roles in cell migration, cell fate specification, and morphogenesis via STAT signaling pathway inhibition.

Name: marionette
Description: marionette (mrn) encodes a subunit of the basal transcription and DNA repair factor TFIIH.

Description: Receptor for the neuropeptide CCHamide-1 (PubMed:21110953, PubMed:23293632). Plays a role in the modulation of starvation-induced olfactory behavior where starved flies show increased responsiveness to food odorants, repellants and pheromones (PubMed:24067446). (UniProtKB:A1ZAX0)

Name: Shaker cognate w
Description: Shaker cognate w (Shaw) encodes a voltage-gated potassium channel (Kv3.1) that mediates a non-inactivating potassium current open at resting membrane potential. It is important for controlling excitability of motor neurons and clock neurons. It regulates circadian rhythms and is in a pathway with the product of qsm and Na[+] K[+] Ca[2+] Co-transporter.

Description: Death-associated inhibitor of apoptosis 2 (Diap2) encodes a protein with ubiquitin E3-ligase activity that functions in the Imd pathway by conjugating the product of imd with K63-polyubiquitin chains.

Name: Male-specific transcript 36Fa
Description: Involved in spermatogenesis. Is expressed in primary spermatocyte; spermatid; and spermatocyte.

Name: pickpocket 6
Description: pickpocket 6 (ppk6) encodes a member of the DEG/ENaC family, whose members act as non-voltage-gated cation channels. DEG/ENaC family members have been implicated in the maintenance of sodium gradients across epithelial membranes, as well as in diverse sensory modalities, which include gustatory chemosensation, mechanosensation, hygrosensation, and nociception.

Name: X box binding protein-1
Description: X box binding protein-1 (Xbp1) encodes a transcription factor that mediates the unfolded protein response. Xbp1 mRNA undergoes splicing after being cleaved by the product of Ire1, inducing the expression of ER quality control transcripts. Xbp1 mutants fail to develop beyond the 2nd instar larval stage, indicative of a requirement to resolve inherent ER stress during normal development.

Name: Phosphatidylserine synthase
Description: Catalyzes a base-exchange reaction in which the polar head group of phosphatidylethanolamine (PE) is replaced by L-serine. (UniProtKB:Q9VPD3)

Name: Zinc transporter 41F

Is expressed in adult head; embryonic central brain; germ layer derivative; and gut section. Orthologous to human SLC30A4 (solute carrier family 30 member 4).

Name: Phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase, alpha-subunit
Description: Phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase, alpha-subunit (alpha-PheRS) encodes a cytoplasmic aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase that catalyzes the ligation of Phenylalanine to its cognate tRNAPhe. Together with the beta-subunit it forms a tetrameric enzyme complex. This subunit provides the catalytic core.

Name: P58IPK
Description: Predicted to enable chaperone binding activity and misfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding in endoplasmic reticulum. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval digestive system; embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval garland cell; extended germ band embryo; and presumptive embryonic/larval digestive system. Orthologous to human DNAJC3 (DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member C3).

Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in anion transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head.

Description: non-stop (not) encodes a component of the Spt-Ada-Gcn5 Acetyltransferase (SAGA) chromatin modifying complex. It deubiquitinates the product of His2B at active promoters, thereby promoting transcription elongation. It was first identified for its role in neural development in the optic lobe.

Name: Ligand-gated chloride channel homolog 3
Description: GABA, an inhibitory neurotransmitter, mediates neuronal inhibition by binding to the GABA receptor and opening an integral chloride channel. Combines with the ligand-gated ion channel subunit GRD to form cation-selective GABA-gated ion channels when coexpressed in Xenopus laevis oocytes. (UniProtKB:Q08832)

Description: Predicted to enable snoRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in rRNA processing. Predicted to be part of box C/D RNP complex and small-subunit processome. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; adult heart; and embryonic/larval optic lobe. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spinocerebellar ataxia type 36. Name: methuselah-like 5
Description: methuselah-like 5 (mthl5) encodes a G protein-coupled receptor involved in heart morphogenesis.

Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary folate malabsorption. Orthologous to human SLC46A1 (solute carrier family 46 member 1) and SLC46A3 (solute carrier family 46 member 3).

Name: estrogen-related receptor
Description: estrogen-related receptor (ERR) encodes a protein that directly induces a transcriptional switch in mid-embryogenesis, up-regulating the genes that act in biosynthetic pathways associated with aerobic glycolysis. This nuclear receptor establishes the metabolic state that supports growth during larval stages.

Orthologous to human KHNYN (KH and NYN domain containing); N4BP1 (NEDD4 binding protein 1); and NYNRIN (NYN domain and retroviral integrase containing).

Name: Dietary and metabolic glutamate transporter
Description: Dietary and metabolic glutamate transporter (dmGlut) encodes a sodium-independent transmembrane glutamate transporter. It plays an essential role during early embryogenesis. It causes megamitochondria formation when it is overexpressed.

Name: Pi3K21B
Description: Pi3K21B (Pi3K21B) encodes an adaptor protein (p60) that binds the product of Pi3K92E to form the functional class IA phosphoinositide 3-kinase. This heterodimeric kinase is involved in phosphatidylinositol phosphorylation and regulates cell size and proliferation.

Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic Malpighian tubule; extended germ band embryo; labral sensory complex; labral sensory complex primordium; and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in fumarase deficiency and lung non-small cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human FH (fumarate hydratase).

Name: Crustacean cardioactive peptide receptor
Description: Binds to the cardioactive peptide (CCAP), which is a neuropeptide. (UniProtKB:Q868T3)

Name: Painting of fourth
Description: Painting of fourth (Pof) encodes a protein that binds to nascent RNA from actively transcribed genes and increases their expression levels. It specifically targets the 4th chromosome and two loci on the X-chromosome.

Name: Muscle LIM protein at 84B
Description: Muscle LIM protein at 84B (Mlp84B) encodes a muscle cytoskeletal protein found primarily at the Z-line boundary. It maintains muscle structural integrity and regulates actin bundling.

Orthologous to several human genes including UBAP1 (ubiquitin associated protein 1).

Name: Lysine demethylase 4A
Description: Lysine (K)-specific demethylase 4A (Kdm4A) encodes a histone lysine demethylase that catalyzes removal of methyl groups using alpha-ketoglutarate as a cofactor. It demethylates H3K36me3 and is implicated in the demethylation of H3K9me3 and H3K56me3. Its roles include transcription, DNA repair, and heterochromatin silencing.

Name: alpha-L-fucosidase
Description: alpha-L-fucosidase (Fuca) encodes an enzyme belonging to the family of hydrolases. It has also been identified as a transmembrane protein in the plasma-membrane of spermatozoa. Its roles include N-glycan degradation, glycan structure degradation, and is potentially involved in fertilization, particularly in initial sperm-egg recognition.

Description: Amylase proximal (Amy-p) encodes one of three amylases encoded in the Drosophila genome. It is a digestive enzyme required for the hydrolysis of dietary starch.

Description: As a subunit of eukaryotic initiation factor 2 (eIF-2), involved in the early steps of protein synthesis. This leads to the displacement of eIF-1 to allow GTPase-activating protein (GAP) eIF-5-mediated hydrolysis of eIF2-bound GTP. In order for eIF-2 to recycle and catalyze another round of initiation, the GDP bound to eIF-2 must be exchanged with GTP by way of a reaction catalyzed by GDP-GTP exchange factor (GEF) eIF-2B. Description: Cdk5 activator-like protein (Cdk5alpha) encodes the sole, essential stimulatory subunit for the kinase encoded by Cdk5. The Cdk5/Cdk5alpha complex is active in post-mitotic neurons. Description: Polycomb group (PcG) protein. Catalytic component of the PR-DUB complex, a complex that specifically mediates deubiquitination of histone H2A monoubiquitinated at 'Lys-118' (H2AK118ub1). Does not deubiquitinate monoubiquitinated histone H2B. Required to maintain the transcriptionally repressive state of homeotic genes throughout development. The PR-DUB complex has weak or no activity toward 'Lys-48'- and 'Lys-63'-linked polyubiquitin chains. (UniProtKB:Q7K5N4)

Name: astrocytic leucine-rich repeat molecule
Description: Is expressed in CNS glial cell; adult head; and larval ventral nerve cord. Orthologous to human NRROS (negative regulator of reactive oxygen species) and TSKU (tsukushi, small leucine rich proteoglycan).

Name: hedgehog
Description: hedgehog (hh) encodes the Hh signaling pathway ligand. It acts as a morphogen contributing to segment polarity determination, stem cells maintenance and cell migration. Post-translational modifications of the product of hh are essential for its restrictive spreading and signaling activity.

Name: ETHR
Description: ETHR (ETHR) encodes two distinct G protein-coupled receptors through alternative splicing. During development, the receptors are essential in initiating the molt-related behaviors of ecdysis, and in adults they function to promote juvenile hormone signaling and reproduction.

Name: Mucin 26B
Description: Predicted to be an extracellular matrix structural constituent. Predicted to be located in extracellular matrix. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval tracheal section; and gut section.

Description: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing involved in protein targeting to mitochondrion. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including adult heart; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and spermatozoon. Description: Predicted to enable heparin binding activity and integrin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell adhesion; negative regulation of cell death; and signal transduction. Predicted to be active in extracellular matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in arthropathy and progressive pseudorheumatoid arthropathy of childhood. Orthologous to several human genes including CCN1 (cellular communication network factor 1); CCN2 (cellular communication network factor 2); and CCN5 (cellular communication network factor 5).

Description: Rox8 (Rox8) encodes a protein involved in the regulation of alternative mRNA splicing.

Predicted to be part of tricarboxylic acid cycle enzyme complex. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in fumarase deficiency and lung non-small cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human FH (fumarate hydratase).

Name: Gustatory receptor 28b
Description: Gustatory receptor 28b (Gr28b) encodes a gustatory receptor involved in the detection of some bitter taste compounds. It is necessary for the detection of L-canavanine and coumarin.

It also controls other signaling pathways, including Notch, receptor tyrosine kinase, Hedgehog, and Toll. It is required maternally for normal embryonic patterning and zygotically for larval viability.

Name: Gustatory receptor 64f
Description: One of the few identified sugar gustatory receptors identified so far and which promotes the starvation-induced increase of feeding motivation. Required in combination with Gr64a to detect sucrose, maltose, and glucose. (UniProtKB:P83297)

Description: nervous fingers 1 (nerfin-1) encodes a zinc finger transcription factor that regulates early axon guidance at the embryonic stage and is required for the maintenance of larval neuron differentiation. In the larval medulla cortex, nerfin-1 is expressed in medulla neurons at the early stage and protects them from dedifferentiation via the repression of Notch signaling pathway.

Name: Mitochondrial trifunctional protein beta subunit
Description: Mitochondrial trifunctional protein beta subunit (Mtpbeta) encodes a protein involved in fatty acid beta-oxidation.

Description: Dorsocross2 (Doc2) encodes one of the three tissue-specific T-box transcription factors encoded by the Dorsocross cluster. It is crucial for completion of differentiation, cell proliferation arrest and survival of amnioserosa cells, as well as for cardiogenesis and the patterning and morphogenesis of particular ectodermal derivatives.

Name: like-AP180
Description: like-AP180 (lap) encodes a cytosolic protein that acts as a clathrin adaptor to promote clathrin-coated vesicle formation and restrict coated vesicle size. At synapses it regulates synaptic vesicle size as well as the efficacy of synaptic vesicle protein retrieval.

Name: Vacuolar H[+]-ATPase SFD subunit
Description: Subunit of the V1 complex of vacuolar(H+)-ATPase (V-ATPase), a multisubunit enzyme composed of a peripheral complex (V1) that hydrolyzes ATP and a membrane integral complex (V0) that translocates protons (By similarity). V-ATPase is responsible for acidifying and maintaining the pH of intracellular compartments and in some cell types, is targeted to the plasma membrane, where it is responsible for acidifying the extracellular environment (By similarity). Subunit H is essential for V-ATPase activity, but not for the assembly of the complex (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9V3J1)

Description: Enables GTPase activator activity. Involved in negative regulation of endocytosis and regulation of ARF protein signal transduction. Located in Golgi stack. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human ARFGAP1 (ADP ribosylation factor GTPase activating protein 1).

Orthologous to several human genes including SLC36A1 (solute carrier family 36 member 1); SLC36A2 (solute carrier family 36 member 2); and SLC36A3 (solute carrier family 36 member 3).

Name: wingless
Description: wingless (wg) is a segment polarity gene that encodes a ligand of the Wnt/Wg signaling pathway. Its post-translational modification (addition of palmitoleate by the product of por) is essential for signaling activity. It contributes to segment polarity, tissue growth and patterning, neuromuscular junction morphogenesis, gut homeostasis and long term memory formation.

Name: Suppressor of fused
Description: Suppressor of fused (Su(fu)) encodes a negative regulator of the Hedgehog signaling pathway. It forms a complex with the transcription factor encoded by ci to inhibit its activity.

Description: Multiple inositol polyphosphate phosphatase 1 (Mipp1) encodes a highly conserved extracellular enzyme that removes phosphates from inositol polyphosphates (IP6, IP5 and IP4) to form IP3. The Mipp1 product functions extracellularly to promote filopodia formation. Its enzymatic activity and localization are both key during tracheal cell migration.

Name: Syntaxin 5
Description: Syntaxin 5 (Syx5) encodes a type II transmembrane protein in the Q-SNARE family that forms hetero tetramers required for membrane function in the early secretory pathway (ER and Golgi). It has been involved in cytokinesis during spermatogenesis.

Description: Involved in endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval central nervous system; embryonic/larval circulatory system; embryonic/larval digestive system; embryonic/larval fat body; and ring gland. Orthologous to human HERPUD2 (HERPUD family member 2) and HERPUD1 (homocysteine inducible ER protein with ubiquitin like domain 1).

Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in adult head; adult midgut; and embryonic hypopharynx. Orthologous to human SLC2A8 (solute carrier family 2 member 8).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; adult thorax; embryonic/larval salivary gland; and larval ventral nerve cord. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in iminoglycinuria. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC36A1 (solute carrier family 36 member 1); SLC36A2 (solute carrier family 36 member 2); and SLC36A3 (solute carrier family 36 member 3).

Name: slalom
Description: slalom (sll) encodes the first transporter of 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate (PAPS), that transfers PAPS from cytosol into the lumen of Golgi. It contributes to the sulfation of glycans and proteins, the regulation of several signaling pathways (Hh, Wingless) mediated by glycosaminoglycans during patterning and morphogenesis, and the determination of the embryonic dorsal/ventral axis.

Description: Predicted to enable aspartic-type endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Orthologous to human PGC (progastricsin).

Name: Hexokinase testis 1
Description: Catalyzes the phosphorylation of various hexoses to hexose 6-phosphate. (UniProtKB:Q9NFT9)

Name: loquacious
Description: loquacious (loqs) encodes a double-stranded RNA binding protein with multiple splicing isoforms. loqs-PB and loqs-PA associate with the product of Dcr-1 to facilitate processing of precursor miRNA into mature miRNA, whereas loqs-PD interacts with the product of Dcr-2 to enhance processing of dsRNA into siRNA.

Name: HMG Coenzyme A synthase
Description: Predicted to enable hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA synthase activity. Predicted to be involved in acetyl-CoA metabolic process and farnesyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate pathway. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval tracheal dorsal trunk; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in HMG-CoA synthase 2 deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including HMGCS1 (3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult brain; adult brain cell body rind; and adult head.

Name: PR/SET domain 13
Description: Predicted to enable chromatin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including extended germ band embryo; larval ventral nerve cord; and presumptive embryonic/larval central nervous system. Used to study macular degeneration. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pontocerebellar hypoplasia. Orthologous to human PRDM13 (PR/SET domain 13).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in heterochromatin. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human ZNF497 (zinc finger protein 497).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in actin filament polymerization. Predicted to be active in actin cytoskeleton and cytoplasm. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human TTC17 (tetratricopeptide repeat domain 17).

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5
Description: Catalyzes the hydrolysis of GTP bound to the 40S ribosomal initiation complex (40S.mRNA.Met-tRNA[F].eIF-2.GTP) with the subsequent joining of a 60S ribosomal subunit resulting in the release of eIF-2 and the guanine nucleotide. The subsequent joining of a 60S ribosomal subunit results in the formation of a functional 80S initiation complex (80S.mRNA.Met-tRNA[F]) (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VXK6)

Name: Tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial (TyrRS-m) encodes an enzyme that catalyzes the ligation of tyrosine to the mitochondrial-encoded tRNA-Tyr. The TyrRS-m protein is encoded by a nuclear gene and imported to the mitochondria where it functions in mitochondrial protein synthesis.

Name: knockdown
Description: Plays a role in controlling neuronal activity and seizure susceptibility. (UniProtKB:Q9W401)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Description: Predicted to be involved in hematopoietic progenitor cell differentiation. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human ARMC6 (armadillo repeat containing 6).

Name: Fas-associated factor 2
Description: Fas-associated factor 2 (Faf2) encodes a putative E3 ligase adaptor protein with a proteosome dependent function.

Name: Seryl-tRNA synthetase-like insect mitochondrial protein
Description: Seryl-tRNA synthetase-like insect mitochondrial protein (Slimp) encodes an essential mitochondrial protein with a sharp expression profile during the G2 phase of the cell cycle.

Description: Predicted to enable enzyme binding activity and phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein methylation and regulation of response to DNA damage stimulus. Orthologous to human ARMT1 (acidic residue methyltransferase 1).

Name: RYamide receptor
Description: Receptor for the neuropeptides RYamide-1 and RYamide-2 (PubMed:21843505, PubMed:21704020). The activity of this receptor is mediated by G proteins which activate a phosphatidyl-inositol-calcium second messenger system (PubMed:21843505, PubMed:21704020). RYamide signaling may suppress feeding behavior (PubMed:21704020). (UniProtKB:P25931)

Name: Type III alcohol dehydrogenase
Description: Catalyzes the cofactor-independent reversible oxidation of gamma-hydroxybutyrate (GHB) to succinic semialdehyde (SSA) coupled to reduction of 2-ketoglutarate (2-KG) to D-2-hydroxyglutarate (D-2-HG). L-3-hydroxybutyrate (L-3-OHB) is also a substrate for HOT when using 2-KG as hydrogen acceptor, resulting in the formation of D-2-HG (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9W265)

Name: Ets at 97D
Description: May have a role in germline development. (UniProtKB:Q04688)

Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in syndromic X-linked intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including NKAP (NFKB activating protein).

Name: Juvenile hormone epoxide hydrolase 2
Description: Juvenile hormone epoxide hydrolase 2 (Jheh2) encodes an enzyme that hydrolyzes cis-stilbene oxide. Jheh2 expression changes are associated with increased tolerance to oxidative stress.

Name: N/A
Description: Involved in long-term memory and neuromuscular synaptic transmission. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; gonad; and gut section.

Name: yellow-h
Description: Catalyzes the conversion of dopaminechrome to 5,6-dihydroxyindole in the eumelanin biosynthetic pathway originating from dopamine (PubMed:34388859). Catalyzes tautomerization of dopaminechrome to 5,6-dihydroxyindole during eumelanin biosynthesis (PubMed:34388859). Acts both dopaminechrome and N-methyl dopaminechrome but not on dopachrome or other aminochromes tested (PubMed:34388859). (UniProtKB:Q9V4C0)

Name: eukaryotic translation elongation factor 1 alpha 1
Description: This protein promotes the GTP-dependent binding of aminoacyl-tRNA to the A-site of ribosomes during protein biosynthesis. (UniProtKB:P08736)

Name: female sterile (1) K10
Description: female sterile (1) K10 (fs(1)K10) encodes a nuclear protein of unknown biochemical function required during oogenesis for the proper localization of grk mRNA and protein in the oocyte, a key step in the specification of the dorsoventral axis of the oocyte, mature egg, and future embryo.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable methyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in translation. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium. Orthologous to human METTL17 (methyltransferase like 17).

Description: Predicted to enable microtubule binding activity. Predicted to be part of kinesin complex.

Name: Rlb1
Description: Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA. Located in membrane and nucleus. Is expressed in embryonic/larval midgut and organism.

Name: Cytochrome P450 4d8
Description: May be involved in the metabolism of insect hormones and in the breakdown of synthetic insecticides. (UniProtKB:Q9VS79)

Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of very high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed during late larval stages.

Name: tricornered
Description: tricornered (trc) encodes a nuclear Dbf2-related kinase whose mutations lead to mulitpled hairs, split and multipled arista laterals and to defects in dendritic tiling.

Name: beta-Tubulin at 65B
Description: Tubulin is the major constituent of microtubules, a cylinder consisting of laterally associated linear protofilaments composed of alpha- and beta-tubulin heterodimers. Microtubules grow by the addition of GTP-tubulin dimers to the microtubule end, where a stabilizing cap forms. Below the cap, tubulin dimers are in GDP-bound state, owing to GTPase activity of alpha-tubulin. (UniProtKB:Q9VRX3)

Name: Chitinase 4
Description: Chitinase 4 (Cht4) encodes a chitin binding protein with chitinolytic activity.

Name: piopio
Description: piopio (pio) encodes a zona pellucida (ZP) domain protein that mediates the adhesion of the apical epithelial surface and the overlying apical extracellular matrix.

Name: Nfs1 cysteine desulfurase
Description: Catalyzes the removal of elemental sulfur from cysteine to produce alanine. It supplies the inorganic sulfur for iron-sulfur (Fe-S) clusters. (UniProtKB:Q9VKD3)

Name: eukaryotic translation elongation factor 1 alpha 2
Description: This protein promotes the GTP-dependent binding of aminoacyl-tRNA to the A-site of ribosomes during protein biosynthesis. (UniProtKB:P05303)

Name: tube
Description: tube (tub) encodes an adaptor protein, which functions downstream of the product of Myd88 in the Toll pathway. Toll pathway is a signaling cascade that plays a key role in various developmental and immune processes, notably embryonic dorsoventral patterning and regulation of antimicrobial peptides.

Name: Heparan sulfate 6-O-sulfotransferase
Description: Heparan sulfate 6-O-sulfotransferase (Hs6st) encodes a heparan sulfate modifying enzyme, which transfers a sulfate group to the 6-O position of glucosamine residues of heparan sulfate. Loss of Hs6st eliminates 6-O sulfation, but increases 2-O sulfation performed by the product of Hs2st. Simultaneous elimination of Hs6st and Hs2st disrupts FGF, Wg and Dpp signaling pathways.

Name: escl
Description: escl (escl) encodes an essential component of the Polycomb Repressive Complex 2, whose function is to methylate histone H3K27. Although the product of escl is functionally equivalent to the product of esc, it is not maternally supplied in equally high levels and some homeotic phenotypes occur in the absence of the product of esc.
