Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages.

Name: Dihydrolipoamide branched chain transacylase E2
Description: Predicted to enable acetyltransferase activity and lipoic acid binding activity. Involved in isoleucine catabolic process; leucine catabolic process; and valine catabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; embryonic/larval midgut; and organism. Used to study maple syrup urine disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in maple syrup urine disease. Orthologous to human DBT (dihydrolipoamide branched chain transacylase E2).

Name: SET and MYND domain containing, arthropod-specific, member 8
Description: Predicted to enable S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methyltransferase activity and histone deacetylase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in histone lysine methylation and negative regulation of gene expression. Predicted to be located in chromatin. Is expressed in eye; photoreceptor neurons; and spermatozoon.

Name: alpha-Tubulin at 67C
Description: alpha-Tubulin at 67C (alphaTub67C) encodes a protein that form heterodimers with beta-tubulins to polymerise and form microtubules. Tubulin molecules containing the product of alphaTub67C are essential for fast growth of the microtubules during the initial cleavage divisions of embryogenesis.

Name: Gasz
Description: Gasz (Gasz) encodes an essential factor for primary piRNA biogenesis. It is predicted to stimulate cleavage of piRNA precursors by the endonuclease encoded by zuc via the recruitment of piRNA precursors and biogenesis factors to the mitochondrial surface.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity.

Name: Gram-negative bacteria binding protein 2
Description: Involved in the recognition of invading microorganisms. Binds specifically to beta-1,3-glucan and activates the phenoloxidase cascade (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q9VVR4)

Name: Gustatory receptor 32a
Description: Gustatory receptor which mediates acceptance or avoidance behavior, depending on its substrates. Required for the response to N,N-Diethyl-meta-toluamide (DEET), the most widely used insect repellent worldwide. Functions as a pheromone receptor for a male inhibitory pheromone and promotes male-male aggression and suppresses male-male courtship. Also promotes preferentially virgin females courting over mated females. (UniProtKB:Q9VKJ7)

Name: goliath
Description: goliath (gol) encodes an E3 ubiquitin ligase, whose cellular substrates are unknown. During embyrogenesis gol is expressed in fusion-competence myoblasts of the somatic and visceral mesoderm.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable iron ion binding activity and stearoyl-CoA 9-desaturase activity. Predicted to be involved in unsaturated fatty acid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in adult head; hindgut proper primordium; integumentary specialization; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 79. Orthologous to human SCD (stearoyl-CoA desaturase) and SCD5 (stearoyl-CoA desaturase 5).

Name: alpha-tubulin acetylase
Description: Specifically acetylates 'Lys-40' in alpha-tubulin on the lumenal side of microtubules. Promotes microtubule destabilization and accelerates microtubule dynamics; this activity may be independent of acetylation activity. Acetylates alpha-tubulin with a slow enzymatic rate, due to a catalytic site that is not optimized for acetyl transfer. Enters the microtubule through each end and diffuses quickly throughout the lumen of microtubules. Acetylates only long/old microtubules because of its slow acetylation rate since it does not have time to act on dynamically unstable microtubules before the enzyme is released. (UniProtKB:Q9VSY4)

Name: N/A
Description: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Located in Golgi cis cisterna. Is expressed in embryonic proventriculus; embryonic/larval salivary gland; organism; and salivary gland body primordium. Orthologous to human FAM114A1 (family with sequence similarity 114 member A1) and FAM114A2 (family with sequence similarity 114 member A2).

Name: Nitrilase and fragile histidine triad fusion protein
Description: Nitrilase and fragile histidine triad fusion protein (NitFhit) encodes a bis(5'-adenosyl)-triphosphatase involved in nucleobase-containing compound metabolism.

Description: Predicted to be involved in flagellated sperm motility. Predicted to be located in sperm flagellum. Is expressed in chordotonal neurons and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human TCTE1 (t-complex-associated-testis-expressed 1).

Peak expression observed during late pupal stages.

Name: polyphemus
Description: Probable glutamate transporter which transports extracellular glutamate into the cells. Regulates the production of intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) probably by controlling the synthesis of antioxidant glutathione. By regulating ROS production in blood cells, required for maintaining bacteria phagocytosis following infection with S.aureus and possibly E.coli. (UniProtKB:Q4V5R4)

Name: Birt-Hogg-Dube
Description: Birt-Hogg-Dube (BHD) encodes a protein involved in the maintenance of germ-line stem cells and the regulation of nucleolar large rRNA transcription.

Name: peter pan
Description: Required for initiation of larval growth and normal mitotic growth but is not absolutely required for general biosynthesis or DNA replication. Required for progression of normal oogenesis and maturation of some imaginal tissues into adult structures. (UniProtKB:Q9VDE5)

Name: Dead box protein 80
Description: Dead box protein 80 (Dbp80) encodes a putative ATP-dependent RNA helicase (DEAD box helicase), based on sequence similarity to other Dead box proteins, which are involved in mRNA export from the nucleus.

Name: king tubby
Description: king tubby (ktub) encodes a protein that belongs to the tubby and tubby-like protein family. It functions in endocytosis of the rhodopsin encoded by ninaE, retinal degeneration upon light stimulation, and the localization of channel encoded by the channel encoded by trp in cilia.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in transmembrane transport. Predicted to be active in membrane.

Name: pickpocket 13
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval tracheal dorsal trunk; gustatory sensory organ; olfactory receptor neuron of dorsal organ; tarsal segment; and terminal organ.

Name: Origin recognition complex subunit 5
Description: Component of the origin recognition complex (ORC) that binds origins of replication. DNA-binding is ATP-dependent, however specific DNA sequences that define origins of replication have not been identified so far. ORC is required to assemble the pre-replication complex necessary to initiate DNA replication (By similarity). (UniProtKB:Q24169)

Name: Grasp65
Description: Grasp65 (Grasp65) encodes a myristoylated Golgi protein that binds the product of GM130 and has been shown to mediate the Golgi bypass of transmembrane proteins.

Name: Asparaginyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Predicted to enable asparagine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in asparaginyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 94 and combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 24. Orthologous to human NARS2 (asparaginyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial).

Peak expression observed at stages throughout the pupal period, in adult male stages.

Name: cGAS-like receptor 2
Description: Nucleotidyltransferase that catalyzes the formation of cyclic GMP-AMP from ATP and GTP and plays a key role in antiviral innate immunity (PubMed:34261128). Directly binds some unknown nucleic acid, activating the nucleotidyltransferase activity, leading to synthesis of both 3',2'-cGAMP and 2',3'-cGAMP second messengers (PubMed:34261128). 3',2'-cGAMP and 2',3'-cGAMP bind to and activate Sting, thereby triggering the antiviral immune response via activation of the NF-kappa-B transcription factor Rel (Relish) (PubMed:34261128). (UniProtKB:A8DYP7)

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism; pole plasm; and spermatozoon.

Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG5644 (FBgn0035948). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:8977395..8979880. Its molecular function is described by: ecdysteroid 22-kinase activity. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages.

Name: DDB1 and CUL4 associated factor 12
Description: Substrate-recognition component of a DCX (DDB1-CUL4-X-box) E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex, which mediates ubiquitination of target proteins, leading to their degradation (PubMed:30670470, PubMed:31857346). Required for synaptic function and plasticity at larval neuromuscular junctions (NMJs) by promoting neurotransmitter release (PubMed:30670470). The DCX(DCAF12) complex catalyzes ubiquitination and degradation of yorkie (yki), thereby regulating the Hippo/SWH (Sav/Wts/Hpo) signaling pathway (PubMed:31857346). Acts as a regulator of tissue growth during development: required for the apoptotic elimination of supernumerary cells during metamorphosis (PubMed:26972874). (UniProtKB:Q9VGE3)

Name: mulet
Description: mulet (mlt) encodes a tubulin-specific chaperone E-like protein involved in sperm individualization and regulation of microtubule depolymerization.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4B
Description: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4B (eIF4B) encodes a protein involved in cap-dependent translation, cell survival, and proliferation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable chaperone binding activity. Involved in cellular response to hypoxia. Predicted to be part of PAM complex, Tim23 associated import motor. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to human TIMM44 (translocase of inner mitochondrial membrane 44).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in spermatozoon.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-ornithine transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial L-ornithine transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial envelope. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult abdomen; adult head; and adult thorax. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amino acid metabolic disorder; citrullinemia; and ornithine translocase deficiency. Orthologous to human SLC25A15 (solute carrier family 25 member 15) and SLC25A2 (solute carrier family 25 member 2).

Name: maelstrom
Description: Involved both in the piRNA and miRNA metabolic processes. As a component of the meiotic nuage, plays a central role during oogenesis by repressing transposable elements and preventing their mobilization, which is essential for the germline integrity. Repression of transposable elements is mediated via the piRNA metabolic process, which mediates the repression of transposable elements during meiosis by forming complexes composed of piRNAs and Piwi proteins and governs the repression of transposons. As a nuclear component, it is required for proper differentiation in the germline stem cell (GSC) lineage by repressing microRNA-7 (miR-7), thereby acting as an indirect regulator of bag-of-marbles (Bam). Acts by binding to the promoter of miR-7 gene and repressing its expression; miR-7 repression alleviates the Bam repression by miR-7, thereby allowing differentiation in the germline stem cell (GSC) lineage. Indirectly required to position the microtubule organizing center in stage 2-6 oocytes. (UniProtKB:Q9VNS0)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Predicted to be active in extracellular space. Is expressed in embryonic/larval fat body.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nuclear body. Is expressed in organism and spermatozoon.

Name: no child left behind
Description: Chromatin-associated factor that regulates transcription (PubMed:21752937). Regulates Pol I-mediated rRNA biogenesis and, probably, Pol III-mediated transcription (PubMed:29065309). Regulates the localization to the nucleolus of Cdk7, a regulator of the Pol I-elongation factor TFIIH (PubMed:29065309). Acts as regulator of cell proliferation and tissue growth as part of the TORC1 and Myc signaling pathway in response to nutrients (PubMed:29065309). Required in males for both germline stem cell (GSC) maintenance and early stages of germ cell differentiation of germ cell cysts (PubMed:21752937). Not required for female germline stem cell (GSC) maintenance, but necessary to regulate germ cell differentiation and egg chamber development (PubMed:21752937). In female somatic cells, required for follicle stem cell survival and maintenance (PubMed:21752937). (UniProtKB:A1Z8D0)

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4H2
Description: Predicted to enable nucleic acid binding activity and ribosomal small subunit binding activity. Predicted to be involved in eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4F complex assembly and formation of translation preinitiation complex. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Williams-Beuren syndrome. Orthologous to human EIF4H (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4H).

Name: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class W a
Description: Predicted to enable glucosaminyl-phosphatidylinositol O-acyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in GPI anchor biosynthetic process and protein localization to plasma membrane. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Orthologous to human PIGW (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class W).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable acid phosphatase activity and metal ion binding activity. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; blastoderm embryo; circulatory system; germ layer; and head mesoderm derivative. Orthologous to human ACP7 (acid phosphatase 7, tartrate resistant (putative)).

Name: maternal expression at 31B
Description: ATP-dependent RNA helicase which is a core component of a variety of ribonucleoprotein complexes (RNPs) that play critical roles in translational repression and mRNA decapping during embryogenesis, oogenesis, neurogenesis and neurotransmission (PubMed:11546740, PubMed:16256742, PubMed:17178403, PubMed:18590813, PubMed:21267420, PubMed:21447556, PubMed:28875934, PubMed:28388438, PubMed:17982591, PubMed:31114929). Recruits core components and translational repressors to some RNP complexes, and mediates RNP aggregation into processing granules such as P-bodies (PubMed:28875934, PubMed:11546740, PubMed:16256742, PubMed:17178403, PubMed:21267420, PubMed:21447556, PubMed:17982591). As part of a RNP complex containing tral, eIF4E1, cup, and pAbp, involved in RNP-mediated translational repression of maternal mRNAs during oogenesis and embryogenesis (PubMed:28875934). As part of a RNP complex containing tral and the RNA localization factors exu and yps, mediates translational silencing of mRNAs such as osk/oskar and bcd/bicoid during their transport to the oocyte in order to prevent their translation until they reach their positional destinations (PubMed:11546740). In neurons and possibly imaginal disks, involved in miRNA-mediated translational repression, possibly in association with components of the piRNA transposon silencing pathway (PubMed:21447556, PubMed:17178403, PubMed:21267420, PubMed:17982591, PubMed:21081899). Involved in RNA localization and protein trafficking in the oocyte (PubMed:11546740, PubMed:16256742). As part of an ER-associated RNP containing tral, cup and yps, required for tral-dependent ER exit site formation and consequently efficient trafficking of proteins such as grk and yl through the secretory pathway (PubMed:16256742). Component of neuron RNPs that mediate transport and translation of neuronal RNAs, including translation repression of synaptic transcripts in preparation for their dendritic targeting (PubMed:17178403, PubMed:21267420, PubMed:28388438). As part of the Atx2-Not1 repressor complex promotes Not1-dependent post-transcriptional gene silencing in adult circadian pacemaker neurons in order to sustain high-amplitude circadian rhythms and Pdf cycling in a per-independent manner (PubMed:28388438). Promotes the interaction between Atx2 and Not1 within the Atx2-Not1 RNP complex (PubMed:28388438). Recruited to the 4EHP-GYF2 complex by Gyf, where it plays a role in 4EHP-GYF2 mediated translational repression and mRNA decay (PubMed:31114929). (UniProtKB:P23128)

Name: Origin recognition complex subunit 4
Description: Origin recognition complex subunit 4 (Orc4) encodes is a subunit of the hetero-hexameric origin recognition complex (ORC). The ORC binds to origins of DNA replication and scaffolds assembly of a pre-replicative complex, which is required for the initiation of DNA replication. At other loci, the ORC is required for heterochromatin formation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be part of transcription regulator complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Spermine synthase
Description: Enables spermine synthase activity. Involved in spermine biosynthetic process. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval midgut; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; embryonic/larval muscle system; germ layer; and spermatozoon. Used to study syndromic X-linked intellectual disability Snyder type. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in syndromic X-linked intellectual disability Snyder type. Orthologous to human SMS (spermine synthase).

Name: Equilibrative nucleoside transporter 2
Description: Equilibrative nucleoside transporter 2 (Ent2) encodes a member of the equilibrative nucleoside transporter family and represents a primary plasma membrane equilibrative transporter. It is involved in stress signaling and adenosin recycling.

Name: rings lost
Description: rings lost (rngo) encodes a ubiquitin receptor that binds to ubiquitinated proteins via its ubiquitin-associated domain. It is an essential protein that is required for proper development of ring canals in the female germ line.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ATP hydrolysis activity. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human AFG1L (AFG1 like ATPase).

Name: Prolyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Predicted to enable proline-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in prolyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 75. Orthologous to human PARS2 (prolyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial).

Name: Sorting nexin 1
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in early endosome to Golgi transport. Predicted to be part of retromer, tubulation complex. Predicted to be active in endosome membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including circulatory system; embryonic/larval nervous system; germline cell; gut section; and plasmatocyte primordium. Orthologous to human SNX1 (sorting nexin 1) and SNX2 (sorting nexin 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of chitin-based larval cuticle. Predicted to be active in chitin-based extracellular matrix. Is expressed in presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: Mannosyl (alpha-1,3-)-glycoprotein beta-1,2-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase
Description: Mannosyl (alpha-1,3-)-glycoprotein beta-1,2-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase (Mgat1) encodes an enzyme involved in the synthesis of paucimannose N-glycans. It is required in the CNS, with involvement in locomotion, brain development and lifespan.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in protein N-linked glycosylation via asparagine. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in adult heart. Orthologous to human RPN1 (ribophorin I).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum.

Name: Xyloside xylosyltransferase
Description: Enables xylosyl alpha-1,3-xylosyltransferase activity. Involved in negative regulation of Notch signaling pathway and protein O-linked glycosylation. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Orthologous to human XXYLT1 (xyloside xylosyltransferase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic/larval circulatory system; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; and extraembryonic structure. Orthologous to human LRTM2 (leucine rich repeats and transmembrane domains 2).

Name: concertina
Description: May play a role in a signal transduction pathway used during gastrulation. Required specifically for the ventral furrow and posterior midgut invaginations, where it is necessary for coordinating cell shape changes. Guanine nucleotide-binding proteins (G proteins) are involved as modulators or transducers in various transmembrane signaling systems. (UniProtKB:P25157)

Name: Sulfide quinone oxidoreductase
Description: Predicted to enable FAD binding activity and sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase activity. Predicted to be involved in sulfide oxidation, using sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; and organism. Orthologous to human SQOR (sulfide quinone oxidoreductase).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval visceral muscle cell; gonad; gut section; and larval ventral nerve cord. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 67. Orthologous to several human genes including OSBPL2 (oxysterol binding protein like 2).

Name: egghead
Description: Glycosyltransferase with a proposed role in glycosphingolipid biosynthesis. Neurogenic protein implicated in epithelial development. Critical component of a differential oocyte-follicle cell adhesive system. (UniProtKB:O01346)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable creatine kinase activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head and spermatozoon. Orthologous to human CKMT1A (creatine kinase, mitochondrial 1A); CKMT1B (creatine kinase, mitochondrial 1B); and CKMT2 (creatine kinase, mitochondrial 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein transport. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in adult fat body and organism. Orthologous to human ARRDC5 (arrestin domain containing 5).

Name: pickpocket 30
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Involved in regulation of terminal button organization. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable triglyceride lipase activity. Involved in sexual reproduction. Located in extracellular space. Is expressed in adult head and male accessory gland. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Wolman disease; autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 8; cholesterol ester storage disease; and lysosomal and lipase deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including LIPA (lipase A, lysosomal acid type); LIPF (lipase F, gastric type); and LIPJ (lipase family member J).

Name: beta-Tubulin at 97EF
Description: beta-Tubulin at 97EF (betaTub97EF) is one of five distinct paralogs that codes for a beta-tubulin protein. beta-tubulin protein can polymerize into microtubules after heterodimerization with an alpha-tubulin protein. betaTub97EF expression is tissue-specific and up-regulated at low temperature. Microtubules containing this beta-tubulin are relatively stable.

Name: Zinc-finger protein interacting with CP190
Description: Zinc-finger protein interacting with CP190 (ZIPIC) encodes a promoter-binding transcription factor that displays architectural and insulator functions.

Name: N/A
Description: Specifically methylates the N1 position of guanosine-37 in various cytoplasmic and mitochondrial tRNAs. Methylation is not dependent on the nature of the nucleoside 5' of the target nucleoside. This is the first step in the biosynthesis of wybutosine (yW), a modified base adjacent to the anticodon of tRNAs and required for accurate decoding. (UniProtKB:Q8IRE4)

Name: Zpr1
Description: Zpr1 (Zpr1) encodes a protein that functions downstream of the EGFR and other tyrosine kinase receptors. It also contributes to the assembly of spliceosome snRNPs. In the developing tracheal system it is required for terminal cell lumen formation.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable triglyceride lipase activity. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 8. Orthologous to human LIPK (lipase family member K); LIPM (lipase family member M); and LIPN (lipase family member N).

Name: gamma-Tubulin at 37C
Description: gamma-Tubulin at 37C (gammaTub37C) encodes a maternally expressed member of the tubulin family. It localizes predominantly to centrosomes and plays an essential role in microtubule nucleation at the centrosomes.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in amino acid transmembrane transport. Is expressed in adult abdomen and adult thorax. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in iminoglycinuria. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC36A1 (solute carrier family 36 member 1); SLC36A2 (solute carrier family 36 member 2); and SLC36A3 (solute carrier family 36 member 3).

Name: Rad9
Description: Rad9 (Rad9) encodes a protein that, together with the Rad1 and Hus1-like products, forms the 9-1-1 checkpoint protein complex. This complex plays a central role in the DNA damage-induced checkpoint response.

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG12003 (FBgn0035234). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3L:1565392..1567802. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed during late pupal stages.

Name: meng-po
Description: Serine/threonine-protein kinase involved in memory formation. Together with the cAMP-dependent protein kinase A Pka-C1, promotes long-term memory (LTM) by regulating CrebB stability and activity. Involved in the maintenance of anesthesia-sensitive memory (ASM) which includes short-term memory (STM) and middle-term memory (MTM). (UniProtKB:Q9VM90)

Name: mitochondrial translation elongation factor Tu 2
Description: mitochondrial translation elongation factor Tu 2 (mEFTu2) encodes a protein predicted to function within mitochondria to bring aminoacyl-tRNA to the ribosome during the elongation phase of mRNA translation. Unlike the protein encoded by mEFTu1, mEFTu2 product is enriched in the testis, suggesting a testis-specific role for this factor.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable methyltransferase activity. Is expressed in larval ventral nerve cord and organism. Orthologous to human METTL25B (methyltransferase like 25B).

Name: shifted
Description: shifted (shf) encodes a secreted protein that positively modulates Hedgehog signaling. It controls the diffusion of the lipid-modified protein encoded by hh by stabilizing its interaction with the heparan sulfate proteoglycans.

Name: forkhead domain 59A
Description: forkhead domain 59A (fd59A) encodes a transcription factor that is expressed largely in postmitotic neurons in the central nervous system. Its roles include nervous system development and egg-laying behavior.

Name: hebe
Description: Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic antennal sense organ; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; lateral cord neurons; midline ventral glial cell; and ventral midline of embryo.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity and pre-mRNA 3'-splice site binding activity. Involved in wound healing. Predicted to be part of U12-type spliceosomal complex and U2AF complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome. Orthologous to human ZRSR2P1 (ZRSR2 pseudogene 1) and ZRSR2 (zinc finger CCCH-type, RNA binding motif and serine/arginine rich 2).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable transcription coactivator activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be part of RNA polymerase II transcription regulator complex. Orthologous to human POU2AF1 (POU class 2 homeobox associating factor 1).

Name: pontin
Description: pontin (pont) encodes a member of the AAA+ (ATPases Associated with various cellular Activities) family. It is found in different complexes involved in transcriptional regulation, chromatin remodelling, DNA repair or ribonucleoprotein assembly, and participates in the control of cell proliferation and survival.

Name: Growth-blocking peptide 2
Description: Predicted to enable N-acetyltransferase activity and cytokine activity. Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Located in extracellular region. Is expressed in adult fat body; amnioserosa; embryonic/larval fat body; and yolk nucleus.

Name: Gustatory receptor 64a
Description: One of the few identified sugar gustatory receptors identified so far and which promotes the starvation-induced increase of feeding motivation. Required in combination with Gr64f to detect sucrose, maltose, and glucose. (UniProtKB:P83293)

Name: ste24c prenyl protease type I
Description: ste24c prenyl protease type I (ste24c) encodes a protein that, along with the products of ste24a and ste24b, are paralogous (tandemly duplicated) type I prenyl proteases. The product of ste24c plays an essential role in the male germline.

Name: lethal (2) 09851
Description: Predicted to be involved in ribosome biogenesis. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and gut section. Orthologous to human GRWD1 (glutamate rich WD repeat containing 1).

Name: Glutamate-gated chloride channel subunit alpha
Description: Glutamate-gated chloride channel subunit (PubMed:11095718, PubMed:8702744). Together with Gamma-aminobutyric acid receptor Rdl, plays an important role in the visual response by regulating the activity of ON/OFF-selective neurons (PubMed:31535971).  ACTIVITY REGULATION: Glutamate binding triggers a rapidly reversible current, while the anti-helmintic drug ivermectin triggers a permanently open channel configuration (PubMed:8702744, PubMed:11095718). Inhibited by picrotoxin (PubMed:31535971). (UniProtKB:Q94900)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable neuropeptide receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in peroxisome organization. Predicted to be located in peroxisome. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human TMEM135 (transmembrane protein 135).

Name: Adipokinetic hormone receptor
Description: Adipokinetic hormone receptor (AkhR) encodes a G protein-coupled receptor for the hormone encoded by Akh. It modulates both lipid and carbohydrate homeostasis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sodium-dependent organic anion transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium-dependent organic anion transport. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in intestinal disease. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC10A5 (solute carrier family 10 member 5).

Name: glass bottom boat
Description: glass bottom boat (gbb) encodes a BMP ligand in the TGF-beta/BMP family of dimeric signaling molecules. It binds to a receptor complex to transduce signal through phosphorylation of the product of Mad. It contributes to maintain stem cell populations, control cell fate specification, proliferation, synapse growth and neuropeptide release.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism.

Name: L-2-hydroxyglutarate dehydrogenase
Description: Predicted to enable (S)-2-hydroxy-acid oxidase activity and 2-hydroxyglutarate dehydrogenase activity. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in 2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria; L-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria; cerebellar ataxia; hereditary spastic paraplegia; and visual epilepsy. Orthologous to human L2HGDH (L-2-hydroxyglutarate dehydrogenase).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable GTP binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Predicted to be involved in microtubule cytoskeleton organization and mitotic cell cycle. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and microtubule. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Golgi pH Regulator
Description: Golgi pH Regulator (GPHR) encodes an anion channel that regulates Golgi luminal pH. It is expressed in both ER and Golgi apparatus and is necessary for proper function of the secretory pathway.

Name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B subunit gamma
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and translation initiation factor activity. Involved in cellular response to hypoxia. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B complex and guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in leukoencephalopathy with vanishing white matter. Orthologous to human EIF2B3 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B subunit gamma).

Name: Mothers against dpp
Description: Mothers against dpp (Mad) encodes the primary transcription factor that mediates cellular response to the BMP like ligands encoded by dpp, scw and gbb. Upon phosphorylation by either the products of sax or tkv (type I BMP receptors), it forms a complex with the product of Med and translocates to the nucleus where, together with cofactors, it regulates expression of BMP response target genes.

Name: Acid phosphatase 1
Description: Enables acid phosphatase activity and protein homodimerization activity. Involved in dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in extracellular exosome and nucleus. Is expressed in adult heart and germline cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amelogenesis imperfecta type 1J and prostate cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including ACP2 (acid phosphatase 2, lysosomal) and ACP4 (acid phosphatase 4).

Name: lethal (3) neo38
Description: lethal (3) neo38 (l(3)neo38) encodes an essential regulator of neuromuscular junction and brain development, required at post-embryonic stages.

Name: Sorting nexin 6
Description: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in phagosome-lysosome fusion involved in apoptotic cell clearance and retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi. Predicted to be located in endosome. Predicted to be part of retromer, tubulation complex. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; embryonic/larval garland cell; garland cell primordium; and organism. Orthologous to human SNX32 (sorting nexin 32); SNX5 (sorting nexin 5); and SNX6 (sorting nexin 6).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in peroxisome organization. Predicted to be located in peroxisome. Orthologous to human TMEM135 (transmembrane protein 135).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable carbohydrate binding activity. Predicted to be active in external side of plasma membrane. Is expressed in embryonic/larval tracheal system; labral sensory complex; larval foregut atrium; and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm; anterior endoderm anlage; embryonic/larval muscle system; extended germ band embryo; and visceral muscle primordium.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in peroxisome organization. Predicted to be located in peroxisome. Is expressed in adult head; embryonic/larval midgut; and gastric caecum. Orthologous to human TMEM135 (transmembrane protein 135).

Name: shutdown
Description: shutdown (shu) encodes an immunophilin cochaperone that collaborates with Hsp90 during piRNA biogenesis and is essential for normal function of germline stem cells.

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including blastoderm embryo; ectoderm anlage; extended germ band embryo; and inclusive hindgut primordium. Orthologous to human LRRC26 (leucine rich repeat containing 26) and LRRC52 (leucine rich repeat containing 52).

Name: N/A
Description: Located in nucleus. Is expressed in adult brain cell body rind; adult optic lobe; and organism. Orthologous to human C19orf47 (chromosome 19 open reading frame 47).

Name: Nuclear envelope integral membrane protein
Description: Contributes to nuclear envelope stiffness in germ cells (PubMed:32923640). Required for male and female fertility (PubMed:32923640). (UniProtKB:Q9VXD6)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable sodium-dependent organic anion transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium-dependent organic anion transport. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in intestinal disease. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC10A5 (solute carrier family 10 member 5).

Name: beta-Tubulin at 60D
Description: Tubulin is the major constituent of microtubules, a cylinder consisting of laterally associated linear protofilaments composed of alpha- and beta-tubulin heterodimers. Microtubules grow by the addition of GTP-tubulin dimers to the microtubule end, where a stabilizing cap forms. Below the cap, tubulin dimers are in GDP-bound state, owing to GTPase activity of alpha-tubulin. (UniProtKB:P08841)

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG31279 (FBgn0051279). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 3R:16430681..16432897. Its molecular function is described by: . It is involved in the biological process described with: . No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of no expression detected.  Peak expression observed in adult male stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in cytoskeleton organization. Is expressed in several structures, including larval foregut atrium; presumptive embryonic/larval system; and sensory nervous system primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in axial spondylometaphyseal dysplasia. Orthologous to human CFAP410 (cilia and flagella associated protein 410).

Name: Inwardly rectifying potassium channel 2
Description: Inwardly rectifying potassium channel 2 (Irk2) encodes a protein that is required in transepithelial fluid secretion and potassium transport in the Malpighian tubule. It contributes to wing patterning, through the regulation of release of the product of dpp.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Predicted to be part of tRNA-splicing ligase complex. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; embryonic brain; embryonic/larval midgut; and embryonic/larval nervous system. Orthologous to several human genes including FAM98A (family with sequence similarity 98 member A) and FAM98B (family with sequence similarity 98 member B).

Name: Cyclin-dependent kinase 8
Description: Component of the Mediator complex, a coactivator involved in regulated gene transcription of nearly all RNA polymerase II-dependent genes. Mediator functions as a bridge to convey information from gene-specific regulatory proteins to the basal RNA polymerase II transcription machinery. Mediator is recruited to promoters by direct interactions with regulatory proteins and serves as a scaffold for the assembly of a functional pre-initiation complex with RNA polymerase II and the general transcription factors. May phosphorylate the CTD (C-terminal domain) of the large subunit of RNA polymerase II (RNAp II), which may inhibit the formation of a transcription initiation complex. Required for leg and eye development and macrochaete specification or differentiation. (UniProtKB:Q9VT57)

Name: N/A
Description: Located in egg chorion.

Name: Diphthamide biosynthesis 1
Description: Predicted to enable 2-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)histidine synthase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-diphthamide biosynthetic process from peptidyl-histidine. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including anlage in statu nascendi; blastoderm embryo; extended germ band embryo; germ layer; and gut section. Orthologous to human DPH1 (diphthamide biosynthesis 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable glutathione oxidoreductase activity. Is expressed in presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 25. Orthologous to human GRXCR1 (glutaredoxin and cysteine rich domain containing 1).

Name: pummelig
Description: Enables carboxylic ester hydrolase activity and phospholipase activity. Involved in lipid storage. Located in lipid droplet; mitochondrion; and peroxisome. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic/larval fat body; embryonic/larval midgut primordium; embryonic/larval posterior spiracle; germ layer; and spermatozoon. Used to study obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 1; colon adenocarcinoma; and neutral lipid storage disease. Orthologous to several human genes including ABHD4 (abhydrolase domain containing 4, N-acyl phospholipase B).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable [methionine synthase] reductase activity. Predicted to be involved in methionine biosynthetic process. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including endocrine gland cancer (multiple); heart disease (multiple); hematologic cancer (multiple); homocystinuria; and homocystinuria-megaloblastic anemia cblE type. Orthologous to human MTRR (5-methyltetrahydrofolate-homocysteine methyltransferase reductase).

Name: Hexokinase C
Description: Hexokinase C (Hex-C) encodes a hexokinase involved in glucose homeostasis.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and rRNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial fusion and positive regulation of mitochondrial translation. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial membrane. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Williams-Beuren syndrome. Orthologous to human RCC1L (RCC1 like).

Name: Gustatory receptor 21a
Description: Gustatory receptor 21a (Gr21a) encodes a transmembrane domain protein unrelated to GPCRs. Together with the product Gr63a, it forms a heteromultimeric receptor for carbon dioxide, an important chemosensory cue for insects.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to be involved in G2/M transition of mitotic cell cycle; SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process; and regulation of cell cycle. Predicted to be part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase, mitochondrial
Description: Is responsible for the charging of tRNA(Phe) with phenylalanine in mitochondrial translation. (UniProtKB:O16129)

Name: Ubiquitin-like activating enzyme 4
Description: Ubiquitin-like activating enzyme 4 (Uba4) encodes a protein involved in molybdopterin cofactor synthesis and protein urmylation.

Name: Odorant receptor 83a
Description: Odorant receptor which mediates acceptance or avoidance behavior, depending on its substrates. The odorant receptor repertoire encodes a large collection of odor stimuli that vary widely in identity, intensity, and duration. May form a complex with Orco to form odorant-sensing units, providing sensitive and prolonged odorant signaling and calcium permeability. Involved in the behavioral responses to pentanol, ethyl acetate, and propyl acetate. (UniProtKB:Q9VNB3)

Name: yellow-b
Description: yellow-b (yellow-b) is a member of the multifunctional yellow family of genes that encodes a protein involved in color pattering, eggshell integrity and mating behavior.

Name: Sarcoglycan alpha
Description: Predicted to be a structural constituent of muscle. Predicted to be part of sarcoglycan complex. Is expressed in dorsal sensory complex proper primordium; embryonic/larval gut; embryonic/larval muscle cell; embryonic/larval nervous system; and presumptive embryonic/larval system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2D; muscular dystrophy; and myoclonic dystonia 11. Orthologous to human SGCA (sarcoglycan alpha) and SGCE (sarcoglycan epsilon).

Name: N/A
Description: Orthologous to human SAMD5 (sterile alpha motif domain containing 5).

Name: N/A
Description: Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human FKBP15 (FKBP prolyl isomerase family member 15).

Name: N/A
Description: This gene is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\CG3548 (FBgn0035033). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. Gene sequence location is 2R:24599947..24602367. Its molecular function is unknown. The biological processes in which it is involved are not known. No alleles are reported. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderately high expression to a trough of low expression.  Peak expression observed within 00-18 hour embryonic stages, during early pupal stages, in adult female stages.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable phosphoric diester hydrolase activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid metabolic process. Orthologous to human PLCXD1 (phosphatidylinositol specific phospholipase C X domain containing 1).

Name: Phosphorylated adaptor for RNA export
Description: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in snRNA export from nucleus. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human PHAX (phosphorylated adaptor for RNA export).

Name: vestigial
Description: vestigial (vg) encodes a wing/haltere identity selector gene. It functions as a transcriptional activator when bound to the product of sd to direct wing specific gene expression and regulate cell proliferation. It also has a role in muscle specification.

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable metallocarboxypeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteolysis. Located in vesicle. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior endoderm anlage; ectoderm; ectoderm anlage; embryonic/larval crystal cell; and extended germ band embryo. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in chronic kidney disease. Orthologous to several human genes including CPA5 (carboxypeptidase A5).

Name: Multiple inositol polyphosphate phosphatase 2
Description: Predicted to enable acid phosphatase activity; bisphosphoglycerate 3-phosphatase activity; and inositol phosphate phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in dephosphorylation. Predicted to be located in extracellular exosome. Predicted to be part of TORC1 complex. Is expressed in adult head. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 16 and thyroid gland papillary carcinoma. Orthologous to human MINPP1 (multiple inositol-polyphosphate phosphatase 1).

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity. Predicted to be involved in peptidyl-proline hydroxylation to 4-hydroxy-L-proline. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in adult head.

Name: fuseless
Description: fuseless (fusl) encodes a protein involved in the clustering of voltage-gated calcium channels and the exocytosis of calcium-dependent synaptic vesicles.

Name: yellow-f2
Description: Tautomerization of L-dopachrome with decarboxylation to give 5,6-dihydroxyindole (DHI). Also catalyzes the tautomerization of the methyl ester of L-dopachrome and dopamine chrome. May play a role in melanization reactions during late pupal and adult stages. (UniProtKB:Q9VG08)

Name: Imaginal disc growth factor 6
Description: Imaginal disc growth factor 6 (Idgf6) is one of six genes in the IDGF family, which evolved from chitinases that lost their enzymatic activity. Idgf6 encodes a secreted protein that is highly expressed in larval fat body and adult head. Idgf6 product is involved in molting and egg chamber tube morphogenesis.

Name: temperature-induced paralytic E
Description: Enhances para sodium channel function. Required during pupal development to rescue adult paralysis and also protects adult flies against heat-induced lethality. (UniProtKB:P48613)

Name: N/A
Description: Predicted to enable protein-cysteine S-palmitoyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein palmitoylation. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult central nervous system; adult head; embryonic/larval brain; and organism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 91. Orthologous to several human genes including ZDHHC2 (zinc finger DHHC-type palmitoyltransferase 2) and ZDHHC20 (zinc finger DHHC-type palmitoyltransferase 20).

Name: N/A
Description: DNA binding protein which is involved in the positive regulation of both basal and inducible transcription (PubMed:33456983). Mainly localizes to active promoter sites and interacts with components of various transcription and replication regulatory complexes, such as the ORC, SAGA, THO, TFIID and SWI/SNF complexes (PubMed:30713769, PubMed:33456983). It may therefore regulate transcription by promoting the association of these complexes to their binding sites (PubMed:30713769, PubMed:33456983). (UniProtKB:Q9W1V7)

Name: Gustatory receptor 28a

Atypical expression suggests also nongustatory roles in the nervous system and tissues involved in proprioception, hygroreception, and other sensory modalities. Name: Serpin 77Ba
Description: Serpin 77Ba (Spn77Ba) encodes a serine protease inhibitor of the serpin family. It functions in the trachea in a protease cascade required for melanization, a host defense reaction against microbial pathogens.

Name: DNA fragmentation factor-related protein 4
Description: DNA fragmentation factor-related protein 4 (Drep4) encodes a CIDE domain containing protein that can interact with the proteins encoded by Drep3 and Drep1 via CIDE-CIDE interaction. It is the ortholog of human DFFB, which has a nuclease activity. The Drep4 product might function in apoptotic DNA fragmentation.

Predicted to be involved in biosynthetic process and kynurenine metabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Name: Lipid storage droplet-1
Description: Lipid storage droplet-1 (Lsd-1) encodes a protein associated with lipid droplets. It protects lipid droplets from lipase mediated remobilization and facilitates lipolysis by serving as an anchoring point for lipases such as the one encoded by Hsl. It is involved in lipid storage amount regulation and energy homeostasis in concert with the product of Lsd-2.

Name: eukaryotic translation elongation factor 1 gamma
Description: eukaryotic translation elongation factor 1 gamma (eEF1gamma) encodes a protein that associates with other EF1 subunits (alpha/beta/delta). It regulates organelle movement along microtubules. It binds tubulin and the protein kinase encoded by Doa, which in turns phosphorylates the product of eEF1gamma.

Name: Saccheropin dehydrogenase 2
Description: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity. Predicted to be involved in glycolipid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in lipid droplet. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to human SCCPDH (saccharopine dehydrogenase (putative)).

Name: DNA polymerase delta subunit 3
Description: DNA polymerase delta subunit 3 (PolD3) encodes a non-essential subunit of the multi-subunit DNA polymerases delta and zeta. It has roles during embryonic DNA replication and promotes several types of DNA repair, including homologous recombination repair of double-strand breaks.

Name: pickpocket 17
Description: Predicted to enable ligand-gated sodium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in sodium ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane.

Orthologous to human CHST10 (carbohydrate sulfotransferase 10) and CHST8 (carbohydrate sulfotransferase 8).

Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in organism.

Name: Ornithine aminotransferase precursor
Description: Predicted to enable identical protein binding activity; ornithine-oxo-acid transaminase activity; and pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in arginine catabolic process to glutamate; arginine catabolic process to proline via ornithine; and ornithine metabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; amnioserosa; embryonic/larval fat body; and yolk nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gyrate atrophy. Orthologous to human OAT (ornithine aminotransferase).

Name: Secreted Wg-interacting molecule
Description: Secreted Wg-interacting molecule (Swim) encodes a secreted protein that binds to the product of wg and may function in its spreading.

Name: virus-induced RNA 1
Description: virus-induced RNA 1 (vir-1) is produced from a promoter that is induced by viral infection. It can be used as a marker of the induction of an antiviral response. Its expression is regulated by the Jak/STAT pathway.

Name: Glutamate oxaloacetate transaminase 2
Description: Glutamate oxaloacetate transaminase 2 (Got2) encodes an L-aspartate:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase involved in glutamate biosynthesis, which in turn regulates postsynaptic receptor field size.

Name: DNA polymerase delta subunit 2
Description: Accessory component of both the DNA polymerase delta complex and possibly the DNA polymerase zeta complex (By similarity). As a component of the delta complex, participates in high fidelity genome replication, including lagging strand synthesis, DNA recombination and repair (By similarity). Appears to promote the function of the DNA pol-delta complex accessory subunit PolD3 in both embryonic and postembryonic somatic cells (PubMed:31100062). (UniProtKB:Q9W088)

Name: Polymerase (DNA-directed), delta interacting protein 2
Description: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in error-free translesion synthesis. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial nucleoid and nucleus. Is expressed in adult head; adult heart; and embryonic/larval midgut. Orthologous to human POLDIP2 (DNA polymerase delta interacting protein 2).

Name: Pyrokinin 1 receptor
Description: Pyrokinin 1 receptor (PK1-R) encodes a seven transmembrane G-protein coupled receptor. It is thought to be a receptor for the neuropeptides encoded by Capa and Lst. It regulates the production and release of insulin.

Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic central brain neurons; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and photoreceptor. Name: rau
Description: rau (rau) encodes a protein that sustains RTK signaling downstream of the product of htl or Egfr. This effect is mediated by the two Ras association (RA) domains that together show a binding preference for GTP-loaded Ras. rau depletion produces a rough eye phenotype and reduced differentiation of retinal wrapping glia.

Name: Chromatin assembly factor 1, p55 subunit
Description: Chromatin assembly factor 1, p55 subunit (Caf1-55) encodes a subunit of the MuvB core complex. The MuvB core binds to the oncoprotein encoded by Myb and the Rbf-E2f2-Dp tumor suppressor complex, thereby controlling the expression of many genes, including critical regulators of the cell cycle.

Name: Tryptophanyl-tRNA synthetase
Description: Tryptophanyl-tRNA synthetase (TrpRS) is expressed to high levels in the salivary gland. This could be incidental due to proximity to the salivary gland transcription factor encoded by sage.

Name: Oddjob
Description: Enables DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in heterochromatin. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic brain; embryonic/larval nervous system; and extended germ band embryo.

Name: Z band alternatively spliced PDZ-motif protein 66
Description: Z band alternatively spliced PDZ-motif protein 66 (Zasp66) encodes a scaffold protein that binds the product of Actn and localizes to Z-discs in muscle cells. It plays a role in muscle development, especially in myofibril assembly.

Name: yellow-f
Description: Tautomerization of L-dopachrome with decarboxylation to give 5,6-dihydroxyindole (DHI). Also catalyzes the tautomerization of the methyl ester of L-dopachrome and dopamine chrome. May play a role in melanization reactions during late pupal and adult stages. May play a role in melanization reactions during larval and early pupal stages. (UniProtKB:Q9VG09)

Name: PAICS bifunctional enzyme
Description: PAICS bifunctional enzyme (Paics) encodes an essential enzyme in the pathway for de novo synthesis of the purine nucleotide inosine monophosphate (IMP). IMP is the precursor for purine nucleotides required for nucleic acids, energy transfer, cell signaling, and coenzymes.

Orthologous to several human genes including CPA5 (carboxypeptidase A5).

Name: Transcription factor IIEalpha
Description: Transcription factor IIEalpha (TfIIEalpha) encodes the large subunit of the RNA polymerase II general transcription factor TFIIE. The products of TfIIEalpha and TfIIEbeta are essential for transcription initiation in vitro acting with RNA polymerase II and the other general transcription factors.

Description: Flavin-containing monooxygenase 2 (Fmo-2) encodes a monooxygenase involved in oxidation-reduction metabolism.

Name: RNA-binding protein 4
Description: RNA-binding protein 4 (Rbp4) encodes a protein that mediates the translational repression of CycB during meiosis in males.

Description: Predicted to be involved in Ras protein signal transduction. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is extrinsic component of membrane. Is expressed in organism. Orthologous to human LRR1 (leucine rich repeat protein 1).

Description: tiny tim 50 (ttm50) encodes a mitochondrial inner membrane protein that is involved in mitochondrial protein translocation and maintenance of mitochondrial membrane potential. It plays active roles in regulating metabolic levels for modulation of growth in development.

Name: Something about silencing 10
Description: Something about silencing 10 (Sas10) encodes a protein belonging to the SAS10 family. It might be a substrate of the RNA deaminase encoded by Adar, which shows an adenosine to inosine (A-to-I) deaminase activity in pre-mRNA transcripts. The noncoding strand of the adjacent gene, Rnp4F, reads through to form a duplex with Sas10 transcripts at their 3'-end to target both transcripts for promiscuous A-to-I editing and degradation.

Name: Regulatory particle triple-A ATPase 5
Description: Regulatory particle triple-A ATPase 5 (Rpt5) encodes a component of the 26S proteasome, which degrades polyubiquitinated proteins in the cytoplasm and nucleus.

Name: Translocation protein 1
Description: Predicted to enable protein transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in post-translational protein targeting to membrane, translocation. Located in endomembrane system. Is expressed in several structures, including adult head; adult heart; presumptive embryonic salivary gland; and reproductive system. Orthologous to human SEC62 (SEC62 homolog, preprotein translocation factor).

Predicted to be part of septin complex. Predicted to be active in cell division site; cytoskeleton; and synaptic vesicle. Is expressed in several structures, including dopaminergic neurons; embryonic dorsal vessel; embryonic/larval nervous system; extended germ band embryo; and presumptive embryonic/larval central nervous system. Orthologous to several human genes including SEPTIN4 (septin 4) and SEPTIN5 (septin 5).

Name: tRNA-guanine transglycosylase
Description: Catalytic subunit of the queuine tRNA-ribosyltransferase (TGT) that catalyzes the base-exchange of a guanine (G) residue with queuine (Q) at position 34 (anticodon wobble position) in tRNAs with GU(N) anticodons (tRNA-Asp, -Asn, -His and -Tyr), resulting in the hypermodified nucleoside queuosine (7-(((4, 5-cis-dihydroxy-2-cyclopenten-1-yl)amino)methyl)-7-deazaguanosine). Catalysis occurs through a double-displacement mechanism. The nucleophile active site attacks the C1' of nucleotide 34 to detach the guanine base from the RNA, forming a covalent enzyme-RNA intermediate. The proton acceptor active site deprotonates the incoming queuine, allowing a nucleophilic attack on the C1' of the ribose to form the product. (UniProtKB:Q9VPY8)

Name: Serpin 88Ea
Description: Serine protease inhibitor with activity toward trypsin (PubMed:18956323). Negatively regulates the Toll signaling pathway and suppresses the expression of the antifungal peptide drosomycin (PubMed:19581577). Its negative regulation of the Toll signaling pathway also results in the inhibition of the melanization immune response via the phenoloxidase (PPO1) cascade (PubMed:19581577). Essential for unfolding and expansion of the wings after emergence from the pupal case (PubMed:18956323). May regulate the Toll pathway by blocking the proteolysis of the Toll ligand spz (PubMed:19581577). (UniProtKB:Q9VFC2)

Name: Gustatory receptor 43a
Description: Gustatory receptor which mediates acceptance or avoidance behavior, depending on its substrates. Gr43a is the main sugar receptor in larvae. Functions as a narrowly tuned fructose receptor in taste neurons but also as a fructose receptor in the brain. Necessary and sufficient to sense hemolymph fructose and promote feeding in hungry flies but suppress feeding in satiated flies. (UniProtKB:Q9V4K2)

Name: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class U
Description: Phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class U (PIG-U) encodes a subunit of glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI) transamidase, which mediates GPI anchoring in the endoplasmic reticulum. GPI anchor attachment serves as a general mechanism for linking proteins to the cell surface membrane.

Name: Adaptor Protein complex 1, mu subunit
Description: Adaptor Protein complex 1, mu subunit (AP-1mu) encodes a clathrin adaptor involved in intracellular transport. It controls the trafficking of proteins, including the products of N and spdo.

Description: twine (twe) encodes a putative tyrosine phosphatase. It regulates the meiotic cell cycle and contributes to spermatogenesis.

Description: Histamine-gated chloride channel subunit 1 (HisCl1) encodes an ion transmembrane transport complex subunit that contributes to thermotaxis and chloride transport.

Name: Flap endonuclease 1

It enters the flap from the 5'-end and then tracks to cleave the flap base, leaving a nick for ligation. Also involved in the long patch base excision repair (LP-BER) pathway, by cleaving within the apurinic/apyrimidinic (AP) site-terminated flap. Acts as a genome stabilization factor that prevents flaps from equilibrating into structures that lead to duplications and deletions. Name: cGAS-like receptor 1
Description: Nucleotidyltransferase that catalyzes the formation of cyclic GMP-AMP (3',2'-cGAMP) from ATP and GTP and plays a key role in antiviral innate immunity (PubMed:34261127, PubMed:34261128). Acts as a key sensor of double-stranded RNA (dsRNA), the presence of dsRNA in the cytoplasm being a danger signal that triggers the immune responses (PubMed:34261127). Directly binds dsRNA, activating the nucleotidyltransferase activity, leading to synthesis of 3',2'-cGAMP, a second messenger that binds to and activates Sting, thereby triggering the antiviral immune response via activation of the NF-kappa-B transcription factor Rel (Relish) (PubMed:34261127, PubMed:34261128). 3',2'-cGAMP is protected from poxin cleavage (PubMed:34261127). (UniProtKB:A1ZA55)

The protein complex hth-exd are Hox cofactors but also have additional Hox-independent functions such as in antennal development, proximal appendages patterning, and cell division promotion of the undifferentiated eye field.

Name: Actin 79B
Description: Actins are highly conserved proteins that are involved in various types of cell motility and are ubiquitously expressed in all eukaryotic cells. Multiple isoforms are involved in various cellular functions such as cytoskeleton structure, cell mobility, chromosome movement and muscle contraction. (UniProtKB:P02574)

Name: even skipped

It represses pair-rule and segment polarity genes, contributing to anterior/posterior axis specification and mesoderm and central nervous system development.

Description: Actin 57B (Act57B) is one of several actin genes in the Drosophila genome, and one of the few that encode myofibrillar actin. This essential gene is a transcriptional target of Mef2 and Cf2 and is expressed in all embryonic muscles and a subset of adult muscle.

Name: High mobility group protein 2

These proteins associate with with chromatin and are ubiquitously distributed in the nucleus of eukaryotic cells. The product of Hmg-2 binds to DNA in a non-sequence specific fashion to induce structural changes in DNA that include bending and unwinding that in turn, promote DNA flexibility.

Description: Innexin 2 (Inx2) encodes a gap junction protein that can form heteromeric gap junction channels via interaction with the products of ogre or Inx3. It contributes to epithelial organization and polarity of the embryonic epidermis, regulation of morphogen-dependent organ size and stem cell behavior.

It functions in the Wingless/Wnt pathway where it promotes the interaction of the products of arm and pan, and the recruitment of the product of arm to chromatin. The product of ebd2 functions in a context-specific manner and is important for the development of indirect flight muscles.

Description: aquarius (aqrs) encodes a predicted serine protease produced by the male accessory glands and transferred to females during mating. It is required for the binding of the product of SP to sperm and for the transfer of the products of lectin-46Ca and lectin-46Cb to females during mating.

Description: p38a MAP kinase (p38a) encodes a member of the mitogen-activated protein kinases responsive to diverse stresses. In immune response, it activates its downstream component encoded by Atf-2 that in turn regulates Duox expression.

Description: Predicted to enable (S)-2-hydroxy-acid oxidase activity. Predicted to be located in peroxisome. Is expressed in adult head and adult heart. Orthologous to several human genes including HAO1 (hydroxyacid oxidase 1).

Description: Predicted to enable zinc ion transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in zinc ion transmembrane transport. Located in basolateral plasma membrane. Is expressed in adult head and organism. Orthologous to human SLC39A1 (solute carrier family 39 member 1).

Name: Deoxyribonuclease II
Description: Deoxyribonuclease II (DNaseII) encodes an ubiquitous endonuclease that hydrolyzes DNA without sequence specificity, generating nucleotides with 3'-phosphate. It is localized in lysosomes, and essential for degrading nuclear DNA of the engulfed apoptotic cells. DNase II is also responsible to digest mitochondrial DNA during autophagy.

Name: Transcription factor IIA L
Description: Transcription factor IIA L (TfIIA-L) encodes a precursor protein that, after proteolysis, produces the two larger subunits of TFIIA. TFIIA is a general transcription factor that is required for initiation by RNA polymerase II and is a component of the pre-initiation complex.

Description: Is expressed in several structures, including larval foregut atrium and presumptive embryonic/larval system.

Name: red Malpighian tubules
Description: Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic Malpighian tubule; embryonic/larval midgut; and germ layer derivative. Orthologous to human LYSMD1 (LysM domain containing 1) and LYSMD2 (LysM domain containing 2).

Name: Zinc transporter 86D

Description: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter (MCU) encodes an inner mitochondrial membrane channel that transports calcium from the mitochondrial intermembrane space to the matrix. Name: Forkhead box L1
Description: Forkhead box L1 (FoxL1) encodes a transcription factor that is expressed in ventral intersegmental muscle 5 and in the hindgut. FoxL1 product contributes to salivary gland morphology and the migration of tissues that migrate in close proximity to the FoxL1-expressing cells, such as hemocytes, germ cells and Malpighian tubules.

Name: Taspase 1
Description: Taspase 1 (Tasp1) encodes a threonine-type endopeptidase involved in spermatogenesis and the defense response to Gram-negative bacteria.

Name: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein at 98DE
Description: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein at 98DE (Hrb98DE) encodes a nuclear RNA-binding protein. It controls hnRNA stability, splicing, IRES-dependent translation, and translational repression. It represents one of the main targets of the poly(ADP-ribosyl)ation pathway. It also regulates tissue polarity patterning and germ-line stem cell fate.

Description: lemming B (lmgB) encodes  is part of the dicistronic lemming locus with two open reading frames (ORFs): lmgA (upstream ORF) and lmgB (downstream ORF). Name: Myofilin
Description: Myofilin (Mf) encodes a structural protein of muscular thick filaments, which may be needed for filament assembly. Alternative splicing of the gene, controlled by the product of salm, produces isoforms of varying size in thoracic muscles.

Name: Mitochondrial morphology and cristae structure 1
Description: Mitochondrial morphology and cristae structure 1 (Mics1) encodes an inner mitochondrial membrane protein. It interacts with the protein encoded by Chchd2 and enhances oxidative phosphorylation. By orthology, it is predicted to play a role in the maintenance of mitochondrial morphology and the negative regulation of apoptotic cytochrome c release.

Name: Ribosomal protein S27A
Description: Ubiquitin exists either covalently attached to another protein, or free (unanchored). Ubiquitin is usually conjugated to Lys residues of target proteins, however, in rare cases, conjugation to Cys or Ser residues has been observed. When polyubiquitin is free (unanchored-polyubiquitin), it also has distinct roles, such as in activation of protein kinases, and in signaling (By similarity). Name: Cytochrome c oxidase subunit 7A
Description: Component of the cytochrome c oxidase, the last enzyme in the mitochondrial electron transport chain which drives oxidative phosphorylation. The respiratory chain contains 3 multisubunit complexes succinate dehydrogenase (complex II, CII), ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase (cytochrome b-c1 complex, complex III, CIII) and cytochrome c oxidase (complex IV, CIV), that cooperate to transfer electrons derived from NADH and succinate to molecular oxygen, creating an electrochemical gradient over the inner membrane that drives transmembrane transport and the ATP synthase. Cytochrome c oxidase is the component of the respiratory chain that catalyzes the reduction of oxygen to water. Electrons originating from reduced cytochrome c in the intermembrane space (IMS) are transferred via the dinuclear copper A center (CU(A)) of subunit 2 and heme A of subunit 1 to the active site in subunit 1, a binuclear center (BNC) formed by heme A3 and copper B (CU(B)). The BNC reduces molecular oxygen to 2 water molecules using 4 electrons from cytochrome c in the IMS and 4 protons from the mitochondrial matrix. (UniProtKB:Q9VHS2)

Name: oxen
Description: Component of the ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase, a multisubunit transmembrane complex that is part of the mitochondrial electron transport chain which drives oxidative phosphorylation. The respiratory chain contains 3 multisubunit complexes succinate dehydrogenase (complex II, CII), ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase (cytochrome b-c1 complex, complex III, CIII) and cytochrome c oxidase (complex IV, CIV), that cooperate to transfer electrons derived from NADH and succinate to molecular oxygen, creating an electrochemical gradient over the inner membrane that drives transmembrane transport and the ATP synthase. The cytochrome b-c1 complex catalyzes electron transfer from ubiquinol to cytochrome c, linking this redox reaction to translocation of protons across the mitochondrial inner membrane, with protons being carried across the membrane as hydrogens on the quinol. In the process called Q cycle, 2 protons are consumed from the matrix, 4 protons are released into the intermembrane space and 2 electrons are passed to cytochrome c. (UniProtKB:Q9XY35)
